papers.title: Nonequilibrium thermodynamics of feedback-control: a phase-space perspective
papers.abstract: Maxwell demons can convert knowledge into thermodynamic advantage by using measurement-acquired information. However, standard formulations of this problem assume that the demon has access to the system's entire phase space, an assumption that fails in many practical applications. Here, I address this problem by deriving fluctuation relations for general feedback-controlled systems, including such singular cases. The central quantity is a generalized notion of unavailable information: a portion of the acquired information that cannot be used to extract useful work. Finally, a Szilard engine with finite resolution illustrates these results. In the high-resolution limit, the information acquired by the demon may diverge, yet the extractable work remains finite. This work shows that this occurs because an equally divergent amount of information becomes unavailable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：fluctuation relations、generalized notion、theoretical framework。；研究对象：反馈控制系统的非平衡热力学，具体以麦克斯韦妖和Szilard发动机为模型系统，研究有限测量分辨率下信息与功的转化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限分辨率下，测量获取的信息中有一部分无法用于提取有用功，称为“不可用信息”；当分辨率趋于无穷时，获取的信息量发散，但可提取功保持有限，原因是不可用信息也以同样方式发散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限分辨率下，测量获取的信息中有一部分无法用于提取有用功，称为“不可用信息”；当分辨率趋于无穷时，获取的信息量发散，但可提取功保持有限，原因是不可用信息也以同样方式发散。；创新点：突破了传统麦克斯韦妖理论中“恶魔可访问系统整个相空间”的理想化假设，建立了适用于奇异情况（如有限分辨率）的反馈控制热力学框架，并揭示了信息发散而功有限的物理根源。
papers.method_zh: 从相空间视角推导一般反馈控制系统的涨落关系，引入广义的“不可用信息”概念，并通过有限分辨率的Szilard发动机模型进行解析说明。

papers.title: A Dynamical Phase-Field Model for the Optical Properties of Ferroelectrics
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric materials are promising platforms for controllable photonic devices because of the strong coupling between their spontaneous polarization and optical properties. Yet, these materials remain challenging to design because of the close connection between the ferroelectric domain structure and optical response, which no existing theoretical approach can capture. Here, we develop a dynamical phase-field model that directly couples the ferroelectric order to the local optical response by introducing an electronic polarization field. This approach enables the prediction of the spatially resolved temperature- and wavelength-dependent optical properties in complex ferroelectric microstructures. Applying this method to BaTiO3 thin films, we investigate the evolution of the local refractive index and electro-optic response under varying electric fields and temperatures. We show that the ferroelectric domain structure strongly modifies the local electro-optic response, exceeding 4000 pm/V near domain walls, several times larger than the bulk single crystal value (r_51=1300 pm/V). Our simulations quantitatively reproduce the electro-optic coefficient measured in BaTiO3 on silicon films and capture the temperature-dependent behavior across multiple ferroelectric phase transitions, revealing the role of phase competition and coexistence in determining the electro-optic response. More broadly, this work establishes a general approach for predicting light-matter interactions in complex ferroelectric microstructures, enabling the computational design of ferroelectric materials for photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：dynamical phase-field model、simulations、predicting）；研究对象：铁电材料的光学性质，具体以BaTiO₃薄膜为研究对象，聚焦铁电畴结构对光学响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁电畴壁附近的局域电光响应可超过4000 pm/V，远高于块体单晶的r_51=1300 pm/V；相竞争与共存对电光响应起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁电畴壁附近的局域电光响应可超过4000 pm/V，远高于块体单晶的r_51=1300 pm/V；相竞争与共存对电光响应起关键作用。；创新点：首次建立了能够同时捕捉铁电畴结构与光学响应之间紧密耦合的理论框架，填补了现有方法无法描述该关联的空白。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种动力学相场模型，通过引入电子极化场将铁电序参量与局域光学响应直接耦合，实现空间分辨的、依赖温度和波长的光学性质预测。

papers.title: Atomistic mechanism of corrosion-induced grain boundary migration in NiCr alloys in molten FLiNaK
papers.abstract: Corrosion of Ni-Cr structural alloys in molten fluoride salts is a persistent material degradation problem, yet the atomistic role of grain boundaries in this process remains poorly understood. Here we use reactive molecular dynamics to investigate corrosion of NiCr alloys in molten FLiNaK across four representative grain boundaries ($\Sigma3(111)$, $\Sigma11(113)$, $\Sigma5(012)$, and $\Sigma5(013)$) and corresponding bulk surfaces. Surface crystallography controls the initial dissolution stage, while grain boundary character governs the spatial localization and longer-time evolution of corrosion. We further identify a corrosion-driven grain boundary migration mechanism in which fluorine localization, preferential chromium dissolution, and vacancy-mediated mobility together drive interfacial motion away from the dealloyed region. The coherent $\Sigma3(111)$ boundary suppresses these processes, indicating low-energy special boundaries as targets for grain boundary engineering of corrosion-resistant Ni-Cr alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：reactive molecular dynamics（反应分子动力学）。；研究对象：NiCr合金在熔融FLiNaK（氟化锂-氟化钠-氟化钾）盐中的腐蚀行为，特别是晶界在腐蚀过程中的原子尺度作用机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了腐蚀驱动的晶界迁移机制：氟的局域化、铬的选择性溶解和空位介导的迁移共同推动晶界远离脱合金区域；低能共格Σ3(111)晶界能抑制该过程，为耐腐蚀NiCr合金的晶界工程提供了靶向目标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了腐蚀驱动的晶界迁移机制：氟的局域化、铬的选择性溶解和空位介导的迁移共同推动晶界远离脱合金区域；低能共格Σ3(111)晶界能抑制该过程，为耐腐蚀NiCr合金的晶界工程提供了靶向目标。；创新点：首次在原子尺度揭示了晶界特征（而非仅表面晶体学）如何控制腐蚀的空间局域化和长期演化，并识别出腐蚀驱动的晶界迁移这一新机制。摘要未突出说明与以往实验或理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 反应分子动力学（reactive molecular dynamics）模拟，研究了四种代表性晶界（Σ3(111)、Σ11(113)、Σ5(012)、Σ5(013)）及对应的体表面。

papers.title: Quantum Fisher information of magnetic quantum phase transition on Kondo lattice
papers.abstract: Strange metals exemplify highly collective quantum many-body systems that call for new means of characterization, and there is considerable potential for quantum information approaches contributing to the cause. We investigate multipartite entanglement across the quantum phase transition of a Kondo lattice model using the quantum Fisher information (QFI). We show that the QFI associated with the spin components transverse to the order parameter characterizes the destruction of heavy quasiparticles in the Kondo-destroyed magnetic-ordered phase. The physical origin of this observation is elucidated through an analysis of the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model. We propose to test the results in terms of both unpolarized and polarized inelastic neutron scattering measurements in the ordered part of the heavy fermion phase diagram. Our findings illustrate how different operators of a many-body system can be employed to not only witness multipartite entanglement in different sectors and but also elucidate the overall physics across different parts of the phase diagram.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate”“show”“elucidate”等理论分析词汇，未涉及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：Kondo 晶格模型中的磁量子相变，具体关注重费米子体系中的奇异金属相与多体纠缠特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 与序参量横向的自旋分量相关的量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）能够表征 Kondo 破坏磁有序相中重准粒子的破坏过程，并通过反铁磁海森堡模型分析揭示了其物理起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：与序参量横向的自旋分量相关的量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）能够表征 Kondo 破坏磁有序相中重准粒子的破坏过程，并通过反铁磁海森堡模型分析揭示了其物理起源。；创新点：展示了如何利用多体系统中不同算符不仅在不同扇区中见证多体纠缠，还能阐明相图不同部分的整体物理行为。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）用于多体纠缠的探测；结合反铁磁海森堡模型进行物理机制阐释；提出利用非极化和极化非弹性中子散射实验进行验证。

papers.title: Excitonic structure in CsPbBr$_3$ nanocubes, nanorods and nanoplatelets: the effect of dimensionality
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study comparing the excitonic ground state properties of CsPbBr$_3$ nanocrystals with different dimensionality: nanorods (1D), nanoplatelets (2D) and nanocubes (3D). All three systems are described on equal footing, by means of a general variational effective mass model, which captures the influence of quantum confinement, dielectric confinement, electron-hole correlations and polaronic effects (within a Haken model). The strongly confined directions squeeze the exciton (X) wavefunction and enhance Coulomb attractions along the weakly confined directions. This stimulates superradiance, thus making radiative recombination rates speed up from cubes to platelets and to rods, in line with recent experiments. The anisotropic local field factor is a secondary, yet non-negligible, mechanism further enhancing radiative rates. X binding energies are also determined primarily by the directions of strong confinenement, which is also consistent with experiments. Weakly confined directions become however influential for small aspect ratios. Dielectric confinement plays a major role in determining the binding energies, and less so in the interparticle-distances. For all dimensionalities, the biexciton (XX) geometry is that of a distorted tetrahedron, rather than squared or linear distributions that would result in Coulomb-governed 2D and 1D structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical study、variational effective mass model、Haken model）；研究对象：CsPbBr₃纳米晶体的激子基态性质，具体包括纳米立方体（3D）、纳米棒（1D）和纳米片（2D）三种不同维度体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强量子限域方向会压缩激子波函数并增强弱限域方向的库仑吸引，从而加速辐射复合速率（从立方体到纳米片再到纳米棒依次加快）；双激子几何构型在所有维度下均为扭曲四面体，而非由库仑作用主导的二维或一维结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强量子限域方向会压缩激子波函数并增强弱限域方向的库仑吸引，从而加速辐射复合速率（从立方体到纳米片再到纳米棒依次加快）；双激子几何构型在所有维度下均为扭曲四面体，而非由库仑作用主导的二维或一维结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用统一的变分有效质量模型，同时考虑量子限域、介电限域、电子-空穴关联以及Haken模型中的极化子效应。

papers.title: Subgrain-resolved Analysis of Degradation in Cu Metallization via Scanning 3DXRD and Thermomechanical Modeling
papers.abstract: Metallization layers play a key role in the performance and reliability of modern power semiconductor devices. During short-circuit events, rapid heating of power metallization layers induces thermomechanical incompatibility stresses, which may contribute to material degradation and impact device performance. In this work, potential degradation hotspots associated with thermomechanical loading in Cu power metallization are investigated using a combined experimental--computational approach. Scanning three-dimensional X-ray diffraction measurements are coupled with thermomechanical crystal plasticity simulations to probe the evolution of grain-resolved plastic deformation during rapid cyclic loading. This integrated approach provides insight into the microstructural processes governing degradation hotspot formation, laying the groundwork for future microstructure-informed, physics-based reliability assessment of Cu metallization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：combined experimental–computational approach、scanning three-dimensional X-ray diffraction measurements、thermomechanical crystal plasticity simulations。；研究对象：铜（Cu）功率金属化层在快速循环热机械加载下的降解行为，特别是与晶粒尺度塑性变形相关的降解热点形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合扫描三维X射线衍射与热机械晶体塑性模拟，揭示了晶粒分辨的塑性演化过程，识别了热机械加载下Cu金属化层中降解热点的微观结构机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合扫描三维X射线衍射与热机械晶体塑性模拟，揭示了晶粒分辨的塑性演化过程，识别了热机械加载下Cu金属化层中降解热点的微观结构机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扫描三维X射线衍射（scanning 3DXRD）测量晶粒尺度变形；计算上采用热机械晶体塑性模拟（thermomechanical crystal plasticity simulations）进行耦合分析。

papers.title: Emergent Interfacial Magnetism in Epitaxial RuO$_2$
papers.abstract: The magnetic ground state of the altermagnet candidate RuO$_2$ remains controversial, with magnetic signatures observed mainly in epitaxial films. Here we show, using first-principles calculations, that magnetism in epitaxial RuO$_2$ can emerge as an interfacial boundary phase at TiO$_2$/RuO$_2$ interfaces. While TiO$_2$-induced epitaxial strain alone does not make (001)-oriented RuO$_2$ magnetic, explicit TiO$_2$/RuO$_2$ interfaces stabilize sizable Ru moments confined to the first few Ru layers. Charge-density and orbital-resolved analyses reveal interfacial electronic reconstruction, and substrate doping provides a route to tune the induced moments. In symmetric TiO$_2$/RuO$_2$/TiO$_2$ heterostructures, the two magnetic interfaces couple through the metallic RuO$_2$ spacer, producing a thickness-dependent alternation between weak-ferromagnetic and compensated altermagnetic states. Our results identify interface engineering as a practical route to stabilize and control fragile magnetism in RuO$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：外延生长的RuO₂薄膜，具体为TiO₂/RuO₂异质结界面处的磁性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RuO₂的磁性并非其本征体相性质，而是可以在TiO₂/RuO₂界面处作为界面边界相涌现出来；通过界面工程可以稳定并调控RuO₂中脆弱的磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RuO₂的磁性并非其本征体相性质，而是可以在TiO₂/RuO₂界面处作为界面边界相涌现出来；通过界面工程可以稳定并调控RuO₂中脆弱的磁性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），包括电荷密度分析、轨道分辨分析以及对称异质结模型（TiO₂/RuO₂/TiO₂）的厚度依赖性研究。

papers.title: Programmable transport of rotating particles in obstacle arrays
papers.abstract: Rotating colloids, or spinners, in obstacle arrays exhibit frequency-set stationary orbits and currents set by the competition between an inertial, Magnus-like lift and short-range attraction. Fully resolved lattice-Boltzmann simulations reveal the hydrodynamic coupling and identify the lift mechanism, while a symmetry-based Langevin model captures the resulting balance. In periodic lattices, the superposition of scalar and vector potentials produces two robust orbital regimes: corner states, in which spinners orbit individual posts, and inner states, in which orbits couple across four neighboring obstacles. Slow frequency modulation toggles these states and produces directed, stepwise transport across the grid. This establishes a minimal hydrodynamic mechanism, controlled by a single driving parameter, for programmable guidance of active rotors in structured environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要提到“fully resolved lattice-Boltzmann simulations”（全分辨格子玻尔兹曼模拟）和“symmetry-based Langevin model”（基于对称性的朗之万模型）。；研究对象：旋转胶体（spinners）在障碍物阵列中的输运行为，具体研究旋转颗粒在周期性障碍物阵列中的轨道运动与可控输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 旋转颗粒在障碍物阵列中可形成两种稳定的轨道模式——单柱角态和四柱内态，通过缓慢调节旋转频率可实现这两种状态之间的切换，并产生定向、步进式的输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：旋转颗粒在障碍物阵列中可形成两种稳定的轨道模式——单柱角态和四柱内态，通过缓慢调节旋转频率可实现这两种状态之间的切换，并产生定向、步进式的输运。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 全分辨格子玻尔兹曼模拟（fully resolved lattice-Boltzmann simulations）用于揭示流体动力学耦合和升力机制；基于对称性的朗之万模型（symmetry-based Langevin model）用于描述力平衡。

papers.title: Coherent driving of displacive Higgs fluctuations in superconductors
papers.abstract: Intense phase-stable terahertz (THz) laser pulses can drive collective modes coherently via multi-photon excitation pathways in a manner different than the standard resonant mechanism operative in linear response. Here we show that in superconductors the nonlinear optical response can be enhanced when excited quasiparticles activate a (non-resonant) static displacement of the superconducting order parameter, in full analogy with the displacive excitation of coherent phonons in opaque materials. By combining numerical simulations with analytical results we demonstrate that the displacive mechanism to excite the Higgs mode is operative in both $s$-wave and $d$-wave superconductors. We validate this prediction experimentally by the temperature dependence of the phase of the nonlinear first harmonic in superconducting $s$-wave NbN. We also discuss how the order-parameter relaxation at large times, which can be experimentally accessed via pump-probe protocols is connected to energy-dissipative processes. Our results offer a novel perspective on the ability of intense THz fields to measure, and eventually control, the parametric dependence of the optical response on collective degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验混合类型。关键词：numerical simulations、analytical results、experimentally validate、pump-probe protocols。；研究对象：超导体中的Higgs（希格斯）集体激发模式，具体涉及s波超导体（NbN）和d波超导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新的非共振激发超导Higgs模式的机制——位移激发（displacive mechanism），该机制在s波和d波超导体中均有效，并通过NbN薄膜的非线性光学响应相位随温度的变化得到了实验验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新的非共振激发超导Higgs模式的机制——位移激发（displacive mechanism），该机制在s波和d波超导体中均有效，并通过NbN薄膜的非线性光学响应相位随温度的变化得到了实验验证。；创新点：首次提出并证明了在超导体中，激发准粒子可以导致超导序参量的静态位移（非共振），从而以类似于不透明材料中相干声子位移激发的方式驱动Higgs模，为强太赫兹场测量和控制超导集体自由度提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：结合数值模拟与解析分析，研究强相位稳定太赫兹激光脉冲通过多光子激发路径驱动集体模的非线性光学响应。实验方面：测量s波超导体NbN的非线性第一谐波相位随温度的变化，验证位移激发机制。

papers.title: Structural Relaxation Enables Millisecond Infrared Photodetection in Selenium Iodine Semiconductors
papers.abstract: The optoelectronic performance of amorphous and partially crystalline semiconductors is strongly governed by structural disorder, yet establishing direct correlations between structural evolution and carrier transport remains challenging. Here, we show that the solid state optoelectronic response of selenium iodine (SeI2) is dictated by its transformation from a metastable glassy phase into an ordered lamellar structure. Vertically resolved transport measurements reveal pronounced depth-dependent electrical conductivity within thick SeI2 films, arising from compositional and structural inhomogeneity developed during solidification. Immediately after solidification, the glassy SeI2 network exhibits sluggish carrier transport and persistent photoconductivity. Upon prolonged structural relaxation, however, the material undergoes significant transport enhancement, enabling millisecond-scale infrared photodetection with a response time of 4.3 ms, stable operation up to 8 kHz modulation frequency, and shot-noise-limited detectivities of 108 Jones at 1550 nm and 1011 Jones in the visible. Spatial photocurrent mapping demonstrates highly uniform carrier collection despite the self-assembled lamellar morphology, while infrared thermal imaging confirms practical imaging capability over a broad temperature range. These results establish structural relaxation as a powerful strategy for engineering carrier transport in selenium-based semiconductors and position SeI2 as a promising solution-processable platform for infrared photodetection and thermal imaging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“垂直分辨输运测量”、“空间光电流映射”、“红外热成像”等实验手段。；研究对象：非晶/部分结晶的硒碘（SeI₂）半导体材料，具体研究其从亚稳态玻璃相到有序层状结构的结构弛豫过程对光电性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结构弛豫，SeI₂从玻璃态转变为有序层状结构，其载流子输运性能得到显著增强，实现了毫秒级（4.3 ms响应时间）的红外光电探测，在1550 nm处探测率可达10⁸ Jones。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结构弛豫，SeI₂从玻璃态转变为有序层状结构，其载流子输运性能得到显著增强，实现了毫秒级（4.3 ms响应时间）的红外光电探测，在1550 nm处探测率可达10⁸ Jones。；创新点：首次将“结构弛豫”确立为一种在硒基半导体中工程化载流子输运的有效策略，并展示了SeI₂作为一种可溶液加工的红外光电探测与热成像平台的应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 垂直分辨电导率测量、光电流空间映射、红外热成像。通过测量厚膜中深度依赖的电导率来表征成分和结构的不均匀性，并测试了器件在不同调制频率（最高8 kHz）下的响应。

papers.title: Deconfined quantum critical point in a dissipative spin-1/2 chain
papers.abstract: Open quantum spin systems offer a previously unexplored route to realizing deconfined quantum criticality. We consider a spin-1/2 $J$-$Q_3$ chain, consisting of an antiferromagnetic (AFM) Heisenberg exchange and a competing multi-spin interaction favoring a valence-bond solid (VBS) state, with each spin component coupled to a bosonic bath. Using non-Abelian bosonization and renormalization-group (RG) analysis, combined with large-scale quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations, we determine the phase diagram and the associated phase transitions of the model. We show that strong dissipation stabilizes an AFM phase for sub-Ohmic, Ohmic, and super-Ohmic baths. Continuous AFM-VBS transitions at finite dissipation are found upon increasing the multi-spin interaction in both the sub-Ohmic and Ohmic regimes. Critical properties are obtained through perturbative RG analysis and QMC simulations. In the Ohmic case, the critical point features spinon deconfinement and emergent O(4) symmetry. In the sub-Ohmic regime, the transition may also involve spinon deconfinement, provided that spinons remain deconfined in the dissipative VBS phase. In addition, in the super-Ohmic regime, we propose a transition from AFM phase to a quasi-long-range ordered phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算混合型文章。关键词：non-Abelian bosonization, renormalization-group (RG) analysis, large-scale quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations。；研究对象：一个耗散的自旋-1/2 J-Q₃链，其中包含反铁磁海森堡交换相互作用和竞争的多自旋相互作用（倾向于形成价键固体态），每个自旋分量耦合到一个玻色子浴。研究重点是退禁闭量子临界点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强耗散可以在亚欧姆、欧姆和超欧姆浴中稳定反铁磁相。在欧姆情况下，临界点具有自旋子退禁闭和涌现的O(4)对称性；在亚欧姆和欧姆区域，增加多自旋相互作用可观察到连续的反铁磁-价键固体相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强耗散可以在亚欧姆、欧姆和超欧姆浴中稳定反铁磁相。在欧姆情况下，临界点具有自旋子退禁闭和涌现的O(4)对称性；在亚欧姆和欧姆区域，增加多自旋相互作用可观察到连续的反铁磁-价键固体相变。；创新点：首次在开放量子自旋系统中探索实现退禁闭量子临界性的可能性，揭示了耗散对退禁闭临界点稳定性和对称性的影响。摘要未突出说明与先前闭系统退禁闭临界点研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用非阿贝尔玻色化与重正化群分析，结合大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟，确定模型的相图和相变性质。

papers.title: Magnons reveal topology and dynamics of a skyrmion crystal
papers.abstract: Although individual skyrmions are topologically protected objects, their cooperative crystalline order is fragile, easily disrupted by thermal fluctuations or other external perturbations. Probing the internal dynamics of such a crystal is both compelling and challenging, as its intricate and delicate spin texture must remain stable during measurement. Here, we engineer a nanoscale graphene junction hosting a skyrmion Wigner crystal, embedded between magnon emitters and detectors. The skyrmion crystal geometry leaves a striking imprint on magnon transport: as the gate voltage is varied, near-periodic windows of sharp fluctuations in magnon count are detected across the entire sample. We develop an interpretation that this results from skyrmions being added one by one to a quasi-one-dimensional array. Each burst of the fluctuations thus corresponds to the entry of an additional skyrmion, during which the lattice stiffness reduces. The impinging magnons induce and act as a probe of non-equilibrium collective dynamics of the crystal. These results establish a real-space probe of topological spin textures in quantum Hall-type insulating ground states via magnon transport and open opportunities to explore correlated, topologically ordered phases in moire and multilayer graphene systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：engineer（工程实现）、detected（探测）、measurement（测量）、transport（输运）。；研究对象：嵌入在纳米级石墨烯结中的斯格明子维格纳晶体（skyrmion Wigner crystal），以及通过磁子（magnon）输运探测其拓扑与动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 斯格明子晶体的几何结构在磁子输运中留下显著印记：随栅极电压变化，整个样品中检测到近周期性的磁子计数尖锐涨落窗口，这源于斯格明子逐个加入准一维阵列时晶格刚度的降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：斯格明子晶体的几何结构在磁子输运中留下显著印记：随栅极电压变化，整个样品中检测到近周期性的磁子计数尖锐涨落窗口，这源于斯格明子逐个加入准一维阵列时晶格刚度的降低。；创新点：建立了通过磁子输运对量子霍尔型绝缘基态中拓扑自旋纹理进行实空间探测的方法，为探索莫尔和 multilayer 石墨烯系统中的关联拓扑有序相开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建了纳米级石墨烯结，将斯格明子维格纳晶体嵌入磁子发射器与探测器之间，通过测量磁子输运随栅极电压的变化来探测晶体动力学。

papers.title: Negative quantum friction in nanoscale water flows: the Wigner picture
papers.abstract: We explore the phenomenon of "quantum" friction based on a single-particle model patterned after the Wigner equation describing electrons flow in a solid wall confining nanoscale water flows. The numerical simulations show a clear signature of negative quantum friction, namely a net momentum transfer from the electrons in the solid wall to the flowing water molecules. Such net momentum transfer results into a sizeable reduction of the water friction, up to forty percent, depending on the strength of the coupling between classical and quantum fluctuations. Our results offer the prospect of a theoretical framework bridging classical and quantum description by using continuum kinetic theories and particle-based simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Wigner equation、continuum kinetic theories、particle-based simulations）；研究对象：纳米尺度水流中固体壁面电子与水分子的量子摩擦现象，具体为“负量子摩擦”效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纳米水流中，固体壁面电子向流动水分子传递净动量，导致水摩擦显著降低（最高达40%），即出现负量子摩擦现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纳米水流中，固体壁面电子向流动水分子传递净动量，导致水摩擦显著降低（最高达40%），即出现负量子摩擦现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Wigner方程的单粒子模型进行数值模拟，结合经典与量子涨落的耦合强度分析，采用连续动理学理论与基于粒子的模拟方法。

papers.title: Drosophila of phonon-mediated superconductivity: Full Eliashberg theory of the jellium model
papers.abstract: We present a full numerical solution of the Migdal--Eliashberg equations for the jellium model of phonon-mediated superconductivity. We find very low critical temperatures below 1~K, in contrast to earlier claims that the jellium model for hydrogen solids might reach room-temperature superconductivity. Our results suggest that full momentum and frequency dependence of the gap function and normal self-energy should be taken into account for accurate $T_c$ estimates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：数值解、Migdal-Eliashberg方程、理论模型。；研究对象：jellium模型（均匀电子气模型）中的声子介导超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: jellium模型的超导临界温度远低于1 K，推翻了此前关于该模型可能实现室温超导（如氢固体）的论断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：jellium模型的超导临界温度远低于1 K，推翻了此前关于该模型可能实现室温超导（如氢固体）的论断。；创新点：首次在jellium模型中实现了Eliashberg方程的完全数值解，并指出精确估算Tc必须考虑能隙函数和自能的完整动量与频率依赖，而非仅做近似处理。
papers.method_zh: 对Migdal-Eliashberg方程进行全数值求解，完整考虑了能隙函数和正常自能的动量与频率依赖。

papers.title: Qubit encodings in the p-orbital-valley spectrum for enhanced coherence and tunable two-qubit interaction
papers.abstract: We propose encoding a qubit in a two-level subspace spanned by the lowest $p$-orbital state in the excited valley of an anisotropic quantum dot and the excited $p$-orbital in the ground valley, which we dub the $pOv$ qubit. There is an avoided crossing between these states due to valley-orbit coupling (VOC) induced by alloy disorder, enabling complete single-qubit control using baseband electrical control of the dot anisotropy. We find that `sweet spots' exist at specific dot orientations where the instantaneous eigenstates are first-order insensitive to charge noise. Using a phenomenological two-level fluctuator (TLF) dipole noise model, we estimate an average dephasing time of $T_2^*\approx 10\,μ\text{s}$ and a quality factor of $Q\sim 10^4$. Alternatively, encoding in the $p$-orbital states in the ground valley near the isotropic dot point, we show that one can induce a similar sweet spot via an out-of-plane magnetic field. Finally, we find that two-qubit gates for the $pOv$ qubit are mediated by the quadrupole-quadrupole Coulomb interaction and can be electrically tuned from zero to $\sim 1~\text{GHz}$ by adjusting the relative orientation of the anisotropic dots, providing a novel pathway towards scalable quantum computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、estimate、show、find（均为理论推导和数值估算，无实验数据或计算模拟细节）。；研究对象：基于各向异性量子点中p轨道与谷态耦合的量子比特编码方案（pOv qubit），以及利用四极-四极库仑相互作用实现可调双量子比特门。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种新型量子比特编码（pOv qubit），利用合金无序引起的谷-轨道耦合实现单量子比特全电控，并在特定点阵取向下存在对电荷噪声一阶不敏感的“甜点”，估算退相干时间约10微秒、品质因子约10^4；双量子比特门可通过调节各向异性量子点相对取向实现从零到约1 GHz的连续电调谐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种新型量子比特编码（pOv qubit），利用合金无序引起的谷-轨道耦合实现单量子比特全电控，并在特定点阵取向下存在对电荷噪声一阶不敏感的“甜点”，估算退相干时间约10微秒、品质因子约10^4；双量子比特门可通过调节各向异性量子点相对取向实现从零到约1 GHz的连续电调谐。；创新点：首次提出利用p轨道与谷态交叉能级构造量子比特（pOv qubit），并利用各向异性量子点的取向调控实现可调双量子比特耦合，为可扩展量子计算提供新路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用两能级涨落器（TLF）偶极噪声模型估算退相干时间与品质因子；通过分析谷-轨道耦合（VOC）与点各向异性的关系寻找电荷噪声甜点；利用四极-四极库仑相互作用模型计算双量子比特门耦合强度。

papers.title: Phase-controlled quasi-bound states in the continuum and thermoelectric enhancement in Majorana-quantum-dot nanostructures
papers.abstract: We investigate how the interplay between Majorana zero modes (MZMs) and bound states in the continuum (BICs) governs the electronic thermoelectric response of a crossbar-shaped quantum dot (QD) coupled to two topological-superconductor nanowires. Using the Green-function formalism, exact linear-response energy integrals, and their low-temperature Sommerfeld expansion, we analyze the spectral and thermoelectric properties of the system. We show that symmetry breaking converts BICs into quasi-BICs, allowing them to contribute to electrical and thermal transport and thereby generate a finite thermoelectric response. While unequal nanowire lengths, reflected in different intra-Majorana coupling strengths, produce only a modest enhancement of $ZT_{el}$, detuning the QD level increases $ZT_{el}$ by approximately one order of magnitude. Superconducting-phase control produces a much stronger enhancement, reaching $ZT_{el} \simeq 0.75$ through a quadratic transmission zero and a pronounced violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. The low-temperature values $ZT^{max}_{el} \simeq 0.755$ and $\mathscr{L} /\mathscr{L}_{0} = 21/5$ are universal consequences of this quadratic antiresonance. Our results establish phase-tunable thermoelectric signatures of the Majorana-coupled interference structure and identify superconducting-phase control as an efficient means of engineering the electronic response of topological hybrid nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用格林函数形式、精确线性响应能量积分、索末菲展开等理论框架进行分析。；研究对象：由十字形量子点与两根拓扑超导纳米线耦合构成的混合纳米结构，具体研究其中马约拉纳零模与连续谱束缚态之间的相互作用如何调控电子热电响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过打破对称性，连续谱束缚态可转化为准束缚态，从而贡献热电输运。通过调控超导相位，可实现热电优值 $ZT_{el}$ 的显著增强，达到约0.75，并导致维德曼-弗兰兹定律的强烈违反。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过打破对称性，连续谱束缚态可转化为准束缚态，从而贡献热电输运。通过调控超导相位，可实现热电优值 $ZT_{el}$ 的显著增强，达到约0.75，并导致维德曼-弗兰兹定律的强烈违反。；创新点：揭示了通过超导相位控制来高效调控马约拉纳-量子点混合纳米结构电子响应的机制，并发现了一个由二次传输零点导致的普适低温热电优值上限（$ZT^{max}_{el} \simeq 0.755$）和洛伦兹数比值（$\mathscr{L} /\mathscr{L}_{0} = 21/5$）。摘要未明确说明与之前工作的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 采用格林函数形式主义，结合精确的线性响应能量积分以及低温下的索末菲展开，对系统的光谱和热电性质进行分析。

papers.title: Fast temperature up steps as a test of the Tool-Narayanaswamy formalism
papers.abstract: We investigated the aging dynamics of a glass-forming liquid triethyl-2-acetylcitrate (TEAC), following fast temperature up steps with amplitudes ranging from 0.3 to 13.6 K. The initial states were either at equilibrium or prepared at increasing levels of out-of-equilibrium through a prior down step experiment. Our goal was to test the predictive power of the Tool-Narayanaswamy (TN) formalism which assumes that the non-linear re-equilibration of a liquid can be linked to its linear response to a small perturbation. We determined the TN parameters for steps with small to moderate amplitude ($\leq$ 3.3 K) and crucially took advantage of down step aging experiments below the glass transition temperature to constrain the determination of the equilibrium relaxation time. We tested the TN predictions and found very good agreement for differences in fictive temperature characterizing the distance from equilibrium as high as 10 K. For larger steps, however, the prediction progressively fails to capture the aging dynamics. This likely indicates that the re-equilibration mechanism is no longer related to the equilibrium dynamics. Finally, we discuss the possibility of obtaining a general criterion for the limit of validity of the TN formalism, which we compare to other systems from the literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：investigated the aging dynamics、fast temperature up steps、aging experiments。；研究对象：玻璃形成液体 triethyl-2-acetylcitrate (TEAC) 的老化动力学，以及 Tool-Narayanaswamy (TN) 形式主义的预测能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于距离平衡态的虚温度差高达 10 K 的温升步进，TN 形式主义的预测与实验吻合良好；但对于更大振幅的温升步进（>3.3 K），预测逐渐失效，表明再平衡机制不再与平衡动力学相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于距离平衡态的虚温度差高达 10 K 的温升步进，TN 形式主义的预测与实验吻合良好；但对于更大振幅的温升步进（>3.3 K），预测逐渐失效，表明再平衡机制不再与平衡动力学相关。；创新点：利用降温步进老化实验来约束平衡弛豫时间的确定，从而更严格地测试 TN 形式主义在较大温升步进下的预测能力，并探讨了该形式主义有效性的通用判据。
papers.method_zh: 通过快速升温步进实验（振幅 0.3 至 13.6 K），结合降温步进老化实验（低于玻璃化转变温度）来约束平衡弛豫时间的确定，并利用 TN 形式主义进行预测与实验对比。

papers.title: Nonuniform pressure helps structural superlubricity
papers.abstract: Structural superlubricity, nearly vanishing friction between two structurally incommensurate crystalline surfaces, is a promising avenue for reducing friction in applications, but requires very specific and well-controlled conditions. One of those conditions is perfectly uniform atomically flat surfaces. Real-world surfaces are generally rough, leading to nonuniform pressure distributions. We investigate the effects of nonuniform pressure distributions on structural superlubricity, using analytical calculations for rigid contacts as a basis, and molecular-dynamics simulations for a simple model to include the crucial effects of elasticity. We show that a key ingredient is the vanishing pressure at the edge of the contact, and that this leads to improved scaling depinning and scaling behaviour, leading to lower friction. We thus show that nonuniform pressure distributions actually help structural superlubricity, rather than hinder it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算模拟）。判断依据：analytical calculations（解析计算）、molecular-dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：结构超润滑（structural superlubricity）现象，具体研究非均匀压力分布对两个非公度晶体表面间近零摩擦行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非均匀压力分布（尤其是接触边缘压力为零）实际上有助于改善结构超润滑的脱钉和标度行为，从而降低摩擦力，而非阻碍超润滑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非均匀压力分布（尤其是接触边缘压力为零）实际上有助于改善结构超润滑的脱钉和标度行为，从而降低摩擦力，而非阻碍超润滑。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于以往认为表面粗糙（导致压力非均匀）会破坏超润滑的普遍观点，本文首次指出非均匀压力分布（特别是边缘压力为零）反而有利于结构超润滑。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析计算处理刚性接触模型，并利用分子动力学模拟（针对简单模型）引入弹性效应。

papers.title: Altermagnetism without a long-range order
papers.abstract: The Kugel-Khomskii spin-pseudospin model, originally developed for transition-metal compounds with orbital degrees of freedom, has recently been reinterpreted in the context of altermagnetism. In this work, we theoretically investigate the emergence of altermagnetic behavior in the absence of long-range magnetic or orbital order. Using the rotation-invariant Green's function method for the SU(2) x SU(2) symmetric model on a square lattice and on a linear chain, we analyze spin-spin and spin-pseudospin correlation functions, excitation spectra, heat capacity, and susceptibilities. We show that beyond a critical intersubsystem exchange Kc(T), a composite state arises with nonzero spin-pseudospin correlations, even though the average spin and pseudospin at each site are zero. The excitation spectrum splits into acoustic and optical branches, with nodal lines along qx = qy - a direct signature of altermagnetic symmetry. A peak in heat capacity and a jump in susceptibility are observed at the phase boundary. In 1D, the phase boundary is nonmonotonic and demonstrates reentrant transition. These results establish the concept of an "altermagnetic paramagnet" or "altermagnetic liquid" without long-range order, relevant for low-dimensional and strongly fluctuating systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、rotation-invariant Green's function method、SU(2) × SU(2) symmetric model。；研究对象：Kugel-Khomskii 自旋-赝自旋模型中的交变磁性（altermagnetism），特别关注无长程磁序或轨道序时交变磁性行为的涌现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维正方晶格和一维链上，当子系统间交换耦合超过临界值 Kc(T) 时，即使每个格点的平均自旋和赝自旋为零，仍可形成具有非零自旋-赝自旋关联的复合态，其激发谱出现沿 qx = qy 的节线——这是交变磁性对称性的直接标志。该工作建立了无长程有序的“交变磁性顺磁体”或“交变磁性液体”概念。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维正方晶格和一维链上，当子系统间交换耦合超过临界值 Kc(T) 时，即使每个格点的平均自旋和赝自旋为零，仍可形成具有非零自旋-赝自旋关联的复合态，其激发谱出现沿 qx = qy 的节线——这是交变磁性对称性的直接标志。该工作建立了无长程有序的“交变磁性顺磁体”或“交变磁性液体”概念。；创新点：首次在理论上证明交变磁性行为可以在完全没有长程磁序或轨道序的情况下出现，提出了“交变磁性顺磁体/液体”这一新物相概念，并在一维体系中发现了非单调相边界和重入相变行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用旋转不变的格林函数方法（rotation-invariant Green's function method）分析 SU(2) × SU(2) 对称模型，计算了自旋-自旋和自旋-赝自旋关联函数、激发谱、热容和磁化率。

papers.title: Disentangling topological and anomalous Hall contributions of skyrmions using Kerr microscopy and thermal transport measurements
papers.abstract: The topological Hall effect is a valuable tool to indicate the presence of topologically protected magnetic structures. In this work, we present topological Hall effect measurements originating from topologically protected skyrmions in Ta/CoFeB/MgO single-layer thick films with a one nanometer thick magnetic layer. The simultaneous occurrence of the small topological Hall effect and the dominating anomalous Hall effect in this material system makes direct detection challenging as compared to bulk or multilayer systems. In electronic transport measurements, both effects' contributions impact electron trajectories in the same way, overlapping in the measurement signal, and require disentanglement. Magneto-optical Kerr microscopy was used to image the surface magnetization, enabling the separation of the topological Hall effect from other Hall effect contributions. These measurements reveal a topological Hall resistivity of $249(18)\,$\si{\pico\ohm\meter} for Ta/CoFeB/MgO layer stacks at room temperature. Magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements also allow tracking skyrmion formation during external magnetic field sweeps to confirm their occurrence when measuring the topological Hall effect. We verify this outcome by comparing the results with thermal and electrical transport measurements from which we calculate the overall topological quantity that gives rise to the topological Nernst and Hall effect, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验测量（Kerr显微成像、电输运和热输运测量）以及具体实验数据（拓扑霍尔电阻率值）。；研究对象：Ta/CoFeB/MgO单层厚膜中的斯格明子（skyrmions），具体为厚度仅1纳米的磁性层中由拓扑保护产生的拓扑霍尔效应和反常霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过磁光克尔显微成像与输运测量相结合，成功将拓扑霍尔效应从占主导的反常霍尔效应中分离出来，并在室温下测得Ta/CoFeB/MgO层堆栈的拓扑霍尔电阻率为249(18) pΩ·m。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过磁光克尔显微成像与输运测量相结合，成功将拓扑霍尔效应从占主导的反常霍尔效应中分离出来，并在室温下测得Ta/CoFeB/MgO层堆栈的拓扑霍尔电阻率为249(18) pΩ·m。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 磁光克尔效应（MOKE）显微成像（用于表面磁化成像和追踪斯格明子形成过程）、电输运测量（霍尔效应测量）、热输运测量（用于计算拓扑能斯特效应和拓扑霍尔效应的整体拓扑量）。

papers.title: Property-dependent material times
papers.abstract: We analyze simulations of physical aging following large temperature up-jumps from equilibrated, slowly relaxing states. Specifically, we consider up-jumps from temperatures T=0.43 and T=0.37 to T=0.48 in a binary Lennard-Jones mixture. The Tool-Narayanaswamy (TN) concept of a universal material time was recently shown to become less effective in rationalizing the aging response for such large jumps [Amari et al., Phys. Rev. E 113, 045411 (2026)]. Here, we investigate whether the performance of the TN formalism can be improved by assigning a separate material time to each observable. We examine the potential-energy time-autocorrelation function, the self-intermediate scattering function, and the time-dependent mean-square displacement. As part of this study, we perform a detailed analysis of the extent to which the triangular relation, a necessary condition for the existence of a material time, is satisfied. We find that, for all three properties, the best data collapse is obtained when each property is parameterized by its own material time. The degree of improvement varies considerably among the observables, however; it is most pronounced for the mean-square displacement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：simulations、binary Lennard-Jones mixture、time-autocorrelation function、self-intermediate scattering function、mean-square displacement）；研究对象：二元Lennard-Jones混合物在经历大幅温度上跳后的物理老化过程，具体关注从平衡态（T=0.43和T=0.37）跃迁至T=0.48的非平衡弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于大幅温度上跳后的老化过程，为每个可观测量分配独立的材料时间（property-dependent material times）比使用单一通用材料时间能获得更好的数据塌缩，其中均方位移的改善最为显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于大幅温度上跳后的老化过程，为每个可观测量分配独立的材料时间（property-dependent material times）比使用单一通用材料时间能获得更好的数据塌缩，其中均方位移的改善最为显著。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟，分析势能时间自相关函数、自中间散射函数和随时间变化的均方位移，并检验三角关系（material time存在的必要条件）的满足程度。

papers.title: Zigzag ordering, defects, and anomalous relaxation in antiferromagnetic Kuramoto lattices
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium ordering dynamics of coupled Kuramoto oscillators with negative nearest-neighbor coupling, which induces a zigzag antiferromagnetic ordering. In one dimension, the defect density exhibits anomalously slow coarsening, decaying as $(D(t)\sim t^{-1/4})$ before saturating at a system-size-dependent time $(t_c(N)\sim N^z)$ with (z=2). The local persistence probability follows a stretched-exponential form, $(P(t)\sim \exp(-c t^α))$, with $(α=1/4)$. These exponents are observed are independent of the magnitude of the coupling, which merely rescales the characteristic time scale. The equality $(α=δ=1/4)$ together with (z=2) is consistent with a distinct universality class. These results demonstrate that deterministic nonlinear dynamics and geometric frustration alone are sufficient to generate slow relaxation and anomalous scaling, without quenched disorder or stochastic noise. A continuum approximation and the corresponding coarse-grained partial differential equation provide a theoretical explanation for the observed anomalous exponents, while linear stability analysis accounts for the emergence of the zigzag ordered state. In two dimensions, geometric frustration inhibits complete ordering and gives rise to long-lived metastable domain-wall structures. An initial transient defect decay is observed before crossover and saturation. These results demonstrate how frustration and continuous phase variables can fundamentally modify coarsening dynamics and generate anomalously slow relaxation in deterministic many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：coupled Kuramoto oscillators、continuum approximation、coarse-grained partial differential equation、linear stability analysis。；研究对象：反铁磁Kuramoto晶格中的非平衡有序动力学，具体为具有负最近邻耦合的Kuramoto振荡器体系，以及由此产生的锯齿形反铁磁序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一维体系中缺陷密度呈现异常缓慢的粗化行为，衰减指数为-1/4，局域持续概率呈拉伸指数形式（指数α=1/4），这些标度指数构成一个独特的普适类；二维体系中几何阻挫阻止完全有序，产生长寿命亚稳态畴壁结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一维体系中缺陷密度呈现异常缓慢的粗化行为，衰减指数为-1/4，局域持续概率呈拉伸指数形式（指数α=1/4），这些标度指数构成一个独特的普适类；二维体系中几何阻挫阻止完全有序，产生长寿命亚稳态畴壁结构。；创新点：证明仅凭确定性非线性动力学和几何阻挫（无需淬火无序或随机噪声）即可产生慢弛豫和异常标度行为，揭示了阻挫与连续相位变量如何从根本上改变粗化动力学。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟相结合：采用确定性非线性动力学方程（Kuramoto模型），通过连续近似和粗粒化偏微分方程解释异常标度指数，利用线性稳定性分析解释锯齿形有序态的出现。

papers.title: Ultrametric organization of energy landscapes on random Erdős--Rényi graphs: topological origin of barrier hierarchy
papers.abstract: We investigate the ultrametric organization of energy landscapes defined on sparse random Erdős--Rényi graphs. Each graph vertex is assigned a random free energy from a uniform distribution over an interval of width $ΔF$, and the kinetics are modeled by a Markov process with Kramers transition rates. Using spectral decomposition of the rate matrix, we construct a kinetic Mahalanobis metric between basins of attraction. Computational experiments for graphs with $V=5000$ vertices and $E=5000$ edges show that the degree of nontrivial ultrametricity increases monotonically from $\approx42\%$ for $ΔF=10$ kJ/mol to $\approx96\%$ for $ΔF=1000$ kJ/mol. We prove a limit theorem: as $ΔF\to\infty$, the logarithmic asymptotics of this metric converge pointwise to the classical single-linkage ultrametric. For finite $ΔF$, corrections from suboptimal paths are exponentially suppressed with increasing $ΔF$, so that the metric becomes asymptotically ultrametric. Our results suggest that ultrametricity is a universal property of sparse, locally tree-like networks with rugged energy landscapes in the limit of large energy spreads.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“spectral decomposition of the rate matrix”、“prove a limit theorem”、“computational experiments”。；研究对象：定义在稀疏随机Erdős–Rényi图上的能量景观的ultrametric组织（ultrametric organization）。具体物理现象为：在具有粗糙能量景观的稀疏、局域树状网络中，能量势垒的层级结构及其与度量超度量性（ultrametricity）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着能量分布宽度ΔF增大，能量景观的动力学度量（kinetic Mahalanobis metric）的超度量性单调增加（从约42%增至约96%），并在ΔF→∞极限下收敛到经典的单链接超度量（single-linkage ultrametric）。这表明在能量展宽很大的极限下，超度量性是稀疏、局域树状网络能量景观的普适性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着能量分布宽度ΔF增大，能量景观的动力学度量（kinetic Mahalanobis metric）的超度量性单调增加（从约42%增至约96%），并在ΔF→∞极限下收敛到经典的单链接超度量（single-linkage ultrametric）。这表明在能量展宽很大的极限下，超度量性是稀疏、局域树状网络能量景观的普适性质。；创新点：首次严格证明了在稀疏随机图上，能量景观的动力学度量在能量展宽趋于无穷时收敛到单链接超度量，并揭示了有限ΔF下次优路径的指数抑制机制，从而建立了超度量性与稀疏图拓扑结构之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Kramers跃迁速率的马尔可夫过程建模动力学；利用速率矩阵的谱分解构建盆地间的动力学马氏度量（kinetic Mahalanobis metric）；对V=5000顶点、E=5000边的图进行数值计算实验；并给出极限定理的数学证明。

papers.title: Photoelectrical readout and Ramsey interferometry of single shallowly implanted NV centers in diamond
papers.abstract: Photoelectrical readout of the electronic spin state of the nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in diamond is attracting significant interest due to the numerous advantages it possesses compared with conventional fluorescence readout. The higher charge carrier rate compared to the photon rate and the integration of the detection scheme on a chip can significantly advance quantum sensing and computing with color centers in diamond. Until now, photoelectric readout has been performed on ensembles of NV centers or single NV centers deep in ultrapure diamond substrates. However, many applications require the artificial creation and precise placement of shallow NV centers, and photoelectric detection of such centers has been challenging. Here we demonstrate photoelectrical readout and coherent control of the electronic spin of implanted shallow ($\sim$10 nm) NV centers buried by diamond overgrowth. The photoelectrically measured Ramsey $T_2^*$ agrees with conventional fluorescence readout and shows no measurable dependence on the readout photocurrent, for both shallow implanted and deep ingrown NV centers. We further find that overgrowth improves photoelectric readout by suppressing the background photocurrent. These results establish photoelectric readout as a viable route to chip-integrated, electrically detected nanoscale sensing and to spin registers based on engineered shallow NV centers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验演示（demonstrate）、测量（measured）和结果（results），涉及具体实验操作如离子注入（implanted）、金刚石过生长（overgrowth）等。；研究对象：金刚石中浅层注入（~10 nm深度）的单个氮-空位（NV）色心，及其电子自旋的光电读出与相干控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功实现了对浅层注入NV色心（~10 nm深度）的电子自旋光电读出和相干控制，且光电测量的Ramsey退相干时间（T₂*）与传统荧光读出一致，不受读出光电流影响；金刚石过生长可抑制背景光电流，改善光电读出性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功实现了对浅层注入NV色心（~10 nm深度）的电子自旋光电读出和相干控制，且光电测量的Ramsey退相干时间（T₂*）与传统荧光读出一致，不受读出光电流影响；金刚石过生长可抑制背景光电流，改善光电读出性能。；创新点：首次实现了对浅层注入（~10 nm）单个NV色心的光电读出与相干控制，克服了此前浅层NV色心光电检测的挑战；发现金刚石过生长可有效抑制背景光电流，为芯片集成电学检测的纳米级传感和基于工程化浅层NV色心的自旋寄存器提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：浅层NV色心离子注入与金刚石过生长制备、光电读出（photoelectrical readout）与荧光读出对比、Ramsey干涉仪（Ramsey interferometry）测量自旋相干时间T₂*。

papers.title: Electrothermal control of spin-reorientation transition in Co/Fe_3GaTe_2 heterostructures
papers.abstract: Electrical control of magnetic anisotropy in van der Waals (vdWs) magnets is a key step toward reconfigurable two-dimensional spintronics, yet how a conventional metallic ferromagnet competes with a van der Waals magnet across a direct interface has remained largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate reversible thermal and electrothermal control of a spin-reorientation transition in Co/Fe_3GaTe_2 (FGaT) heterostructures. As Joule heating weakens the FGaT anisotropy, the heterostructure switches from an out-of-plane- to an in-plane-dominated state at a reorientation temperature of approximately 311 K, well below the Curie temperature, consistent with an exchange-mediated anisotropy competition between the Co overlayer and FGaT. An electrically driven device shows a closely matching loop evolution within an 80-100 mW power window, reversibly over five measurement cycles, consistent with an electrothermal origin. In a Co-free FGaT device, Kerr microscopy traces the switching to a power-tunable domain nucleation barrier and demonstrates power-thresholded, field-assisted magnetization reversal at a threshold near 15 mW. These results demonstrate electrothermal anisotropy competition as a route to heat-assisted and device-level control of vdWs magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、measurement、device、Kerr microscopy。；研究对象：Co/Fe₃GaTe₂ (FGaT) 异质结中的自旋重取向转变，以及通过电热效应调控该转变的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过焦耳热效应，Co/Fe₃GaTe₂ 异质结在约311 K（远低于居里温度）处发生从面外到面内的自旋重取向转变，该转变源于Co覆盖层与FGaT之间的交换介导各向异性竞争。电驱动器件可在80-100 mW功率窗口内可逆地实现该转变，且无Co的FGaT器件中观察到功率可调的畴成核势垒和场辅助磁化反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过焦耳热效应，Co/Fe₃GaTe₂ 异质结在约311 K（远低于居里温度）处发生从面外到面内的自旋重取向转变，该转变源于Co覆盖层与FGaT之间的交换介导各向异性竞争。电驱动器件可在80-100 mW功率窗口内可逆地实现该转变，且无Co的FGaT器件中观察到功率可调的畴成核势垒和场辅助磁化反转。；创新点：首次在传统金属铁磁体（Co）与范德华磁体（Fe₃GaTe₂）的直接界面中，利用电热效应实现可逆的自旋重取向转变，并展示了基于功率阈值调控的磁化反转机制，为热辅助和器件级控制范德华磁性提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：焦耳加热、电输运测量、克尔显微镜（Kerr microscopy）对磁畴成像。通过对比有/无Co覆盖层的器件，分析电热效应与交换耦合对磁各向异性的影响。

papers.title: Thermal Order by Disorder in Resonating-Valence Bond States on the Checkerboard Lattice
papers.abstract: We derive a local spin-1/2 Hamiltonian with a resonating valence bond ground state on the checkerboard lattice. The state is characterized by the exponential decay of singlet-singlet correlations, whereas dimer-dimer correlations decay with a power law in the corresponding Quantum Dimer model. This observation leads to a novel mechanism for thermal Order by Disorder whereby thermal decoherence suppresses destructive quantum interference between different contributions to the correlations in the ground state and results in a qualitatively different, quasi-long-range ordered mixed state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive a local spin-1/2 Hamiltonian、Quantum Dimer model、mechanism。；研究对象：棋盘格（checkerboard）晶格上的共振价键（Resonating-Valence Bond, RVB）态，以及该体系中由热无序诱导的有序（Thermal Order by Disorder）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在棋盘格晶格的RVB基态中，单态-单态关联呈指数衰减，而二聚体-二聚体关联在对应的量子二聚体模型中呈幂律衰减。这一特性导致一种新的热无序诱导有序机制：热退相干抑制了基态关联中不同贡献之间的破坏性量子干涉，从而产生一种性质不同的、准长程有序的混合态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在棋盘格晶格的RVB基态中，单态-单态关联呈指数衰减，而二聚体-二聚体关联在对应的量子二聚体模型中呈幂律衰减。这一特性导致一种新的热无序诱导有序机制：热退相干抑制了基态关联中不同贡献之间的破坏性量子干涉，从而产生一种性质不同的、准长程有序的混合态。；创新点：提出了一种全新的热无序诱导有序机制，该机制源于热退相干对基态中破坏性量子干涉的抑制，而非传统意义上的熵驱动选择。摘要未突出说明与已有RVB或热无序诱导有序工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过推导一个局域自旋-1/2哈密顿量来构建棋盘格晶格上的共振价键基态，并利用量子二聚体模型分析其关联函数行为，进而提出热无序诱导有序的理论机制。

papers.title: Quantum and classical entropic complexity of the thermal state: coherence, decoherence, and the ergodic-to-localized crossover in random-matrix and many-body models
papers.abstract: Does thermal averaging preserve signatures of eigenstate complexity? We study the entropic complexity C = S_1 - S_2 (Shannon minus second-order Renyi entropy) across the ergodic-to-localized crossover of three disordered models: the Rosenzweig-Porter (RP) ensemble, the power-law banded random matrix (PLBRM) ensemble, and the random-field Heisenberg chain. We compare a wavefunction-level quantity C_eig to the complexity of the thermal (Gibbs) state before and after pointer-basis dephasing, via the trace (C_tr) and diagonal (C_diag) complexities. The answer is mostly no: thermal averaging strongly suppresses, but does not eliminate, eigenstate-complexity signatures. C_eig develops a pronounced mid-phase maximum in RP and, at matching fractal dimension, in the structurally independent PLBRM model; a high-statistics scan resolves a weak (about 10%) but reproducible thermal shadow of this peak in the thermal diagonal complexity. This feature is confined to the two random-matrix models; in the Heisenberg chain the eigenstate complexity instead peaks at the many-body localization transition. A second, genuinely thermal feature, an edge just inside the ergodic phase, has no eigenstate counterpart and, in PLBRM, recedes with system size. Both features are tracked by scale-invariant crossover indicators: the log-ratio of the trace and diagonal crossover temperatures, which vanishes upon localization, and the relative entropy of coherence. Entropic complexity thus cleanly separates thermal-state and eigenstate physics: a sharp wavefunction-level feature, reproducible across unrelated random-matrix constructions, leaves only a faint, structurally distinct imprint on thermal observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：entropic complexity、random-matrix models、many-body models、crossover indicators。；研究对象：无序系统中的热态（thermal state）与本征态（eigenstate）的熵复杂度（entropic complexity），具体包括Rosenzweig-Porter（RP）系综、幂律带状随机矩阵（PLBRM）系综以及随机场海森堡链（random-field Heisenberg chain）三个模型，研究从遍历态到局域态的交叉（ergodic-to-localized crossover）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热平均强烈抑制但并未完全消除本征态复杂度的特征：在随机矩阵模型中，本征态复杂度在中间相出现显著峰值，而热态对角复杂度仅保留约10%的微弱但可重现的“热影子”；在海森堡链中，本征态复杂度则在多体局域化转变处达到峰值。此外，热态中还存在一个无本征态对应的、位于遍历相边缘的纯热特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热平均强烈抑制但并未完全消除本征态复杂度的特征：在随机矩阵模型中，本征态复杂度在中间相出现显著峰值，而热态对角复杂度仅保留约10%的微弱但可重现的“热影子”；在海森堡链中，本征态复杂度则在多体局域化转变处达到峰值。此外，热态中还存在一个无本征态对应的、位于遍历相边缘的纯热特征。；创新点：系统区分了热态与本征态的物理：发现随机矩阵模型中本征态复杂度在中间相的显著峰值在热态中仅留下微弱且结构不同的印记，而热态中还存在一个无本征态对应的边缘特征。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算Shannon熵与二阶Rényi熵之差定义的熵复杂度C = S₁ - S₂，分别研究本征态复杂度（C_eig）、热态迹复杂度（C_tr）和热态对角复杂度（C_diag，即指针基退相后的复杂度）。使用标度不变的交叉指示量：迹与对角交叉温度的对数比（log-ratio of trace and diagonal crossover temperatures）以及相干相对熵（relative entropy of coherence）。

papers.title: Fermion parity of an Andreev molecule probed by nonlocal Josephson effect
papers.abstract: Fermion parity is a fundamental property of superconducting many-body states. Here, we show that the global fermion parity of a delocalized superconducting state can be detected locally by exploiting the nonlocal Josephson effect. Using a carbon nanotube-based Andreev molecule formed by two coupled quantum-dot Josephson junctions, we observe a pronounced nonlocal Josephson response and demonstrate the formation of delocalized Andreev molecular states extending across both junctions. We further show that changes in the molecular ground-state parity manifest as characteristic $π$-phase shifts in the nonlocal response. Supported by a minimal theoretical model, these results identify global fermion parity as an experimentally accessible degree of freedom in hybrid superconducting circuits that can be readily revealed through the nonlocal Josephson effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：observe、demonstrate、experimentally accessible、nonlocal Josephson effect）；研究对象：基于碳纳米管的安德烈夫分子（Andreev molecule），由两个耦合的量子点约瑟夫森结构成，研究其非局域约瑟夫森效应与费米子宇称。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非局域约瑟夫森效应，可以局域地探测到离域超导态的全局费米子宇称；分子基态宇称的变化会在非局域响应中表现为特征性的π相位偏移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非局域约瑟夫森效应，可以局域地探测到离域超导态的全局费米子宇称；分子基态宇称的变化会在非局域响应中表现为特征性的π相位偏移。；创新点：首次将全局费米子宇识别为混合超导电路中可通过非局域约瑟夫森效应直接探测的实验可观测自由度。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用碳纳米管构建两个耦合的量子点约瑟夫森结，测量非局域约瑟夫森响应；理论上辅以最小模型（minimal theoretical model）进行解释。

papers.title: A Flickering Resonance Degeneracy on Entropy-Ruled Charge Transport in the Extended Hopping Sites for Biological Systems: Role of Static-to-Dynamic Disorder Transition
papers.abstract: Charge transport (CT) in biological systems is of great interest due to its role in various functional activities like photobiology, bioenergetics, redox catalytic and other metabolic activities, etc. It has been observed by various studies that the presence of a dynamic disorder in biomolecules facilitates charge dynamics in the intermediate transport regime, i.e., far from hopping and towards a bank-like mechanism. Hitherto, the dynamic disorder (in a time scale, coupling between electronic and nuclear dynamics) weightage on CT in molecules is not well-established for the measurement of molecular conductivity from small to long-range ordering. With this motivation, we propose the flickering resonance-coupled entropy-ruled charge transport theory for transfer-rate and diffusion-based mobility (D/μ) calculations. The proposed analytical formalism incorporates the impact of dynamic disorder-correlated degeneracy (in a flickering-resonance manner) on the entropy-ruled electron transfer rate and diffusion-mobility, which are valid for localized hopping, delocalized band transport, and regimes in between. By this approach, it has been observed that the dynamics-driven electronic site matching probability enhances the degeneracy, which is quantified by the differential entropy. The analysis clearly shows that for ultra-fast dynamical and degenerate cases, the entropy-ruled mobility is transformed as band mobility, rather than the thermally activated hopping or diffusion process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose...theory、analytical formalism、analysis shows。；研究对象：生物系统中的电荷输运（charge transport, CT），特别是从局域跳跃到离域能带输运的中间输运机制，以及动态无序（dynamic disorder）对分子电导的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“闪烁共振耦合熵主导电荷输运理论”，发现动态无序驱动的电子位点匹配概率会增强简并度（由微分熵量化），且在超快动态和简并情况下，熵主导的迁移率会转变为能带迁移率，而非热激活跳跃或扩散过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“闪烁共振耦合熵主导电荷输运理论”，发现动态无序驱动的电子位点匹配概率会增强简并度（由微分熵量化），且在超快动态和简并情况下，熵主导的迁移率会转变为能带迁移率，而非热激活跳跃或扩散过程。；创新点：首次将动态无序相关的简并度（以闪烁共振方式）与熵主导的电子转移速率和扩散-迁移率关联起来，并定量分析了动态无序对从短程到长程有序分子电导测量的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：构建了基于闪烁共振（flickering resonance）与熵（entropy）耦合的分析形式体系，用于计算转移速率和扩散基迁移率（D/μ），该形式适用于局域跳跃、离域能带输运及中间区域。

papers.title: Scaling regimes of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation from the functional renormalization group
papers.abstract: We revisit the renormalization group (RG) approach to the one-dimensional stochastic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation and show that previous approaches based on perturbative Wilsonian RG with a sharp cutoff are not valid, even though they yield a qualitatively correct picture. The reason is that taking momentum derivatives while using the sharp cutoff is not well-defined in some cases and leads to intrinsic divergencies. This is a well-known problem of Wilsonian RG, which can be simply cured by using a smooth cutoff, and employing the functional renormalization group (FRG) framework. We establish the flow equations for the KS model within the FRG, and demonstrate that it flows to the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) fixed point at large scales. We then calculate the full two-point correlation function over a wide range of momenta and frequencies. We show that it exhibits three universal scaling regimes that we characterize: the KPZ regime (with dynamical exponent $z=3/2$), the Edwards-Wilkinson regime (with $z=2$) and the recently discovered inviscid regime (with $z=1$). The latter develops over an extended range of large wavenumbers and originates from the vanishing of the effective viscosity. Lastly, we investigate the large-scale behavior of the deterministic KS equation by studying the limit of vanishing noise and we determine the scales where the KPZ regime can emerge in the deterministic case.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional renormalization group (FRG)、renormalization group (RG) approach、flow equations。；研究对象：一维随机Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS)方程，及其与Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ)方程、Edwards-Wilkinson (EW)方程的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用功能重整化群（FRG）方法，发现KS方程在大尺度下流向KPZ不动点，并揭示了其两点关联函数在动量-频率空间中存在三个普适标度区：KPZ区（动力学指数z=3/2）、Edwards-Wilkinson区（z=2）和无粘区（z=1）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用功能重整化群（FRG）方法，发现KS方程在大尺度下流向KPZ不动点，并揭示了其两点关联函数在动量-频率空间中存在三个普适标度区：KPZ区（动力学指数z=3/2）、Edwards-Wilkinson区（z=2）和无粘区（z=1）。；创新点：指出以往基于尖锐截断的微扰Wilson重整化群方法存在内在发散问题（动量导数定义不良），而采用光滑截断的FRG方法可有效解决该问题，并首次在FRG框架下系统计算了KS方程的全动量-频率两点关联函数，明确表征了三个普适标度区。
papers.method_zh: 功能重整化群（FRG）框架，采用光滑截断（smooth cutoff）替代传统Wilson重整化群中的尖锐截断（sharp cutoff），建立KS模型的流方程并计算两点关联函数。

papers.title: Reversible and irreversible dynamical topological transitions of magnetic Hopfions
papers.abstract: Magnetic Hopfions are three-dimensional (3D) topological solitons characterized by a nonzero Hopf invariant and offer a promising platform for 3D spintronics. While their static stabilization has been widely studied, their nonlinear dynamics under alternating magnetic (AM) fields remain largely unexplored. We show, using 3D micromagnetic simulations and analytical mode analysis, that an AM field drives two qualitatively distinct dynamical regimes of a confined magnetic Hopfion. In the weak-field regime, resonant excitation of intrinsic Hopfion modes induces a nonlinear instability and an irreversible topological reconfiguration from a Hopfion to a toron. In contrast, in the strong-field regime, the system undergoes reversible field-locked topological switching at GHz frequencies, with the magnetization periodically alternating between a topologically trivial ferromagnetic configuration and a Hopfion state. The switching pathway is selected by the driving frequency: a 2 GHz field drives a breathing pathway associated with the low-frequency collective response, whereas a 40 GHz field produces a nonresonant rotational pathway governed by strong Zeeman-torque-driven precession and field locking. These results identify field amplitude and frequency as independent control knobs and reveal that reversible Hopfion switching can arise either from nonlinear continuation of low-frequency collective motion or from nonresonant high-frequency field locking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：3D micromagnetic simulations, analytical mode analysis）；研究对象：磁性Hopfion在交变磁场（AM field）下的非线性动力学行为，具体为受限磁Hopfion的拓扑态转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁场可驱动磁Hopfion产生两种截然不同的动力学行为：弱场下发生从Hopfion到toron的不可逆拓扑重构；强场下实现可逆的拓扑开关，磁化在铁磁态与Hopfion态之间周期性交替。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁场可驱动磁Hopfion产生两种截然不同的动力学行为：弱场下发生从Hopfion到toron的不可逆拓扑重构；强场下实现可逆的拓扑开关，磁化在铁磁态与Hopfion态之间周期性交替。；创新点：揭示了场振幅和频率可作为独立控制旋钮，并发现可逆Hopfion开关既可通过低频集体运动的非线性延续实现，也可通过非共振高频场锁定实现。摘要未突出说明与已有静态稳定化研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 三维微磁学模拟（3D micromagnetic simulations）与解析模式分析（analytical mode analysis）。

papers.title: Controlling charge and spin currents through nonreciprocal dissipative processes
papers.abstract: We investigate the generation and control of both charge and spin currents via nonreciprocal dissipative mechanisms in a two-dimensional spinful fermionic atom quantum system with broken inversion and time-reversal symmetries. Within the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad master equation formalism and using an approach based on the time-dependent generalized Gibbs ensemble, we identify in the weak dissipative coupling regime the minimal set of nonreciprocal jump operators required to induce charge and spin currents and to control both their direction and magnitude. We find that in the presence of finite tunneling, Rashba coupling and magnetic field, the combine application of two jump operators nonreciprocally coupling each spin species to a different spatial direction of motion is sufficient to generate both types of current. Furthermore, by tuning the degree of nonreciprocity of the jump operators we modify the dominant transport mechanism from spin to charge. Finally, we checked that this nonreciprocal current generation mechanism is robust to the application of dephasing noise as even in the presence of this additional dissipative process the steady-state occupation distributions for the quasiparticle modes of the Hamiltonian remains non-trivial, an essential requirement to obtain non-zero currents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、formalism、approach、identify、find。；研究对象：二维自旋费米子原子量子系统中的非互易耗散过程，以及由此产生的电荷流和自旋流的生成与控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱耗散耦合条件下，通过两个非互易跳变算符分别将每种自旋分量耦合到不同的空间运动方向，即可同时产生电荷流和自旋流；通过调节非互易程度，可将主导输运机制从自旋流转变为电荷流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱耗散耦合条件下，通过两个非互易跳变算符分别将每种自旋分量耦合到不同的空间运动方向，即可同时产生电荷流和自旋流；通过调节非互易程度，可将主导输运机制从自旋流转变为电荷流。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad主方程形式，并基于含时广义吉布斯系综方法进行分析。

papers.title: Machine-learning test of the single-ion model for $dd$ excitations in cuprates
papers.abstract: We investigate $dd$ excitations in Resonant Inelastic X-ray Scattering spectra of YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_6$ and La$_2$CuO$_4$ using the local single-ion model. The data are analyzed by conventional global fitting and by a convolutional neural network trained within the same theoretical framework. For YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_6$, the excited state energies obtained with the two methods coincide, leading to the $xy$, $3z^2-r^2$, $xz/yz$ sequence for increasing energy. This result validates the use of machine learning tools for the analysis of RIXS spectra dominated by $dd$ excitations. By contrast, for La$_2$CuO$_4$, the two methods do not converge to a single solution, revealing the limitations of the single-ion model in describing $dd$ excitations in cuprates and pointing to the role of additional contributions beyond a purely local picture in shaping high-energy excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：machine-learning test、single-ion model、global fitting、convolutional neural network）；研究对象：铜氧化物超导体YBa₂Cu₃O₆和La₂CuO₄中共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）谱的dd激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于YBa₂Cu₃O₆，传统全局拟合与机器学习方法给出的激发态能量一致，验证了机器学习工具在分析dd激发主导的RIXS谱中的有效性；但对于La₂CuO₄，两种方法无法收敛到单一解，揭示了单离子模型在描述铜氧化物dd激发时的局限性，表明高能激发中可能存在超越纯局域图像的额外贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于YBa₂Cu₃O₆，传统全局拟合与机器学习方法给出的激发态能量一致，验证了机器学习工具在分析dd激发主导的RIXS谱中的有效性；但对于La₂CuO₄，两种方法无法收敛到单一解，揭示了单离子模型在描述铜氧化物dd激发时的局限性，表明高能激发中可能存在超越纯局域图像的额外贡献。；创新点：首次将卷积神经网络应用于铜氧化物RIXS谱中dd激发的分析，并与传统拟合方法进行系统性对比，从而检验单离子模型的适用性边界。
papers.method_zh: 采用局域单离子模型分析RIXS谱，分别通过传统全局拟合和在该理论框架内训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）进行数据处理与对比。

papers.title: Contactless terahertz mapping of wafer-scale superconducting NbTiN thin films
papers.abstract: For large-scale superconducting quantum technology, e.g. quantum computing, the homogeneity of wafer-scale superconducting thin films is vital for consistent performance of the fabricated devices. Terahertz (THz) spectroscopy as a contactless and non-destructive measurement technique is a powerful tool to characterize the superconducting films. In this work, a set of niobium titanium nitride (NbTiN) thin films on 4-inch and 6-inch silicon wafers, grown via plasma-enhanced magnetron sputtering, are investigated via THz spectroscopy: full wafers are mapped at room temperatures and exemplary segments are characterized at cryogenic temperatures. The deviations in observed sheet resistance depend on the used deposition device and the film thickness. While the deviations in superconducting sheet kinetic inductance match those of the normal-state sheet resistance, the critical temperature and energy gap exhibit little variation. This THz mapping technique demonstrates the feasibility of evaluating wafer-scale superconducting thin films before lithography, facilitating preparation of the thin films for reproducible device fabrication.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了通过太赫兹光谱对薄膜进行测量和表征，属于实验研究。；研究对象：晶圆级超导氮化铌钛（NbTiN）薄膜，具体为生长在4英寸和6英寸硅晶圆上的薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过太赫兹光谱技术实现了对晶圆级超导薄膜的非接触式、无损映射，发现薄膜的方块电阻偏差取决于沉积设备和膜厚，而超导临界温度和能隙变化很小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过太赫兹光谱技术实现了对晶圆级超导薄膜的非接触式、无损映射，发现薄膜的方块电阻偏差取决于沉积设备和膜厚，而超导临界温度和能隙变化很小。；创新点：展示了在光刻前即可评估晶圆级超导薄膜均匀性的可行性，有助于实现可重复的器件制备。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用太赫兹光谱技术，在室温下对整片晶圆进行映射测量，并在低温下对代表性样品进行表征；薄膜通过等离子体增强磁控溅射生长。

papers.title: Two-step growth of (In,Ga)N pseudo-substrates on GaN templates by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy
papers.abstract: (In,Ga)N layers are grown by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy on GaN templates. We introduce a two-step protocol that involves switching the growth conditions from initially N-stable to metal-stable. Reflection high-energy electron diffraction as well as scanning electron and atomic force microscopy reveal that the first step results in a rough intermediate surface with open pits, whereas the final surface is smooth. The narrow linewidth of the photoluminescence band indicates an excellent compositional homogeneity of the upper layer. Its in-plane lattice constant is determined to be $\approx$3.26 Åfrom X-ray diffraction measurements. This combination of favorable properties makes these layers attractive as pseudo-substrates for the growth of red-emitting (In,Ga)N light-emitting diodes. In particular, the approach presented here does not require any complex external processing and is, thus, scalable and economical.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了材料生长过程（plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy，等离子体辅助分子束外延）和多种表征手段（反射高能电子衍射、扫描电子显微镜、原子力显微镜、光致发光、X射线衍射）。；研究对象：在GaN模板上生长的(In,Ga)N薄膜，特别是作为伪衬底（pseudo-substrates）用于生长红光发光二极管的(In,Ga)N层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一种从氮稳定（N-stable）到金属稳定（metal-stable）的两步生长法，可以在GaN模板上获得表面光滑、组分均匀性极佳且面内晶格常数约为3.26 Å的(In,Ga)N薄膜，使其成为有吸引力的红光LED伪衬底材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一种从氮稳定（N-stable）到金属稳定（metal-stable）的两步生长法，可以在GaN模板上获得表面光滑、组分均匀性极佳且面内晶格常数约为3.26 Å的(In,Ga)N薄膜，使其成为有吸引力的红光LED伪衬底材料。；创新点：提出了一种无需复杂外部处理（如剥离、转移等）的两步生长协议，通过简单地切换生长条件（从N稳定到金属稳定）即可获得高质量的(In,Ga)N伪衬底，该方法具有可扩展性和经济性。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用等离子体辅助分子束外延（PAMBE）进行薄膜生长。使用反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）进行原位表面结构监测，利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和原子力显微镜（AFM）表征表面形貌，通过光致发光（PL）谱评估组分均匀性，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）测量面内晶格常数。

papers.title: Interface-Engineered Giant Multistate Resistance Switching in Altermagnetic CrSb Multiferroic Tunnel Junctions
papers.abstract: Altermagnets enable spin-split transport without stray magnetic fields, yet converting their momentum-dependent spin splitting into a strong tunnel-junction response requires interface-selected tunneling channels. Here, using density functional theory combined with nonequilibrium Green's function calculations, we demonstrate giant multistate resistance switching in CrSb/$α$-In$_2$Se$_3$ altermagnetic multiferroic tunnel junctions. The response is governed not by the bulk spin splitting of CrSb alone, but by a symmetry-selected interfacial mechanism in which Cr/Sb terminations and \textit{h}-BN or graphene insertion layers determine spin-channel matching, while ferroelectric polarization reshapes the electrostatic barrier. Symmetric and asymmetric terminations reverse the correspondence between parallel/antiparallel Néel-vector configurations and high-/low-resistance states, showing that the actual alignment of interfacial Cr moments selects the dominant tunneling channels. Monolayer-In$_2$Se$_3$ junctions exhibit four nonvolatile resistance states, with tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) and tunneling electroresistance (TER) reaching 1626\% and 2206\%, respectively, and increasing to 9576\% and 4144\% upon Fermi-level shifting. Finite-bias calculations further reveal robust spin filtering and tunable spin-polarized currents. Extending the barrier to bilayer In$_2$Se$_3$ introduces interlayer polarization coupling, enabling eight resistance states with maximum TMR and TER values of $3.77\times10^{4}\%$ and $4.18\times10^{5}\%$, respectively. These results establish interface symmetry, spin-channel matching, and ferroelectric barrier reconstruction as design principles for stray-field-free multistate spintronic tunnel devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using density functional theory combined with nonequilibrium Green's function calculations”（使用密度泛函理论结合非平衡格林函数计算）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料、体系是CrSb/α-In₂Se₃ 交替磁多铁隧道结。具体物理现象是：基于交替磁体（altermagnet）的隧道结中的巨大多态电阻开关效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过界面工程（包括Cr/Sb端接、插入h-BN或石墨烯层以及铁电势垒重构），在CrSb/α-In₂Se₃交替磁多铁隧道结中实现了巨大多态电阻开关，其隧穿磁电阻（TMR）和隧穿电阻（TER）可分别达到3.77×10⁴%和4.18×10⁵%的量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过界面工程（包括Cr/Sb端接、插入h-BN或石墨烯层以及铁电势垒重构），在CrSb/α-In₂Se₃交替磁多铁隧道结中实现了巨大多态电阻开关，其隧穿磁电阻（TMR）和隧穿电阻（TER）可分别达到3.77×10⁴%和4.18×10⁵%的量级。；创新点：揭示了决定交替磁体隧道结响应的关键并非体态自旋劈裂，而是由界面对称性、自旋通道匹配和铁电势垒重构共同决定的界面机制。通过界面工程，实现了从四态到八态的非易失性电阻状态，并展示了通过费米能级移动和势垒层厚度（单层到双层In₂Se₃）来调控TMR和TER的巨大潜力。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）结合非平衡格林函数（NEGF）计算。

papers.title: Drift-Induced Nonreciprocal Hyperbolic Polaritons in Graphene/$α$-MoO$_3$ Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Achieving optical isolation requires breaking symmetry between forward- and backward-propagating light, a long-standing challenge at the nanoscale in the absence of magnetic fields. Here we theoretically demonstrate electrically tunable nonreciprocal phonon-plasmon polaritons in a graphene/$α$-MoO$_3$/SiC heterostructure operating in the mid-infrared. A dc current in graphene induces a wavevector-dependent Doppler shift that breaks reciprocity and generates strong directional asymmetry in hybrid plasmon-phonon propagation. In the reciprocal regime, hybridization between graphene plasmons and hyperbolic phonon polaritons in $α$-MoO$_3$, further shaped by the SiC substrate, enables gate-controlled transitions of isofrequency contours, including canalization along orthogonal crystal axes. At drift velocities of 5% of the Fermi velocity, the system exhibits pronounced momentum-dependent nonreciprocity with contrast reaching $\sim$ 0.3, while directions orthogonal to the drift remain unaffected due to symmetry imposed constraints. Real-space calculations confirm that this momentum-space asymmetry translates into directional near-field intensity modulation. These results establish current-biased van der Waals heterostructures as a platform for electrically tunable, magnet-free nonreciprocal nanophotonics in the mid-infrared.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically demonstrate、calculations、momentum-space asymmetry。；研究对象：石墨烯/α-MoO₃/SiC异质结中的非互易声子-等离子体极化激元，具体为在中红外波段由直流电流驱动的非互易双曲极化激元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨烯中施加直流电流可诱导波矢依赖的多普勒频移，打破传播方向上的互易性，产生显著的动量空间非对称性；在漂移速度达到费米速度的5%时，非互易对比度可达约0.3。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在石墨烯中施加直流电流可诱导波矢依赖的多普勒频移，打破传播方向上的互易性，产生显著的动量空间非对称性；在漂移速度达到费米速度的5%时，非互易对比度可达约0.3。；创新点：提出利用电流偏置的范德华异质结实现无磁、电可调的非互易中红外纳米光子学平台，将石墨烯等离子体与α-MoO₃双曲声子极化激元的杂化与漂移诱导的非互易性相结合。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：基于多普勒频移机制分析非互易性，计算等频轮廓（isofrequency contours）的栅压调控转变，以及实空间近场强度分布。

papers.title: First-Order Topological FFLO Transition and Superconducting Diode Sign Reversal in Altermagnetic Nanowires
papers.abstract: Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state conventionally emerges via a second-order phase transition driven by finite magnetization. Here we show that a spin-orbit-coupled nanowire proximitized to $d$-wave altermagnets -- with zero net magnetization -- can realize topological FFLO states through a first-order transition, marked by a sharp sign-reversing superconducting diode effect. The altermagnetic field generates band-resolved competing pairing channels, giving rise to a double-valley free energy landscape whose global minimum switches discontinuously. It consequently leads to a first-order topological FFLO transition with simultaneous jumps in the Cooper pairing amplitude and finite center-of-mass momentum. Remarkably, this discontinuous topological reconfiguration substantially enhances the diode efficiency and drives a characteristic sharp sign reversal across the transition. The mechanism of such exotic phenomena is captured by Ginzburg--Landau theory. Our results provide a field-free altermagnetic route to topological FFLO states and identify their direct transport fingerprint.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“Ginzburg--Landau theory”等理论推导和模型分析关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合纳米线，与d波交变磁体（altermagnet）邻近耦合形成的超导体系，具体研究其中的Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov（FFLO）态及超导二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零净磁化条件下，通过一级相变实现了拓扑FFLO态，该相变伴随超导二极管效应的尖锐符号反转，且二极管效率显著增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零净磁化条件下，通过一级相变实现了拓扑FFLO态，该相变伴随超导二极管效应的尖锐符号反转，且二极管效率显著增强。；创新点：首次提出利用交变磁体（而非传统有限磁化）实现一级相变驱动的拓扑FFLO态，并揭示其与超导二极管符号反转的直接关联。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，包括Ginzburg--Landau理论框架，以及基于能带分辨的配对通道竞争和双谷自由能景观分析。

papers.title: Statistical equivalence of reduced gravity and enhanced friction in granular packings
papers.abstract: Using X-ray tomography, we compare granular packings prepared under buoyancy-reduced effective gravity with normal gravity packings of particles with systematically varied friction. We show that reducing gravity lowers the random loose packing limit in a manner analogous to increasing friction. Granular packings under reduced gravity and with enhanced friction exhibit identical volume distributions, compactivity, and entropy, indicating that both routes sample statistically equivalent Edwards volume ensembles of mechanically stable states. This equivalence originates from a common relaxation of the mechanical stability constraint: under both conditions, fewer particles are required to participate in the underlying load-bearing bridge structures, leading to a lower contact-number requirement and a higher density of mechanically stable states. Nevertheless, reduced gravity retains a distinct contact-scale signature through more isotropic contact orientations. These findings identify gravity as a physical control governing the statistical accessibility of mechanically stable states within the Edwards framework and provide a unified statistical description of granular packings formed through different physical routes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用X射线断层扫描（X-ray tomography）进行实验比较。；研究对象：颗粒堆积体（granular packings），具体比较了在减重力（buoyancy-reduced effective gravity）条件下制备的堆积体与在正常重力下通过系统改变颗粒摩擦系数制备的堆积体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 降低重力与增加摩擦在统计上是等价的：两者均能降低随机松散堆积极限，并产生相同的体积分布、紧密度和熵，表明它们采样了统计等价的Edwards体积系综。但减重力会保留更各向同性的接触取向这一独特特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：降低重力与增加摩擦在统计上是等价的：两者均能降低随机松散堆积极限，并产生相同的体积分布、紧密度和熵，表明它们采样了统计等价的Edwards体积系综。但减重力会保留更各向同性的接触取向这一独特特征。；创新点：首次通过实验证明，在Edwards统计力学框架下，重力（而非仅摩擦）可作为控制力学稳定态统计可达性的物理参数，并揭示了减重力与增摩擦在宏观统计等价性背后的共同微观机制（即承载桥结构所需参与颗粒数减少）。
papers.method_zh: X射线断层扫描（X-ray tomography）实验，用于测量颗粒堆积体的微观结构，并分析体积分布、紧密度、熵以及接触网络等统计性质。

papers.title: Bifurcation reordering programs snap-through symmetry in folded elastic ribbons
papers.abstract: Snap-through in slender elastic structures is often viewed as a sudden transition between stable configurations, yet the pathway taken during this transition can differ fundamentally. A structure may snap while preserving symmetry, or first lose symmetry and pass through an asymmetric state before reaching its final configuration. What selects between these pathways remains less well understood, especially when the geometry and loading are themselves symmetric. Here, we show that snap-through symmetry can be programmed by reordering competing bifurcations in folded elastic ribbons. We study an elastic ribbon with two localized folds placed symmetrically about the midpoint and show that varying the fold position changes the relative order of two instabilities: a symmetry-breaking pitchfork bifurcation and a saddle-node bifurcation on the symmetry-preserving branch. When the pitchfork bifurcation occurs first, the ribbon loses symmetry before snapping and follows an asymmetric pathway. Conversely, when the saddle-node bifurcation occurs first, the ribbon loses stability while remaining on the symmetric branch, resulting in a symmetry-preserving transition. Combining experiments, discrete differential geometry simulations and numerical continuation, we map this exchange in bifurcation ordering and construct a phase diagram that predicts the switch between asymmetric and symmetric snap-through regimes. A reduced-order double-mass von Mises truss model captures the same mechanism as a generic competition between symmetry-breaking and symmetry-preserving instabilities. These results establish bifurcation reordering as a geometric mechanism for programming snap-through pathways in slender elastic structures, offering a design principle for multistable systems, morphing structures and instability-based mechanical devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据关键词：experiments, discrete differential geometry simulations, numerical continuation, reduced-order model。；研究对象：具有两个对称折叠的弹性带（folded elastic ribbons）在压缩或加载过程中的突跳（snap-through）行为，特别是突跳路径的对称性选择机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变折叠位置，可以重新排序两种失稳模式（对称破缺的叉形分岔与对称保持的鞍结分岔）的发生顺序，从而编程控制弹性带在突跳过程中是保持对称性还是先失去对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变折叠位置，可以重新排序两种失稳模式（对称破缺的叉形分岔与对称保持的鞍结分岔）的发生顺序，从而编程控制弹性带在突跳过程中是保持对称性还是先失去对称性。；创新点：首次提出“分岔重排序”（bifurcation reordering）作为几何机制，用于编程控制细长弹性结构突跳路径的对称性，并构建了预测对称与非对称突跳区域转变的相图。
papers.method_zh: 实验（物理弹性带折叠加载测试）、离散微分几何模拟、数值延拓（numerical continuation）分析分岔结构，以及简化双质量von Mises桁架模型（reduced-order double-mass von Mises truss model）捕捉核心机制。

papers.title: How Topology Shapes the Phase Behavior of Polyelectrolytes
papers.abstract: We develop a topology-specific theory of polyelectrolyte coacervation using the random phase approximation and apply it to both simple and complex coacervation. Our results for stars and dendrimers show that more compact chain topologies display a greater propensity for liquid-liquid phase separation, as a function of both Bjerrum length and salt concentration. For mixtures of different topologies, we demonstrate that differences in polymer topology alone are sufficient to drive multiphase coacervation of polyelectrolytes, which we rationalize in terms of an effective $χ$ parameter. Analysis of a simplified global phase diagram reveals that the propensity for such topology-driven phase separation is largest at a finite molecular weight. Overall, our results establish polymer topology as a powerful design lever for tuning the phase diagram of charged macromolecules independently of molecular weight, net charge, and monomer chemistry, since changes in topology enable fine-tuning of the effective charge density without altering these molecular characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a topology-specific theory”、“using the random phase approximation”、“analysis of a simplified global phase diagram”。；研究对象：聚电解质的液-液相分离行为，具体包括简单凝聚（simple coacervation）和复杂凝聚（complex coacervation），研究对象为星形聚合物和树枝状大分子等不同拓扑结构的聚电解质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 更紧凑的链拓扑结构（如星形和树枝状大分子）在改变Bjerrum长度和盐浓度时，表现出更强的液-液相分离倾向；仅凭聚合物拓扑结构的差异就足以驱动多相凝聚，且这种拓扑驱动的相分离倾向在有限分子量下最大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：更紧凑的链拓扑结构（如星形和树枝状大分子）在改变Bjerrum长度和盐浓度时，表现出更强的液-液相分离倾向；仅凭聚合物拓扑结构的差异就足以驱动多相凝聚，且这种拓扑驱动的相分离倾向在有限分子量下最大。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
