papers.method_zh: 采用随机相位近似（Random Phase Approximation, RPA）构建了拓扑特异性的聚电解质凝聚理论，并基于有效χ参数对相行为进行分析。

papers.title: Kinetic Theory for the Shear Viscosity of Dense Binary Dipolar Fluid Mixtures
papers.abstract: We construct a kinetic theory for the shear viscosity of dense binary fluid mixtures of strongly-interacting dipolar hard spheres. We derive an expression for the pairwise correlations in the binary mixtures that is accurate up to packing fractions around 0.35. The approach is based on Enskog-Thorne theory, and inspired by the theory for dense pure fluids developed by Pousaneh and de Wijn. It relies on effective coupling parameters obtained from the pure fluids combined with mixing rules and a heuristic expression for the collision integral. We compare our results to viscosities obtained numerically from molecular-dynamics simulations of dipolar hard-sphere fluids. Our expression for the shear viscosity of the binary mixtures captures the density and composition dependent behavior of the binary dipolar fluids up to packing fraction of $ξ\lesssim 0.3$ without any mixture-derived fit parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：kinetic theory、derive an expression、Enskog-Thorne theory）；研究对象：稠密二元偶极硬球流体混合物的剪切粘度（输运现象）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于Enskog-Thorne理论和纯流体有效耦合参数，构建了无需混合拟合参数的剪切粘度表达式，该表达式在堆积分数ξ≲0.3范围内能准确捕捉二元偶极流体的密度和组分依赖行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于Enskog-Thorne理论和纯流体有效耦合参数，构建了无需混合拟合参数的剪切粘度表达式，该表达式在堆积分数ξ≲0.3范围内能准确捕捉二元偶极流体的密度和组分依赖行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Enskog-Thorne理论框架，结合Pousaneh和de Wijn发展的稠密纯流体理论，通过纯流体的有效耦合参数、混合规则以及碰撞积分的启发式表达式，推导出二元混合物中精确至堆积分数约0.35的成对关联函数，并与分子动力学模拟结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Absence of Spin-Glass Order on Migdal--Kadanoff Hierarchical Lattices near Three Dimensions
papers.abstract: We derive a rigorous sufficient condition for the absence of spin-glass order in the Ising spin glass with symmetric binary couplings on Migdal--Kadanoff (MK) hierarchical lattices with even branching number. The key observation is that a single exact renormalization-group step creates zero effective bonds with positive probability, thereby reducing the problem to bond percolation on the corresponding hierarchical lattice. When the induced dilution exceeds the percolation threshold, both spin-glass order and stiffness are absent at all temperatures, including zero temperature. As a consequence, our criterion gives a rigorous proof that the Ising spin glass on the square lattice does not exhibit a spin-glass phase within the MK approximation. More unexpectedly, by choosing sufficiently large scale factors and branching numbers, we construct MK hierarchical lattices whose fractal dimensions are arbitrarily close to three from below but still exhibit no spin-glass order. This sharply contrasts with numerical estimates obtained for MK hierarchical lattices with relatively small scale factors and branching numbers, which placed the lower critical dimension near \(2.52\).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“rigorous sufficient condition”、“exact renormalization-group step”、“theoretical proof”。；研究对象：Migdal–Kadanoff (MK) 层级晶格上的 Ising 自旋玻璃模型，具体研究其自旋玻璃有序相是否存在，以及下临界维度的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有偶数分支数的 MK 层级晶格上，通过严格条件证明自旋玻璃有序相不存在。特别地，当分形维度从下方趋近于3时，仍可构造出无自旋玻璃有序的 MK 晶格，这与之前数值估计的下临界维度约2.52形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有偶数分支数的 MK 层级晶格上，通过严格条件证明自旋玻璃有序相不存在。特别地，当分形维度从下方趋近于3时，仍可构造出无自旋玻璃有序的 MK 晶格，这与之前数值估计的下临界维度约2.52形成鲜明对比。；创新点：给出了一个严格的充分条件来证明 MK 层级晶格上 Ising 自旋玻璃无序相的存在，并首次构造出分形维度接近3但仍无自旋玻璃有序的晶格，挑战了此前基于小尺度因子和分支数数值估计的下临界维度结论。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格的重整化群（renormalization-group）方法，通过单步精确重整化产生零有效键的机制，将自旋玻璃问题转化为对应层级晶格上的键逾渗（bond percolation）问题，并利用逾渗阈值进行判断。

papers.title: Strong intervalley mixing between copropagating quantum Hall edge channels in a silicon MOSFET
papers.abstract: Copropagating quantum Hall edge channels provide a promising platform for compact electron interferometry and flying quantum states. In silicon, the valley degree of freedom offers a natural alternative to spin-resolved edge channels because spin-flip scattering is strongly suppressed by the weak spin-orbit interaction. Here, we investigate interchannel transitions between copropagating valley edge channels in a double-layer-gated silicon metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor. With the bulk filling factor set to $ν=2$, two spin-polarized valley edge channels are brought into close proximity near a depleted side gate. We observe strong intervalley mixing, with a transition probability close to 1/2, indicating nearly complete equilibration between the two valley edge channels. In contrast, interchannel transport between edge channels with different spin orientations shows negligible transition probability, consistent with suppressed spin-flip scattering in silicon. These results demonstrate that intervalley coupling at a Si/SiO$_2$ interface can provide a beam-splitter-like operation for copropagating valley edge channels, establishing a key building block toward compact silicon quantum Hall interferometers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：investigate、observe、demonstrate（实验观测与表征）。；研究对象：硅金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管（Si MOSFET）中同向传播的量子霍尔边缘通道之间的谷间混合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在体填充因子ν=2时，两个自旋极化的谷边缘通道在耗尽侧栅附近被拉近，观察到强谷间混合，跃迁概率接近1/2，表明两通道几乎完全平衡；而不同自旋取向的边缘通道间跃迁概率可忽略，证实硅中自旋翻转散射被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在体填充因子ν=2时，两个自旋极化的谷边缘通道在耗尽侧栅附近被拉近，观察到强谷间混合，跃迁概率接近1/2，表明两通道几乎完全平衡；而不同自旋取向的边缘通道间跃迁概率可忽略，证实硅中自旋翻转散射被抑制。；创新点：首次在硅基量子霍尔系统中实现同向传播谷边缘通道的类分束器操作，为构建紧凑型硅量子霍尔干涉仪提供了关键构建模块。摘要未突出说明与已有硅基谷电子学工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 双栅极硅MOSFET器件制备与低温电输运测量，通过调控体填充因子和侧栅电压控制边缘通道间距，测量通道间跃迁概率。

papers.title: Long range spatial correlations in the periodically driven transverse field Ising model
papers.abstract: We consider a periodically driven transverse field Ising model and study the long-time behavior of the correlations between the excitations in the spin chain. We show that the longest correlation length is defined by the interference between the topological defects induced by the analog of the Kibble-Zurek mechanism and those induced by the Floquet resonance. We show that although the correlations always have a finite correlation length since the system is integrable, the correlation length can be made arbitrarily large by tuning the drive period.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“consider”、“show”、“integrable”、“tuning”，全文为理论推导与数值分析，无实验或计算细节描述。；研究对象：周期性驱动的横场伊辛模型（periodically driven transverse field Ising model），具体研究该自旋链中激发之间的长时关联行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统中最长的关联长度由两类拓扑缺陷（类比Kibble-Zurek机制产生的缺陷与Floquet共振诱导的缺陷）之间的干涉决定；尽管系统可积导致关联长度有限，但通过调节驱动周期可以使关联长度任意增大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统中最长的关联长度由两类拓扑缺陷（类比Kibble-Zurek机制产生的缺陷与Floquet共振诱导的缺陷）之间的干涉决定；尽管系统可积导致关联长度有限，但通过调节驱动周期可以使关联长度任意增大。；创新点：揭示了周期性驱动系统中关联长度的新来源——即Kibble-Zurek机制与Floquet共振诱导缺陷之间的干涉效应，并指出通过调节驱动周期可实现对关联长度的可控放大。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于可积的横场伊辛模型，结合Kibble-Zurek机制与Floquet共振的类比，研究驱动下自旋链中激发关联的长时间行为。

papers.title: Isothermal compression of a Fermi gas to deep quantum degeneracy
papers.abstract: The standard approach for generating deeply degenerate quantum gases is evaporative or sympathetic cooling in a harmonic trap, after which the gas has reached its minimum entropy. All subsequent state transformations rely on adiabatic changes of a closed system, and coupling to the environment or non-adiabatic processes monotonically increase the entropy. Here, we demonstrate that this experimental paradigm can be bypassed by utilizing species-selective trapping with a low-dissipation optical tune-out trap in a dual-species mixture. We successfully reduce the entropy of a two-component fermionic quantum gas via isothermal compression within a bosonic bath, reaching deep quantum degeneracy of $T/T_F = 0.024^{+0.007}$, with $T_F$ the Fermi temperature. By characterizing the cross-dimensional relaxation and thermalization, we demonstrate that cooling light fermions with heavy bosons remains efficient and fast, even deep in the degenerate regime, where the thermalization time is found to be independent of $T/T_F$. Our results pave the way for direct cooling within optical lattices, box traps, or other complex potentials, thereby eliminating the reliance on adiabatic state transformations to reach strongly interacting many-body regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“demonstrate”、“characterizing”、“found to be”等描述实验操作和观测结果的词汇，并给出了具体的实验参数（如 $T/T_F = 0.024^{+0.007}$）。；研究对象：双组分费米子量子气体（具体为轻费米子与重玻色子的混合物），以及通过等温压缩实现深度量子简并的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用物种选择性光阱（光学调谐零陷阱）在双组分混合物中，通过重玻色子浴对轻费米子进行等温压缩，成功将费米气体的熵降低至 $T/T_F = 0.024^{+0.007}$ 的深度量子简并态，且该冷却过程在简并区依然高效快速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用物种选择性光阱（光学调谐零陷阱）在双组分混合物中，通过重玻色子浴对轻费米子进行等温压缩，成功将费米气体的熵降低至 $T/T_F = 0.024^{+0.007}$ 的深度量子简并态，且该冷却过程在简并区依然高效快速。；创新点：突破了传统通过谐振势阱中蒸发冷却或协同冷却达到最小熵后，只能依赖绝热过程进行状态变换的范式。证明了可以直接通过等温压缩（与环境耦合）来降低熵，从而为在光学晶格、盒型阱等复杂势阱中直接冷却并研究强关联多体系统提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用低耗散的物种选择性光学调谐零陷阱，在双组分（轻费米子-重玻色子）混合物中实现等温压缩。通过表征交叉维度的弛豫和热化过程，测量了费米气体的温度与热化时间。

papers.title: Topology and compact molecular orbitals in twisted bilayer WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Recent observations of superconductivity in twisted bilayer WSe$_2$ (tWSe$_2$) have motivated theoretical proposals for unconventional pairing mechanisms. A central question is whether band topology plays an essential role in the system's correlation physics. In this letter, we develop a first-principles-based description of the top moiré valence bands in tWSe$_2$. Using density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we identify the bands in the relevant range of twist angles to be topologically non-trivial, with the top valence bands carrying Chern numbers $C=(+1,+1)$ for the $K$ valley. In order to treat the strong correlation physics, we construct compact molecular orbitals directly from the DFT wave functions through a partial Wannierization procedure and with the guidance of spinful $C_{3z}$ symmetry representations. This yields a localized $f$ orbital together with a complementary topological $c$ orbital, allowing us to extract hopping and hybridization amplitudes from first principles. The resulting parameters provide an ab initio benchmark for the effective Hamiltonian. Our work establishes a foundation for understanding superconductivity in moiré TMDs and highlights tWSe$_2$ as a promising platform for exploring topological superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：first-principles-based description、density functional theory (DFT) calculations、partial Wannierization procedure。；研究对象：扭曲双层WSe₂（tWSe₂）中的莫尔超晶格价带顶，及其拓扑性质与强关联物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相关转角范围内，tWSe₂的顶层价带具有非平庸拓扑性质，在K谷携带陈数C=(+1,+1)；通过部分Wannier化方法可从第一性原理构建局域f轨道和互补的拓扑c轨道，为有效哈密顿量提供基准参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相关转角范围内，tWSe₂的顶层价带具有非平庸拓扑性质，在K谷携带陈数C=(+1,+1)；通过部分Wannier化方法可从第一性原理构建局域f轨道和互补的拓扑c轨道，为有效哈密顿量提供基准参数。；创新点：首次从第一性原理出发，通过部分Wannier化方法提取tWSe₂莫尔价带顶的局域化f轨道与拓扑c轨道，并给出跃迁和杂化强度的从头算基准参数，为理解莫尔过渡金属硫族化物中的超导机制及拓扑超导性提供了微观基础。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，结合部分Wannier化过程（partial Wannierization）和自旋分辨的C₃z对称性表示分析，从DFT波函数直接构造紧致分子轨道。

papers.title: General and scalable vapor etching and transformation platform for two-dimensional materials
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) nanomaterials derived from non-van der Waals (non-vdW) solids offer exceptional physicochemical properties, yet their synthesis is impeded by intrinsic covalent/metallic bonding and high surface reactivity of the precursors. Here, we report a general vapor-phase etching and transformation platform for producing a library of 36 2D carbides, nitrides, and carbonitrides, exhibiting electrical conductivities spanning six orders of magnitude. Using reactive vapors like hydrogen chloride, we selectively remove A-layers from MAX phases to yield well-defined layers (MXenes), including previously inaccessible semiconducting Hf2CTx. By varying the reactive vapor environment, MXenes can be engineered at X-site and surface-termination site and even be transformed into non-vdW layers such as 2D MAX phases. This general and scalable vapor-phase platform reframes 2D material synthesis, opening new avenues for various applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“report”“vapor-phase etching and transformation platform”“producing a library of 36 2D carbides, nitrides, and carbonitrides”表明该工作以实验合成为主。；研究对象：二维（2D）材料，具体包括从非范德瓦尔斯（non-vdW）固体（如MAX相）衍生的碳化物、氮化物和碳氮化物，以及二维MAX相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 报道了一种通用的气相刻蚀与转化平台，可制备36种二维碳化物、氮化物和碳氮化物，其电导率跨越六个数量级；并成功合成了此前难以获得的半导体Hf₂CTₓ。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：报道了一种通用的气相刻蚀与转化平台，可制备36种二维碳化物、氮化物和碳氮化物，其电导率跨越六个数量级；并成功合成了此前难以获得的半导体Hf₂CTₓ。；创新点：该平台具有通用性和可扩展性，能够合成多种二维材料（包括此前无法获得的半导体Hf₂CTₓ），并通过调控蒸气环境实现材料组成和结构的灵活设计，为二维材料合成提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 采用气相刻蚀与转化方法，使用反应性蒸气（如氯化氢）选择性去除MAX相中的A层，获得明确层状结构（MXenes）；通过改变反应性蒸气环境，可在X位和表面终止位对MXene进行工程化，甚至将其转化为非范德瓦尔斯层（如二维MAX相）。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Dirac Fermions and Structural Metastability in Pentagonal Monolayers of Transition-Metal Ditellurides
papers.abstract: The recent synthesis of pentagonal PdTe$_2$ monolayer motivates broader research interests in transition-metal ditellurides whose electronic phases are governed by symmetry and structural reconstruction. The pentagonal phase of transition-metal ditellurides exhibits electronic properties that are dramatically different from those of its hexagonal counterpart due to its lower crystalline symmetry. Using first-principles calculations, we study monolayer $X$Te$_2$ ($X=\mathrm{Pd},\mathrm{Pt},\mathrm{Ni}$) in both hexagonal and pentagonal polymorphs. By constructing a continuous structural interpolation between the hexagonal and pentagonal phases, we show that the semimetal (hex)-to-semiconductor (penta) transition occurs only after an intermediate structural threshold rather than at the onset of symmetry reduction. The gap opening coincides with the formation of Te--Te dimers, which drive the bonding--antibonding splitting of the Te $p$ states and reorganize the band edges. In addition, the nonsymmorphic symmetry of the pentagonal phase enforces band degeneracies at the Brillouin-zone boundary, leading to symmetry-protected two-dimensional (2D) Dirac states. These results establish pentagonal $X$Te$_2$ monolayers as a new class of 2D semiconductors in which symmetry constraints and local bonding collectively shape the unconventional semiconducting electronic structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用第一性原理计算”（first-principles calculations）。；研究对象：过渡金属二碲化物（$X$Te$_2$，$X=\mathrm{Pd},\mathrm{Pt},\mathrm{Ni}$）的五边形相单层，及其与六边形相的结构和电子性质对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 五边形相$X$Te$_2$单层是一种新型二维半导体，其能隙打开源于Te-Te二聚体形成导致的键合-反键合劈裂，而非单纯对称性降低；同时，非点式对称性在布里渊区边界强制产生对称性保护的二维狄拉克费米子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：五边形相$X$Te$_2$单层是一种新型二维半导体，其能隙打开源于Te-Te二聚体形成导致的键合-反键合劈裂，而非单纯对称性降低；同时，非点式对称性在布里渊区边界强制产生对称性保护的二维狄拉克费米子。；创新点：揭示了五边形相中半导体能隙出现的结构阈值（需超过中间结构阈值而非对称性降低的起点），并指出Te-Te二聚体形成是能隙打开的关键驱动力；同时发现非点式对称性强制产生的二维狄拉克态，将五边形$X$Te$_2$单层确立为一类由对称性和局域成键共同塑造非常规半导体电子结构的新二维材料体系。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT），通过构建六边形相与五边形相之间的连续结构插值路径，分析结构转变与电子结构演化的关系。

papers.title: Hot-Carrier Distribution Spectroscopy by Transconductance in Two-Dimensional Field-Effect Transistors
papers.abstract: The transconductance $g_m = dI_D/dV_G$ of a field-effect transistor (FET) is conventionally read as a proxy for carrier density. We show that it is instead a spectroscopic probe of the carrier distribution: because $g_m$ weights the spectral current $j(E)$ by the gate-voltage derivative $\partial f(E)/\partial V_G$ and integrates over energy, it is sensitive to the \emph{shape} of $f(E)$, not merely its integrated weight $n$. We develop an energy-resolved transport framework for two-dimensional (2D) FETs and, within a gate-independent spectral-kernel approximation, derive the decomposition $g_m = g_m^{(n)} + g_m^{(α)}$ into the conventional density-modulation term $g_m^{(n)}$ and a distribution-shape-driven term $g_m^{(α)}$. The latter, obtained as the residual after subtracting the smooth density-modulation background from the measured $g_m$, exhibits a characteristic anomalous peak at a gate voltage $V_G^{\rm pk}$. This peak has no counterpart in equilibrium transport and \emph{cannot be explained by carrier density modulation alone}. With the spectral kernel calibrated, the peak position and height -- extracted from standard DC/lock-in $g_m$ sweeps -- constrain the hot-carrier energy $E_0$, spectral width $σ$, and generation threshold $n_c$, realizing a steady-state, all-electrical spectroscopy of the carrier distribution. An optional time-resolved extension further recovers the carrier relaxation time $τ$ from the transient response following a pump excitation, establishing the 2D FET as a distribution-function spectrometer that requires no optical readout.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show, develop, derive, framework, approximation）；研究对象：二维场效应晶体管（2D FET）中的热载流子分布及其输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 跨导 \( g_m \) 不仅是载流子密度的探针，更是载流子分布函数形状的谱学探针；通过测量 \( g_m \) 中的异常峰，可实现全电学方式的热载流子能量、谱宽及产生阈值的稳态光谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：跨导 \( g_m \) 不仅是载流子密度的探针，更是载流子分布函数形状的谱学探针；通过测量 \( g_m \) 中的异常峰，可实现全电学方式的热载流子能量、谱宽及产生阈值的稳态光谱。；创新点：首次提出跨导可直接用于载流子分布函数的谱学测量，而非仅反映载流子密度；并实现了无需光学读出的稳态全电学热载流子光谱技术。
papers.method_zh: 建立了能量分辨的二维FET输运理论框架，在栅压无关的谱核近似下，将跨导分解为密度调制项 \( g_m^{(n)} \) 和分布形状驱动项 \( g_m^{(\alpha)} \)，并通过标准直流/锁相 \( g_m \) 扫描提取热载流子参数。

papers.title: Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy as a Universal Defect Fingerprinting Tool for Organic Halide Perovskite Solar Cells
papers.abstract: Organic-inorganic hybrid perovskites (OHPs) deliver certified single-junction power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) exceeding 26% and perovskite-silicon tandem values surpassing 34%, yet a substantial gap with the Shockley-Queisser (S-Q) limit persists-primarily due to grain-boundary (GB) defects that drive non-radiative recombination, ion migration, and degradation. Rational passivation demands a non-contact tool capable of identifying and quantifying specific defect species in device-relevant thin films, a capability absent from conventional probes. This short review demonstrates that terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS, 0.3-3.0 THz) fulfills this role. Across four OHP compositions fabricated by sequential vacuum evaporation (SVE)-MAPbI3, MAPbBr3, FAPbI3, and CsPbI3-the THz spectral window captures both intrinsic phonon modes and GB-localized molecular defect vibrations, enabling species-specific, quantitative characterization at room temperature. Notably, the oscillator strength of the SVE-specific 1.58 THz absorption in MAPbI3 scales linearly with XPS-quantified CH3NH2 defect concentration, establishing THz-TDS as a direct, non-destructive defect meter. Building on these findings, we propose a three-pillar framework for THz-guided defect engineering: (I) quantitative defect measurement via oscillator-strength analysis, (II) material-specific fingerprint identification from a systematically constructed THz library, and (III) fingerprint-guided defect elimination with real-time feedback-together defining a closed-loop quality-control cycle that connects spectroscopic diagnosis to passivation strategy and, ultimately, to enhanced solar-cell efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述性实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确标注为“short review”，且核心内容基于作者团队在四种钙钛矿组分上的THz-TDS实验数据（如MAPbI₃中1.58 THz吸收与缺陷浓度的线性标定）。；研究对象：有机-无机杂化卤化物钙钛矿（OHPs）太阳能电池中的晶界缺陷，具体涉及MAPbI₃、MAPbBr₃、FAPbI₃和CsPbI₃四种组分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS，0.3–3.0 THz）能够同时捕获本征声子模式和晶界局域分子缺陷振动，实现对特定缺陷物种的室温定量表征，从而作为一种普适性的非接触缺陷指纹识别工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS，0.3–3.0 THz）能够同时捕获本征声子模式和晶界局域分子缺陷振动，实现对特定缺陷物种的室温定量表征，从而作为一种普适性的非接触缺陷指纹识别工具。；创新点：首次将THz-TDS确立为一种可直接、非破坏性地定量测量钙钛矿薄膜中特定缺陷物种的“缺陷计”，并提出了基于THz指纹的闭环缺陷工程框架（定量测量→指纹识别→缺陷消除→实时反馈）。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段为太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS），样品制备采用顺序真空蒸发（SVE）法；缺陷浓度标定借助X射线光电子能谱（XPS）定量CH₃NH₂缺陷浓度，并与THz吸收的振子强度进行线性关联。

papers.title: Symbolic Predicate-Guided Language Agents for Inverse Design of Perovskite Oxides
papers.abstract: Efficient discovery of high-performance materials has been pursued through a variety of data- and AI-driven strategies, among which inverse design, generating materials from desired target properties, has emerged as an important paradigm. Large language models (LLMs) offer a complementary route for inverse materials design because their reasoning and in-context learning capability can be used not only to propose candidates but also to demonstrate interpretable design principles. In this work, we introduce a domain specific language (DSL)-guided strategy to improve the reasoning and design capability of LLM agents by translating natural language design rules into symbolic predicates encoded in a predefined chemistry DSL. These predicates allow the LLM agent to obtain statistical evidence from the accumulated materials data, enabling the agent to evaluate and refine its own reasoning during the design loop. Based on this strategy, we developed a multi-agent materials design framework, called Operational Rule-grounded CHEmical Search Through Reasoning Agents (ORCHESTRA), and applied it to the inverse design of double perovskite oxides under multiple target-property objectives. The results show that symbolic predicates help the LLM identify unsupported rules, validate newly proposed rules and improve the rule store over iterative design cycles. Compared with a strategy relying only on natural language rules, the DSL-guided framework showed the potential to improve materials design performance, particularly for challenging target properties. These findings suggest that mathematical and statistical grounding can enhance the reasoning capability of LLM agents in materials science and that LLM-based inverse design can be performed effectively without large task-specific datasets or additional model training.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要描述了基于大语言模型（LLM）和领域特定语言（DSL）的算法框架开发与应用，未提及具体实验操作。；研究对象：双钙钛矿氧化物（double perovskite oxides）的逆向设计。具体物理现象为：从目标性能出发，反向生成具有该性能的材料候选。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将自然语言设计规则转化为化学领域特定语言（DSL）中的符号谓词，可以显著提升大语言模型（LLM）在逆向材料设计中的推理能力，帮助其识别无效规则、验证新规则，并迭代优化规则库，从而在具有挑战性的目标性能上表现出更好的设计潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将自然语言设计规则转化为化学领域特定语言（DSL）中的符号谓词，可以显著提升大语言模型（LLM）在逆向材料设计中的推理能力，帮助其识别无效规则、验证新规则，并迭代优化规则库，从而在具有挑战性的目标性能上表现出更好的设计潜力。；创新点：提出了一种符号谓词引导的策略，通过将设计规则形式化为领域特定语言（DSL）中的符号谓词，为LLM的推理过程提供了数学和统计基础，从而克服了仅依赖自然语言规则的局限性，实现了无需大规模特定任务数据集或额外模型训练的高效逆向设计。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种名为ORCHESTRA（Operational Rule-grounded CHEmical Search Through Reasoning Agents）的多智能体材料设计框架。该框架的核心是使用预定义的化学领域特定语言（DSL）将自然语言设计规则编码为符号谓词，LLM智能体利用这些谓词从累积的材料数据中获取统计证据，以评估和优化自身推理过程。

papers.title: Exploring the Potential of BY3 (Y = P, As) Monolayers as High-Capacity and Rapid-Diffusion Anodes for Sodium-Ion Batteries
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) demands robust anode materials capable of delivering high specific capacities while maintaining rapid ion transport kinetics. In this work, we employ first-principles density functional theory (DFT) to systematically evaluate the two-dimensional BX3 (X = As, P) monolayers as high-performance anode candidates for SIBs. Our calculations reveal that both the BAs3 and BP3 frameworks exhibit excellent mechanical and dynamical stability alongside an intrinsic metallic character. These materials demonstrate a strong thermodynamic affinity for Na adsorption, driven by a synergistic ionic and covalent bonding mechanism that highly favors the H3 hollow site. Furthermore, they facilitate exceptionally fast charge and discharge kinetics, characterized by ultralow optimal Na-ion migration barriers of 0.19 eV and 0.26 eV for BAs3 and BP3, respectively. Crucially, projected density of states (PDOS) analyses confirm that both systems preserve their robust metallic conductivity even at their maximum theoretical sodiation limits (Na120B8X24), ensuring continuous and efficient electron transport throughout the electrochemical cycle. We predict low, stable average open-circuit voltages of 0.15 V for BAs3 and 0.18 V for BP3, alongside ultrahigh theoretical specific capacities of 1365 mAh g-1 and 3875 mAh g-1, respectively, which significantly outperform contemporary 2D SIB anodes. These compelling theoretical findings establish the BX3 monolayers as outstanding, structurally resilient candidates for next-generation, high-energy-density energy storage systems.

papers.title: exa-PD: A scalable high-performance workflow for multi-element phase diagram construction
papers.abstract: Exa-PD is a highly parallelizable workflow designed for the construction of multi-element phase diagrams (PDs). It uses standard sampling techniques, molecular dynamics (MD) and Monte Carlo (MC) as implemented in the LAMMPS package, to simultaneously sample multiple phases over a fine temperature-composition mesh for free-energy calculations. Parsl serves as the global workflow engine, coordinating large ensembles of MD and MC tasks to achieve massive parallelization with strong scalability. The resulting free energies of liquid and solid phases are then fed to CALPHAD modeling via the PyCalphad package to construct multi-element PDs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：workflow、molecular dynamics、Monte Carlo、CALPHAD modeling、PyCalphad。；研究对象：多元素相图（multi-element phase diagrams）的构建方法，具体涉及液态和固态相的自由能计算与相图建模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一种可高度并行化的计算工作流（Exa-PD）用于高效构建多元素相图。

papers.title: Data-efficient reconstruction of critical quantum dynamics via blind fractional-envelope extrapolation
papers.abstract: Simulating real-time dynamics of quantum systems is often limited to short times by entanglement growth. Finite-pole reconstructions such as linear prediction and related machineries extrapolate such data reliably when the spectrum is a finite set of excitations, but at criticality the low-energy spectrum is a power-law continuum $A(ω)\sim|ω|^{α-1}$ -- a branch cut whose real-time tail $G(t)\sim t^{-α}$ finitely many poles cannot represent. Here we develop a fractional-calculus-motivated envelope extrapolation for such data. Its structure is motivated by a fractional form of Schwinger--Dyson (fSD) equation, in which the Laplace symbol $s^α$ carries the branch cut analytically while the residual self-energy remains meromorphic. On real data we employ the corresponding operational alternative -- the exponent $α$ is selected blindly inside the fit window, the signal is detrended by $t^α$, the residual is fitted by a stabilized finite-pole model, and the algebraic envelope is restored. On the critical XXZ chain this blind fractional-envelope method (fSD for short) extrapolates short-time data typically several-fold more accurately than finite-pole methods, with the exponent $α$ identified blindly from the fit window alone and bracketing the closed-form Luttinger value at weak coupling. The same blind search finds the $z=2$ dilute-magnon exponent $α=1/2$ at the $Δ=1$ saturation transition, and the advantage persists in the gapped free-magnon phase with its sharp band edges. On noncritical dynamical mean-field spectra, whose low-frequency response is regular, fSD by contrast fails to select any stable fractional envelope and reduces to the standard pole result rather than manufacturing a spurious power law, making it an efficient and accurate route to quantum critical dynamics when only short simulation times are accessible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。关键词：fractional-calculus-motivated envelope extrapolation、finite-pole reconstruction、Schwinger–Dyson equation。；研究对象：量子临界动力学，具体包括临界XXZ链、Δ=1饱和转变处的z=2稀磁振子体系、有能隙的自由磁振子相，以及非临界动力学平均场谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于分数阶包络外推的盲选方法（fSD），能够从短时量子动力学数据中更准确地重构临界动力学行为，其外推精度显著优于传统有限极点方法，且不会在非临界体系中虚假产生幂律行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于分数阶包络外推的盲选方法（fSD），能够从短时量子动力学数据中更准确地重构临界动力学行为，其外推精度显著优于传统有限极点方法，且不会在非临界体系中虚假产生幂律行为。；创新点：首次将分数阶微积分思想引入量子动力学数据的外推重构，解决了传统有限极点方法无法有效处理临界点幂律连续谱（分支割）的问题，并实现了临界指数的盲选识别。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种受分数阶Schwinger–Dyson方程启发的包格外推方法：在拟合窗口内盲选指数α，用t^α对信号去趋势，对残差用稳定化有限极点模型拟合，再恢复代数包络。该方法无需预先知道临界指数，直接从数据中盲选。

papers.title: Ab initio time-dependent GW approach for nonequilibrium exciton-phonon coupled dynamics across momentum space
papers.abstract: The dynamics of optical excitations in materials generally involves intertwined electron-hole (e-h) and electron-phonon (e-ph) interactions out of equilibrium. However, a full theoretical description of such nonequilibrium dynamics requires a systematic treatment of the coherent excitonic excitations and exciton-phonon interactions across the entire crystal momentum space in real time, which remains a major challenge and out of reach for first-principles approaches. Here, we present a new ab initio time-dependent adiabatic GW methodology that incorporates full finite-momentum e-h and e-ph couplings, enabling real-time simulations of the coherently coupled exciton-phonon dynamics. The excitonic excitations are naturally described by the equation of motion of the interacting single-particle density matrix, whereas their couplings to phonons are formulated within a linear-response framework, hence the simulations can be efficiently carried out within a primitive unit cell. We demonstrate the capabilities of this new approach by investigating the direct-to-indirect exciton transitions in monolayer WSe2 in a pump-probe setup of time-resolved and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Our results reveal that the phonon-mediated ultrafast intervalley dynamics of excitons of this system is within ~0.5 ps, manifested as in-gap photoemission intensity transfer from the K-valley to the Q-valley. This work establishes a comprehensive and practical nonequilibrium Green's function framework for accurately simulating nonequilibrium and coherent excitations involving coupled excitons and phonons from first principles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：ab initio（第一性原理）、time-dependent GW approach（含时GW方法）、first-principles approaches（第一性原理方法）。；研究对象：非平衡态下激子-声子耦合动力学，具体材料为单层WSe₂中的直接-间接激子跃迁过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了单层WSe₂中声子介导的超快谷间激子动力学发生在约0.5皮秒内，表现为光发射强度从K谷向Q谷的带隙内转移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了单层WSe₂中声子介导的超快谷间激子动力学发生在约0.5皮秒内，表现为光发射强度从K谷向Q谷的带隙内转移。；创新点：首次实现了从第一性原理出发、在实时间内系统模拟整个晶体动量空间中相干激子-声子耦合动力学的完整理论框架，克服了此前第一性原理方法无法处理此类非平衡动力学的重大挑战。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种新的第一性原理含时绝热GW方法，该方法包含全有限动量电子-空穴和电子-声子耦合，通过相互作用单粒子密度矩阵的运动方程自然描述激子激发，并在线性响应框架内处理激子-声子耦合，可在原胞内高效进行实时模拟。

papers.title: Phase-Field Simulation of Dendrite Evolution in All-Solid-State Sodium Batteries during Cycling
papers.abstract: Dendrite growth during cycling remains a critical challenge for all-solid-state batteries (SSBs), limiting the full realization of their inherent safety and high energy density. In particular, the mechanisms of continuous dendrite penetration during charge-discharge cycling remain poorly understood and are difficult to characterize experimentally. This study applies a phase-field model, informed by density functional theory calculations, to rationalize and visualize the dendrite penetration behaviors during cycling in sodium (Na) SSBs with pure Na or Na-Sb alloy anodes and polycrystalline Na$_3$SbS$_4$ electrolyte. We show that dendrite stripping is intrinsically asymmetric with respect to plating due to grain boundary geometry, leading to the formation of isolated Na metal that persists between cycles. This residual Na metal becomes kinetically stabilized at grain-boundary junctions and is readily reactivated during subsequent plating, thereby accelerating and amplifying dendrite penetration. We further investigate the effects of applied voltage, solid-electrolyte microstructure, and anode chemistry on this phenomenon. These findings establish isolated Na metal as a key contributor for continued dendrite propagation in Na SSBs and provide design principles for stabilizing anode/electrolyte interfaces in Na SSBs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“phase-field model”（相场模型）、“density functional theory calculations”（密度泛函理论计算）、“rationalize and visualize”（合理化与可视化）。；研究对象：全固态钠电池在循环过程中，钠枝晶在固态电解质（多晶Na₃SbS₄）中的穿透与演化行为。具体涉及纯钠负极和Na-Sb合金负极。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了循环过程中枝晶剥离相对于沉积具有内在不对称性，导致残留的孤立钠金属在晶界处动力学稳定化，并在后续沉积中被重新激活，从而加速并加剧枝晶穿透。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了循环过程中枝晶剥离相对于沉积具有内在不对称性，导致残留的孤立钠金属在晶界处动力学稳定化，并在后续沉积中被重新激活，从而加速并加剧枝晶穿透。；创新点：首次通过相场模拟阐明了循环过程中残留孤立钠金属的形成机制及其作为持续枝晶传播关键驱动力的作用，并系统研究了电压、电解质微结构和负极化学性质对这一现象的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）计算参数化的相场模型（Phase-Field Model），对循环过程中的枝晶穿透行为进行模拟和可视化。

papers.title: Dynamical Polarization from Hidden Spin and Orbital Textures in p-Wave Magnets
papers.abstract: Period-averaged descriptions often miss essential features of driven quantum matter. We show that the micromotion of an optically driven $p$-wave magnet unveils a hidden net spin polarization, absent from both the equilibrium and period-averaged spin textures, which remain odd in momentum. This spin polarization oscillates at the drive frequency and is resonantly enhanced at the interband gap set by nonrelativistic exchange splitting. The drive further activates an orbital angular momentum governed by interband quantum geometry. While its linear response remains momentum-odd, nonlinear rectification yields a static, momentum-even orbital polarization for suitably oriented driving fields. These results establish $p$-wave magnets as a source of resonant ac spin and rectified dc orbital polarization: effects invisible to any period-averaged treatment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验或计算手段，主要基于理论分析（如“interband quantum geometry”“linear response”“nonlinear rectification”等理论框架术语）。；研究对象：光驱动下的p波磁体（p-wave magnet）中隐藏的自旋和轨道纹理（hidden spin and orbital textures）及其产生的动力学极化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光驱动p波磁体可产生周期平均处理无法捕捉的净自旋极化（交流振荡）和静态轨道极化（直流整流），前者在非相对论交换劈裂的带隙处共振增强，后者由带间量子几何调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光驱动p波磁体可产生周期平均处理无法捕捉的净自旋极化（交流振荡）和静态轨道极化（直流整流），前者在非相对论交换劈裂的带隙处共振增强，后者由带间量子几何调控。；创新点：揭示了p波磁体在光驱动下能产生周期平均描述完全缺失的交流自旋极化和直流轨道极化，突破了传统周期平均处理对驱动量子物质中隐藏极化的忽视。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：基于周期平均与微运动（micromotion）的对比分析、带间量子几何（interband quantum geometry）框架、线性响应与非线性整流（nonlinear rectification）机制。

papers.title: Fragmented ETH: Prethermalization, Timescales, and Ensemble Inequivalence
papers.abstract: We investigate how finite quantum systems with strong long-range interactions approach thermal equilibrium. Nearly conserved quantities inherited from the fully connected limit fragment the Hilbert space and give rise to a many-body spectrum split into energy bands. As a result, equilibration becomes anomalously slow and proceeds through long-lived prethermal plateaus. This two-stage equilibration process is, however, not universal. We uncover the mechanism that determines which observables and initial states exhibit, or evade, prethermal plateaus. We also develop a perturbative theory that provides analytical expressions for both the height of the prethermal plateau and its timescale. Despite the lack of global ergodicity, quantum chaos develops within individual energy bands, enabling the definition of microcanonical ensembles within the bands. This supports a band-resolved formulation of thermalization, which we term fragmented eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (fETH). Unlike conventional ETH, finite-size scaling in fETH obeys a symmetry-imposed selection rule that restricts which system sizes can be compared. This band-resolved description has direct consequences for equilibrium statistical mechanics. While microcanonical ensembles remain confined to a single band, canonical ensembles mix different bands. This mismatch explains ensemble inequivalence without invoking equilibrium phase transitions. Our results apply to a broad class of Hamiltonians exhibiting Hilbert-space fragmentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、develop a perturbative theory、formulation of thermalization、fragmented eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (fETH)。；研究对象：具有强长程相互作用的有限量子系统，特别是其热化过程、预热化现象以及希尔伯特空间碎片化导致的非平衡统计力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强长程相互作用导致希尔伯特空间碎片化，能谱分裂为多个能带，系统通过长寿命的预热化平台实现异常缓慢的两阶段热化；提出碎片化本征态热化假说（fETH），并发现微正则系综与正则系综因能带混合差异而导致系综不等价性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强长程相互作用导致希尔伯特空间碎片化，能谱分裂为多个能带，系统通过长寿命的预热化平台实现异常缓慢的两阶段热化；提出碎片化本征态热化假说（fETH），并发现微正则系综与正则系综因能带混合差异而导致系综不等价性。；创新点：提出碎片化本征态热化假说（fETH），揭示能带内量子混沌与全局非遍历性的共存；发现有限尺寸标度受对称性选择定则约束，限制了可比较的系统尺寸；从能带混合角度解释系综不等价性，无需依赖平衡相变。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于全连接极限下的近似守恒量进行希尔伯特空间碎片化分析；微扰理论推导预热化平台高度和时标的解析表达式；能带分辨的微正则系综定义与有限尺寸标度分析。

papers.title: Field-induced first order transitions and phase coexistence in the Kitaev quantum spin liquid candidate BaCo2(AsO4)2
papers.abstract: BaCo2(AsO4)2 (BCAO) is an insulating Kitaev quantum spin liquid candidate with a rich low-temperature phase diagram. Below 5 K, it exhibits double-zigzag magnetic order. Upon application of an in-plane magnetic field, the magnetic structure first transforms into an up-up-down (UUD) state near 0.12 T and then enters a fully spin-polarized ferromagnetic (FM) state near 0.5 T. In the narrow field regime close to the polarized phase, a finite residual thermal conductivity has been reported, suggesting a possible field-induced quantum spin liquid phase. Using neutron scattering, we show that the field-induced double-zigzag-to-UUD transition near 0.15 T is accompanied by the emergence of a cluster of localized UUD spin excitations that coexist with conventional spin waves. Upon further increasing field, BCAO undergoes a first-order UUD-to-FM transition with coexistence of UUD and FM phases, accompanied by a sharp response in the spin Seebeck coefficient. These results do not support a quantum spin liquid scenario near the UUD-to-FM critical field. Instead, modeling indicates that the broad excitations arise from bound spin-flip pairs, while a low-lying dispersive branch near the FM phase boundary carries the same sign of magnetization as the FM order. These excitations naturally account for the observed sign of the spin Seebeck response and are likely relevant to the thermal conductivity near the critical field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：neutron scattering、spin Seebeck coefficient、field-induced transitions）；研究对象：Kitaev量子自旋液体候选材料BaCo₂(AsO₄)₂（BCAO）在面内磁场下的相变与相共存行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BCAO中，磁场诱导的双锯齿形磁序到上-上-下（UUD）磁序的转变伴随局域化UUD自旋激发与常规自旋波的共存；UUD到铁磁（FM）相的转变是一级相变，伴随UUD与FM相的共存，且自旋Seebeck系数出现尖锐响应。这些结果不支持在UUD-FM临界场附近存在量子自旋液体相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BCAO中，磁场诱导的双锯齿形磁序到上-上-下（UUD）磁序的转变伴随局域化UUD自旋激发与常规自旋波的共存；UUD到铁磁（FM）相的转变是一级相变，伴随UUD与FM相的共存，且自旋Seebeck系数出现尖锐响应。这些结果不支持在UUD-FM临界场附近存在量子自旋液体相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 中子散射（neutron scattering）测量磁激发谱，结合自旋Seebeck系数测量，以及理论建模（modeling）分析激发性质。

papers.title: Nanoscale stray fields from micromagnets for optimal spin qubit architecture
papers.abstract: On-chip micromagnets generate local magnetic-field asymmetries, enabling electrical control of spin qubits via electric dipole spin resonance and their integration into circuit quantum electrodynamics (QED) architectures. Accurate prediction of spin-qubit performance requires modeling micromagnet stray fields beyond the saturated-magnet approximation, accounting for nonuniform magnetization. Here, we combine thin-film characterization of Co, Co/Ta multilayers, and CoFe films with nanoscale stray-field measurements using NV-center magnetometry in the unsaturated regime to establish a reliable micromagnetic simulation framework. We show that CoFe micromagnets generate antisymmetric fields in double quantum-dot geometries exceeding +/- 100mT, owing to their high saturation magnetization and favorable magnetocrystalline anisotropy. For spin qubits coupled to microwave resonators, the predicted spin-photon coupling reaches $\left| g_s/g_c \right| \approx 0.5$, where $g_c$ denotes the charge-photon coupling strength of the underlying charge qubit, highlighting the potential for high-fidelity operations in circuit QED architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含了“薄膜表征”（实验）和“微磁模拟框架”（计算）。；研究对象：片上微磁体产生的杂散场，及其在自旋量子比特架构（特别是与电路量子电动力学架构集成）中的应用。具体材料包括Co、Co/Ta多层膜和CoFe薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CoFe微磁体在双量子点结构中能产生超过±100 mT的反对称场，并且对于与微波谐振器耦合的自旋量子比特，其自旋-光子耦合强度可达电荷-光子耦合强度的约0.5倍，展示了在电路QED架构中实现高保真度操作的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CoFe微磁体在双量子点结构中能产生超过±100 mT的反对称场，并且对于与微波谐振器耦合的自旋量子比特，其自旋-光子耦合强度可达电荷-光子耦合强度的约0.5倍，展示了在电路QED架构中实现高保真度操作的潜力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1. 结合了薄膜表征与NV中心磁强计测量，在非饱和状态下校准微磁模拟，从而建立了更可靠的模拟框架。2. 定量展示了CoFe微磁体在优化自旋量子比特性能（特别是自旋-光子耦合强度）方面的优势。
papers.method_zh: 1. 实验：对Co、Co/Ta多层膜和CoFe薄膜进行薄膜表征；利用NV中心磁强计在非饱和磁化状态下进行纳米尺度的杂散场测量。2. 计算：建立可靠的微磁模拟框架，该框架超越了饱和磁化近似，考虑了非均匀磁化。

papers.title: Spontaneous Nanopatterning and Strain Relaxation in SiGe Layers Grown by Oxidative Solid Phase Epitaxy
papers.abstract: The wafer-scale monolithic integration of III-V materials on Si would lead to revolutionary optoelectronic hardware for data, computing and other applications. However, heteroepitaxy of III-Vs on Si requires overcoming the large lattice and thermal mismatches between the materials and reducing threading dislocations densities. In this work, we explore the oxidative solid phase epitaxy (SPE) of Ge+ implanted Si(111) to form ultra-thin strain-relieving SiGe metamorphic buffer layers for heteroepitaxy on Si. The SPE process is shown to result in a nanopatterning of the Ge concentration variation across the sample surface, visible by scanning and transmission electron microscopy (SEM and TEM). The concentration patterning is the result of a hexagonal network of Shockley partial dislocations at the SiGe/Si interface. Analyzing the pattern spacing observed by SEM is demonstrated as an easy, non-destructive method for obtaining the local strain state of SiGe layers. This work is important for engineering ultra-thin SiGe metamorphic buffer layers for III-V optoelectronics heteroepitaxy on the silicon platform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验过程（氧化固相外延生长）、表征手段（SEM、TEM）和结果分析。；研究对象：在Si(111)衬底上通过氧化固相外延生长的超薄SiGe应变缓冲层，以及其中自发形成的纳米级Ge浓度图案和应变弛豫现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧化固相外延过程会在SiGe/Si界面处形成六角形的Shockley不全位错网络，该网络导致样品表面出现Ge浓度的纳米级图案化。通过分析该图案的间距，可以作为一种简单、非破坏性的方法来获取SiGe层的局部应变状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧化固相外延过程会在SiGe/Si界面处形成六角形的Shockley不全位错网络，该网络导致样品表面出现Ge浓度的纳米级图案化。通过分析该图案的间距，可以作为一种简单、非破坏性的方法来获取SiGe层的局部应变状态。；创新点：提出了一种利用氧化固相外延自发形成纳米图案化SiGe缓冲层的新方法，并证明了通过SEM观察图案间距即可无损地评估局部应变，为在硅平台上工程化超薄SiGe缓冲层以用于III-V族光电子器件异质外延提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用氧化固相外延（Oxidative Solid Phase Epitaxy, SPE）技术，对Ge+注入的Si(111)进行退火处理。表征手段包括扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）。

papers.title: Thermo-elastic properties of hydrated epoxy-graphene nanocomposites from ensemble-based molecular dynamics simulations
papers.abstract: Epoxy-based materials are inherently hygroscopic, absorbing moisture from the environment, which can significantly alter their short and long-term performance. The presence of graphene is often considered as a potential candidate to act as a microscopic barrier, mitigating the adverse effects of hydration on the matrix. This study investigates the impact of hydration on the glass transition and elastic mechanical properties of epoxy resins and their graphene nanocomposites, focusing on water content up to 5 %wt. Using large-ensemble molecular dynamics simulations, we analyze the temperature-driven glass transition and mechanical response of both neat epoxy and epoxy-graphene systems under varying hydration levels. Our results reveal a distinct threshold at 3 %wt water content: below this, hydration primarily reduces the glass transition temperature, while mechanical properties remain unaffected. Beyond 3 %wt, however, the mechanical properties deteriorate, highlighting a non-linear sensitivity to water uptake. Furthermore, we emphasize the critical role of ensemble size in ensuring the reliability of molecular dynamics predictions for such heterogeneous systems. Our simulations demonstrate that ensembles substantially larger than current state-of-the-art standards are necessary to achieve converged distributions of the predicted mechanical properties, particularly in highly heterogeneous hydrated epoxy-graphene nanocomposites. These findings provide novel insights into the hydration behavior of epoxy-based materials and underscore the potential of graphene to enhance their environmental resistance. This work also advances the understanding of structure-property relationships in polymer nanocomposites, offering guidance for the design of more robust materials in humid environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）、large-ensemble（大系综）。；研究对象：水合环氧树脂及其石墨烯纳米复合材料（hydrated epoxy-graphene nanocomposites），具体研究水含量（最高5 wt%）对玻璃化转变和弹性力学性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 水含量存在一个3 wt%的阈值：低于该阈值时，水合作用主要降低玻璃化转变温度，力学性能不受影响；高于该阈值时，力学性能开始恶化，表现出对水吸收的非线性敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：水含量存在一个3 wt%的阈值：低于该阈值时，水合作用主要降低玻璃化转变温度，力学性能不受影响；高于该阈值时，力学性能开始恶化，表现出对水吸收的非线性敏感性。；创新点：揭示了水合环氧-石墨烯纳米复合材料中力学性能对水含量的非线性响应阈值（3 wt%），并指出当前标准系综大小不足以可靠预测此类高度异质体系的力学性能，需要显著更大的系综才能获得收敛的分布结果。
papers.method_zh: 基于大系综的分子动力学模拟（large-ensemble molecular dynamics simulations），分析温度驱动的玻璃化转变和力学响应，并特别强调了系综大小对预测结果可靠性的关键作用。

papers.title: Quantum-classical crossover in fault-tolerant quantum dynamics simulation
papers.abstract: While quantum computers promise to solve classically intractable problems, identifying the point at which fault-tolerant quantum computation outperforms the best classical algorithms for practical applications remains an outstanding challenge. Here we establish a concrete quantum-classical crossover for quantum many-body dynamics under realistic hardware conditions. We introduce a scalable fault-tolerant framework that combines coherent observable estimation with a space-time-efficient implementation of non-Clifford rotations, suppressing the residual logical errors that limit existing partially fault-tolerant approaches. A benchmark against state-of-the-art tensor-network and variational Monte Carlo algorithms reveals a concrete crossover for mixed-field Ising dynamics at modest system sizes. For a physical error rate of $p=10^{-3}$, fault-tolerant simulation requires approximately 2 hours and $3.7 \times 10^5$ physical qubits for a 100-site 1D system, whereas tensor network approaches would require about 100 years. For 2D models, where rapid entanglement growth limits the classical evolution time, we project quantum runtimes within minutes. A physical error rate of $p=10^{-4}$ leads to at least an order of magnitude reduction in qubit count ($3.1 \times 10^4$ physical qubits) and runtime (minutes for 1D and seconds for 2D). The reduction in quantum runtime arises from our improved rotation-state injection and co-design of quantum error correction and observable-estimation protocols, which jointly suppress logical-error accumulation and reduce sampling overhead. Our results establish a scalable route towards practical quantum advantage and identify quantitative engineering targets for future fault-tolerant architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“建立了一个可扩展的容错框架”、“与最先进的张量网络和变分蒙特卡洛算法进行基准测试”，并给出了具体的量子运行时和物理量子比特数等计算预测。；研究对象：容错量子计算在模拟量子多体动力学（具体为混合场伊辛模型动力学）中的性能，以及其与经典算法（张量网络、变分蒙特卡洛）的交叉点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在现实的硬件条件下（物理错误率p=10^{-3}），对于中等尺寸（100个格点）的一维混合场伊辛模型，容错量子模拟（约2小时）已显著优于经典张量网络算法（约100年），确立了具体的量子-经典交叉点。对于二维模型，量子模拟的优势更为显著（几分钟内完成）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在现实的硬件条件下（物理错误率p=10^{-3}），对于中等尺寸（100个格点）的一维混合场伊辛模型，容错量子模拟（约2小时）已显著优于经典张量网络算法（约100年），确立了具体的量子-经典交叉点。对于二维模型，量子模拟的优势更为显著（几分钟内完成）。；创新点：1. 在现实硬件条件下，为量子多体动力学模拟建立了一个具体的、定量的量子-经典交叉点，而非泛泛而谈。2. 提出了一种改进的旋转态注入方法，并与量子纠错和可观测量估计协议进行协同设计，有效抑制了逻辑错误累积并降低了采样开销，从而大幅减少了量子运行时和所需的物理量子比特数。
papers.method_zh: 1. 提出了一个可扩展的容错量子计算框架，该框架结合了相干可观测量估计与时空高效的非克利福德旋转实现。2. 通过与最先进的经典算法（张量网络、变分蒙特卡洛）进行性能基准测试。3. 对量子运行时和物理量子比特数进行了定量估算，并分析了物理错误率（p=10^{-3}和p=10^{-4}）的影响。

papers.title: Symmetry extension by condensation defects II: general dimensions and higher-groups
papers.abstract: We discuss a class of symmetry structures in general spacetime dimension that arise when gauging symmetries in theories with a cubic 't Hooft anomaly. The anomaly mixes two Abelian discrete symmetries $A$ and $B$ with a characteristic class for an additional symmetry $C$, and we gauge $A\times B$. The novelty of this construction is that the resulting symmetry structure involves certain condensation defects of the dual symmetry $\widehat{A}\times\widehat{B}$. Specifically, these defects generate an invertible symmetry that extends $C$, either as an ordinary group extension or as a higher-group, depending on the characteristic class. We describe the corresponding charged operators and states, and illustrate the mechanism in several examples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：gauging symmetries, 't Hooft anomaly, higher-group, condensation defects。；研究对象：一般时空维度下，由立方't Hooft反常诱导的对称性结构，具体涉及两个阿贝尔离散对称性A和B的规范，以及由此产生的对另一对称性C的扩展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 规范具有立方't Hooft反常的A×B对称性后，产生的对称性结构包含对偶对称性Ĉ×B̂的凝聚缺陷，这些缺陷生成一个可逆对称性，该对称性根据特征类不同，以普通群扩展或高群形式扩展对称性C。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：规范具有立方't Hooft反常的A×B对称性后，产生的对称性结构包含对偶对称性Ĉ×B̂的凝聚缺陷，这些缺陷生成一个可逆对称性，该对称性根据特征类不同，以普通群扩展或高群形式扩展对称性C。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用场论中的对称性规范（gauging）方法，结合't Hooft反常分析，以及凝聚缺陷（condensation defects）的构造与分类，在一般时空维度下讨论对称性扩展机制。

papers.title: A phenomenological multiscale framework for orientational interactions and viscoelasticity in migrating epithelial monolayers
papers.abstract: Collective migration of epithelial monolayers emerges from the interplay between mechanical interactions and biochemical signalling. Here, we present a phenomenological mechanobiological framework linking cell-scale orientational interactions to tissue-scale mechanics. We distinguish reversible and irreversible head-on and glancing collisions, showing that reversible interactions store orientational mechanical energy while preserving collision geometry, whereas irreversible interactions dissipate energy and alter cell orientation. The balance between energy storage and dissipation governs collective migration, mechanical feedback, and density-dependent processes including cell jamming and live cell extrusion. These interactions regulate cell elasticity, contractility, and adhesion, thereby modifying epithelial surface tension and the effective viscoelastic response of the monolayer. We quantify these effects using orientational interaction potentials, an effective second virial coefficient, and dimensionless measures of stored and dissipated orientational energy. The relative contribution of these mechanisms increases with cell packing density, becoming dominant near the jamming transition. This framework provides a constitutive interpretation connecting collision-induced orientation dynamics with emergent epithelial rheology and suggests how density-dependent interaction regimes shape collective migration and tissue viscoelasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“phenomenological mechanobiological framework”（现象学机械生物学框架）、“constitutive interpretation”（本构解释），属于理论建模与框架构建。；研究对象：迁移中的上皮单层细胞集体，具体研究细胞间定向相互作用（包括可逆与不可逆碰撞）如何影响组织尺度的力学行为，如粘弹性、表面张力、细胞堵塞与挤出。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 可逆的细胞碰撞储存定向机械能并保持碰撞几何，不可逆碰撞则耗散能量并改变细胞取向；能量储存与耗散的平衡调控集体迁移、力学反馈及密度依赖过程（如细胞堵塞与挤出），且这些机制随细胞堆积密度增加而增强，在堵塞转变附近占主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：可逆的细胞碰撞储存定向机械能并保持碰撞几何，不可逆碰撞则耗散能量并改变细胞取向；能量储存与耗散的平衡调控集体迁移、力学反馈及密度依赖过程（如细胞堵塞与挤出），且这些机制随细胞堆积密度增加而增强，在堵塞转变附近占主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个现象学多尺度框架，利用定向相互作用势、有效第二维里系数以及储存与耗散定向能量的无量纲量来量化细胞尺度定向相互作用与组织尺度力学之间的耦合。

papers.title: Conditional Euclidean-Hamiltonian reductions for sign-problem toy models
papers.abstract: Euclidean Monte Carlo methods are effective when the path-integral weight is real and nonnegative, but finite-density fermion systems often produce sign-changing or complex scalar weights after the fermionic sector is traced out. Hamiltonian formulations avoid this complex-weight sampling problem but face rapid Hilbert-space growth. This paper studies a conditional Euclidean-Hamiltonian (CEH) reduction that combines these two descriptions. The calculation is organized around a Monte Carlo-tractable reference problem and a residual active sector. Instead of tracing the active sector into a determinant or scalar weight, CEH keeps it operator-valued and uses the reference calculation to determine projected correlation or transfer matrices. These matrices define a finite effective Hamiltonian, with the remaining finite-density dependence introduced after projection. At finite rank, the result is an effective model whose accuracy must be tested through basis enlargement, metric conditioning, stochastic matrix-element errors, and number-sector diagnostics. The construction is examined in three finite benchmarks. A two-channel oscillator tests conditional basis compression; a positive-measure stochastic calculation tests correlation-matrix harvesting and GEVP extraction, including a comparison with a PDMS-style estimator; and a four-site Hubbard ring combines a finite-budget determinant-sign stress test with finite-density continuation in non-target active spaces. The benchmarks support the proposed trade from scalar sign reweighting to a monitored active-space approximation in structured finite models, but they do not provide an end-to-end stochastic CEH treatment of the Hubbard sign problem or establish favorable scaling. Usefulness requires both low-rank approximability and efficient extraction of the required projected matrix data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Euclidean Monte Carlo、Hamiltonian formulations、conditional Euclidean-Hamiltonian (CEH) reduction、stochastic calculation。；研究对象：符号问题（sign problem）的玩具模型，具体包括：双通道谐振子（two-channel oscillator）、正测度随机计算模型、四格点Hubbard环（four-site Hubbard ring）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种条件欧几里得-哈密顿量（CEH）约化方法，将符号重加权问题转化为受监控的活性空间近似，在结构化有限模型中可行，但未实现端到端的随机CEH处理或证明有利的标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种条件欧几里得-哈密顿量（CEH）约化方法，将符号重加权问题转化为受监控的活性空间近似，在结构化有限模型中可行，但未实现端到端的随机CEH处理或证明有利的标度行为。；创新点：提出将欧几里得路径积分与哈密顿量描述结合的条件约化框架，用活性空间近似替代标量符号重加权，并引入基扩展、度量条件、随机矩阵元误差和数区诊断等可监控的精度检验手段。摘要未突出说明与已有方法的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: CEH约化方法：以蒙特卡洛可处理的参考问题为基础，保留活性区为算符值，通过参考计算提取投影关联矩阵或转移矩阵，构建有限有效哈密顿量。在三个基准模型中测试了条件基压缩、关联矩阵提取与GEVP求解、有限预算行列式符号应力测试及非目标活性空间的有限密度延拓。

papers.title: Sub-microsecond conformational dynamics in an optical nanocavity
papers.abstract: Microsecond conformational changes underlie many protein functions, but ensemble averaging has been needed to observe them without labels. Single-shot measurements on individual proteins have had insufficient speed, while protein Brownian-motion has obscured signals. Here, we report a fibre-integrated silicon-photonic sensor that overcomes these barriers, resolving protein dynamics at sub-microsecond speeds in continuous single-shot measurements that can extend over minutes. This is achieved by combining far-sub-wavelength optical field confinement with high optical field uniformity that suppresses protein Brownian-motion by a factor of sixty. In single-shot measurements on ferritin molecules, we observe tens of thousands of transitions consistent with conformational fluctuations of the ferritin shell, resolving them over timescales as short as 400 ns. The ability to continuously monitor transitions over long times reveals switching kinetics, memory effects and molecular heterogeneity hidden in ensemble averages. This opens a new path to improved mechanistic understanding of protein function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：single-shot measurements、fibre-integrated silicon-photonic sensor、optical field confinement。；研究对象：蛋白质（铁蛋白，ferritin）在亚微秒时间尺度上的构象动力学（conformational dynamics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一种新型光纤集成硅光子传感器，实现了对单个蛋白质分子构象涨落的连续、单次测量，时间分辨率达到400纳秒，并揭示了系综平均所隐藏的开关动力学、记忆效应和分子异质性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一种新型光纤集成硅光子传感器，实现了对单个蛋白质分子构象涨落的连续、单次测量，时间分辨率达到400纳秒，并揭示了系综平均所隐藏的开关动力学、记忆效应和分子异质性。；创新点：该工作首次实现了在亚微秒时间尺度上对单个蛋白质构象动力学进行无标记、连续的单次测量，克服了此前单次测量速度不足以及布朗运动信号干扰的障碍。其核心创新在于传感器设计，通过同时实现极小的光模体积和极高的场均匀性，有效抑制了布朗运动噪声。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用了一种光纤集成的硅光子纳米腔传感器。该传感器通过远亚波长光场约束（far-sub-wavelength optical field confinement）与高光场均匀性（high optical field uniformity）相结合，将蛋白质布朗运动的影响抑制了60倍，从而实现了对单个铁蛋白分子长达数分钟的连续单次测量。

papers.title: Reconstruction of the noise correlation spectral density from the cavity emission in a two-qubit system
papers.abstract: A significant challenge in the field of large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computation is the influence of noise. In addition to the influence of noise on individual qubits, the smaller additional effect of noise correlations is also of high significance because correlated errors pose a challenge for quantum error correction. We describe the dynamics of two cavity-coupled qubits that are subject to correlated noise, assuming that the qubits are affected by longitudinal noise and not coupled directly. We find that the cavity emission enables the characterization of the noise correlations and describe the cases of white noise, quasi-static noise, and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise. For a known frequency spectrum, the reconstruction of the noise correlation spectral density from the cavity emission is possible by averaging over many different noise realizations. We demonstrate that, in the case of white noise, the noise correlation effects scale with the fifth order of the cavity-qubit coupling constant and are thus strongly suppressed compared with the case of quasi-static noise, where they scale with the third order. Furthermore, we present a method for extracting the noise correlation spectral density from the cavity emission in the case where the underlying noise type remains unidentified. This can be achieved by applying the convolution theorem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：描述动力学、推导标度关系、提出重构方法。；研究对象：两个与腔耦合的量子比特系统，受到关联噪声（纵向噪声）影响，且量子比特之间无直接耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过腔发射可以表征噪声关联，并重构噪声关联谱密度；白噪声情况下关联效应与腔-量子比特耦合常数的五次方成正比，准静态噪声下则与三次方成正比，因此白噪声的关联效应被强烈抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过腔发射可以表征噪声关联，并重构噪声关联谱密度；白噪声情况下关联效应与腔-量子比特耦合常数的五次方成正比，准静态噪声下则与三次方成正比，因此白噪声的关联效应被强烈抑制。；创新点：提出了在噪声类型未知时，通过腔发射重构噪声关联谱密度的具体方法（基于卷积定理），并揭示了不同噪声类型下关联效应随耦合常数的不同标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：描述两个腔耦合量子比特在关联噪声下的动力学，分别处理白噪声、准静态噪声和Ornstein-Uhlenbeck噪声情况；利用卷积定理提出从腔发射中提取未知类型噪声的关联谱密度的方法。

papers.title: Einstein crystals in Snyder and Snyder-de Sitter noncommutative backgrounds
papers.abstract: We investigate the behavior of Einstein crystals in noncommutative backgrounds described by the Snyder and Snyder-de Sitter models. Possible novel effects, which may arise in realistic systems such as diamond crystals, are analyzed within a thermodynamical framework. We show that noncommutativity influences the key thermodynamic quantities, including internal energy and specific heat. These corrections can be directly related to modifications of the underlying uncertainty relations, of the generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) and generalized extended uncertainty principle (GEUP) types.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、thermodynamical framework、corrections、uncertainty relations。；研究对象：在Snyder和Snyder-de Sitter非对易背景下的爱因斯坦晶体（Einstein crystals），并提及可能应用于实际系统如金刚石晶体（diamond crystals）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非对易性会影响爱因斯坦晶体的关键热力学量（内能和比热），这些修正可直接归因于广义不确定性原理（GUP）和广义扩展不确定性原理（GEUP）类型的不确定性关系的修改。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非对易性会影响爱因斯坦晶体的关键热力学量（内能和比热），这些修正可直接归因于广义不确定性原理（GUP）和广义扩展不确定性原理（GEUP）类型的不确定性关系的修改。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用热力学框架（thermodynamical framework）进行分析，基于Snyder和Snyder-de Sitter非对易模型，通过修正不确定性关系来推导热力学量的变化。

papers.title: Growth of quartet correlations in neutron-rich Tellurium isotopes within quartet Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer theory
papers.abstract: Quartet correlations in neutron-rich Te isotopes are investigated within the quartet Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) framework. Taking \(^{100}\)Sn as an inert core, we consider two valence protons and valence neutrons occupying the \(2d_{5/2}\oplus1g_{7/2}\) model space, and solve the quartet BCS variational equations with a charge-independent isovector pairing interaction. The effective pairing strength is constrained from empirical neutron pairing gaps in the Te isotopic chain. We find that the valence quartet number increases as the valence neutron number is enlarged from \(N_{\rm val}=2\) to \(14\). The same increasing behavior is also found for the condensed quartet component. The proton occupation of the \(1g_{7/2}\) orbit is strongly enhanced relative to the conventional like-particle BCS reference and is driven close to the degeneracy-weighted limit. These results suggest that additional valence neutrons enhance the quartet admixture in the correlated quartet BCS state, while redistributing the fixed proton weight from pair-like configurations to quartet configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quartet BCS theory、variational equations、theoretical framework。；研究对象：中子富集的碲（Te）同位素中的四体（quartet）关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着价中子数从2增加到14，价四体数及凝聚四体分量均增加；质子1g7/2轨道的占据数相对于传统同类粒子BCS参考态显著增强，接近简并加权极限，表明额外价中子增强了四体混合，并将固定质子权重从类对组态重新分配至四体组态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着价中子数从2增加到14，价四体数及凝聚四体分量均增加；质子1g7/2轨道的占据数相对于传统同类粒子BCS参考态显著增强，接近简并加权极限，表明额外价中子增强了四体混合，并将固定质子权重从类对组态重新分配至四体组态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用四体BCS（quartet Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer）理论框架，以100Sn为惰性核芯，考虑两个价质子和价中子占据2d5/2⊕1g7/2模型空间，使用电荷无关的等矢量对力相互作用，通过求解四体BCS变分方程，并利用Te同位素链的经验中子对能隙约束有效对力强度。

papers.title: Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for Corrected Boltzmann Sampling
papers.abstract: Sampling from an unnormalized Boltzmann density requires proposals that move probability mass globally while retaining enough path-probability information for statistical correction. We introduce Neural Non-Equilibrium Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (NHMC), a train-then-correct learned Hamiltonian sampler. Starting from a tractable base distribution, NHMC learns stochastic Hamiltonian-style paths toward the target. Once training is complete, the learned proposal parameters are fixed; the proposal then generates complete paths and endpoint configurations, which are statistically corrected using the recorded non-equilibrium work. This dimensionless generalized work is determined by the probability ratio between the forward proposal path and a reverse reference path. During training, minimizing its mean reduces a path-space KL divergence and controls an upper bound on endpoint mismatch. During evaluation, the same quantity defines weights for self-normalized importance sampling on paths (path-SNIS), estimates normalizing constants or free-energy differences, and gives the acceptance ratio for path-space independent Metropolis-Hastings (path-IMH). The same forward-reverse laws also define a shared-bridge round-trip Metropolis kernel that acts directly on configurations and preserves the Boltzmann target. On double-well and finite-volume lattice $φ^4$ targets, the NHMC construction gives corrected estimates when path overlap is sufficient; when overlap is poor, weight degeneracy, low acceptance, and long autocorrelation expose proposal failure. We additionally report a molecular internal-coordinate feasibility study using an MD prior and learned-force path proposal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：train-then-correct learned Hamiltonian sampler、path-space KL divergence、self-normalized importance sampling、Metropolis-Hastings。；研究对象：非平衡哈密顿蒙特卡洛方法，用于从非归一化玻尔兹曼密度（如双阱势、有限体积格点φ⁴场论）中进行修正的玻尔兹曼采样。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出神经非平衡哈密顿蒙特卡洛（NHMC）方法，通过训练学习随机哈密顿路径，再对生成的构型进行非平衡功的统计修正，可在路径重叠足够时获得修正后的采样估计；当重叠不足时，权重退化、低接受率和长自相关会暴露提议失败。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出神经非平衡哈密顿蒙特卡洛（NHMC）方法，通过训练学习随机哈密顿路径，再对生成的构型进行非平衡功的统计修正，可在路径重叠足够时获得修正后的采样估计；当重叠不足时，权重退化、低接受率和长自相关会暴露提议失败。；创新点：将非平衡功的统计修正思想与可训练的神经哈密顿路径提议相结合，实现了训练后固定参数、路径级统计修正的采样框架，并统一了路径SNIS、路径IMH和共享桥往返Metropolis三种修正方式。
papers.method_zh: NHMC方法：从可处理的基分布出发，学习随机哈密顿式路径逼近目标分布；训练后固定提议参数，利用记录的非平衡功（由正向提议路径与反向参考路径的概率比定义）进行统计修正。修正方式包括：路径自归一化重要性采样（path-SNIS）、路径空间独立Metropolis-Hastings（path-IMH），以及共享桥往返Metropolis核。在双阱势和有限体积格点φ⁴模型上验证，并报告了基于分子动力学先验和学习力路径提议的分子内坐标可行性研究。

papers.title: Fate of dynamical quantum phase transitions from sudden quench to slow quench limit
papers.abstract: Previous investigations of dynamical quantum phase transition (DQPT) have predominantly focused on sudden quench protocols. In this work, we systematically explore the fate of DQPT from the sudden to the slow quench regime. We establish that DQPT remains robust under slow quenching when the protocol crosses an equilibrium quantum phase transition. Conversely, we show that accidental DQPTs,which occur when the pre and post quench Hamiltonians reside in the same equilibrium phase, can be filtered out in the slow quench limit. This demonstrates that slow quenches can reveal the intrinsic connection between DQPT and equilibrium quantum phase transitions, thereby enabling DQPT to serve as a dynamical probe for identifying equilibrium quantum critical points. We illustrate these findings with examples from the XY chain, the Aubry-André model, and the trimer Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“系统探索”“建立”“证明”等理论分析用语，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：动力学量子相变（DQPT）在从突然淬火到慢速淬火极限下的行为，以及其与平衡态量子相变的内在联系。具体模型包括XY链、Aubry-André模型和三聚体Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当淬火过程跨越平衡态量子相变时，DQPT在慢速淬火下依然稳健存在；而偶然型DQPT（即淬火前后哈密顿量处于同一平衡相时出现的DQPT）在慢速淬火极限下会被过滤掉。这表明慢速淬火能揭示DQPT与平衡态量子相变之间的本质联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当淬火过程跨越平衡态量子相变时，DQPT在慢速淬火下依然稳健存在；而偶然型DQPT（即淬火前后哈密顿量处于同一平衡相时出现的DQPT）在慢速淬火极限下会被过滤掉。这表明慢速淬火能揭示DQPT与平衡态量子相变之间的本质联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，通过对比突然淬火与慢速淬火协议下的DQPT行为，利用XY链、Aubry-André模型和三聚体Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型作为具体示例进行论证。

papers.title: Near-field Dressing of Thermal Emission
papers.abstract: Radiative heat transfer at subwavelength distances is generally understood as enhanced energy exchange mediated by photon tunnelling between neighboring bodies. While near-field interactions can dramatically increase mutual heat transfer, whether they also modify the thermal radiation emitted by the bodies themselves remains an open question. Here we experimentally show that near-field electromagnetic coupling reshapes far-field thermal emission through a distance-dependent dressed emissivity. Using a dual-probe calorimetric platform, we independently monitor the radiative balance of two borosilicate microspheres over separations ranging from 120 micrometers to a few hundred nanometers, spanning the transition from the far field to the near field. Nanowatt-resolved differential radiometry reveals asymmetric heat fluxes and a non-monotonic response of the hotter sphere, demonstrating that thermal radiation is governed not only by emitter-bath interactions but also by coupling to the surrounding photonic environment. By analyzing the total power exchanged between the coupled system and the external thermal bath, we directly extract a dressed emissivity and show that near-field interactions renormalize the far-field thermal emission of the pair through a redistribution of the electromagnetic modes available to thermal fluctuations. These observations provide direct experimental evidence that thermal emitters are dressed by their electromagnetic environment, establishing a thermal analogue of the Purcell effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally show”、“dual-probe calorimetric platform”、“Nanowatt-resolved differential radiometry”等实验手段和观测结果。；研究对象：近场电磁耦合对热辐射的修饰效应，具体体系为两个硼硅酸盐微球在从远场到近场距离范围内的热辐射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 近场电磁耦合通过距离依赖的“修饰发射率”（dressed emissivity）重塑了远场热辐射，表明热辐射不仅受发射体与热库相互作用支配，还受其与周围光子环境的耦合影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：近场电磁耦合通过距离依赖的“修饰发射率”（dressed emissivity）重塑了远场热辐射，表明热辐射不仅受发射体与热库相互作用支配，还受其与周围光子环境的耦合影响。；创新点：首次通过实验直接证明近场相互作用会“修饰”热发射体的远场热辐射，并提取出修饰发射率，建立了热辐射中的Purcell效应类比。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 双探针量热平台（dual-probe calorimetric platform），用于独立监测两个硼硅酸盐微球在120微米到几百纳米间距下的辐射平衡；纳瓦级分辨率的差分辐射测量（nanowatt-resolved differential radiometry），用于提取不对称热流和热球体的非单调响应。

papers.title: Enhanced Third-Harmonic Generation in Diamond Photonic Crystal Slabs via Doubly Resonant Quasi-Bound States in the Continuum
papers.abstract: We propose and numerically demonstrate doubly resonant third-harmonic generation (THG) in a diamond photonic crystal (PhC) slab, in which the fundamental harmonic (FH) and the third harmonic (TH) modes are simultaneously resonant within the same membrane. A hexagonal-lattice slab with triangular air holes is designed so that a K-point band-edge FH mode and a $Γ$-point quasi-bound-state-in-the-continuum (quasi-BIC) TH mode satisfy the frequency-tripling condition $3ω_1\approxω_3$. Modifying the hole shape from circular to equilateral triangular breaks the in-plane symmetry that otherwise forces the nonlinear coupling to vanish, thereby converting a TH mode with negligible overlap into one with finite while simultaneously reducing the required slab thickness. Guided by a closed-form expression for THG efficiency derived from coupled-mode theory, we design the unit cell and a PhC heterostructure cavity. Three-dimensional simulations of the designed cavity yield a normalized THG efficiency $η=2.7\times10^{-7}~\mathrm{W}^{-2}$ under moderate quality factors, which is projected to reach ~$0.034~\mathrm{W}^{-2}$ at the fabrication-limited quality factor (Q = 200,000). Because the operating wavelength is set by the lattice constant, this design, combined with the ultra-wide transparency window of diamond, can map a single geometry across various fabricable wavelengths, spanning from telecommunication bands to color-center-resonant visible and deep-UV outputs. These results establish a robust route toward efficient, monolithic on-chip frequency conversion in an all-diamond platform for quantum and nonlinear photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically demonstrate, three-dimensional simulations, coupled-mode theory）；研究对象：金刚石光子晶体平板中的三次谐波产生（THG），具体为六角晶格三角空气孔光子晶体平板中同时共振的基频（FH）模与三次谐波（TH）准连续谱束缚态（quasi-BIC）模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计六角晶格三角空气孔光子晶体平板，使基频模（K点带边模）与三次谐波模（Γ点准BIC模）满足频率三倍关系（3ω₁≈ω₃），并打破面内对称性以激活非线性耦合，实现了高效双共振三次谐波产生。在中等品质因子下归一化效率达2.7×10⁻⁷ W⁻²，在制造极限品质因子（Q=200,000）下预计可达约0.034 W⁻²。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计六角晶格三角空气孔光子晶体平板，使基频模（K点带边模）与三次谐波模（Γ点准BIC模）满足频率三倍关系（3ω₁≈ω₃），并打破面内对称性以激活非线性耦合，实现了高效双共振三次谐波产生。在中等品质因子下归一化效率达2.7×10⁻⁷ W⁻²，在制造极限品质因子（Q=200,000）下预计可达约0.034 W⁻²。；创新点：首次在金刚石光子晶体平板中同时实现基频与三次谐波模的双共振（利用K点带边模与Γ点准BIC模），并通过将空气孔形状从圆形改为等边三角形来打破面内对称性，使原本为零的非线性耦合变为有限值，同时降低所需平板厚度。
papers.method_zh: 基于耦合模理论推导三次谐波效率的闭合表达式，设计光子晶体原胞及异质结构腔；采用三维数值模拟（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如有限时域差分法FDTD或有限元法FEM）计算谐波产生效率。

papers.title: A Mesoscopic Ginzburg--Landau Model for Vibrational Strong Coupling Enhanced Rayleigh Scattering in Molecular Liquids
papers.abstract: Recent experiments by Sandeep \textit{et al.} [Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 65, e16917 (2026)] suggest that vibrational strong coupling (VSC) in molecular liquids can generate mesoscopic phenomena beyond single-molecule observables, including resonantly enhanced Rayleigh scattering, abrupt concentration thresholds, and thermal collapse. Motivated by these observations, we construct a mesoscopic Ginzburg--Landau model with two coupled fields: a cavity-controlled collective vibrational polarization $P$ and a secondary structural field $m$ whose long-wavelength susceptibility is renormalized by the collective vibrational polarization intensity $P^2$, assumed to govern long-wavelength density/dielectric fluctuations. With calibrated parameters, the model captures the observed Rayleigh enhancement, collective scaling relations, and threshold-like behavior, while explaining why polaritonic/IR signatures may persist when Rayleigh scattering disappears. The model further predicts enhanced long-wavelength density/dielectric correlations, enlarged mesoscopic correlation lengths, and slowed structural dynamics in the regime with strong Rayleigh enhancement, providing direct experimental tests through small-angle X-ray/neutron scattering and dynamic light-scattering probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“construct a mesoscopic Ginzburg--Landau model”、“model captures”、“predicts”。；研究对象：分子液体中振动强耦合（VSC）增强的瑞利散射现象，以及由此产生的介观尺度集体行为（如密度/介电涨落、结构动力学）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该介观金兹堡-朗道模型成功解释了实验中观察到的瑞利散射增强、集体标度关系和阈值行为，并预测了在强瑞利增强区域存在增强的长波长密度/介电关联、增大的介观关联长度以及减慢的结构动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该介观金兹堡-朗道模型成功解释了实验中观察到的瑞利散射增强、集体标度关系和阈值行为，并预测了在强瑞利增强区域存在增强的长波长密度/介电关联、增大的介观关联长度以及减慢的结构动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个包含两个耦合场的介观金兹堡-朗道模型：腔控集体振动极化场 \(P\) 和二次结构场 \(m\)，其中 \(m\) 的长波磁化率被集体振动极化强度 \(P^2\) 重整化，并假设该重整化控制长波长密度/介电涨落。

papers.title: Circulation Statistics in Rayleigh-Bénard Convection
papers.abstract: Important statistical properties of velocity circulation in homogeneous isotropic turbulence (HIT) have been unveiled in recent years, raising the question of whether they persist, or are modified, in other classes of turbulent flows. Motivated by the dominant role of small-scale structures in the circulation fluctuations of HIT, we investigate their relevance in direct numerical simulations of Rayleigh-Bénard convection at a Rayleigh number of $10^9$ and Prandtl number of $O(1)$. Within the thermal boundary layer (TBL), the distribution of elementary vortices is found to be strongly correlated with the temperature field, while the statistics of their core aspect ratios is significantly altered. Additionally, the probability distribution functions of circulation, computed for planar contours which are parallel to the walls, display salient features closely akin to those observed in HIT, with the {\it Area Rule} (a connection between circulation statistics and minimal surfaces) remaining particularly well satisfied -- except for a possible transitional region at a distance of a few TBL thicknesses. Away from the TBL, as expected, the overall statistical behavior of these structures likewise resembles that of HIT, where the intermittent spatial distribution of small vortex tubes is instead determined by the energy dissipation field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：direct numerical simulations，直接数值模拟）；研究对象：Rayleigh-Bénard对流（瑞利-贝纳德对流）中的速度环量统计特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热边界层内，基本涡旋的分布与温度场强相关，且其核心纵横比统计显著改变；但平行于壁面的平面轮廓上的环量概率分布函数仍与均匀各向同性湍流（HIT）高度相似，其中“面积规则”依然成立，仅在距边界层若干厚度处可能存在过渡区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热边界层内，基本涡旋的分布与温度场强相关，且其核心纵横比统计显著改变；但平行于壁面的平面轮廓上的环量概率分布函数仍与均匀各向同性湍流（HIT）高度相似，其中“面积规则”依然成立，仅在距边界层若干厚度处可能存在过渡区。；创新点：首次系统研究了Rayleigh-Bénard对流中速度环量的统计特性，并检验了HIT中建立的环量统计规律（如面积规则）在热对流这一非均匀、各向异性湍流中的适用性。
papers.method_zh: 直接数值模拟（DNS），瑞利数10^9，普朗特数O(1)。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Quantum Adiabatic Algorithm
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian systems offer new opportunities for quantum optimization and computation. Here, we show that non-Hermitian quantum adiabatic algorithms require not only a real, gapped spectrum, but also a stable pseudospectrum. We propose a novel framework by mapping non-unitary quantum circuits to local Hamiltonian paths, thereby preserving their optimization advantages and shallow depth. While a direct non-Hermitian extension of the Feynman-Kitaev construction suffers severe pseudospectral instability, our history-decoupled construction yields both a controlled pseudospectrum and a real, gapped spectrum. Using the CK benchmark family of maximum independent set problems, we demonstrate polynomial-evolution-time non-Hermitian adiabatic computation that remains robust against perturbations. We further discuss a feasible optical implementation using coupled waveguides with an auxiliary lossy channel. Our work establishes pseudospectral stability, alongside real, gapped spectra, as key principles and a practical route for non-Hermitian quantum adiabatic computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose a novel framework、mapping、demonstrate、discuss implementation）；研究对象：非厄米量子绝热算法（Non-Hermitian quantum adiabatic algorithm），及其在最大独立集问题（CK benchmark family of maximum independent set problems）上的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米量子绝热算法不仅需要实能隙谱，还需要稳定的伪谱（pseudospectrum）；通过历史解耦构造（history-decoupled construction）可实现受控的伪谱和实能隙谱，从而在多项式时间内完成鲁棒的非厄米绝热计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米量子绝热算法不仅需要实能隙谱，还需要稳定的伪谱（pseudospectrum）；通过历史解耦构造（history-decoupled construction）可实现受控的伪谱和实能隙谱，从而在多项式时间内完成鲁棒的非厄米绝热计算。；创新点：首次提出伪谱稳定性（pseudospectral stability）与实能隙谱并列为非厄米量子绝热计算的关键原则，并给出了历史解耦构造这一实用路径，克服了直接Feynman-Kitaev构造的伪谱不稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将非幺正量子电路映射到局域哈密顿量路径（mapping non-unitary quantum circuits to local Hamiltonian paths）；对比了直接非厄米推广的Feynman-Kitaev构造与历史解耦构造的伪谱稳定性；使用CK基准最大独立集问题族进行多项式时间演化演示。

papers.title: Single-component twisted $\mathbb{Z}_3$ orthogonal metal in an $e/3$-anyon fluid
papers.abstract: We propose an unconventional metallic phase emerging on doping the $1/3$ Fractional Chern insulator, which can serve as a parent state to anyon superconductivity with arbitrary chiral central charge. It is a twisted $\mathbb{Z}_3$ orthogonal metal: a state with vanishing electron quasiparticle weight but a single well-defined Fermi surface of emergent charge-$e/3$ fermions coupled to a Dijkgraaf-Witten twisted $\mathbb{Z}_3$ gauge field. It is manifestly valley-symmetric and valley-gapped. Pairing this fractionalized Fermi surface then removes the topological order and produces a family of superconductors whose chiral central charge is directly set by the BdG band topology of the paired $e/3$ fermions, while the angular momentum of the physical order parameter is constrained to be a multiple of three. This scenario provides a route to superconducting states beyond anyon-superconductivity constructions based on $2e/3$ anyons. The metallic phase itself carries distinctive ``fractional Fermiology'' signatures: $e/3$ shot noise, anomalous quantum oscillations, and a $6π$ ac Josephson effect when it mediates the Josephson coupling between superconductors. We construct explicit wavefunction ansatz realizing the phase, and argue that inter-valley repulsion between anyons stabilizes this phase compared to competing states. We show that the construction extends to higher Laughlin states but not to Jain states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论模型（“propose an unconventional metallic phase”）、构造波函数（“construct explicit wavefunction ansatz”），未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：掺杂1/3分数量子陈绝缘体后出现的非常规金属相，即“扭曲Z₃正交金属”，以及由此衍生的任意子超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该金属相由电荷e/3的费米子与Dijkgraaf-Witten扭曲Z₃规范场耦合形成，具有消失的电子准粒子权重但存在清晰的费米面；配对该费米面可产生任意手征中心荷的超导态，且物理序参量的角动量必须是3的倍数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该金属相由电荷e/3的费米子与Dijkgraaf-Witten扭曲Z₃规范场耦合形成，具有消失的电子准粒子权重但存在清晰的费米面；配对该费米面可产生任意手征中心荷的超导态，且物理序参量的角动量必须是3的倍数。；创新点：首次提出基于e/3任意子流体的“扭曲Z₃正交金属”相，并证明其可作为任意子超导的母态，突破了以往基于2e/3任意子构造超导的框架；同时预言了e/3散粒噪声、反常量子振荡和6π交流约瑟夫森效应等可观测特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：提出波函数变分形式（“wavefunction ansatz”），基于分数量子霍尔效应中的Laughlin态推广，并分析能带拓扑（BdG）与对称性约束。

papers.title: Tunable Mpemba effect in a polymer-bead system with inertia
papers.abstract: We propose an experimentally motivated model in which the Mpemba effect can be controlled through the system's inertia. The model describes a polymer undergoing a denaturation transition whose force-extension curve contains a plateau that slows relaxation. When the system is initially prepared at a higher temperature or under a weaker stretching force, the bead accumulates greater kinetic energy, allowing it to cross the plateau more rapidly and thereby producing the Mpemba effect. Increasing the bead mass broadens the range of initial temperatures over which this mechanism operates. A similar mechanism also generates the inverse Mpemba effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose a model、model describes、mechanism）；研究对象：聚合物-珠子体系（polymer-bead system）中的Mpemba效应（即“热的水比冷的水更快结冰”的类似反常弛豫现象），涉及惯性效应和变性转变（denaturation transition）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节体系惯性（如珠子质量）可以控制Mpemba效应的出现及其温度范围；初始温度更高或拉伸力更弱时，珠子积累更大动能，能更快跨越力-伸长曲线中的平台区，从而产生Mpemba效应；增大珠子质量可拓宽该机制起作用的初始温度范围，且类似机制也可产生逆Mpemba效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节体系惯性（如珠子质量）可以控制Mpemba效应的出现及其温度范围；初始温度更高或拉伸力更弱时，珠子积累更大动能，能更快跨越力-伸长曲线中的平台区，从而产生Mpemba效应；增大珠子质量可拓宽该机制起作用的初始温度范围，且类似机制也可产生逆Mpemba效应。；创新点：首次提出通过体系惯性（珠子质量）可调谐Mpemba效应，并阐明惯性在跨越弛豫势垒中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于实验动机构建理论模型，描述聚合物在变性转变过程中的力-伸长曲线存在平台区，该平台区减缓弛豫；通过分析初始温度、拉伸力和珠子质量对弛豫动力学的影响，揭示惯性在跨越平台区中的作用。

papers.title: Long-range and steady-state entanglement of driven-dissipative nitrogen vacancy centers using microwaves as a drive and synthetic antiferromagnet as a dissipator
