papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：分子动力学模拟、粗粒化聚合物模型）；研究对象：聚合物在拥挤环境中的构象转变，具体为可逆的线圈-球状-线圈（coil-globule-coil）转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅通过改变单一类型可吸引性拥挤剂的体积分数，就足以驱动聚合物发生完整的可逆构象转变。该转变源于拥挤剂与单体之间可饱和的桥接作用：低密度时桥接导致塌缩，高密度时结合位点饱和导致再膨胀。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅通过改变单一类型可吸引性拥挤剂的体积分数，就足以驱动聚合物发生完整的可逆构象转变。该转变源于拥挤剂与单体之间可饱和的桥接作用：低密度时桥接导致塌缩，高密度时结合位点饱和导致再膨胀。；创新点：揭示了“可饱和几何桥接”作为驱动中性及带电聚合物在拥挤环境中发生可逆构象转变的最小物理机制。该机制打破了自回避行走（SAW）的普适性，且对于带电聚合物，静电作用会放大而非抑制这种可逆转变。
papers.method_zh: 采用粗粒化聚合物的分子动力学模拟，研究了聚合物与单一类型可吸引性拥挤剂（attractive crowder）的相互作用。同时对比了纯排斥性拥挤剂的情况，并考虑了带电聚合物与显式抗衡离子的体系。

papers.title: Monopole Spin Density Wave States in Magnetic Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: The interplay between topology and magnetism in Weyl semimetals has recently emerged as a fertile ground for novel quantum phases. While monopole harmonic order parameters have been established for superconductivity and charge density waves in these systems, their spin density wave counterparts remain unexplored. Here we introduce monopole spin density wave (SDW) states arising from particle-hole pairing between nested Fermi surfaces enclosing Weyl nodes of the same chirality. We demonstrate that the SDW order parameter inherits a nontrivial pairing Berry phase and is described by monopole harmonic functions that exhibit topologically protected nodal structures in the gap function. Through a concrete lattice model, we show that helical and cycloidal SDW orders produce distinct signatures in band structures, Fermi arc distributions, and surface spin polarization patterns, which can be directly resolved by spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Remarkably, we find that the quantum geometric tensor of the monopole pairing realizes ideal quantum geometry in the weak-coupling limit, where quantum distance fluctuations are entirely governed by Berry curvature. Our results not only unify the understanding of monopole ordered states across pairing channels but also provide experimental avenues for distinguishing competing magnetic orders in ReAlX (Re=rare earth elements, X=Si, Ge) materials and suggest potential applications in topological spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：introduce、demonstrate、show、find，无实验数据或计算模拟细节描述）；研究对象：磁性Weyl半金属中的单极自旋密度波（monopole SDW）态，具体涉及手性相同Weyl节点之间嵌套费米面的粒子-空穴配对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单极SDW序参量具有非平庸配对贝里相位，由单极调和函数描述，并在能隙函数中呈现拓扑保护的节点结构；在弱耦合极限下，单极配对的量子几何张量实现理想量子几何，量子距离涨落完全由贝里曲率决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单极SDW序参量具有非平庸配对贝里相位，由单极调和函数描述，并在能隙函数中呈现拓扑保护的节点结构；在弱耦合极限下，单极配对的量子几何张量实现理想量子几何，量子距离涨落完全由贝里曲率决定。；创新点：首次提出Weyl半金属中单极自旋密度波态，填补了此前仅针对超导和电荷密度波建立单极调和序参量而自旋密度波通道未被探索的空白；揭示了单极配对在弱耦合极限下实现理想量子几何的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于粒子-空穴配对与嵌套费米面构建单极SDW序参量；具体晶格模型计算：展示螺旋和摆线SDW序在能带结构、费米弧分布和表面自旋极化图案中的不同特征；建议实验验证手段：自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱（spin-ARPES）。

papers.title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and Perovskites
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of the Born effective charge (BEC) tensor is crucial for modeling materials under electric fields but remains computationally expensive. To bridge this gap, we present SevenNet-Polar, an equivariant graph neural network framework based on the SevenNet architecture for fast and accurate BEC predictions. Our BEC-only predictors can achieve an RMSE as low as 0.0043 e on ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and perovskites, despite the presence of high-temperature (up to 2,000 K) and defect-laden training data. Our all-in-one multitask models for predicting energy, forces, stress, and BEC in ZrO$_2$ and Li$_3$PO$_4$ achieve high accuracy with an RMSE of 1.0 meV/atom for energy, 12 meV/angstrom for forces, 0.05 GPa for stress, and 0.0029 e for BEC. BEC accuracy is not degraded by multitask training. Scaling analysis reveals distinct exponents for diagonal and off-diagonal BEC components, both of which exhibit less favorable scaling than energy, force and stress errors. SevenNet-Polar generalizes robustly when tested on scenarios containing structural environments absent from the training set, such as along nudged elastic band (NEB) trajectories or grain boundaries in ZrO$_2$. Accelerated by FlashTP, SevenNet-Polar enables simulations containing up to 1.5 million atoms on multi-GPU supercomputers and up to approximately 15,000 atoms on a single consumer-grade GPU. This makes charge-aware molecular dynamics simulations under electric fields more accessible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：equivariant graph neural network framework、multitask models、molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：ZrO₂、Li₃PO₄ 以及钙钛矿材料中的 Born 有效电荷（BEC）张量预测，以及能量、力、应力和 BEC 的多任务预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于 SevenNet 架构的等变图神经网络框架 SevenNet-Polar 能够快速、准确地预测 Born 有效电荷，且多任务训练不会降低 BEC 的预测精度；该模型在包含高温（高达 2000 K）和缺陷的训练数据下仍能实现低至 0.0043 e 的 RMSE，并可在单 GPU 上模拟约 15,000 个原子，在多 GPU 超算上模拟多达 150 万个原子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于 SevenNet 架构的等变图神经网络框架 SevenNet-Polar 能够快速、准确地预测 Born 有效电荷，且多任务训练不会降低 BEC 的预测精度；该模型在包含高温（高达 2000 K）和缺陷的训练数据下仍能实现低至 0.0043 e 的 RMSE，并可在单 GPU 上模拟约 15,000 个原子，在多 GPU 超算上模拟多达 150 万个原子。；创新点：首次将 SevenNet 架构扩展用于 Born 有效电荷的快速预测，并实现了能量、力、应力和 BEC 的高精度多任务学习；展示了模型在训练集未包含的结构环境（如 NEB 路径、晶界）中的鲁棒泛化能力；通过 FlashTP 加速实现了电荷感知的电场下分子动力学模拟的大规模计算。
papers.method_zh: 采用等变图神经网络（equivariant graph neural network）框架 SevenNet-Polar，基于 SevenNet 架构进行 BEC 预测；构建了仅预测 BEC 的模型以及同时预测能量、力、应力和 BEC 的多任务模型；利用 FlashTP 加速实现大规模模拟；通过缩放分析研究不同物理量（能量、力、应力、BEC 对角/非对角分量）的误差标度指数。

papers.title: $c$-axis strain tuning of superconductivity and symmetric elastoresistivity in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: The kagome metal CsV$_{3}$Sb$_{5}$ hosts an intriguing interplay between charge-density-wave (CDW) order and superconductivity that is highly sensitive to lattice distortions. However, determining the specific roles of the in-plane ($A_{1g,1}$) and out-of-plane ($A_{1g,2}$) symmetric strain channels has been hindered by their intrinsic mixing in conventional piezo-based experiments. Here, we combine in-plane uniaxial strain with direct $c$-axis compression to independently access and disentangle these symmetry-resolved responses in CsV$_{3}$Sb$_{5}$. We reveal that $c$-axis compression drives a massive, linear enhancement of the superconducting transition temperature ($T_c$) alongside a suppression of $T_{\rm CDW}$. The tuning efficiency of this out-of-plane deformation acts with an opposite sign and far exceeds that of in-plane strain, demonstrating that $c$-axis lattice control dictates the phase competition. Furthermore, by isolating the pure elastoresistivity coefficients, we find that the out-of-plane cross-coupling coefficient ($m_{13}$) is comparable in magnitude but opposite in sign to the in-plane response ($m_{11}+m_{12}$). Unlike the sharply peaked in-plane response, $m_{13}$ exhibits a distinct, order-parameter-like onset across the CDW transition. Our results establish that out-of-plane lattice control plays a dominant role in tuning the intertwined states in CsV$_{3}$Sb$_{5}$ and provide a general pathway for resolving strain-coupled electronic responses in layered quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combine in-plane uniaxial strain with direct c-axis compression”等实验手段，并测量了超导转变温度（\(T_c\)）和弹性电阻系数等物理量。；研究对象：层状笼目金属 CsV₃Sb₅，具体研究其电荷密度波（CDW）序与超导电性之间的竞争关系，以及面内与面外晶格应变对这两种电子序的调控作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: c轴压缩应变能大幅线性提升超导转变温度（\(T_c\)）并抑制CDW转变温度（\(T_{\rm CDW}\)），其调控效率远高于面内应变且符号相反，表明面外晶格控制主导了CsV₃Sb₅中相竞争行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：c轴压缩应变能大幅线性提升超导转变温度（\(T_c\)）并抑制CDW转变温度（\(T_{\rm CDW}\)），其调控效率远高于面内应变且符号相反，表明面外晶格控制主导了CsV₃Sb₅中相竞争行为。；创新点：首次通过独立施加c轴压缩应变，将面内与面外对称应变通道解耦，揭示了面外晶格变形在调控CsV₃Sb₅中相互交织的电子序（CDW与超导）中起主导作用，并发现面外交叉耦合弹性电阻系数\(m_{13}\)在CDW转变处呈现类似序参量的行为，与面内响应截然不同。
papers.method_zh: 结合面内单轴应变与直接c轴压缩实验，独立施加并解耦面内（\(A_{1g,1}\)）与面外（\(A_{1g,2}\)）对称应变通道；通过测量弹性电阻系数（包括面外交叉耦合系数\(m_{13}\)与面内响应\(m_{11}+m_{12}\)）来表征应变耦合的电子响应。

papers.title: The distribution of eccentricities in random regular graphs
papers.abstract: We derive a closed-form analytical expression for the distribution of eccentricities (DoE) in random regular graphs (RRGs) that consist of $N$ nodes of degree $c$. The DoE is given by the tail distribution $P(E > \ell) \simeq 1 - \exp \left[ - \exp \left( - \frac{ e^{b \ell} - μ}β \right) \right]$, where the distance $\ell$ takes integer values, $b = \ln (c-1)$ is the shape parameter, $β= \frac{c-2}{c} N$ is the scale parameter and $μ= \frac{c-2}{c} N \ln N$ is the location parameter. By providing the full distribution rather than a single characteristic length scale, we present a detailed view of the large-scale structure. In spite of the fact that the degrees of all the nodes are the same, their eccentricities exhibit non-trivial variations. We derive a closed-form expression for the mean eccentricity, which is given by $\langle E \rangle \simeq \frac{\ln N}{\ln (c-1)} + \frac{\ln \ln N}{\ln (c-1)} - \frac{ \ln c - \ln (c-2) }{ \ln (c-1) } + \frac{1}{2}$. We calculate the mode of the DoE, which exhibits a staircase profile as a function of the network size. Interestingly, the mode is given by $E_{\rm mode} ={\rm Round} \left( \langle E \rangle \right)$, where ${\rm Round}( x )$ is the nearest integer to $x$. We also calculate the variance ${\rm Var}(E)$ and show that it exhibits oscillations as a function of the network size $N$. The results presented in this paper may serve as benchmarks for algorithmic approaches to eccentricity calculations in large sparse networks. The eccentricities are important in practical applications such as broadcasting and global dissemination, where the network performance is determined by the longest delay times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“derive a closed-form analytical expression”（推导解析表达式）、“distribution”（分布）、“mean eccentricity”（平均离心率）等，属于统计物理与图论结合的解析理论分析。；研究对象：随机正则图（random regular graphs, RRGs）中节点离心率（eccentricity）的分布。具体为节点度数为 \(c\)、节点数为 \(N\) 的随机正则图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了随机正则图中离心率分布的闭合解析表达式，发现尽管所有节点度数相同，离心率仍存在非平凡涨落；并给出了平均离心率、众数及方差的解析形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了随机正则图中离心率分布的闭合解析表达式，发现尽管所有节点度数相同，离心率仍存在非平凡涨落；并给出了平均离心率、众数及方差的解析形式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比，但明确指出该工作提供了离心率的完整分布（而非单一特征长度尺度），并给出了均值、众数、方差的精确解析表达式，可作为大型稀疏网络中离心率算法计算的基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析推导方法，基于随机正则图的统计性质，推导出离心率分布的尾分布函数 \(P(E > \ell)\) 的闭合形式，并进一步计算了均值、众数（呈现阶梯状）和方差（随网络大小振荡）。

papers.title: Computing binary alloy phase diagrams with explicit configurational and vibrational entropy
papers.abstract: Phase stability in multicomponent solid solutions depends on configurational entropy beyond the ideal mixing limit, but capturing it together with vibrational entropy within the same atomistic framework remains challenging. Here, we extend non-equilibrium thermodynamic integration to composition-dependent transformations through an alchemical interpolation of the interactions, combined with Monte Carlo identity exchange moves and molecular dynamics that sample the vibrational and non-ideal configurational entropy along the integration path. We apply the framework to the Au-Cu binary alloy using Atomic Cluster Expansion potentials trained on density functional theory data using the LDA, PBE, and r2SCAN functionals, and construct composition-temperature phase diagrams directly from atomistic free energies. We find that explicit configurational sampling lowers the AuCu order-disorder transition temperature predicted by the ACE potential trained on LDA data from approximately 810 K to 710 K, closer to the experimental value of 683 K, and substantially widens the stability range of the solid solution. At the same time, the much larger sensitivity to the exchange-correlation functional shows that this level of agreement should not be interpreted as general predictive accuracy. Non-ideal configurational entropy must therefore be sampled explicitly, alongside a careful choice of functional, for a reliable atomistic description of binary phase diagrams.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：non-equilibrium thermodynamic integration、Monte Carlo、molecular dynamics、density functional theory。；研究对象：Au-Cu二元合金的相图，特别是其有序-无序相变及固溶体稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 显式地采样非理想构型熵会显著降低AuCu有序-无序转变温度（从约810 K降至710 K，更接近实验值683 K），并大幅拓宽固溶体的稳定范围；但相图结果对交换关联泛函的选择非常敏感，表明不能将单一泛函下的良好一致性视为普遍预测精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：显式地采样非理想构型熵会显著降低AuCu有序-无序转变温度（从约810 K降至710 K，更接近实验值683 K），并大幅拓宽固溶体的稳定范围；但相图结果对交换关联泛函的选择非常敏感，表明不能将单一泛函下的良好一致性视为普遍预测精度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡热力学积分结合炼金术（alchemical）相互作用插值，在积分路径上通过蒙特卡洛身份交换移动和分子动力学分别采样振动熵和非理想构型熵；使用基于LDA、PBE和r2SCAN泛函的密度泛函理论数据训练的原子簇展开（ACE）势。

papers.title: Emergence of a monopole phase in the $J_1{-}J_2$ Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice for small magnetic fields
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state phase diagram of the $J_1{-}J_2$ Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice under an external Zeeman field $H$ by using the variational Monte Carlo approach. We span a region with $0 \le J_2/J_1 \le 0.2$ and $0 \le H/J_1 \le 2$, to assess the fate of the (putative) spin-liquid phase that has been detected for $J_2/J_1=1/8$ at zero magnetic field. Simple variational ansatze are proposed for a few candidate states, and their energetics are compared on large clusters to obtain the phase diagram. For $J_2/J_1 \lesssim 1/6$, a continuous transition from a gapless "Y'' phase to a gapped "up-up-down'' phase is obtained, as predicted by spin-wave theory. Most importantly, around $J_2/J_1=1/8$, a condensate of monopoles (which are gapless gauge excitations of the spin liquid at $H=0$) is stabilized in a significant region of the phase diagram, for small Zeeman fields. Here, a finite scalar chirality is present, while no transverse magnetic order is detected. The stability of the monopole phase is confirmed by a field-theory approach that includes a self-consistent random-phase approximation of the low-lying spin fluctuations. The boundary between the monopole and "Y'' phases is also obtained with no free parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：variational Monte Carlo approach（变分蒙特卡洛方法）、field-theory approach（场论方法）、self-consistent random-phase approximation（自洽随机相位近似）。；研究对象：三角晶格上的 $J_1{-}J_2$ 海森堡模型在外加塞曼磁场下的基态相图，特别是零场下 $J_2/J_1=1/8$ 处可能存在的自旋液体相在弱磁场下的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 $J_2/J_1 \approx 1/8$ 附近、小塞曼磁场区域，稳定存在一个“单极子相”（monopole phase）。该相具有有限标量手性（scalar chirality），但无横向磁有序，是零场自旋液体中单极子（无能隙规范激发）的凝聚态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 $J_2/J_1 \approx 1/8$ 附近、小塞曼磁场区域，稳定存在一个“单极子相”（monopole phase）。该相具有有限标量手性（scalar chirality），但无横向磁有序，是零场自旋液体中单极子（无能隙规范激发）的凝聚态。；创新点：首次在三角晶格 $J_1{-}J_2$ 海森堡模型的小磁场相图中，明确识别并表征了一个由自旋液体的单极子激发凝聚而成的“单极子相”，并利用场论方法（无自由参数）验证了其稳定性及相边界。
papers.method_zh: 使用变分蒙特卡洛方法（VMC）在大尺寸团簇上比较多种候选变分波函数的能量，以确定相图；同时采用包含自洽随机相位近似（RPA）的场论方法，对低能自旋涨落进行处理，以确认单极子相的稳定性，并无自由参数地得到单极子相与“Y”相之间的边界。

papers.title: Boson peak and medium-range elastic heterogeneity in calcium silicate hydrate probed by terahertz spectroscopy and low-temperature calorimetry
papers.abstract: The boson peak (BP), a universal vibrational anomaly of disordered solids, has been predicted but not systematically characterized in calcium silicate hydrate (C-S-H), the binding phase of hardened cement. Building on a preliminary terahertz survey, we characterize the BP across five Ca/Si ratios (0.5-1.7) using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) and low-temperature calorimetry, two probes of vibrational dynamics that complement the static picture of conventional structural methods. After Bruggeman correction for crystalline impurities, both probes locate the BP near 1 THz; they agree on frequency but diverge in intensity. The terahertz integrated spectral weight and the calorimetric Cp/T3 peak both fall monotonically with Ca/Si, whereas the apparent terahertz peak height is maximal at Ca/Si = 1.0, where damping is low and oscillator strength still substantial. This decoupling marks a structural crossover between silicate-chain depolymerization and interlayer calcium filling. From the BP we obtain a medium-range dynamical correlation length of order 1 nm (0.3-2 nm) and a coherent-potential elastic-heterogeneity parameter that decreases from gamma = 0.98 to 0.48 as Ca/Si rises; the Debye-normalized BP frequency (nu_BP/nu_D = 0.15-0.17) places C-S-H within the range reported for silicate glasses. Because gamma governs the distribution of energy barriers for local structural rearrangements, it provides a quantitative, composition-resolved descriptor relevant to the intrinsic creep and thermal transport of C-S-H, linking nanoscale vibrational dynamics to the macroscopic durability of concrete. The dual-probe boson-peak approach is transferable to other amorphous solids, including the supplementary cementitious materials of low-carbon cements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS)、low-temperature calorimetry。；研究对象：水化硅酸钙（C-S-H），即硬化水泥中的结合相，具体研究其在不同钙硅比（Ca/Si = 0.5-1.7）下的玻色峰（Boson peak）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过太赫兹光谱和低温量热两种互补手段，首次系统表征了C-S-H中的玻色峰，发现其频率位于约1 THz，且玻色峰的强度与钙硅比存在非单调关系，揭示了硅酸盐链解聚与层间钙填充之间的结构交叉。从中提取的中程动力学关联长度（~1 nm）和弹性异质性参数（γ从0.98降至0.48）为理解C-S-H的蠕变和热输运提供了定量描述符。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过太赫兹光谱和低温量热两种互补手段，首次系统表征了C-S-H中的玻色峰，发现其频率位于约1 THz，且玻色峰的强度与钙硅比存在非单调关系，揭示了硅酸盐链解聚与层间钙填充之间的结构交叉。从中提取的中程动力学关联长度（~1 nm）和弹性异质性参数（γ从0.98降至0.48）为理解C-S-H的蠕变和热输运提供了定量描述符。；创新点：1.  **首次系统表征**：在C-S-H中系统性地表征了玻色峰，此前仅有初步的太赫兹调查，缺乏系统研究。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）**：直接探测振动动力学，获取玻色峰的频率和强度信息。

papers.title: Tunable Magneto-Excitonic Coupling in Alloyed van der Waals Antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: The unique coupling between magnetic order and photo-generated excitons, electron-hole pairs bound by Coulomb interaction, in layered magnetic semiconductors offers a powerful mechanism for controlling light-matter interactions. In the van der Waals antiferromagnet CrSBr, this coupling is exceptionally strong and manifests distinctly between two coexisting excitonic states: the localised, Frenkel-like XA exciton and the more delocalised, Wannier-Mott-like XB exciton, providing a unique playground for the optical control of magnetism. Here, we reveal how chlorine incorporation reshapes the magneto-optical interplay in CrSBr1-xClx by simultaneously modifying its electronic structure, excitonic properties, and magnetic interactions. Combining magneto-optical spectroscopy up to 85 T with state-of-the-art quasiparticle self-consistent GW (QSGW) calculations on alloy supercells, we show that Cl insertion progressively localises the excitonic wavefunctions and drives both states toward a more Frenkel-like regime. This evolution is accompanied by a systematic reduction of the magnetic-field-induced energy renormalisation, most prominently for the XB exciton. Our work connects exciton character directly to magneto-excitonic coupling. Furthermore, it establishes compositional alloying as an effective strategy for engineering the coupling between magnetic and optical properties in van der Waals magnetic semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“结合磁光光谱实验（高达85 T）”和“准粒子自洽GW (QSGW) 计算”。；研究对象：合金化范德华反铁磁体 CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ 中的磁激子耦合现象，具体关注其两种共存激子态（局域的类弗伦克尔XA激子和离域的类万尼尔-莫特XB激子）的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氯元素的掺入（形成CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ合金）会同时改变材料的电子结构、激子性质和磁相互作用，导致激子波函数逐渐局域化，使两种激子态都向类弗伦克尔激子转变，并系统性地减弱了磁场诱导的能量重整化效应，尤其是对XB激子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氯元素的掺入（形成CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ合金）会同时改变材料的电子结构、激子性质和磁相互作用，导致激子波函数逐渐局域化，使两种激子态都向类弗伦克尔激子转变，并系统性地减弱了磁场诱导的能量重整化效应，尤其是对XB激子。；创新点：该工作直接将激子特性（局域化程度）与磁激子耦合强度联系起来，并确立了“组分合金化”作为一种在范德华磁性半导体中调控磁性与光学性质耦合的有效策略。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高达85特斯拉的强磁场磁光光谱学；理论上采用基于合金超胞的准粒子自洽GW (QSGW) 计算方法。

papers.title: Amoeboid swimming of active vesicles
papers.abstract: We investigate the shape dynamics and migration of weakly deflated active vesicles driven by processes acting either directly in the membrane or transmitted by the cytoskeleton. For a force-free vesicle, local membrane incompressibility suppresses rigid-body translation, so that migration arises from time-dependent shape deformations. Assuming small excess area enables a systematic analysis of the coupled deformation and migration dynamics in free space, i.e. in the absence of substrate adhesion or confinement. Depending on the strength and frequency of the activity, the vesicle exhibits several dynamical regimes, including synchronized oscillations, quasiperiodic shape changes, transitions between non-propelling and propelling states, and intermittent motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”“systematic analysis”“dynamical regimes”等理论分析术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：活性囊泡（active vesicles）的变形与迁移行为，特别是弱瘪陷（weakly deflated）囊泡在自由空间中的类阿米巴（amoeboid）游泳运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无外力、无基底粘附或约束条件下，活性囊泡通过时变形状变形实现迁移，并展现出同步振荡、准周期形变、推进与非推进态之间的转变以及间歇运动等多种动力学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无外力、无基底粘附或约束条件下，活性囊泡通过时变形状变形实现迁移，并展现出同步振荡、准周期形变、推进与非推进态之间的转变以及间歇运动等多种动力学行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于小过量面积（small excess area）假设，对膜局部不可压缩性约束下的耦合变形与迁移动力学进行系统理论分析。

papers.title: Direct observation of anisotropic exciton dispersion in the 2D semiconductor CrSBr
papers.abstract: We report momentum-resolved measurements of exciton dispersion in multilayer CrSBr using defocus-engineered electron energy-loss spectroscopy, supported by first-principles calculations. A pronounced in-plane anisotropy is observed, with the exciton exhibiting a linear dispersion along $Γ$Y within $\lvert \boldsymbol{q} \rvert$ < 0.007 Å$^{-1}$, while remaining nearly dispersionless along $Γ$X. The slope reaches 7.02 eV Å, among the largest reported in low-dimensional systems. The calculations reproduce the experimentally observed linear dispersion, confirming its intrinsic origin. We attribute the anisotropic dispersion to the long-range electron--hole exchange interaction, enhanced by strong out-of-plane confinement and governed by the directional selection rules of the transition dipole moment. Comparative measurements across the magnetic phase transition from the paramagnetic to the A-type antiferromagnetic state show that the dispersion remains essentially unchanged, indicating negligible coupling between exciton propagation and magnetic order. These results establish CrSBr as a model system for investigating anisotropic exciton dynamics in low-symmetry layered semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。判断依据：defocus-engineered electron energy-loss spectroscopy（实验手段）、first-principles calculations（计算支持）。；研究对象：二维半导体 CrSBr 中的激子色散及其各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 CrSBr 中观测到显著的面内各向异性激子色散：沿 ΓY 方向在 |q| < 0.007 Å⁻¹ 范围内呈线性色散（斜率高达 7.02 eV·Å），而沿 ΓX 方向几乎无色散。该色散源于长程电子-空穴交换相互作用，且与磁有序耦合极弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 CrSBr 中观测到显著的面内各向异性激子色散：沿 ΓY 方向在 |q| < 0.007 Å⁻¹ 范围内呈线性色散（斜率高达 7.02 eV·Å），而沿 ΓX 方向几乎无色散。该色散源于长程电子-空穴交换相互作用，且与磁有序耦合极弱。；创新点：首次直接观测到低对称性二维半导体中激子色散的强面内各向异性，并揭示其物理机制为长程交换相互作用受跃迁偶极矩方向选择规则调控。同时，通过对比顺磁与A型反铁磁态的测量，明确排除了磁有序对激子传播的显著影响。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用离焦工程电子能量损失谱（defocus-engineered EELS）实现动量分辨测量；理论上使用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）进行验证。

papers.title: Imaging and characterization of spontaneous vortices in a proximity-induced superconductor
papers.abstract: Observation of spontaneous symmetry breaking is crucial to our understanding of a continuous second-order phase transition from a disordered system into an ordered one, which often leads to the formation of topological defects. In the case of superconductors, such topological defects are identified as quantized vortices. However, their geometrical characteristics have not been well investigated and understood yet. For the imaging of spontaneous vortices, we employ a proximity-coupled superconducting nanocomposite. Here we show from scanning superconducting quantum interference device microscope measurements that vortices with different polarities, size and shapes are observed stochastically especially under near zero-field conditions. The field distributions of the spontaneous vortices are more extended and intricate than those of the field induced Abrikosov vortices, yielding longer penetration depths ranging from ~1 to ~10 micrometer. The spontaneous vortices are created during cooling as a result of the competition between Josephson coupling and thermal phase fluctuation, both of which are inherently present in this proximity-coupled system. The morphology of the vortices most likely imprints the information that is frozen at the time of vortex formation, providing insights into the local phase differences that are present in the early stage of the phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：scanning superconducting quantum interference device microscope measurements（扫描超导量子干涉器件显微镜测量）。；研究对象：邻近效应诱导的超导纳米复合体系中的自发涡旋（spontaneous vortices），具体关注其几何特征、磁场分布及形成机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近零场条件下，自发涡旋具有不同的极性、尺寸和形状，其磁场分布比场诱导的阿布里科索夫涡旋更扩展和复杂，穿透深度约为1至10微米；涡旋形态冻结了形成时的局域相位差信息，反映了约瑟夫森耦合与热相位涨落竞争的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近零场条件下，自发涡旋具有不同的极性、尺寸和形状，其磁场分布比场诱导的阿布里科索夫涡旋更扩展和复杂，穿透深度约为1至10微米；涡旋形态冻结了形成时的局域相位差信息，反映了约瑟夫森耦合与热相位涨落竞争的结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 扫描超导量子干涉器件显微镜（scanning SQUID microscope）成像测量。

papers.title: Spin fluctuation-mediated unconventional superconductivity in ThFeAsN from first-principles
papers.abstract: Superconducting (SC) pairing mechanism, origin of high $T_c$ and symmetry of SC order parameter in Fe-based superconductors are among the important unsolved problems in condensed matter and materials physics. We study the SC properties of ThFeAsN, a Fe-based high $T_c$ superconductor, by {\it ab initio} superconducting density functional theory calculations with electron-phonon coupling, screened static and dynamic electron-electron Coulomb repulsion and spin fluctuation (SF) mediated pair-interaction fully taken into account. Our calculations reveal that ThFeAsN is a SF-mediated multiband superconductor with the calculated $T_c$ of 22.4 K and the $d_{xy}$-wave SC order parameter with different signs on different Fermi surface sheets, in consistent with experiments. We also present distinct SC properties such as quasiparticle density of states and ultrasonic attenuation coefficient which can be immediately verified by experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles、ab initio superconducting density functional theory calculations）；研究对象：铁基高温超导体 ThFeAsN 的超导配对机制、超导转变温度及超导序参量对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ThFeAsN 是一种自旋涨落介导的多带超导体，计算得到的超导转变温度 Tc 为 22.4 K，超导序参量为 dxy 波，在不同费米面片上符号相反，与实验一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ThFeAsN 是一种自旋涨落介导的多带超导体，计算得到的超导转变温度 Tc 为 22.4 K，超导序参量为 dxy 波，在不同费米面片上符号相反，与实验一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的超导密度泛函理论计算，全面考虑了电子-声子耦合、屏蔽的静态和动态电子-电子库仑排斥以及自旋涨落介导的配对相互作用。

papers.title: Numerical and experimental framework for bending elasticity of highly flexible slender structures
papers.abstract: Slender structures are highly flexible, spanning several orders of magnitude in length scale. Their deformation depends on the slenderness of their cross sections, highlighting that the elasticity and geometry of structures are intrinsically coupled. The deformation of the cross-section becomes significant, particularly when tubes and pipes are subjected to bending, known as the Brazier instability. Although the bending performance of slender structures is quantified experimentally using a canonical three-point bending test, their numerical counterparts remain under-explored because complex contact mechanics must be implemented in simulations. In this study, we develop a computational framework to simulate experimental three-point bending tests using a hybrid material point method (hybrid-MPM) approach, which integrates Lagrangian finite element and Eulerian finite difference frameworks. We adapt our framework to elastic tubes and tape springs as canonical examples that exhibit characteristic bending deformation in which the cross-sectional and lengthwise bending are coupled. The predictions of numerical simulations are validated against desktop experiments and classical theory. The excellent agreement between the simulation and the experiments implies that the hybrid-MPM framework provides a robust computational framework for predicting the large deformation of structures involving complex contact, such as soft robots and deployable structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算文章为主，辅以实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a computational framework”（开发计算框架）、“validated against desktop experiments”（通过桌面实验验证）、“numerical simulations”（数值模拟）与“experiments”（实验）结合。；研究对象：高度柔性细长结构（如弹性管和带弹簧）在弯曲下的变形行为，特别是截面与长度方向弯曲耦合的 Brazier 不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种混合物质点法（hybrid-MPM）计算框架，能够准确模拟细长结构在三点弯曲实验中的大变形，预测结果与经典理论和桌面实验高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种混合物质点法（hybrid-MPM）计算框架，能够准确模拟细长结构在三点弯曲实验中的大变形，预测结果与经典理论和桌面实验高度一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合物质点法（hybrid-MPM），该方法结合了拉格朗日有限元框架与欧拉有限差分框架，用于模拟包含复杂接触力学的三点弯曲实验。

papers.title: Second-Order Optical Nonlinearity of AlScN Films Grown By Molecular Beam Epitaxy
papers.abstract: Alloys of AlN have rapidly emerged as a material platform for nonlinear optics. In this paper, we measure the second-order optical nonlinearity of AlScN films grown directly on nitrided c-plane sapphire by molecular beam epitaxy. This direct growth approach, which bypasses a thick AlN buffer layer, allows us to isolate the true nonlinear response of the AlScN film. Our results show a large enhancement of d31, but a suppression of d33 in AlScN films compared to AlN. We observe that d31 can be as high as 4.92 pm/V , which is 60 times larger than that of AlN. The development of AlScN-based photonic devices can enable energy-efficient nonlinear optical operations that can be epitaxially integrated with electronic and photonic devices based on Si, GaN and AlN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：measure（测量）、grown（生长）、molecular beam epitaxy（分子束外延）。；研究对象：AlScN薄膜（AlN与Sc的合金薄膜）的二阶光学非线性特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在分子束外延生长的AlScN薄膜中，二阶非线性系数d31相比AlN增强高达60倍（可达4.92 pm/V），而d33则被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在分子束外延生长的AlScN薄膜中，二阶非线性系数d31相比AlN增强高达60倍（可达4.92 pm/V），而d33则被抑制。；创新点：通过直接生长AlScN薄膜（绕过厚AlN缓冲层），隔离并测量了AlScN薄膜本身的真实非线性响应，首次报道了d31的大幅增强与d33的抑制现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（MBE）方法，将AlScN薄膜直接生长在氮化c面蓝宝石衬底上（无需厚AlN缓冲层），并测量其二阶光学非线性响应。

papers.title: A Modern Multimodal Assistant on a 6 GB 2011 GPU: Stage-Validated, All-GPU CUDA Inference for Fermi
papers.abstract: A companion study ran a 35B mixture-of-experts model on a 2011 NVIDIA Tesla C2075 (Fermi, sm_20, 6GB) as a GPU-prefill/CPU-decode hybrid, because the 4-bit model did not fit in device memory (arXiv:2606.24031). This report keeps the hardware and asks what a model that fits can do: we deploy MiniCPM-V-4.6, a modern multimodal assistant pairing a SigLIP2 vision encoder and window-attention merger (16x visual token compression) with a compact hybrid gated-delta-net backbone, entirely on the GPU. Three results. (i) An all-GPU engine built on measured foundations: projections that dequantize 8-bit weights once and call the vendor SGEMM still in the last Fermi toolchain (64% of FP32 peak; our best hand-written GEMM hit 37%, wrongly called the ceiling); a chunked delta-rule rewrite of the recurrent layers, 2.8x faster than the sequential scan once attribution exposed one bad kernel; and a measured negative: 4-bit weights make decode slower than 8-bit here, since Fermi issues nibble-unpacking shifts at half rate. (ii) The vision side is a port with a proof obligation: we translate tower, merger, and projector to sm_20 CUDA, validating every stage against a locally generated reference forward (full tower 1.4e-5). One failure, position-embedding bucketization differing on exact rational ties, generalizes to a rule: float tie-breaking in index arithmetic is implementation-defined; call the reference operator, do not reimplement it. (iii) Long context exposes an O(N^2) wall short benchmarks hide: prefill falls from 114 tok/s at 2k tokens to 21 at 10k in a naive attention kernel; per-head vendor-GEMM calls writing into the existing score buffer (zero extra memory) restore a flat profile (408 at 2k, 361 at 10k; 17x), verified by exact needle retrieval from 60% depth. The same rewrite cuts image encoding 6x, to 0.93s. The system answers an image question end-to-end in 1.7s.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：CUDA推理、GPU计算、模型部署、性能基准测试。；研究对象：论文研究的对象并非传统凝聚态物理体系，而是一个现代多模态AI助手（MiniCPM-V-4.6）在2011年老旧GPU（NVIDIA Tesla C2075，Fermi架构）上的全GPU推理实现。这是一个计算系统与算法优化的研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一系列针对Fermi架构的底层优化（包括手写GEMM、分块delta规则重写循环层、以及利用供应商SGEMM实现长上下文注意力），成功在6GB显存的2011年GPU上全GPU运行了一个现代多模态模型，实现了端到端1.7秒的图像问答速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一系列针对Fermi架构的底层优化（包括手写GEMM、分块delta规则重写循环层、以及利用供应商SGEMM实现长上下文注意力），成功在6GB显存的2011年GPU上全GPU运行了一个现代多模态模型，实现了端到端1.7秒的图像问答速度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于其他AI推理框架或方法的创新点。其核心新意在于：证明了在极端受限的硬件（2011年Fermi GPU）上，通过精细的底层优化和算法重写，可以全GPU运行现代多模态模型，并揭示了在短基准测试中隐藏的长上下文O(N^2)性能瓶颈。此外，还发现了一个关于浮点数索引算术中“tie-breaking”实现定义的通用规则。

papers.title: Phase coherence control of a programmable high-Tc superconductor created by light
papers.abstract: The quest for superconductivity created by light extends for more than half a century, yet direct evidence of a true zero-resistance state -whose macroscopic quantum phase coherence is both created and controlled by light -- has remained elusive. Here we report for the first time on a complex but robust light-programmable superconducting (LiPS) state at an aluminium-silicon heterojunction that is created and fully controlled with femtosecond laser pulses. The superconducting critical temperatures -- ranging from 1.8-8.5 K, can be increased or erased at will by the application of tailored pulse sequences. At low temperatures the LiPS state shows features characteristic of a Berezinski-Kosterlitz-Thouless topological transition, but another distinct state appears at temperatures above 2 K, which shows clear signatures of quantum phase disorder. In the presence of a magnetic field we observe behaviour characteristic of vortex pinning and creep consistent with the 2-dimensional (2D) nature of the phase coherent system. The origin of the LiPS effect is attributed to light pulse control of the Moire-like superlattice of misfit dislocations (MDs) that naturally occur as a result of discommensurations between Al and Si lattices at the interface, and is clearly observable by high-resolution electron microscopy. We show how light pulses can be used to control the superlattice periodicity and highlight the appearance of topologically protected soliton-like kinks along the dislocation lines, important for imparting metastability to the system. The demonstration of LiPS opens a route to the design of metastable long-range phase coherent superconducting states, leading to light-engineering of quantum circuits, local gap tuning in quantum processors and novel devices utilizing switchable superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report、femtosecond laser pulses、high-resolution electron microscopy。；研究对象：铝-硅异质结（Al-Si heterojunction）中由飞秒激光脉冲创建和完全控制的可编程高温超导态（LiPS），涉及界面失配位错（misfit dislocations）形成的莫尔超晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实验证明了一种由光创建并完全控制的宏观量子相位相干超导态（LiPS），其超导临界温度可在1.8-8.5 K范围内通过激光脉冲序列任意增减或擦除，并表现出二维超导特征（如BKT转变、涡旋钉扎与蠕变）以及高温区（>2 K）的量子相位无序行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实验证明了一种由光创建并完全控制的宏观量子相位相干超导态（LiPS），其超导临界温度可在1.8-8.5 K范围内通过激光脉冲序列任意增减或擦除，并表现出二维超导特征（如BKT转变、涡旋钉扎与蠕变）以及高温区（>2 K）的量子相位无序行为。；创新点：首次实现了光对宏观量子相位相干超导态的创建与完全控制（而非仅光诱导超导），并揭示了通过光脉冲调控界面失配位错超晶格周期性和拓扑保护孤子型扭结（soliton-like kinks）的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 使用飞秒激光脉冲对Al-Si异质结进行照射和脉冲序列调控；通过低温输运测量（临界温度、BKT转变、磁阻行为）表征超导态；利用高分辨率电子显微镜（HRTEM）直接观察界面失配位错及其莫尔超晶格结构。

papers.title: Dispersive Readout of a SiMOS Quantum Dot Using a Flip-Chip Integrated Microwave Resonator
papers.abstract: Heterogeneous integration provides a promising route to combine semiconductor quantum dot devices and superconducting microwave circuits, while allowing each component to be fabricated using an optimized process flow. Here, we demonstrate a flip-chip integrated platform for dispersive readout of silicon metal-oxide semiconductor (SiMOS) quantum dot devices. A SiMOS double quantum dot chip is bonded to a superconducting aluminum resonator chip using indium bump interconnects to enable microwave coupling to the quantum dot gate. We show that the developed flip-chip process is compatible with cryogenic operation of both the SiMOS device and the superconducting resonator, and demonstrate resonator-based detection of charge transitions in the quantum dot system. The readout signal-to-noise ratio follows a dependence of $\sqrt{t}$ with the integration time, reaching SNR = 1 at an integration time of approximately 0.3 ms. These results establish flip-chip bonding as a viable integration approach for SiMOS quantum dot devices operating at both dc and microwave frequencies, with potential applications for resonator-based techniques such as spin-photon coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的器件制备（flip-chip bonding, indium bump interconnects）和测量（dispersive readout, resonator-based detection）过程。；研究对象：硅金属氧化物半导体（SiMOS）量子点器件，具体为一个双量子点系统，并与超导微波谐振器通过倒装芯片（flip-chip）技术集成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功演示了利用倒装芯片集成技术，将SiMOS量子点与超导铝谐振器耦合，实现了对量子点电荷跃迁的色散读出，并获得了约0.3毫秒内信噪比达到1的读出性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功演示了利用倒装芯片集成技术，将SiMOS量子点与超导铝谐振器耦合，实现了对量子点电荷跃迁的色散读出，并获得了约0.3毫秒内信噪比达到1的读出性能。；创新点：证明了倒装芯片键合是一种可行的集成方案，能够将SiMOS量子点器件同时工作在直流和微波频率下，为基于谐振器的技术（如自旋-光子耦合）提供了潜在的实现路径。摘要未突出说明与之前其他集成方案（如直接键合、引线键合）相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用了异质集成方法，具体为倒装芯片键合（flip-chip bonding）技术，使用铟凸点（indium bump interconnects）将SiMOS双量子点芯片与超导铝谐振器芯片连接，以实现微波耦合。测量手段为基于谐振器的色散读出（resonator-based dispersive readout），通过监测谐振器响应来探测量子点中的电荷跃迁。

papers.title: Moment-Resolved Readout and Reservoir Diversity in Nonequilibrium Langevin Computing
papers.abstract: Nonlinear thermodynamic computers based on Langevin dynamics exploit thermal fluctuations as a physical substrate for computation. Recent work has shown that quartic-confined fluctuating degrees of freedom can act as thermodynamic neurons capable of nonlinear function approximation at finite observation times. Here we extend this paradigm from mean-only readout to moment-resolved readout. Instead of representing each driven reservoir solely by its first moment, we construct a response vector from the elementwise raw polynomial moments \(\mathbb{E}[\bm{x}]\), \(\mathbb{E}[\bm{x}^{\odot 2}]\), and \(\mathbb{E}[\bm{x}^{\odot 4}]\). These observables combine displacement and central-shape contributions and are naturally aligned with the linear, quadratic, and quartic terms of the local driven dynamics. We further introduce a heterogeneous multi-reservoir architecture in which three reservoirs with distinct initialization and training histories form a joint \(2304\)-dimensional response representation. Under the fixed MNIST \(60000/10000\) reproduction protocol, feature-level fusion achieves the best observed accuracy of \(9695/10000=96.95\%\), compared with \(9682/10000=96.82\%\) for the strongest single-reservoir model and \(9684/10000=96.84\%\) for equal-weight logit averaging. An exact paired McNemar test does not establish a statistically significant improvement over the strongest single reservoir, but the ablation and wrong-set overlap results provide suggestive evidence of complementary classification errors. These results motivate higher-order polynomial-moment readout and reservoir heterogeneity as candidate design principles for finite-time Langevin computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Langevin dynamics、thermodynamic computers、response vector、MNIST reproduction protocol。；研究对象：基于Langevin动力学的非线性热力学计算机，具体为四阶约束（quartic-confined）涨落自由度构成的“热力学神经元”系统，以及异质多储层（heterogeneous multi-reservoir）架构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入矩分辨读出（moment-resolved readout）和异质多储层架构，在固定MNIST测试协议下实现了96.95%的最佳准确率，略高于最强单储层模型的96.82%，但统计检验未达到显著差异；消融实验和错误集重叠分析提示了互补性分类误差的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入矩分辨读出（moment-resolved readout）和异质多储层架构，在固定MNIST测试协议下实现了96.95%的最佳准确率，略高于最强单储层模型的96.82%，但统计检验未达到显著差异；消融实验和错误集重叠分析提示了互补性分类误差的存在。；创新点：将热力学神经元的读出方式从仅依赖一阶矩扩展到包含二阶和四阶多项式矩，并首次引入异质多储层架构以利用不同训练历史带来的互补信息。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架基于Langevin动力学的非线性热力学计算。具体方法包括：1）从仅均值读出（mean-only readout）扩展到矩分辨读出，构造由原始多项式矩 \(\mathbb{E}[\bm{x}]\)、\(\mathbb{E}[\bm{x}^{\odot 2}]\)、\(\mathbb{E}[\bm{x}^{\odot 4}]\) 组成的响应向量；2）引入异质多储层架构，将三个具有不同初始化和训练历史的储层联合形成2304维响应表示；3）在固定MNIST 60000/10000复制协议下进行特征级融合（feature-level fusion）和等权logit平均（equal-weight logit averaging）对比；4）使用精确配对McNemar检验进行统计显著性评估。

papers.title: Fractional quantum ferroelectric control of spin-valley locking and valley Hall effects in altermagnetic monolayer Cr2S2
papers.abstract: Fractional quantum multiferroics, arising from the coupling between fractional quantum ferroelectricity (FQFE) and altermagnetism (AM), provide a promising platform for nonvolatile control of momentum dependent spin splitting in systems with zero net magnetization. However, extending this FQFE-AM coupling to valley degrees of freedom and Berry curvature driven valley Hall effects remains largely unexplored. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that monolayer Cr2S2 realizes a two dimensional FQFE-AM platform with two switchable FQFE states connected by composite symmetry operations combining a fractional lattice translation with time reversal or parity-time reversal. We show that FQFE switching reverses the AM spin-polarized band structure and interchanges the spin characters of the X and Y valleys without rotating the Néel vector, thereby enabling polarization switchable spin-valley locking. Moreover, the two FQFE states exhibit reversed Berry curvature distributions, which, together with the switched spin-valley locking, enable polarization controlled valley Hall effects under both electron and hole doping. These results demonstrate a symmetry based mechanism for nonvolatile electrical control of AM spin splitting, spin-valley locking, and valley Hall effects, offering a general route toward low-power valleytronic devices based on FQFE-AM coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：单层Cr₂S₂中的分数量子铁电性（FQFE）与交变磁性（AM）耦合，以及由此产生的自旋-谷锁定和谷霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层Cr₂S₂是一种二维分数量子铁电-交变磁性平台，通过切换FQFE态可以反转AM自旋极化能带结构、交换X和Y谷的自旋特性，并反转贝里曲率分布，从而实现极化可控的自旋-谷锁定和谷霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层Cr₂S₂是一种二维分数量子铁电-交变磁性平台，通过切换FQFE态可以反转AM自旋极化能带结构、交换X和Y谷的自旋特性，并反转贝里曲率分布，从而实现极化可控的自旋-谷锁定和谷霍尔效应。；创新点：首次将分数量子铁电-交变磁性耦合拓展到谷自由度及贝里曲率驱动的谷霍尔效应，提出了一种基于对称性（复合平移与时间反演或宇称-时间反演操作）的非易失性电控交变磁自旋劈裂、自旋-谷锁定和谷霍尔效应的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Multistate ferroelectricity and switchable layer-locked anomalous valley Hall effects in bilayer ReIrGe2Se6
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional multiferroic materials, which combine magnetic and ferroelectric (FE) orders with strong magnetoelectric coupling, represent ideal platforms for high-density information storage and low-power multistate electronics. However, the intrinsic bistability of conventional ferroelectricity poses a substantial challenge to realizing multiple nonvolatile states and programmable Berry-curvature driven transport responses within a single material. Here, using first-principles calculations, we predict multistate ferroelectricity in AA0-stacked bilayer ReIrGe2Se6. The system hosts four energetically stable FE polarization configurations, among which three are connected through reversible switching pathways, while the fourth exhibits a unidirectional switching pathway. The distinct FE configurations further give rise to a cyclic semiconductor-metal-semiconductor evolution in the electronic structure. Notably, FE polarization switching is intimately coupled to layer degrees of freedom and Berry curvature. The layer-dependent electrostatic potential associated with different FE configurations controls the layer character of the band-edge states, thereby locking the Berry curvature to specific layer channels. As a result, bilayer ReIrGe2Se6 enables switching between an anomalous valley Hall effect and a layer-locked anomalous valley Hall effect, providing nonvolatile control of layer, valley, and spin-resolved transport responses. In addition, magnetization reversal switches the valley and spin channels while preserving the layer-resolved character. These results establish bilayer ReIrGe2Se6 as a multistate ferroelectric platform for programmable Berry-curvature related transport, offering microscopic insight into topology based multifunctional electronic and valleytronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：双层ReIrGe2Se6材料，具体为AA0堆叠的双层结构中的多态铁电性及其与层自由度、贝里曲率耦合导致的异常谷霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AA0堆叠的双层ReIrGe2Se6中预测了多态铁电性，存在四种能量稳定的铁电极化构型，其中三种可通过可逆路径切换，第四种为单向切换路径；不同铁电态可实现对异常谷霍尔效应与层锁定异常谷霍尔效应的非易失性切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在AA0堆叠的双层ReIrGe2Se6中预测了多态铁电性，存在四种能量稳定的铁电极化构型，其中三种可通过可逆路径切换，第四种为单向切换路径；不同铁电态可实现对异常谷霍尔效应与层锁定异常谷霍尔效应的非易失性切换。；创新点：在单一材料中实现了多态铁电性（而非传统双稳态），并揭示了铁电极化与层自由度、贝里曲率的紧密耦合，从而实现了层、谷和自旋分辨输运响应的非易失性调控，为可编程贝里曲率相关输运提供了多态铁电平台。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Interlayer sliding direction as a symmetry selector in altermagnetic bilayer Fe2WS4: Switchable anomalous Hall and anomalous valley Hall effects
papers.abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated collinear magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, offering a promising platform for coupling spin and valley degrees of freedom with ferroelectricity and Berry-curvature driven transport in the absence of net magnetization. However, achieving nonvolatile and selective control of these intertwined degrees of freedom remains a key challenge. Here, using first-principles calculations, we show that the direction of interlayer sliding serves as a symmetry selective control parameter in altermagnetic bilayer Fe2WS4. Diagonal sliding breaks inversion symmetry and produces two sliding ferroelectric states with opposite out-of-plane polarizations. Reversal of the ferroelectric polarization switches the momentum-dependent spin texture and reverses the anomalous Hall conductivity, revealing strong magnetoelectric coupling and enabling a ferroelectrically switchable anomalous Hall effect. In contrast, axial sliding preserves inversion symmetry but breaks the crystalline symmetry relating the X and Y valleys, leading to reversible valley polarization and a switchable anomalous valley Hall effect. These results establish the direction of interlayer sliding as a nonvolatile symmetry selector for controlling ferroelectricity, spin texture, valley polarization, and Hall transport responses in two-dimensional altermagnetic bilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：双层Fe₂WS₄中的交变磁体（altermagnet），具体研究层间滑动方向对铁电性、自旋织构、谷极化以及反常霍尔效应和反常谷霍尔效应的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 层间滑动方向可作为对称性选择器：对角滑动产生铁电态并实现可开关的反常霍尔效应；轴向滑动则实现可开关的反常谷霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：层间滑动方向可作为对称性选择器：对角滑动产生铁电态并实现可开关的反常霍尔效应；轴向滑动则实现可开关的反常谷霍尔效应。；创新点：首次提出在二维交变磁体双层中，通过非易失的层间滑动方向（而非传统电场或磁场）选择性控制铁电性、自旋织构、谷极化及霍尔输运响应，实现了强磁电耦合与可开关的霍尔效应。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否使用DFT+U等），但属于密度泛函理论框架下的计算。

papers.title: Memory-Driven Self-Propulsion and Flocking of Chemically Active Droplets
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates are continually remodeled by biochemical reactions that can exhibit non-Markovian, history-dependent dynamics. We develop a theory of active phase separation with non-Markovian reactions and show that delayed reaction feedback destabilizes stationary droplets: when the memory time becomes comparable to the reaction turnover time, condensates deform and spontaneously acquire a polar, self-propelled state. In multidroplet systems, persistent memory wakes mediate alignment, producing polar flocks and, at higher concentrations, traveling labyrinths. These results establish reaction memory as a control parameter of active phase separation, linking condensate remodeling, autonomous motility, and collective organization, and suggest a possible route to flocking-like behavior within cells.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a theory、non-Markovian reactions、delayed reaction feedback。；研究对象：化学活性液滴（chemically active droplets）及其在非马尔可夫反应驱动下的自推进与集体运动（flocking）行为，属于活性相分离（active phase separation）体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当反应记忆时间与反应周转时间相当时，延迟反应反馈会使静止液滴失稳，自发变形并获得极性自推进状态；在多液滴系统中，持久记忆尾迹（memory wakes）介导对齐，产生极性集群运动及更高浓度下的行波迷宫结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当反应记忆时间与反应周转时间相当时，延迟反应反馈会使静止液滴失稳，自发变形并获得极性自推进状态；在多液滴系统中，持久记忆尾迹（memory wakes）介导对齐，产生极性集群运动及更高浓度下的行波迷宫结构。；创新点：将反应记忆（reaction memory）确立为活性相分离的一个控制参数，揭示了记忆效应如何驱动液滴自主运动与集群组织，为细胞内类似 flocking 行为提供了可能的理论路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：构建了具有非马尔可夫反应的活性相分离理论，通过引入反应记忆时间与反应周转时间的竞争机制，分析液滴的动力学不稳定性及集体行为。

papers.title: The two-particle density matrix of a Luttinger liquid
papers.abstract: Two-particle coherence is the first level of the reduced-density-matrix hierarchy that contains correlations inaccessible to single-particle observables, yet analytic two-particle density matrices are rare even in one dimension. We derive a closed, finite-size expression for the equal-time two-particle reduced density matrix of spinless fermions in a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid using constructive bosonization with an explicit ultraviolet cutoff. In addition to the familiar Luttinger parameter $K$-dependent exponent $γ^2=(K+K^{-1}-2)/2$ which governs the spatial decay of matrix elements, the result exposes a second exponent, $λ=(K^{-1}-K)/2$, which encodes correlations between opposite chiralities and controls the off-diagonal structure. The diagonal limit of the two-particle reduced density matrix yields density correlations and the static structure factor, while its coherences resolve algebraic $2k_F$ charge-density-wave correlations for repulsion and odd-parity p-wave pairing correlations for attraction. After fixing the cutoff from the one-particle density matrix, the analytic result quantitatively reproduces density matrix renormalization group calculations of the interacting J-V chain within the Luttinger liquid regime. The result connects universal Luttinger liquid scaling with observables in finite microscopic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“constructive bosonization”（构造性玻色化）、“analytic result”（解析结果）、“closed, finite-size expression”（闭合有限尺寸表达式），以及未提及实验或数值计算作为主要手段（DMRG仅用于验证）。；研究对象：Tomonaga-Luttinger液体中无自旋费米子的两粒子约化密度矩阵，具体涉及一维相互作用费米子体系（如J-V链）中的电荷密度波和p波配对关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出等时两粒子约化密度矩阵的闭合有限尺寸解析表达式，揭示出除已知的Luttinger参数K依赖的指数γ²外，还存在第二个指数λ=(K⁻¹-K)/2，该指数编码相反手征之间的关联并控制非对角结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出等时两粒子约化密度矩阵的闭合有限尺寸解析表达式，揭示出除已知的Luttinger参数K依赖的指数γ²外，还存在第二个指数λ=(K⁻¹-K)/2，该指数编码相反手征之间的关联并控制非对角结构。；创新点：首次给出Luttinger液体中两粒子约化密度矩阵的解析有限尺寸表达式，并识别出第二个手征关联指数λ，该指数在以往研究中未被明确揭示。
papers.method_zh: 采用构造性玻色化方法，并引入显式紫外截断；通过一粒子密度矩阵固定截断参数后，与密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算结果进行定量对比验证。

papers.title: Memory of Initial Conditions in Self-Similar Diffusion: A Renormalization-Group Perspective
papers.abstract: Universality is usually associated with asymptotic behavior becoming independent of details of the initial state. Using a unified renormalization-group (RG) framework for self-similar dynamics, we show that retaining relevant length scales leads naturally to distinct classes of memory-retaining fixed points. A modified density-dependent diffusion model reveals a general scaling structure in which initial-condition information remains asymptotically relevant, with the Barenblatt equation emerging as a special case. These results provide a new perspective on universality and anomalous scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization-group framework、self-similar dynamics、scaling structure。；研究对象：自相似扩散过程中的初始条件记忆效应，具体以密度依赖扩散模型为体系，探讨标度行为与普适性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自相似动力学中，通过重正化群框架保留相关长度尺度，可自然产生不同类别的记忆保持不动点；初始条件信息在渐近行为中仍然相关，而Barenblatt方程仅是其中的特例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自相似动力学中，通过重正化群框架保留相关长度尺度，可自然产生不同类别的记忆保持不动点；初始条件信息在渐近行为中仍然相关，而Barenblatt方程仅是其中的特例。；创新点：揭示了在传统认为普适性应抹去初始细节的渐近区域中，初始条件信息仍可通过特定不动点类保持相关性，从而对普适性和反常标度提出新视角。
papers.method_zh: 统一的重正化群（RG）理论框架，用于分析自相似动力学；结合修正的密度依赖扩散模型推导一般标度结构。

papers.title: Long-lived memory in sliding spin chains
papers.abstract: We study a system of two ferromagnetic one-dimensional Ising chains coupled to a thermal bath, which are driven out of equilibrium by being moved past one another at a constant speed. We show that even at modest speeds, magnetic friction between the two chains significantly increases the ability of the system to order. In particular, at inverse temperature $β$, Ising coupling $J$, and sliding speed $v$, the dynamics retains memory of its initial magnetization for a time that increases from $\exp(O(βJ))$ at $v = 0$ to $\exp(O((βJ)^2v\ln v))$ when $v>v_c$, where $v_c$ is a small constant. Magnetic friction thus provides a simple mechanism for parametrically slowing down thermalization in a one-dimensional magnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We study、dynamics、theoretical framework（基于伊辛链模型和热浴耦合的理论分析）。；研究对象：滑动铁磁伊辛链系统中的磁摩擦与记忆效应。具体为两条一维铁磁伊辛链在恒定速度相对滑动时，与热浴耦合的非平衡动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在中等滑动速度下，磁摩擦会显著增强系统的有序性，使系统对初始磁化强度的记忆时间从平衡态（v=0）的指数增长（exp(O(βJ))）提升至超指数增长（exp(O((βJ)² v ln v))），从而参数化地延缓了一维磁体的热化过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在中等滑动速度下，磁摩擦会显著增强系统的有序性，使系统对初始磁化强度的记忆时间从平衡态（v=0）的指数增长（exp(O(βJ))）提升至超指数增长（exp(O((βJ)² v ln v))），从而参数化地延缓了一维磁体的热化过程。；创新点：揭示了磁摩擦作为简单机制可参数化地延长一维磁体记忆时间，且记忆时间随速度v增大呈超指数增长（exp(O((βJ)² v ln v))），突破了平衡态下指数增长（exp(O(βJ))）的标度。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于一维伊辛链模型，引入恒定滑动速度v驱动的非平衡动力学，结合热浴耦合，通过解析推导（如记忆时间标度律）研究磁摩擦对有序化和热化时间的影响。

papers.title: Structure Selection by Non-Conservative 3-Body Acoustic Interactions
papers.abstract: Non-conservative multi-body interactions are typically associated with instabilities and activity in driven, field-mediated systems. Here we show that they can also promote stable static structures. Combining experiments and simulations in a minimal, acoustically levitated three-particle system, we tune the relative strength of conservative and non-conservative contributions to the force field. The conservative component favors a symmetric equilibrium configuration, whereas the non-conservative 3-body contribution selects a flattened isosceles triangle. Our results identify non-conservative multi-body forces as a mechanism for static structure selection in driven-dissipative matter in the absence of an effective-energy landscape.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Combining experiments and simulations”，即结合实验与模拟。；研究对象：声悬浮三粒子系统中的非保守多体相互作用，具体研究非保守三体声学相互作用对静态结构选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非保守多体相互作用不仅通常与驱动、场介导系统中的不稳定性相关，还能促进稳定的静态结构；在声悬浮三粒子系统中，非保守三体贡献选择了一个扁平的等腰三角形构型，而保守成分则倾向于对称平衡构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非保守多体相互作用不仅通常与驱动、场介导系统中的不稳定性相关，还能促进稳定的静态结构；在声悬浮三粒子系统中，非保守三体贡献选择了一个扁平的等腰三角形构型，而保守成分则倾向于对称平衡构型。；创新点：首次识别出非保守多体力作为驱动-耗散物质中静态结构选择的机制，且该机制在缺乏有效能量景观的条件下仍能发挥作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用最小化的声悬浮三粒子系统，通过调节保守力与非保守力的相对强度；模拟上对应进行数值模拟，共同分析力场中保守与非保守成分对结构选择的作用。

papers.title: AutoHF: a general Hartree-Fock solver utilizing direct energy minimization with automatic differentiation
papers.abstract: We present autohf, a general, easy-to-use mean-field solver for quantum many-fermion Hamiltonians. It allows the user to bypass the process of deciphering the mean-field form for each many-body Hamiltonian $H$ and thus avoid setting up a tailored program for each $H$. Rather, autohf finds the optimal Slater determinant $|Ψ\rangle$, written in terms of orbital coefficients and subject to symmetry constraints, by directly minimizing the variational energy $\langle H \rangle$. By embracing this variational approach, autohf makes use of the growing power of automatic differentiation and optimization tools developed by the machine learning community.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：mean-field solver、directly minimizing the variational energy、automatic differentiation。；研究对象：量子多费米子哈密顿量的平均场求解方法，不针对特定材料体系，而是通用方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为AutoHF的通用平均场求解器，通过直接能量最小化结合自动微分技术，自动寻找最优Slater行列式，无需为每个多体哈密顿量单独推导平均场形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为AutoHF的通用平均场求解器，通过直接能量最小化结合自动微分技术，自动寻找最优Slater行列式，无需为每个多体哈密顿量单独推导平均场形式。；创新点：用户无需为每个多体哈密顿量手动推导平均场形式并编写定制程序，而是通过自动微分实现通用求解，简化了平均场计算流程。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分法直接最小化期望值⟨H⟩，利用机器学习社区发展的自动微分和优化工具，通过轨道系数参数化Slater行列式并施加对称性约束。

papers.title: Phonons in low-dimensional confined systems: Emergent non-reciprocity in 1D
papers.abstract: An important feature of solid-state or cold atom systems in low dimensions is the restricted oscillations of ionic/atomic degrees of freedom in the confining directions, for which the conventional phonon from canonical quantization is not an ideal description. In this work we propose a general recipe to introduce this feature to otherwise unrestricted systems by mapping displacement fields to spin degrees of freedom. We demonstrate the validity of the approach with a 1D harmonic chain, and the results lead to massive Dirac fermions at long distances, showing the absence of acoustic modes as the signature of confined out-of-plane motion of the entire chain. We then introduce a short-range interaction via anharmonicities and show that for energy scale slightly above the gap, it gives rise to a (quantum) phase transition to a nonreciprocal state with spontaneous time reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) of the type $\hat{T}^2=+1$. Despite the non-conserved total particle number, the model holds an under-appreciated $U(1)$ symmetry with conserved "polarization charge", so that the nonreciprocity can be probed by measuring the change of inductivity to artificial gauge fields in and out of the ordered phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a general recipe、mapping、demonstrate、show、give rise to。；研究对象：低维受限系统中的声子，具体为一维（1D）谐振链中受限的离子/原子振动，以及由此产生的非互易性现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低维受限系统中，通过将位移场映射为自旋自由度，可得到长程表现为无质量狄拉克费米子的有效理论，且当引入非谐性短程相互作用后，系统在能隙以上会发生量子相变，进入一个自发时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB，满足$\hat{T}^2=+1$）的非互易态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低维受限系统中，通过将位移场映射为自旋自由度，可得到长程表现为无质量狄拉克费米子的有效理论，且当引入非谐性短程相互作用后，系统在能隙以上会发生量子相变，进入一个自发时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB，满足$\hat{T}^2=+1$）的非互易态。；创新点：提出了一种将低维受限系统中离子/原子在约束方向上的受限振动映射到自旋自由度的通用方法，并揭示了由此产生的非互易性及自发时间反演对称性破缺的量子相变。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型分析。具体包括：通过映射位移场到自旋自由度构建通用方案；以一维谐振链为例进行验证；引入非谐性相互作用分析相变；利用U(1)对称性（极化电荷守恒）探讨非互易性的探测方法。

papers.title: Spinless charged excitation at the interface between a conventional topological insulator and a topological Mott insulator
papers.abstract: We investigate the interface separating two topologically distinct insulating phases of matter using extensive density-matrix renormalization group calculations to study the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model with a spatially varying interaction strength, chosen to realize both integer quantum Hall and chiral spin liquid states in different spatial regions. We find that the integer quantum Hall-chiral spin liquid interface hosts a spinless charged excitation that is bound to the interface. This mode at the interface is identified through charge and spin pumping, and by direct calculations of low-lying excited states. We also characterize bulk excitations in both phases, finding evidence for fractionalization in the chiral spin liquid and for spin-triplet exciton formation in the integer quantum Hall phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations、extensive numerical study。；研究对象：三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型，具体研究其中整数量子霍尔相与手性自旋液体相之间的界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在整数量子霍尔相与手性自旋液体相的界面处，存在一种束缚于界面的无自旋带电激发。此外，在手性自旋液体相中发现了分数化现象，在整数量子霍尔相中发现了自旋三重态激子形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在整数量子霍尔相与手性自旋液体相的界面处，存在一种束缚于界面的无自旋带电激发。此外，在手性自旋液体相中发现了分数化现象，在整数量子霍尔相中发现了自旋三重态激子形成。；创新点：首次在拓扑平庸的整数量子霍尔相与拓扑莫特绝缘体（手性自旋液体）之间的界面中，发现并表征了无自旋的带电界面激发模式。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度矩阵重归一化群（DMRG）方法，对具有空间变化相互作用强度的三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型进行大规模数值计算。通过电荷与自旋泵浦以及低激发态的直接计算来识别界面模式。

papers.title: Gravity-Induced Thermal Rectification in Gaseous Systems
papers.abstract: Thermal rectification (TR) typically relies on structural asymmetry or material heterogeneity. Here, we show that gravity alone can induce and modulate TR in gaseous systems. Using a minimal model of a single gas particle confined in a two-dimensional channel between heat baths at different temperatures, we analytically demonstrate that gravitational fields generate TR, enabling perfect unidirectional heat conduction across broad gravitational parameter ranges. This effect exhibits an intrinsic trade-off between rectification efficiency and heat power. Extending beyond the single-particle limit, numerical simulations confirm that gravitationally induced TR persists in interacting many-particle systems. Notably, in interacting gas mixtures, the rectification direction can be reversed. Gravity-mediated control of heat currents thus provides new fundamental insights into thermal transport and suggests design principles for gaseous thermal diodes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“analytically demonstrate”“numerical simulations”“minimal model”。；研究对象：气体系统中的热整流现象，具体为重力场对单粒子及多粒子气体体系热传导方向性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅依靠重力场即可在气体系统中诱导并调控热整流，实现近乎完美的单向热传导，且在相互作用的多粒子气体混合物中，整流方向可发生反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅依靠重力场即可在气体系统中诱导并调控热整流，实现近乎完美的单向热传导，且在相互作用的多粒子气体混合物中，整流方向可发生反转。；创新点：突破了传统热整流依赖结构不对称或材料异质性的限制，首次证明重力场本身可作为独立机制诱导和调制气体系统的热整流。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维通道中单气体粒子的最小模型进行解析分析，并利用数值模拟验证相互作用多粒子系统及气体混合物中的热整流行为。

papers.title: Discovery of a symmetry-driven electronic cascade in a $d$-wave altermagnet
papers.abstract: Altermagnets host magnetic compensation together with non-relativistic spin-split bands, a coexistence enabled by crystal symmetry. Yet whether and how crystal symmetry organizes collective electronic order remains largely unexplored. Here we uncover a symmetry-driven cascade of finite-$q$ charge order in a $d$-wave altermagnet Rb$_{1-δ}$V$_2$Te$_2$O, using phase-resolved scanning tunneling microscopy. A primary density-wave instability drives an initial electronic reconstruction, followed by the emergence of a nematic component and an off-axis modulation with wave vectors geometrically tied to the preceding orders. Phase-resolved spectroscopy distinguishes these components through separate contrast-inversion energies and maps out branch-selective spectral-weight redistribution within the off-axis mode. Together with doping and temperature evolution, these observations establish a highly coordinated hierarchy of coupled density-wave instabilities, consistent with successive symmetry lowering. This multi-component hierarchy can be well described in the Landau framework through sequential softening of the charge orders, where bilinear coupling to their compatible octupolar partners at the lower-symmetry stages enables mutual stabilization within an intertwined charge-multipole state. Such a transparent realization of a charge-order cascade shows how altermagnetic symmetry can extend beyond band formation to organize collective electronic order, offering a new perspective on emergent many-body states in correlated quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了phase-resolved scanning tunneling microscopy（相位分辨扫描隧道显微镜）进行实验观测。；研究对象：d波交变磁体Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O中的有限波矢电荷序级联现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在d波交变磁体Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O中，发现由晶体对称性驱动的有限波矢电荷序级联：首先出现初级密度波不稳定性导致电子重构，随后依次出现向列分量和离轴调制，这些分量通过几何关联的波矢和光谱权重再分布形成高度协调的耦合密度波级联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在d波交变磁体Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O中，发现由晶体对称性驱动的有限波矢电荷序级联：首先出现初级密度波不稳定性导致电子重构，随后依次出现向列分量和离轴调制，这些分量通过几何关联的波矢和光谱权重再分布形成高度协调的耦合密度波级联。；创新点：首次在交变磁体中实验揭示了晶体对称性如何组织集体电子序，展示了交变磁对称性超越能带形成、扩展到组织集体电子序的能力，并建立了电荷序级联与对称性逐级降低之间的清晰对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 相位分辨扫描隧道显微镜（phase-resolved STM），结合掺杂和温度演化实验，以及Landau理论框架下的唯象描述。

papers.title: Pressure-Driven Structural Transitions without a Displacive Charge-Density Wave in La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: We investigated the structural properties of bilayer nickelate La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$ as a function of pressure and temperature. At ambient conditions, we show that the material crystallizes as a monoclinic superstructure distinct from the one previously reported and close to the pseudo-orthorhombic structure of pristine La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. No signatures of satellite reflections associated with charge density wave (CDW) ordering are detected at low temperature. Upon compression, a sequence of pressure-induced structural transitions from monoclinic to orthorhombic 15 GPa and then tetragonal 21 GPa symmetry is observed. Within the superconducting dome, the quality of the X-ray diffraction data enables structural refinements enabling theoretical models to understand the emergence of superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：X-ray diffraction、structural refinements、pressure-induced structural transitions。；研究对象：双层镍氧化物 La₂SmNi₂O₇ 在压力与温度下的结构性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在常压低温下未检测到与电荷密度波（CDW）有序相关的卫星反射；随着压力增加，材料依次经历从单斜到正交（约15 GPa）再到四方（约21 GPa）的结构相变，且在超导穹顶区域内可进行结构精修。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在常压低温下未检测到与电荷密度波（CDW）有序相关的卫星反射；随着压力增加，材料依次经历从单斜到正交（约15 GPa）再到四方（约21 GPa）的结构相变，且在超导穹顶区域内可进行结构精修。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: X射线衍射（XRD）实验，结合变温与变压条件，进行结构精修。

papers.title: Locality of deep thermalisation through the lens of entanglement teleportation
papers.abstract: Deep thermalisation characterises the emergence of universal quantum state ensembles on subsystems due to projective measurements on their complement. We study the notion of locality, or lack thereof, in this phenomenon by considering a subsystem partitioned into two disjoint subregions which remain causally disconnected at all times under unitary dynamics. We show that the onset of deep thermalisation in this geometry is fundamentally bounded by measurement-induced entanglement teleportation between the subregions. While measurements on the environment generate entanglement across the disconnected partitions -- suggesting an apparent non-locality -- we demonstrate that generic locally interacting systems exhibit an emergent locality. Specifically, the timescales for both deep thermalisation and entanglement teleportation scale logarithmically with the distance separating the subregions. Exceptions to this include special circuits where the randomness of the measurement outcomes is perfectly transmitted to the ensemble of states of the subsystem, conditioned on the outcomes; in such cases the timescale for deep thermalisation is finite leading to genuine non-locality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论“通过投影测量”“酉动力学”“纠缠传送”等理论概念，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：深热化现象中的局域性，具体研究子系统被划分为两个因果断开的子区域时，深热化与测量诱导的纠缠传送之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一般局域相互作用系统中，深热化和纠缠传送的时间尺度随子区域间距呈对数增长，表现出涌现的局域性；但在特殊电路中，测量结果的随机性可完美传递至子系统态系综，导致深热化时间尺度有限，出现真正的非局域性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一般局域相互作用系统中，深热化和纠缠传送的时间尺度随子区域间距呈对数增长，表现出涌现的局域性；但在特殊电路中，测量结果的随机性可完美传递至子系统态系综，导致深热化时间尺度有限，出现真正的非局域性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于量子信息中的纠缠传送框架，结合投影测量和酉动力学，研究子系统分区几何下的深热化行为。

papers.title: Coulomb blockade in microscopic material defects as a source of decoherence and noise in solid-state quantum circuits
papers.abstract: A critical limitation of solid-state quantum devices arises from the materials from which they are fabricated: uncontrolled surfaces, interfaces, and structural imperfections introduce numerous sources of loss and decoherence. Despite extensive efforts, linking these decoherence mechanisms to their microscopic material origins -- essential for developing effective mitigation strategies -- remains an outstanding challenge that has slowed coherence improvements. Here, using scanning gate microscopy on live superconducting circuits we identify a previously unrecognised decoherence mechanism originating from Coulomb blockade and microwave-driven charge tunnelling in metallic grains. Such grains are ubiquitous in thin-film devices fabricated by standard lithography processes. By characterising multiple defects across different devices, we find such defects to be as common and as debilitating to device performance as two-level system (TLS) defects, while originating from a fundamentally different physical mechanism. Importantly, conventional characterisation techniques would misattribute this loss to other, microwave power-independent processes. Our observations thus reveal a widespread source of decoherence in superconducting circuits, challenging the prevailing paradigm that coherence lifetimes are primarily limited by TLS defects. Eliminating metallic grains during fabrication provides a clear and practical route to suppress this mechanism, offering a pathway towards improved coherence and reduced noise in microwave-based solid-state quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：scanning gate microscopy（扫描门显微镜）、characterising multiple defects（表征多个缺陷）、observations（观测）。；研究对象：固态量子电路（超导电路）中由金属颗粒（metallic grains）引起的库仑阻塞（Coulomb blockade）和微波驱动电荷隧穿（microwave-driven charge tunnelling）导致的退相干与噪声机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种此前未被认识的退相干机制，源于标准光刻工艺制备的薄膜器件中普遍存在的金属颗粒的库仑阻塞效应，其与常见的二能级系统（TLS）缺陷同样普遍且有害，但物理机制根本不同；传统表征技术会误将其归因于其他与微波功率无关的过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种此前未被认识的退相干机制，源于标准光刻工艺制备的薄膜器件中普遍存在的金属颗粒的库仑阻塞效应，其与常见的二能级系统（TLS）缺陷同样普遍且有害，但物理机制根本不同；传统表征技术会误将其归因于其他与微波功率无关的过程。；创新点：识别出金属颗粒的库仑阻塞作为超导电路中一种广泛存在的退相干源，挑战了“相干寿命主要受限于TLS缺陷”的主流范式，并指出通过消除制造过程中的金属颗粒可抑制该机制。
papers.method_zh: 对工作中的超导电路进行扫描门显微镜（scanning gate microscopy）成像，并对不同器件中的多个缺陷进行表征。

papers.title: Analytical and Numerical Study of Quartic Nonlinear Electrodynamics in Holographic Fermion Systems
papers.abstract: We study how the leading string-inspired quartic correction $α'^2 F^4$ modifies holographic fermionic observables in a bottom-up $AdS_4/CFT_3$ model. The gauge sector is described by Maxwell electrodynamics supplemented by the quartic interaction, while the geometry is kept fixed in the probe approximation. We first analyze the nonlinear electrostatic background and derive an exact first integral of the gauge equation, the associated constitutive relation for the radial electric field, the critical coupling for globally regular solutions, and weak-coupling expansions for the electrostatic potential and chemical potential. We then use these backgrounds to compute the retarded Green's function and spectral function of charged probe fermions. The quartic interaction increases the chemical potential, lowers the effective ratio $T/μ$, shifts the Fermi momentum, and enhances the spectral weight without destroying the holographic Fermi surface. We further show that the fermionic observables inherit the even-power dependence on $α'$ implied by the analytic structure of the gauge sector. The resulting probe-limit analysis makes explicit how quartic bulk nonlinearities propagate from the bulk to boundary fermionic observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical and numerical study、holographic fermion systems、bottom-up AdS₄/CFT₃ model、probe approximation。；研究对象：全息费米子系统中由弦理论启发的四次非线性电动力学（quartic nonlinear electrodynamics，即 α'² F⁴ 修正）对费米子可观测量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 四次非线性相互作用会提高化学势、降低有效比值 T/μ、移动费米动量并增强谱权重，但不会破坏全息费米面；费米子可观测量继承了规范场部分解析结构所隐含的 α' 的偶次幂依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：四次非线性相互作用会提高化学势、降低有效比值 T/μ、移动费米动量并增强谱权重，但不会破坏全息费米面；费米子可观测量继承了规范场部分解析结构所隐含的 α' 的偶次幂依赖关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自下而上的 AdS₄/CFT₃ 全息模型，在探针近似下固定几何背景，规范场部分为麦克斯韦电动力学加上四次相互作用项。首先解析求解非线性静电场背景，导出规范方程的第一积分、径向电场的本构关系、全局正则解的临界耦合以及弱耦合展开；然后利用这些背景计算带电探针费米子的推迟格林函数和谱函数。

papers.title: Stochastic binary networks with asymmetric and time-delayed interactions
papers.abstract: Stochastic binary networks are widely used to describe collective dynamics in complex systems and to perform neuromorphic computation, yet realistic networks often contain both asymmetric interactions and finite signal propagation times that fall outside conventional theories. Here we study stochastic binary networks with asymmetric and time-delayed interactions motivated by experimental observations in coupled superparamagnetic tunnel junctions. We find that time delay fundamentally reshapes the dynamics induced by anti-symmetric couplings, producing strong oscillatory temporal correlations consistent with experiment. At the same time, sufficiently long delays drive the steady-state probabilities toward equal state occupations even in strongly coupled systems. These apparently featureless probability distributions coexist with pronounced temporal correlations, distinguishing them from equilibrium high-temperature behavior. We further show analytically that delay-induced uniform distributions emerge in a broad class of stochastic networks, while symmetry-breaking bias fields restore interaction-dependent steady states with qualitatively modified behavior. Simulations of networks with five coupled spins demonstrate that these effects persist beyond minimal systems with only two spins. Our results establish a unified framework for stochastic binary networks in the intermediate regime between symmetric instantaneous interactions and asymmetric or time-delayed interactions, and suggest that asymmetry and delay can be exploited as functional resources in neuromorphic hardware and complex network dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“we study”“we find”“we further show analytically”，并包含“simulations of networks with five coupled spins”。；研究对象：具有非对称相互作用和时滞的随机二元网络，其动力学受耦合超顺磁隧道结实验观测启发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间延迟会根本性地重塑由反称耦合诱导的动力学，产生与实验一致的强振荡时间关联；足够长的延迟会驱使稳态概率趋于均匀分布，即使强耦合系统也不例外，但这种均匀分布伴随显著的时间关联，区别于平衡态高温行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时间延迟会根本性地重塑由反称耦合诱导的动力学，产生与实验一致的强振荡时间关联；足够长的延迟会驱使稳态概率趋于均匀分布，即使强耦合系统也不例外，但这种均匀分布伴随显著的时间关联，区别于平衡态高温行为。；创新点：建立了介于对称瞬时相互作用与非对称/时滞相互作用之间的随机二元网络的统一理论框架，并提出非对称性和延迟可被用作神经形态硬件和复杂网络动力学中的功能性资源。摘要未突出说明与已有理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（解析推导延迟诱导均匀分布的普适条件）与数值模拟（对含五个自旋的网络进行仿真）。

papers.title: Type I/II Vortex Dynamics With Excited Normal Modes
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of excited normal modes on vortex dynamics in the Abelian Higgs model in the type I (static attraction) and type II (static repulsion) regimes. We demonstrate that shape normal modes compete with the static inter-vortex forces. This can result in excited type I (II) vortices repelling (attracting). In addition we observe the existence of spectral walls that prevent the formation (break up) of bound states in type I (II) systems. We study the long lived quasi-bound states and orbits induced by their competing forces and the effective centrifugal forces. Finally, we observe that the effect is strong enough to induce vortex-antivortex pairs to follow long-lived orbits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Abelian Higgs model、normal modes、spectral walls、理论分析。；研究对象：阿贝尔-希格斯模型中的第一类（静态吸引）和第二类（静态排斥）涡旋动力学，特别是激发正常模式对涡旋行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激发正常模式会与静态涡旋间力竞争，导致第一类激发涡旋相互排斥、第二类激发涡旋相互吸引；同时，谱墙的存在会阻止第一类/第二类系统中束缚态的形成或分裂，并诱导涡旋-反涡旋对进入长寿命轨道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激发正常模式会与静态涡旋间力竞争，导致第一类激发涡旋相互排斥、第二类激发涡旋相互吸引；同时，谱墙的存在会阻止第一类/第二类系统中束缚态的形成或分裂，并诱导涡旋-反涡旋对进入长寿命轨道。；创新点：揭示了激发正常模式可以反转第一类/第二类涡旋间力的符号（吸引变排斥、排斥变吸引），并首次在涡旋动力学中观察到谱墙对束缚态形成/分裂的阻碍作用，以及由此诱导的长寿命涡旋-反涡旋对轨道。
papers.method_zh: 基于阿贝尔-希格斯模型的理论分析，通过研究激发正常模式对涡旋动力学的影响，分析谱墙、有效离心力以及准束缚态和轨道的形成机制。

papers.title: Backpropagating Pauli Propagation
papers.abstract: We develop a backpropagation algorithm for evaluating parameter gradients in quantum circuits using Pauli propagation simulation. The method has computational complexity comparable to that of standard sparse Pauli simulation techniques, while producing gradients whose accuracy is of the same order as the corresponding observable expectation values. By exploiting the reversibility of quantum circuits, the algorithm reduces the memory cost by a factor of $\mathcal{O}(n_\text{param})$ compared with conventional reverse-mode automatic differentiation, where $n_\text{param}$ denotes the number of parameters in the circuit. Compared with finite difference methods, the algorithm is $\mathcal{O}(n_\text{param})$ more efficient in function evaluations. These features enable efficient and accurate classical optimization of quantum circuits for applications such as state preparation and time-evolution compression, while also allowing operator-complexity measures such as the operator stabilizer Rényi entropy to be monitored and regularized during optimization. We demonstrate the method by optimizing low-energy state-preparation circuits for transverse-field Ising models in one, two, and three dimensions and for the three-dimensional Heisenberg model, and by compressing two-dimensional time-evolution circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“backpropagation algorithm”、“Pauli propagation simulation”、“classical optimization of quantum circuits”。；研究对象：量子电路中的参数梯度计算与优化，具体应用于低能态制备电路（如横场伊辛模型、海森堡模型）和时间演化压缩电路。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于Pauli传播模拟的反向传播算法，能够在与标准稀疏Pauli模拟相当的计算复杂度下，以与可观测量期望值同量级的精度计算量子电路参数梯度，并将内存成本降低约O(n_param)倍，函数评估效率比有限差分法提高O(n_param)倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于Pauli传播模拟的反向传播算法，能够在与标准稀疏Pauli模拟相当的计算复杂度下，以与可观测量期望值同量级的精度计算量子电路参数梯度，并将内存成本降低约O(n_param)倍，函数评估效率比有限差分法提高O(n_param)倍。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用量子电路的可逆性，结合Pauli传播模拟技术，开发了反向传播自动微分算法。该方法在优化过程中可同时监测和正则化算子复杂度度量（如算子稳定子Rényi熵）。演示系统包括一维、二维、三维横场伊辛模型和三维海森堡模型的低能态制备电路，以及二维时间演化电路的压缩。

papers.title: Periodic orbits and quantum many-body scars in integrable spin chains
papers.abstract: Quantum many-body scars provide an exception to generic thermalising dynamics, but their relation to integrability remains unclear. Here we apply the periodic-orbit framework to the integrable XYZ/XXZ spin-1/2 chain, developing an energy-resolved approach that enables us to locate and track periodic orbits across the spectrum. We identify families of scarred orbits and resolve their supporting eigenstates in terms of Bethe-ansatz quantum numbers, revealing a common string core dressed by zero-momentum magnon pairs. This allows us to reconstruct both the scarred eigenstates and the associated towers directly within the Bethe ansatz, and explain the equidistant tower spacing analytically from the decoupling of zero-momentum magnon pairs in the Bethe equations, providing a microscopic realisation of scar phenomenology in an integrable setting. We further show that this structure persists upon breaking integrability with a transverse field, with the periodic orbits continuing to govern the dynamics. Our results establish a direct connection between the periodic-orbit picture of quantum scarring and the algebraic structure of integrable models, showing that key features of scar dynamics can be understood analytically within the Bethe ansatz framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：periodic-orbit framework、Bethe-ansatz、analytically。；研究对象：可积自旋链（XYZ/XXZ自旋-1/2链）中的量子多体疤痕态及其与可积性的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在可积自旋链中，通过周期轨道框架识别出疤痕轨道家族，并利用Bethe-ansatz量子数解析重构了疤痕本征态及其塔状结构，揭示了零动量磁子对解耦导致等间距塔状能谱的微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在可积自旋链中，通过周期轨道框架识别出疤痕轨道家族，并利用Bethe-ansatz量子数解析重构了疤痕本征态及其塔状结构，揭示了零动量磁子对解耦导致等间距塔状能谱的微观机制。；创新点：首次在可积模型中建立了周期轨道图像与Bethe-ansatz代数结构之间的直接联系，实现了疤痕现象学的微观解析实现，并展示了该结构在弱破坏可积性时仍能主导动力学。
papers.method_zh: 采用周期轨道理论框架，结合Bethe-ansatz方法进行能量分辨分析，通过Bethe方程中零动量磁子对的解耦解析推导塔状能谱间距，并进一步通过引入横向场破坏可积性来检验结构的鲁棒性。

papers.title: On the origin of finite entanglement scaling
papers.abstract: The concept of finite entanglement scaling forms one of the pillars on which the tensor network ecosystem is built. In this paper, we resolve the open problem of determining the actual perturbations induced by matrix product state approximations of critical systems, and we demonstrate that these can be quite different than the ones predicted by conformal field theory. To that aim, we develop a sparse linear solver to calculate the forward and backward derivatives of 2-dimensional tensor networks with respect to their defining parameters in an implicit way. This algorithm is of independent interest as it provides a primitive for the variational optimization of projected entangled pair states that circumvents the instabilities plaguing traditional automatic differentiation methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tensor network、matrix product state、conformal field theory、sparse linear solver、variational optimization。；研究对象：临界系统中矩阵乘积态（MPS）近似所引入的微扰，以及有限纠缠标度（finite entanglement scaling）的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了临界系统矩阵乘积态近似所引入的实际微扰与共形场论预测的微扰存在显著差异，解决了有限纠缠标度中微扰来源的未解问题。
