papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了临界系统矩阵乘积态近似所引入的实际微扰与共形场论预测的微扰存在显著差异，解决了有限纠缠标度中微扰来源的未解问题。；创新点：首次精确确定了临界系统MPS近似引入的实际微扰形式，并揭示了其与共形场论预测的偏离；所提出的稀疏线性求解器为PEPS变分优化提供了新的稳定计算原语。
papers.method_zh: 开发了一种稀疏线性求解器，以隐式方式计算二维张量网络关于其定义参数的前向和反向导数。该算法可规避传统自动微分方法在投影纠缠对态（PEPS）变分优化中的不稳定性问题。

papers.title: An experimental pathway towards an exact theory of strong coupling
papers.abstract: We employ a mathematically equivalent form of the GKLS master equation to arrive at an exact theoretical description of a two-level system strongly coupled to the environment. The framework, while intuitive, shedding light on the physics of the problem, and agreeing with existing results, such as thermalisation to a non-canonical state, is based around three parameters that are unknown outside of the weak coupling regime -- the analogue to the detailed balance relation, and two coupling strength constants. As a way forward, we propose a feasible experimental protocol based on a solid-state electronic quantum dot device, through which the fundamental parameters of the problem can be revealed, which would further the fundamental understanding of strong coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验方案提议）。判断依据：摘要中提及“mathematically equivalent form of the GKLS master equation”“exact theoretical description”，属于理论推导；同时提出“feasible experimental protocol”，属于实验方案设计，因此为混合类型。；研究对象：强耦合环境下二能级系统（two-level system strongly coupled to the environment）的精确理论描述，具体实验体系为固态电子量子点器件（solid-state electronic quantum dot device）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一种与GKLS主方程数学等价的形式，得到了强耦合二能级系统的精确理论描述，该框架能自然解释非正则热化等已知现象，但依赖于三个在弱耦合区域未知的参数（类似细致平衡关系的量及两个耦合强度常数）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一种与GKLS主方程数学等价的形式，得到了强耦合二能级系统的精确理论描述，该框架能自然解释非正则热化等已知现象，但依赖于三个在弱耦合区域未知的参数（类似细致平衡关系的量及两个耦合强度常数）。；创新点：提出了一种通过实验协议（量子点器件）来直接测量强耦合区域中原本未知的三个基本参数的方法，从而为建立强耦合的精确理论提供实验途径。摘要未突出说明与已有理论相比的具体形式差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架基于GKLS主方程的数学等价形式；实验方案基于固态电子量子点器件，用于揭示强耦合问题中的三个基本参数。

papers.title: Interaction energies of H$_2$ and CO on transition-metal surfaces computed by a range-separated hybrid van der Waals density functional
papers.abstract: Dissociative chemisorption (DC) of H$_2$ on the Cu(111) surface is a prototypical problem for understanding elements of heterogeneous catalysis [Science 326, 832 (2009)]. The challenge lies in modeling the reaction dynamics that in turn reflects a classical potential for atomic deformations, friction, and inelastic scattering. Here, I test the use of a set of range-separated hybrid (RSH) van der Waals density functionals (vdW-DFs) [JPCM 37, 211501 (2025)] on their ability to describe the classical barrier for dynamics in this H$_2$+Cu(111) DC problem. I furthermore document use of a variant for fast accurate predictions of the molecular quasi-particles (QPs), finding excellent performance across a set of small molecules that are often studied in catalysis. Finally, I suggest and implement a way to use that QP focus to identify what I consider a best-possible non-empirical (yet adsorbate specific) RSH vdW-DF version, denoted AHBR($γ^*$) for H$_2$ DC modeling, navigating what are partly conflicting requirements on the molecule and metal sides. I find that the AHBR($γ^*$) can determine the classical H$_2$+Cu(111) DC barrier height close to chemical accuracy. I suggest that DC modeling can test broader relevance of the physics underpinning these RSH vdW-DFs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：test、compute、density functional、modeling）；研究对象：H₂在Cu(111)表面的解离化学吸附（DC）问题，以及CO等小分子在过渡金属表面的相互作用能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一种特定非经验性的范围分离杂化范德瓦尔斯密度泛函（AHBR(γ*)），可以接近化学精度地计算H₂+Cu(111)体系的经典解离势垒高度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一种特定非经验性的范围分离杂化范德瓦尔斯密度泛函（AHBR(γ*)），可以接近化学精度地计算H₂+Cu(111)体系的经典解离势垒高度。；创新点：提出并实现了一种利用分子准粒子（QP）焦点来识别针对特定吸附质（如H₂）的最佳非经验性RSH vdW-DF版本（AHBR(γ*)），以协调分子侧和金属侧的部分矛盾要求。
papers.method_zh: 使用范围分离杂化（RSH）范德瓦尔斯密度泛函（vdW-DFs）进行第一性原理计算，并发展了一种基于分子准粒子（QP）的快速准确预测变体，用于筛选最佳的非经验性泛函版本（AHBR(γ*)）。

papers.title: Neural operators solve inverse problems for constitutive model discovery
papers.abstract: Characterizing the mechanical response of materials traditionally requires solving optimization problems in which model parameters are calibrated or trained to minimize the discrepancy between model predictions and experimental data. This process can be computationally expensive and time-consuming. To overcome this limitation, we propose two neural operator architectures that directly map experimentally measured data to the constitutive functions governing the mechanical response of the material: Physics-Augmented Neural Operators (PANO) and Constitutive Artificial Neural Operators (CANO). The proposed neural operators approximate the mapping between the infinite-dimensional input space of full-field displacement measurements and net reaction forces, and the infinite-dimensional output space of hyperelastic strain-energy density functions. The displacement fields are encoded through Laplacian eigenfunctions to obtain discretization-independent and noise-robust predictions. Our framework constrains the output space to physically admissible material models that satisfy fundamental physical requirements by design. The neural operators are trained on simulated data tuples of displacement fields and reaction forces for a range of material models. Once trained, the neural operators enable near-instantaneous material characterization and require only a single forward pass to infer the strain-energy density function from a given experimental dataset. We test the predictive power of the neural operators for unseen data, noisy data, data with missing information, data from different spatial discretizations, and data from geometries of different sizes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要描述神经网络架构（PANO, CANO）的设计、训练和测试，属于计算方法与理论框架的构建。；研究对象：材料本构模型发现。具体而言，是研究如何从实验测量数据（全场位移和反作用力）直接反演得到描述材料力学响应的超弹性应变能密度函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了两种神经算子架构（PANO和CANO），能够将全场位移和反作用力数据直接、近乎即时地映射到物理上可接受的超弹性本构函数，从而绕过了传统优化方法中计算昂贵的参数校准过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了两种神经算子架构（PANO和CANO），能够将全场位移和反作用力数据直接、近乎即时地映射到物理上可接受的超弹性本构函数，从而绕过了传统优化方法中计算昂贵的参数校准过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，主要创新点在于：1）将神经算子框架应用于本构模型发现这一逆问题，实现了从无限维输入空间（全场位移和力）到无限维输出空间（应变能密度函数）的直接映射；2）通过设计，强制输出满足物理约束；3）使用拉普拉斯本征函数编码输入，提高了对噪声和不同离散化方式的鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 提出了两种神经算子架构：物理增强神经算子（PANO）和本构人工神经算子（CANO）。该方法使用拉普拉斯本征函数对位移场进行编码，以实现离散化无关和噪声鲁棒的预测。输出空间被约束为满足基本物理要求的物理上可接受的材料模型。模型在模拟生成的数据集上进行训练。

papers.title: Implicit differentiation of tensor network algorithms
papers.abstract: The current leading approach to the variational optimization of projected entangled-pair states (PEPS) is based on automatic differentiation, which allows for a convenient evaluation of the energy gradient with respect to the local variational degrees of freedom. However, evaluating the energy gradient not only remains a major computational bottleneck of the optimization procedure, but also suffers from frequent numerical instabilities. In this work, we adopt recent advances in implicit differentiation techniques to address these challenges in PEPS optimization. By reformulating the core step of the gradient computation in terms of a single characteristic equation for the contraction environment, we reduce the cost of the gradient computation and improve its scaling with the problem size. By choosing a suitable parametrization of this characteristic equation based on the intrinsic symmetries of the contraction environment, we can directly remove instabilities from the global gradient computation that would otherwise arise from the derivatives of subroutines of the contraction algorithm. Finally, we demonstrate how this approach drastically simplifies the practical implementation of stable gradient-based PEPS optimization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“variational optimization”、“automatic differentiation”、“implicit differentiation techniques”、“tensor network algorithms”。；研究对象：投影纠缠对态（PEPS）的变分优化问题，具体关注其能量梯度计算中的计算瓶颈和数值不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过采用隐式微分技术，将梯度计算的核心步骤重新表述为单个收缩环境的特征方程，降低了计算成本并改善了随问题规模的扩展性；同时利用收缩环境的内在对称性选择特征方程的合适参数化，直接消除了全局梯度计算中的数值不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过采用隐式微分技术，将梯度计算的核心步骤重新表述为单个收缩环境的特征方程，降低了计算成本并改善了随问题规模的扩展性；同时利用收缩环境的内在对称性选择特征方程的合适参数化，直接消除了全局梯度计算中的数值不稳定性。；创新点：将隐式微分方法引入PEPS优化，通过单一特征方程替代传统自动微分中的多子程序求导，同时利用对称性参数化从根本上移除数值不稳定性，显著简化了稳定梯度优化的实际实现。
papers.method_zh: 隐式微分技术（implicit differentiation techniques），结合基于收缩环境对称性的特征方程参数化方法，用于改进PEPS优化中的梯度计算。

papers.title: A Geometric Theory of Fermion-to-Qubit Encodings
papers.abstract: Exact fermion to qubit transformations are conventionally regarded as algorithmic tools that translate many-body Hamiltonians into qubit representations for quantum simulation. Here we show that they also define intrinsic geometric representations whose structure encodes physically meaningful information beyond spectral equivalence. We develop a geometric framework based on weighted hypergraphs and coupling space representations constructed from the Bravyi--Kitaev (BK) and Xia--Bian--Kais (XBK) encodings. Within the BK representation, we introduce a geometric observable that compares the algebraic connectivities of the kinetic and interaction hypergraphs, derive its exact analytical dependence on interaction strength, and uncover two geometric universality classes together with an exact spectral organization originating from the binary tree architecture of the encoding. The complementary XBK representation describes the evolution of encoded Hamiltonians through probability measures in coupling space, where optimal transport quantifies interaction-driven reorganization independently of the spectral analysis. Applications to the Hubbard, spinless tV , single impurity Anderson, and Kitaev models demonstrate that these connectivity and transport based geometric descriptions consistently capture the structural evolution of encoded quantum Hamiltonians across distinct classes of many-body systems. Our results establish hypergraph geometry as a new framework for understanding fermion-to-qubit encodings,revealing that they serve not only as computational mappings but also as geometric representations of quantum many-body Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：geometric framework、weighted hypergraphs、coupling space representations、analytical dependence、universality classes。；研究对象：费米子到量子比特编码（如Bravyi–Kitaev和Xia–Bian–Kais编码）所定义的几何结构，以及这些结构如何描述多体哈密顿量的内在几何信息。具体应用模型包括：Hubbard模型、自旋less tV模型、单杂质Anderson模型和Kitaev模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 费米子到量子比特的编码不仅是计算映射，还定义了内在的几何表示，其结构编码了超越谱等价的物理信息。通过引入基于加权超图的几何可观测量，发现了两种几何普适类以及源于编码二叉树结构的精确谱组织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：费米子到量子比特的编码不仅是计算映射，还定义了内在的几何表示，其结构编码了超越谱等价的物理信息。通过引入基于加权超图的几何可观测量，发现了两种几何普适类以及源于编码二叉树结构的精确谱组织。；创新点：将费米子到量子比特编码视为几何表示，而非仅作为量子模拟的算法工具；建立了基于超图几何的新框架，揭示了编码哈密顿量在不同多体系统间的结构演化规律。
papers.method_zh: 基于加权超图和耦合空间表示构建几何框架；在Bravyi–Kitaev表示中引入几何可观测量，比较动能与相互作用超图的代数连通性，并推导其对相互作用强度的精确解析依赖；在Xia–Bian–Kais表示中，通过耦合空间中的概率测度描述编码哈密顿量的演化，并用最优输运量化相互作用驱动的重组。

papers.title: Electrons Hopping across a Molecular Network: Spectra and Symmetries
papers.abstract: We investigate interacting spinless electrons on finite molecular ring networks described by a tight-binding Hubbard Hamiltonian. The interplay between lattice geometry, Coulomb interactions and discrete symmetries is analysed for rings with $L=3,4,5,6$ nodes, filled with one, two or three electrons. Special attention is devoted to the role of the network symmetries in determining the structure of the many-body spectrum and the Mulliken classification of the eigenstates. Using group-theoretical methods, we examine the evolution of the spectra in the presence of an external magnetic flux. The Zeeman effect lifts degeneracies and results in combination with the Coulomb interaction to avoided crossings in symmetry sectors. We identify a qualitatively distinction between systems with an even and odd number of particles. At half-filling, particle-hole symmetry (duality) protects selected symmetry sectors against Zeeman splitting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：tight-binding Hubbard Hamiltonian、group-theoretical methods、many-body spectrum。；研究对象：有限分子环网络上的相互作用无自旋电子体系，具体为具有L=3,4,5,6个节点、填充1、2或3个电子的环状网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统能谱结构由晶格几何、库仑相互作用与离散对称性共同决定；粒子数为偶数和奇数时存在定性区别，且在半填充时粒子-空穴对称性（对偶性）保护特定对称扇区免受塞曼分裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统能谱结构由晶格几何、库仑相互作用与离散对称性共同决定；粒子数为偶数和奇数时存在定性区别，且在半填充时粒子-空穴对称性（对偶性）保护特定对称扇区免受塞曼分裂。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚哈伯德哈密顿量进行理论建模，采用群论方法分析多体能谱结构，并利用Mulliken分类对本征态进行对称性分类；通过引入外磁通研究塞曼效应与库仑相互作用耦合导致的能级交叉避免现象。

papers.title: Tuning the universality class of a quantum process by Trotterization
papers.abstract: We numerically analyze a discretized version of the quantum contact process, a non-equilibrium model having a competition between a coherent infection process and a dissipative recovery process. Previously, the continuous-time version has been discussed to have a phase transition in a novel quantum universality class, while experimental investigations of a related process have pointed towards the transition being in the classical directed percolation class. We demonstrate that these differences stem from details of the discretization of the process and construct a systematic way to continuously interpolate between these results. Finally, we provide evidence that the modification of the universality class is due to destructive interference effects, showing a clear quantum-mechanical origin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“numerically analyze”（数值分析）、“discretized version”（离散化版本）、“construct a systematic way”（构建系统方法）。；研究对象：量子接触过程（quantum contact process）的离散化版本，这是一个非平衡模型，涉及相干感染过程与耗散恢复过程之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该量子过程的普适类（universality class）可以通过Trotter化（离散化）的细节进行调控，并且普适类的改变源于破坏性干涉效应，具有明确的量子力学起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该量子过程的普适类（universality class）可以通过Trotter化（离散化）的细节进行调控，并且普适类的改变源于破坏性干涉效应，具有明确的量子力学起源。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数值分析离散化的量子接触过程，通过系统性地连续插值（continuously interpolate）不同离散化方案来研究普适类的变化。

papers.title: Lyapunov spectrum scaling transition for quasiperiodic nonlinear unitaries
papers.abstract: We study the Lyapunov spectrum scaling of thermal weakly-nonlinear unitary maps in the presence of quasiperiodic potentials. We search for the crossover from long-range to short-range scaling as the localization length ξ decreases and compare the details to the case of uncorrelated Anderson disorder [Phys. Rev. Res. 6 L012064 (2024)]. A comparative statistical analysis of the eigenstates for the linear case shows that quasiperiodicity has a stronger localization impact at the same value of ξ. Therefore we expect that the scaling crossover should be enhanced as well. However, the numerical analysis shows that it is strongly delayed as compared to Anderson disorder, and is observed at anomalously small values of ξ. These findings hint at the potential impact of long range correlations of quasiperiodic localized eigenstates, which persist in the presence of interactions even in the case of integrability breaking and thermalization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Lyapunov spectrum scaling、numerical analysis、statistical analysis。；研究对象：准周期势场中的弱非线性幺正映射，具体研究其Lyapunov谱标度行为，并与安德森无序情形进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准周期势场中，随着局域化长度ξ减小，Lyapunov谱从长程标度到短程标度的交叉被强烈延迟，仅在异常小的ξ值下才出现，这与安德森无序情形不同。这一现象可能源于准周期局域本征态的长程关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准周期势场中，随着局域化长度ξ减小，Lyapunov谱从长程标度到短程标度的交叉被强烈延迟，仅在异常小的ξ值下才出现，这与安德森无序情形不同。这一现象可能源于准周期局域本征态的长程关联。；创新点：揭示了准周期势场中局域化长度与Lyapunov谱标度交叉之间的反常关系，指出其与安德森无序的关键差异，并暗示准周期局域本征态的长程关联在相互作用和热化过程中仍可能持续存在。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值分析计算弱非线性幺正映射的Lyapunov谱标度，并对线性情况下的本征态进行统计比较分析，以对比准周期势与安德森无序的局域化效应。

papers.title: Overlapping Network Community Detection Using Sparse Backbones
papers.abstract: Community structures are common in real networks, and extracting them provides valuable insight in applications ranging from drug discovery to market segmentation. Overlapping community detection (OCD) is the task of clustering networked data in which nodes may belong to multiple clusters. Existing OCD algorithms often struggle to achieve a suitable balance between detection quality and scalability. We, therefore, propose Highway, a scalable OCD algorithm that exploits the sparse backbone of the input network to perform efficient community inference. We used 728 Lancichinetti-Fortunato-Radicchi benchmark networks to compare Highway and its ablated version against 10 existing OCD algorithms. Our results, based on five performance measures, demonstrate a competitive performance for Highway. It ranks first in overlapping normalized mutual information with a 6.9% improvement over the strongest baseline. It also ranks second in all the other four performance measures. These comparative results suggest that Highway coupled with its backbone procedure offers a suitable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. The Highway algorithm is open-source and available as part of the CDlib library.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：提出并实现了一种新的算法（Highway），并在基准网络上进行了性能比较和评估。；研究对象：网络中的重叠社区检测（Overlapping Community Detection, OCD）问题。这是一个数据聚类问题，应用于药物发现、市场细分等领域，研究对象是网络数据中的社区结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为Highway的可扩展重叠社区检测算法，该算法通过利用输入网络的稀疏骨干（sparse backbone）进行社区推理，在检测质量与可扩展性之间取得了良好的平衡。在728个基准网络上的测试表明，其重叠归一化互信息（ONMI）指标比最强基线方法提升了6.9%，并在其他四项性能指标中均排名第二。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为Highway的可扩展重叠社区检测算法，该算法通过利用输入网络的稀疏骨干（sparse backbone）进行社区推理，在检测质量与可扩展性之间取得了良好的平衡。在728个基准网络上的测试表明，其重叠归一化互信息（ONMI）指标比最强基线方法提升了6.9%，并在其他四项性能指标中均排名第二。；创新点：提出了一种利用网络稀疏骨干（sparse backbone）进行高效社区推理的新算法（Highway），旨在解决现有OCD算法在检测质量与可扩展性之间难以平衡的问题。该算法已开源并集成于CDlib库中。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种名为Highway的算法，其核心创新是利用输入网络的稀疏骨干（sparse backbone）来提升社区检测的效率。作者使用了728个Lancichinetti-Fortunato-Radicchi (LFR) 基准网络，将Highway算法及其消融版本与10种现有的OCD算法进行了比较，并基于五种性能指标（包括重叠归一化互信息ONMI等）进行评估。

papers.title: Full-data accuracy with fewer labels for training and fine-tuning machine-learning force fields
papers.abstract: Machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) are reliable only near their training distribution, making efficient construction of diverse training sets a major bottleneck for both train-from-scratch and foundation fine-tuning workflows. Active learning can reduce this cost, but standard model-committee uncertainty is impractical for foundation MLFFs because each committee member requires a separate fine-tuning run. We present an active-learning workflow based on last-layer-projection regression (LLPR), a forward-pass-cheap per-configuration uncertainty estimator. Across molecular, condensed-phase, and electrolyte systems, LLPR identifies compact, high-value training sets that recover full-data accuracy using only a small fraction of electronic-structure labels. In foundation-model fine-tuning, LLPR-selected configurations reach the full-pool fine-tuning ceiling with substantially fewer labels than random selection. In iterative electrolyte fine-tuning, LLPR detects unphysical local coordination before DFT labelling, provides an absolute force-error threshold, and enables automatic termination of the learning loop. The resulting models reproduce reference density and ion-coordination structure, providing a scalable uncertainty-quantification strategy across MLFF training regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine-learning force fields (MLFFs)”、“active-learning workflow”、“last-layer-projection regression (LLPR)”，核心是提出并验证一种新的计算工作流和不确定性量化方法。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是机器学习力场（MLFF）的训练过程，具体应用于分子、凝聚相（如液态）和电解质体系。摘要未明确说明具体的材料名称，而是泛指这几类体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于最后一层投影回归（LLPR）的主动学习工作流，能够仅使用一小部分电子结构标签数据，就训练出达到全数据训练精度的机器学习力场。在基础模型微调中，该方法比随机选择更高效；在迭代微调中，它能自动检测非物理的局域配位并实现学习循环的自动终止。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于最后一层投影回归（LLPR）的主动学习工作流，能够仅使用一小部分电子结构标签数据，就训练出达到全数据训练精度的机器学习力场。在基础模型微调中，该方法比随机选择更高效；在迭代微调中，它能自动检测非物理的局域配位并实现学习循环的自动终止。；创新点：提出了一种适用于基础模型微调的实用主动学习策略，解决了标准模型委员会不确定性方法因需要多次微调而成本过高的问题。LLPR方法不仅高效，还能提供绝对力误差阈值，并实现学习过程的自动终止，为MLFF训练提供了一种可扩展的不确定性量化策略。
papers.method_zh: 主要方法是主动学习工作流，其核心是**最后一层投影回归（LLPR）**，这是一种计算成本低廉的逐构型不确定性估计器。该方法被应用于从头训练和基础模型微调两种场景，并在分子、凝聚相和电解质体系中进行测试。

papers.title: Confined acoustic phonon mode filtering in free-standing nanocrystalline silicon membranes
papers.abstract: We report the femtosecond time-resolved measurements of confined acoustic phonons in free-standing nanocrystalline silicon membranes and compare them directly with the crystalline silicon counterpart. While the latter exhibit well-resolved higher-order modes, a strong suppression of these modes is observed in nanocrystalline samples with grain size distribution controlled by thermal annealing. The suppression is strongly frequency dependent and becomes more pronounced as the phonon wavelength approaches the characteristic grain size. By separating intrinsic and extrinsic contributions to the phonon lifetime, we identify an additional frequency-dependent decay channel associated with grain boundaries, with scattering rates following a power-law dependence close to $f^{2}$, where $f$ is the frequency. The measured sound velocity is consistent with previous reports for nanocrystalline silicon and indicates an effective elastic response arising from multiple crystallographic orientations. These results establish coherent phonons as a sensitive probe of microstructure-dependent scattering in nanocrystalline materials and indicate that grain boundaries act as an effective spectral filter for high-frequency acoustic phonons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：femtosecond time-resolved measurements（飞秒时间分辨测量）。；研究对象：自由支撑纳米晶硅薄膜中的受限声学声子，以及晶界对高频声子传播的滤波效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纳米晶硅薄膜中，高阶声学声子模式被强烈抑制，且抑制程度随频率增加而增强；晶界引入了一个额外的频率依赖的衰减通道，其散射率接近频率的平方（f²）关系，从而起到高频声子谱滤波器的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纳米晶硅薄膜中，高阶声学声子模式被强烈抑制，且抑制程度随频率增加而增强；晶界引入了一个额外的频率依赖的衰减通道，其散射率接近频率的平方（f²）关系，从而起到高频声子谱滤波器的作用。；创新点：首次将受限相干声子作为敏感探针，系统区分了本征与非本征贡献，定量揭示了晶界对高频声子的频率选择性散射机制，并建立了散射率与频率的幂律关系（~f²）。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒时间分辨光学测量（femtosecond time-resolved measurements），通过热退火控制晶粒尺寸分布，并与晶体硅样品进行直接对比。

papers.title: Circuit complexity lower bounds for quantum spin glasses
papers.abstract: A central question in quantum information theory is the circuit complexity of states arising from standard many-body models. We study this question for quantum $p$-spin glasses, random Hamiltonians whose interactions act on $p$-tuples of qubits through Pauli strings. Anschuetz, Gamarnik, and Kiani (arXiv:2404.07231) showed that the optimum energy is separated from the best energy achievable by product states. This leaves open whether shallow circuits can close the gap, since even depth-one circuits can generate entanglement. We show that the entanglement needed to close the product-state gap cannot be generated at shallow depth. When the average interaction degree grows with $n$, we prove that, for all sufficiently large fixed $p$, any circuit preparing an $n$-qubit state whose normalized energy is within a fixed positive constant of the optimum must have depth $Ω_p(\log n)$. In the bounded-average-degree regime, we prove a fixed-depth obstruction: for every fixed $D$, a sufficiently large degree prefactor rules out depth-$D$ preparation of near-ground states. Both results hold uniformly over circuits with an arbitrary number of ancilla qubits. Our results give an obstruction in the spirit of the No Low-Energy Trivial States problem of Freedman and Hastings (arXiv:1301.1363), but for random quantum spin glasses rather than code-based Hamiltonians such as those of Anshu, Breuckmann, and Nirkhe (arXiv:2206.13228), whose ground states admit polynomial-size preparation circuits. This setting opens a probabilistic route to NLTS-like questions: we recast state-preparation lower bounds for random quantum Hamiltonians as uniform control of Gaussian processes indexed by shallow circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：circuit complexity（电路复杂度）、lower bounds（下界）、proof（证明）、Gaussian processes（高斯过程）。；研究对象：量子自旋玻璃（quantum spin glasses），具体为随机哈密顿量，其相互作用通过泡利字符串作用于量子比特的p元组上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于量子p-自旋玻璃，任何制备接近最优能量状态的量子电路，其深度必须随系统规模增长（在平均相互作用度随n增长时，深度至少为Ω_p(log n)）；在平均度有界时，足够大的度前因子会完全禁止固定深度的电路制备近基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于量子p-自旋玻璃，任何制备接近最优能量状态的量子电路，其深度必须随系统规模增长（在平均相互作用度随n增长时，深度至少为Ω_p(log n)）；在平均度有界时，足够大的度前因子会完全禁止固定深度的电路制备近基态。；创新点：将Freedman和Hastings提出的“无低能平凡态”（NLTS）问题中的障碍思想，从基于编码的哈密顿量（如Anshu等人的工作）推广到随机量子自旋玻璃，开辟了通过概率方法研究NLTS类问题的路径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用高斯过程对浅层电路进行均匀控制，将状态制备下界问题转化为对浅层电路索引的高斯过程的统一控制问题。证明中区分了“平均相互作用度随n增长”和“平均度有界”两种情形，并考虑了任意数量辅助量子比特的电路。

papers.title: Disorder-enhanced compressibility of Floquet random quantum circuits
papers.abstract: Current quantum hardware is limited by noise and decoherence, which restrict the depth of unitary circuits that can be implemented with high fidelity. We investigate how the compressibility of time-evolution operators depends on the dynamical regime of the underlying many-body system. As a testbed, we study a one-dimensional Floquet random circuit with a tunable competition between interactions and on-site disorder. Using tensor-network simulations, we characterize operator growth through the operator-entanglement entropy of the Floquet unitary as well as of out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs). We find rapid operator scrambling at weak disorder, while strong disorder leads to slow OTOC-front propagation and logarithmic or near-logarithmic operator-entanglement growth over the accessible time window. We then optimize shallow brickwall circuits to approximate the Floquet evolution and show that strong-disorder circuits can be compressed to substantially smaller depths than weak-disorder circuits at fixed logarithmic fidelity density. These results suggest that localized or slowly scrambling dynamics provide a favorable regime for compressed quantum simulation on noisy devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tensor-network simulations（张量网络模拟）、operator-entanglement entropy（算符纠缠熵）、数值优化。；研究对象：一维Floquet随机量子电路，研究其中相互作用与无序的竞争对时间演化算符可压缩性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强无序导致的局域化或慢速量子混沌动力学，使得Floquet时间演化算符可以被压缩到显著更浅的电路深度，从而有利于在含噪量子硬件上进行压缩量子模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强无序导致的局域化或慢速量子混沌动力学，使得Floquet时间演化算符可以被压缩到显著更浅的电路深度，从而有利于在含噪量子硬件上进行压缩量子模拟。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用张量网络模拟，通过计算Floquet幺正算符的算符纠缠熵以及out-of-time-ordered correlators（OTOC）来表征算符增长；然后优化浅层砖墙电路以近似Floquet演化，并比较不同无序强度下的压缩深度。

papers.title: Nonplanar qubit with tunable gauge symmetry
papers.abstract: Circuit quantum electrodynamics embeds Josephson junction qubits within superconducting cavities, and has emerged as a leading approach to quantum computing and quantum simulation. Despite the many permutations of circuit geometry that have been explored, Josephson connectivities have so far been planar, making them effectively low-dimensional. Here we show that a non-planar qubit -- a $3\times3$ crossbar Josephson array -- gives rise to flux-tunable $\mathbb{Z}_3$ combinatorial gauge symmetry (CGS), potentially enabling spin-liquid behavior when networked into a lattice. The observed excitation spectrum shows excellent agreement with predictions from a neural network trained to generate variational quantum states, demonstrating that we have predictive power over our high-dimensional quantum system. Fine-structure splittings near the CGS point are compatible with weak tunneling or symmetry breaking due to experimental imperfections. We additionally use the superconducting cavity to externally induce symmetry breaking, observing a restoration of symmetry at the CGS point where ground states differ only by a $\mathbb{Z}_3$ phase. This work initiates a general program exploring lattice gauge theories using the toolbox of circuit quantum electrodynamics. More broadly, introducing non-planar Josephson connectivities opens a vast space for experimental and theoretical exploration of structures in almost any imaginable dimensionality and geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：circuit quantum electrodynamics, observed excitation spectrum, experimental imperfections, superconducting cavity）；研究对象：非平面约瑟夫森结阵列量子比特（3×3交叉条约瑟夫森阵列），及其在电路量子电动力学中实现的Z₃可调谐规范对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非平面约瑟夫森结阵列（3×3交叉条结构）可产生通量可调的Z₃组合规范对称性，其激发谱与神经网络生成的变分量子态预测高度吻合，并在规范对称点附近观察到精细结构分裂及外部诱导的对称性破缺与恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非平面约瑟夫森结阵列（3×3交叉条结构）可产生通量可调的Z₃组合规范对称性，其激发谱与神经网络生成的变分量子态预测高度吻合，并在规范对称点附近观察到精细结构分裂及外部诱导的对称性破缺与恢复。；创新点：首次在电路量子电动力学中引入非平面约瑟夫森连接性，突破了传统平面几何的维度限制，开辟了利用该平台探索任意维度与几何结构晶格规范理论的新方向。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用电路量子电动力学平台，将非平面约瑟夫森结阵列嵌入超导腔中；理论上使用神经网络训练生成变分量子态以预测激发谱；通过超导腔外部诱导对称性破缺，并观测对称性恢复行为。

papers.title: Quantum many-body mixed phase space revealed by hybrid feedback control
papers.abstract: Understanding how complex systems transition between order and chaos is a central challenge of nonequilibrium physics. While weak perturbations of classical integrable systems give rise to a mixed phase space of coexisting regular and chaotic trajectories, analogous behavior in interacting quantum many-body systems has remained elusive. Here we develop and experimentally implement a hybrid quantum-classical feedback protocol that autonomously discovers and stabilizes long-lived regular trajectories in a superconducting quantum processor. Each iteration combines short-time quantum evolution with classical optimization that projects the dynamics back onto a low-entanglement variational manifold, effectively distilling coherence from chaotic evolution. The stabilized trajectories reveal a quantum many-body mixed phase space emerging from nonlinear variational dynamics, without a direct analogue in classical or few-body quantum systems. Our results establish a versatile framework for algorithmic discovery and control of coherent dynamics previously inaccessible to experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally implement”“superconducting quantum processor”以及“classical optimization”“nonlinear variational dynamics”等理论框架。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的混合相空间（mixed phase space），即在相互作用量子多体系统中，规则轨迹与混沌轨迹共存的现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过混合量子-经典反馈控制协议，在超导量子处理器上自主发现并稳定了长寿命的规则轨迹，揭示了量子多体混合相空间的存在，该相空间源于非线性变分动力学，在经典或少数体量子系统中没有直接对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过混合量子-经典反馈控制协议，在超导量子处理器上自主发现并稳定了长寿命的规则轨迹，揭示了量子多体混合相空间的存在，该相空间源于非线性变分动力学，在经典或少数体量子系统中没有直接对应。；创新点：首次在实验上实现并揭示了相互作用量子多体系统中的混合相空间，通过算法自主发现并稳定了此前实验无法触及的相干动力学轨迹。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用超导量子处理器，结合短时量子演化与经典优化（将动力学投影回低纠缠变分流形），实现混合量子-经典反馈控制协议。

papers.title: Magic Without Entanglement: Exact Revivals and Their Fisher Information Origin
papers.abstract: Magic and entanglement are independent quantum resources, yet their exact relation in many-body dynamics has remained elusive. We uncover two structural principles. First, at any stabilizer state, the curvature of the second stabilizer Rényi entropy under an arbitrary Hermitian generator equals the quantum Fisher information up to a fixed normalization, creating a bidirectional bridge between computational and metrological resources. Second, for commuting Ising evolution on any forest graph, a Clifford pruning circuit yields the full stabilizer-Rényi family at arbitrary size and in any spatial embedding, thereby furnishing a graph-theoretic construction of families with finite magic density and vanishing entanglement density in the thermodynamic limit. We solve two paradigmatic one-dimensional realizations central to quantum simulation -- an Ising quench and a kicked Floquet chain -- exactly for arbitrary system size and directly in the thermodynamic limit, revealing finite magic density with vanishing entanglement density, distinct magic and entanglement revival periods, and Clifford points with zero magic but finite bipartite entanglement. The same tangent geometry fixes initial growth, perturbative revival lifting, and stability of thermodynamic magic minima. Large-scale Pauli-basis matrix-product-state calculations verify all predictions, and the tangent bridge yields a concrete protocol for detecting magic through established quantum-Fisher-information measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了“structural principles”（结构原理）、“graph-theoretic construction”（图论构造）、“exact solutions”（精确解）以及“matrix-product-state calculations”（矩阵乘积态计算），属于理论推导与数值验证相结合。；研究对象：多体量子动力学中“魔法”（magic，即非稳定子资源）与“纠缠”（entanglement）这两种量子资源之间的关系，具体以伊辛模型（Ising model）的淬火动力学和 kicked Floquet 链为范例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了两个结构原理：1）在任意稳定子态下，第二稳定子Rényi熵关于任意厄米生成元的曲率（归一化后）等于量子Fisher信息，建立了计算资源与计量资源之间的双向桥梁；2）对于任意森林图上的对易伊辛演化，存在一个Clifford剪枝电路，可在热力学极限下构造出具有有限魔法密度但纠缠密度为零的家族。具体在一维伊辛淬火和kicked Floquet链中，实现了有限魔法密度与零纠缠密度共存、魔法与纠缠具有不同复兴周期、以及Clifford点处魔法为零但纠缠有限等精确结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了两个结构原理：1）在任意稳定子态下，第二稳定子Rényi熵关于任意厄米生成元的曲率（归一化后）等于量子Fisher信息，建立了计算资源与计量资源之间的双向桥梁；2）对于任意森林图上的对易伊辛演化，存在一个Clifford剪枝电路，可在热力学极限下构造出具有有限魔法密度但纠缠密度为零的家族。具体在一维伊辛淬火和kicked Floquet链中，实现了有限魔法密度与零纠缠密度共存、魔法与纠缠具有不同复兴周期、以及Clifford点处魔法为零但纠缠有限等精确结果。；创新点：首次在可精确求解的多体动力学模型中，严格证明了魔法与纠缠可以完全解耦（有限魔法密度伴随零纠缠密度），并揭示了量子Fisher信息与稳定子Rényi熵曲率之间的定量等价关系，从而为通过已有的量子Fisher信息测量实验来探测魔法提供了具体协议。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（基于稳定子Rényi熵的几何曲率分析、图论构造、Clifford剪枝电路）、精确解析求解（任意系统尺寸及热力学极限下的伊辛淬火和Floquet链）、以及大规模Pauli基矩阵乘积态（MPS）数值计算验证。

papers.title: Exploring the shell structure of trapped superfluid gases
papers.abstract: We provide quantum Monte Carlo calculations of a two-component Fermi system interacting with an attractive interaction confined in harmonic traps. We investigate the role of the interaction's scattering length and effective range and show its important role in modifying shell effects in the structure of these systems. We show that in the strongly interacting regime, where the scattering length is large, the dominant role to shell effects is due to the effective range. These conclusions are very relevant for nuclear physics, in particular for neutron-rich systems, and open the way to perform new atomic experiments that can help to explain the disappearance of shell-effects in nuclei.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo calculations（量子蒙特卡洛计算）。；研究对象：被囚禁在谐振子势阱中的双组分费米超流气体，具体研究其壳层结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强相互作用区域（散射长度很大时），有效力程对壳层效应起主导作用，而散射长度的影响相对次要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强相互作用区域（散射长度很大时），有效力程对壳层效应起主导作用，而散射长度的影响相对次要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 量子蒙特卡洛（Quantum Monte Carlo）数值计算方法，用于模拟双组分费米系统在谐振子势阱中的基态性质，并系统分析相互作用散射长度和有效力程对壳层结构的影响。

papers.title: Benchmarking quantum simulation at scale
papers.abstract: The applications for which quantum computers will clearly outperform classical computers are still being identified and benchmarking such an advantage is challenging. We propose a scalable verification scheme for non-equilibrium quantum simulation based on stabilizer scars, a special class of quantum many-body scars, whose structure ensures both classical simulability and efficient direct fidelity estimation. Assuming a physically motivated error model, we show that the fidelity of quantum simulating these states bounds the fidelity of classically intractable simulations, providing a benchmark for quantum-advantage experiments in non-equilibrium dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了一个“可扩展的验证方案”（scalable verification scheme），并基于“假设的物理误差模型”（assuming a physically motivated error model）进行理论分析，未提及具体实验操作或数值计算。；研究对象：非平衡量子模拟（non-equilibrium quantum simulation）中的量子优势验证问题。具体体系为基于“稳定子疤痕态”（stabilizer scars）的量子多体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种利用稳定子疤痕态作为基准的可扩展验证方案，证明了对这些经典可模拟态进行量子模拟的保真度，可以作为对经典难解模拟保真度的上界，从而为非平衡动力学中的量子优势实验提供基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种利用稳定子疤痕态作为基准的可扩展验证方案，证明了对这些经典可模拟态进行量子模拟的保真度，可以作为对经典难解模拟保真度的上界，从而为非平衡动力学中的量子优势实验提供基准。；创新点：提出了一种可扩展的（scalable）验证方案，利用稳定子疤痕态同时具备经典可模拟性和高效保真度估计的特性，将量子模拟的验证问题与量子优势的基准测试联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于稳定子疤痕态（一种特殊的量子多体疤痕态）的结构特性，结合直接保真度估计（direct fidelity estimation）方法。通过假设一个物理上合理的误差模型，推导出经典可模拟态与经典难解态之间的保真度关系。

papers.title: Renormalisation of Inhomogeneous Random Graphs
papers.abstract: We consider inhomogeneous random graphs in which vertices are assigned i.i.d.\ random weights, pairs of distinct vertices are connected by an edge independently with a probability that is a bi-variate function of the weights of the vertices, and single vertices are connected to themselves by a self-loop independently with a probability that is a uni-variate function of the weight of the vertex. We apply a renormalisation transformation in which vertices are aggregated into groups of equal size according to a greedy algorithm, namely, distinct groups of aggregated vertices are connected by an aggregated edge if and only if there is at least one edge connecting two constituent vertices across the groups, while a group of aggregated vertices is connected to itself by an aggregated self-loop if and only if there is at least one self-loop at an internal vertex or one edge connecting a pair of distinct internal vertices. We analyse what happens when the renormalisation transformation is iterated. In particular, we show that, starting from appropriately scaled connection functions, the iterated renormalised graphs converge to a two-parameter family of random graphs, acting as an attractor in a universality class. We consider a light-tailed regime, for which the scaling limit is a homogeneous Erdős--Rényi random graph, and a heavy-tailed regime, for which the scaling limit is an inhomogeneous random graph with stable infinite-mean random weights and an exponential disconnection function. Different scalings are needed for the two regimes. Which of the two regimes prevails depends on the choice of the connection functions and the choice of the law of the random weights.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalisation transformation（重整化变换）、scaling limit（标度极限）、universality class（普适类）。；研究对象：非均匀随机图（inhomogeneous random graphs），其中顶点带有独立同分布的随机权重，边和自环的连接概率分别由权重决定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在迭代重整化变换下，非均匀随机图会收敛到一个两参数族随机图，该族作为普适类中的吸引子；具体收敛到均匀的Erdős–Rényi随机图还是非均匀的稳定无限均值随机图，取决于连接函数和权重分布的选择。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在迭代重整化变换下，非均匀随机图会收敛到一个两参数族随机图，该族作为普适类中的吸引子；具体收敛到均匀的Erdős–Rényi随机图还是非均匀的稳定无限均值随机图，取决于连接函数和权重分布的选择。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用重整化变换：通过贪心算法将顶点聚集成等大小组，组间存在聚合边当且仅当至少有一条跨组边，组内存在聚合自环当且仅当至少有一条内部边或自环。分析该变换的迭代行为，并区分轻尾和重尾两种标度区域。

papers.title: Quantum Transport and Apparent Work Function Distributions of Atomic Contacts via a 3D-Printed High-Vacuum Platform
papers.abstract: We present a low-cost, 3D-printed high-vacuum platform integrating a mechanically controllable break-junction system and a custom logarithmic amplifier for room-temperature quantum transport measurements. Using copper as a highly reactive test case, we successfully resolve the $1G_0$ conductance quantum under both high vacuum and anhydrous glycerol, demonstrating the effectiveness of these environments against rapid atmospheric oxidation. In parallel, utilizing gold as a robust benchmark, we systematically extract the apparent work function ($φ$) from thousands of tunneling traces across ambient air, vacuum, and glycerol. Our analysis demonstrates that the statistical distribution of $φ$ rigorously follows a non-central chi-square distribution. The obtained gold work functions match existing literature across all environments. Although lower than bulk values, they perfectly align with theoretical models accounting for atomic-scale roughness, apex geometry, and environmental adsorbates. Ultimately, this methodology establishes an accessible and reproducible framework for systematic nanoscale research on reactive materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：3D-printed high-vacuum platform、quantum transport measurements、mechanically controllable break-junction system。；研究对象：原子尺度金属接触（铜和金）的量子输运性质，以及表观功函数的统计分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低成本3D打印高真空平台上，成功观测到铜的$1G_0$电导量子，并系统提取了金的表观功函数，其统计分布严格遵循非中心卡方分布，且与环境（空气、真空、甘油）无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低成本3D打印高真空平台上，成功观测到铜的$1G_0$电导量子，并系统提取了金的表观功函数，其统计分布严格遵循非中心卡方分布，且与环境（空气、真空、甘油）无关。；创新点：开发了一种低成本、可复现的3D打印高真空平台，能够对高活性金属（如铜）进行室温量子输运测量，并建立了表观功函数统计分布的理论模型（非中心卡方分布），为活性材料的纳米尺度研究提供了系统框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用3D打印高真空平台集成机械可控断裂结系统与定制对数放大器，在室温下进行量子输运测量；通过数千条隧穿曲线统计提取表观功函数，并利用非中心卡方分布进行拟合分析。

papers.title: An exactly solvable macroscopic fluctuation theory of single-file diffusion
papers.abstract: Single-file diffusion is a ubiquitous phenomenon in low-dimensional systems, arising in transport inside narrow channels. Its natural continuum model is a one-dimensional gas of extended Brownian hard rods (BHR). Perhaps owing to the perceived intractability of this problem, much of the literature has traditionally focused on lattice exclusion models, where integrability methods have yielded remarkable, albeit limited, exact results. A major recent advance comes from a formal solution of macroscopic fluctuation theory (MFT) for the exclusion process. Yet, despite the formal solution, only a handful of properties have been made explicit. We show that the corresponding MFT of the extended BHR gas is in fact exactly solvable through a canonical transformation. We demonstrate this by explicit computation of the large-deviation statistics of the tracer-position and integrated-current in both annealed and quenched ensembles. We further show that an analogous canonical transformation applies to the MFT of lattice gases with finite-volume exclusion, yielding corresponding tracer and current statistics. We validate our results using rare-event simulations for both the continuum and the lattice models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“exactly solvable”“canonical transformation”“explicit computation”，属于解析理论推导，并辅以“rare-event simulations”验证。；研究对象：单列扩散（single-file diffusion）中的硬杆气体（extended Brownian hard rods, BHR）连续模型，以及有限体积排斥的晶格气体模型。具体物理现象为一维受限通道中的输运与涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一个正则变换，扩展布朗硬杆气体的宏观涨落理论（MFT）可以被精确求解，从而显式计算出退火和淬火系综中示踪粒子位置与累积流的大偏差统计。该正则变换同样适用于有限体积排斥的晶格气体MFT。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一个正则变换，扩展布朗硬杆气体的宏观涨落理论（MFT）可以被精确求解，从而显式计算出退火和淬火系综中示踪粒子位置与累积流的大偏差统计。该正则变换同样适用于有限体积排斥的晶格气体MFT。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 宏观涨落理论（MFT）框架下的解析正则变换方法，以及针对连续模型和晶格模型的稀有事件模拟（rare-event simulations）验证。

papers.title: Orbital Hybridization Induces Giant Cubic Rashba Effect at Cu/WO$_{3}$ Interface
papers.abstract: Harnessing Rashba spin-orbit interaction and related spintronic functionalities has traditionally relied on metallic surfaces or interfaces containing elemental heavy metals. Here, using first-principles calculations and Cu(001)/WO$_3$(001) as a model heterostructure, we show that interfacing a light metal, Cu, with a band insulator, WO$_3$, yields an interface state that exhibits a robust Rashba spin splitting arising from the interplay between linear and cubic Rashba effects. The spin splitting is driven by the strong spin-orbit coupling of W atoms and enabled by W-Cu orbital hybridization at the interface. The cubic Rashba contribution asymptotically grows with Cu thickness and can be explained in terms of cross-coupling between the vacuum/Cu and Cu/WO$_3$ interfaces. This interfacial cross-coupling, however, diminishes at larger Cu thicknesses, allowing us to extract the intrinsic cubic Rashba parameter, which has a giant value of approximately -1.93 eV $Å^3$. In contrast, the linear Rashba parameter is only weakly affected by this cross-coupling and varies from approximately 0.30 to 0.49 eV Å. We further show that sizable linear and cubic Rashba effects persist across several interface geometries and Cu surface orientations, including (110) and (111). Our work identifies the Cu/WO$_3$ interface as a novel light-metal/heavy-element-based oxide platform for exploring the rich spectrum of Rashba physics, including linear and nonlinear spin-orbit phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：Cu(001)/WO₃(001)异质结界面，具体研究该界面处由轨道杂化诱导的Rashba自旋劈裂现象，包括线性与立方Rashba效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在轻金属Cu与绝缘体WO₃的界面处，通过W-Cu轨道杂化及W原子的强自旋-轨道耦合，产生了巨大的立方Rashba效应（本征立方Rashba参数约-1.93 eV·Å³），同时线性Rashba参数在0.30至0.49 eV·Å之间变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在轻金属Cu与绝缘体WO₃的界面处，通过W-Cu轨道杂化及W原子的强自旋-轨道耦合，产生了巨大的立方Rashba效应（本征立方Rashba参数约-1.93 eV·Å³），同时线性Rashba参数在0.30至0.49 eV·Å之间变化。；创新点：首次在轻金属（Cu）与氧化物绝缘体（WO₃）的界面中发现了巨大的立方Rashba效应，突破了传统依赖重金属表面或界面的限制，提出了基于轻金属/重元素氧化物的新型Rashba物理平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（密度泛函理论，DFT），以Cu(001)/WO₃(001)为模型异质结构，并考察了不同Cu厚度、不同界面几何构型以及Cu(110)和(111)表面取向的影响。

papers.title: Gelation of functional peptides by trivalent cations at the air-water interface
papers.abstract: We report a mechanism for gelation at fluid interfaces driven by multivalent-cation-mediated bridging. At the air-water interface, peptides with bound lanthanide cations undergo a coordination-geometry transition that converts the metal from a single-peptide bound state to a multi-peptide bridging state, driving charge inversion and gel formation. Surface adsorption and non-ideal interfacial electrostatics are implicated in this transition. The gel is stabilized by reversible metal-ligand coordination bonds that resist bulk salt screening, fundamentally distinct from electrostatic charge-inversion gelation in proteins. This reveals the breakdown of the peptide's coordinating sphere as a distinct pathway for interfacial gelation, independent of the diffuse electrostatic mechanisms governing bulk protein aggregation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：report、mechanism、surface adsorption、interfacial electrostatics。；研究对象：空气-水界面处由三价镧系阳离子介导的功能肽凝胶化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多价阳离子介导的桥接作用驱动流体界面凝胶化：肽结合镧系阳离子发生配位几何转变，从单肽结合态转变为多肽桥接态，导致电荷反转并形成凝胶。该凝胶由可逆金属-配位键稳定，能抵抗体相盐屏蔽，与蛋白质中静电电荷反转凝胶化机制根本不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多价阳离子介导的桥接作用驱动流体界面凝胶化：肽结合镧系阳离子发生配位几何转变，从单肽结合态转变为多肽桥接态，导致电荷反转并形成凝胶。该凝胶由可逆金属-配位键稳定，能抵抗体相盐屏蔽，与蛋白质中静电电荷反转凝胶化机制根本不同。；创新点：揭示了肽配位球层在界面凝胶化中的独立作用路径，区别于控制体相蛋白质聚集的扩散静电机制。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如光谱、显微镜、流变学等），仅提及表面吸附和非理想界面静电学分析。

papers.title: Electric field controlled spin transport in a topological insulator interfaced with a ferroelectric antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: Topological insulators have been explored extensively for spin-charge interconversion via magnetic interfaces, yet the true response of their spin-charge conversion, particularly in the absence of an external magnetic field, remains to be studied. Here, we report electric-field control of spin-charge conversion in the topological insulator Bi$_2$Te$_3$ with the antiferromagnetic multiferroic BiFeO$_3$, employing a nonlocal spin transport device. A systematic thickness dependence of the spin transport across the interface between Bi$_2$Te$_3$ and BiFeO$_3$ reveals a signature of topological surface-state-dominated spin transport in the bilayer system. The spin-charge conversion remains robust for thicknesses above 10 nm but falls rapidly with reducing thickness and vanishes at 5 nm. This is consistent with the hybridization-induced emergence of a trivial insulating phase, which is supported by the coherency factor estimated from the magnetoconductance of Bi$_2$Te$_3$. These results establish that spin-momentum-locked surface states dominate interfacial spin transport in the decoupled regime. Beyond presenting efficient spin-charge interconversion at an entirely insulating magnetic interface, this work also highlights sputter-deposited Bi$_2$Te$_3$ as a high-quality and scalable platform for integrating quantum materials into devices. The nonlocal spin transport approach presented here provides a simple and direct evidence of spin-charge conversion and opens an efficient and practical pathway toward designing energy-efficient spin-based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“采用非局域自旋输运器件”、“系统性的厚度依赖关系”、“磁电导分析”等实验手段。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体Bi₂Te₃与多铁性反铁磁体BiFeO₃构成的异质结界面处的自旋-电荷转换现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Bi₂Te₃/BiFeO₃异质结中，通过电场控制实现了自旋-电荷转换，并证实了拓扑表面态主导了界面自旋输运。当Bi₂Te₃厚度低于5纳米时，由于杂化导致平庸绝缘相的出现，自旋-电荷转换效应消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Bi₂Te₃/BiFeO₃异质结中，通过电场控制实现了自旋-电荷转换，并证实了拓扑表面态主导了界面自旋输运。当Bi₂Te₃厚度低于5纳米时，由于杂化导致平庸绝缘相的出现，自旋-电荷转换效应消失。；创新点：1. 在完全绝缘的磁性界面（BiFeO₃）上实现了高效的自旋-电荷转换，无需外加磁场。2. 证明了溅射沉积的Bi₂Te₃可作为高质量、可扩展的平台，用于将量子材料集成到器件中。3. 提供了一种简单直接的、基于非局域自旋输运的方法来证明自旋-电荷转换。
papers.method_zh: 采用非局域自旋输运器件，测量了Bi₂Te₃厚度变化对界面自旋输运的影响。通过分析Bi₂Te₃的磁电导估算相干因子，以支持对拓扑相变的理论解释。Bi₂Te₃薄膜通过溅射沉积制备。

papers.title: Unified Terahertz Framework for Magnetic and Lattice Responses Reveals an Elusive Ordering Transition in Gd$_2$Ru$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: Magnetic order in materials combining localized rare-earth moments with itinerant transition-metal sublattices generates internal fields whose lattice imprint is rarely accessed directly. In Gd pyrochlore ruthenate, we find that a single terahertz spectrum resolves an exchange-split Gd$^{3+}$ mode and an optical phonon. Their coupled evolution quantifies the internal field, oriented as predicted for cluster-multipolar order, and reveals a Gd-ordering transition elusive to bulk thermodynamic probes, establishing a unified framework for accessing magnetic and lattice responses in correlated quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：terahertz spectrum（太赫兹光谱）、resolves（分辨出）、quantifies（量化）。；研究对象：Gd₂Ru₂O₇（钆焦钌酸盐），一种结合局域稀土（Gd³⁺）磁矩与巡游过渡金属（Ru）子晶格的磁性材料，以及其中隐藏的Gd有序相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个太赫兹光谱同时分辨出交换分裂的Gd³⁺模式和一个光学声子，通过它们的耦合演化量化了内场，揭示了体热力学探针难以探测的Gd有序相变，建立了统一框架来同时获取关联量子材料中的磁性和晶格响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个太赫兹光谱同时分辨出交换分裂的Gd³⁺模式和一个光学声子，通过它们的耦合演化量化了内场，揭示了体热力学探针难以探测的Gd有序相变，建立了统一框架来同时获取关联量子材料中的磁性和晶格响应。；创新点：利用单一太赫兹光谱同时探测磁性和晶格响应，并以此揭示传统体热力学手段无法观测到的隐藏有序相变，为研究局域-巡游混合磁性体系提供了统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹光谱（terahertz spectroscopy），通过分析Gd³⁺磁激发模式与光学声子的耦合演化来提取内场信息。

papers.title: The WEST code for large-scale excited-state materials simulations
papers.abstract: We present WEST, an open-source plane-wave pseudopotential code for large-scale excited-state materials simulations, and describe its theoretical foundations, software architecture, and capabilities. WEST implements full-frequency GW, quantum defect embedding theory, the Bethe-Salpeter equation, and time-dependent density functional theory within a common algorithmic framework that avoids the explicit computation of virtual electronic states. By combining density functional and density matrix perturbation theory, low-rank representations of the dielectric screening and exact exchange, and localization techniques, WEST achieves favorable computational scaling with system size. The code supports the calculation of quasi-particle and neutral excitation energies, optical and photoluminescence spectra, excited-state forces, and non-adiabatic couplings, with interoperable workflows connecting to quantum chemistry, vibronic coupling, and quantum computing packages. A hierarchical parallelization strategy and GPU acceleration deliver near-ideal strong scaling to thousands of GPUs, enabling accurate excited-state simulations of systems with more than a thousand atoms. Representative applications, spanning the full optical cycle of solid-state spin defects, self-trapped excitons in metal-halide perovskites, and the optical response of liquid water and ice, demonstrate the accuracy and versatility of the code across diverse material classes. The capabilities implemented in WEST establish the code as a scalable platform for predictive excited-state simulations, high-throughput materials discovery, and the generation of high-fidelity datasets for machine learning in computational materials science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：open-source code, theoretical foundations, software architecture, computational scaling, GPU acceleration）；研究对象：该论文研究的是用于大规模激发态材料模拟的开源平面波赝势代码WEST，其适用的材料体系包括固态自旋缺陷、金属卤化物钙钛矿中的自陷激子、液态水和冰等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WEST代码通过避免显式计算虚电子态的算法框架，结合密度泛函与密度矩阵微扰理论、低秩表示和局域化技术，实现了对超过一千个原子体系的准确激发态模拟，并在数千GPU上达到近理想强扩展性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WEST代码通过避免显式计算虚电子态的算法框架，结合密度泛函与密度矩阵微扰理论、低秩表示和局域化技术，实现了对超过一千个原子体系的准确激发态模拟，并在数千GPU上达到近理想强扩展性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断其创新在于将多种激发态计算方法统一在避免显式虚态计算的框架内，并实现大规模并行与GPU加速，支持与量子化学、振动耦合和量子计算软件包的互操作工作流）。
papers.method_zh: 具体方法包括：全频率GW方法、量子缺陷嵌入理论、Bethe-Salpeter方程、含时密度泛函理论；采用密度泛函与密度矩阵微扰理论、介电屏蔽和精确交换的低秩表示、局域化技术；层次化并行策略和GPU加速。

papers.title: Thermodynamic and electrical transport properties of the half-Heusler plumbide TbAuPb
papers.abstract: Structural, thermodynamic and electrical transport properties of TbAuPb were investigated on single crystals. The compound was found to crystallize with the cubic MgAgAs-type structure characteristic of half-Heusler materials. It orders antiferromagnetically at TN = 5 K and undergoes a transition into a different antiferromagnetic phase emerging in high magnetic fields. Electrical transport in TbAuPb exhibits a multiband character, with a predominance of hole-like carriers. Angular magnetoresistance evolves systematically with applied magnetic field and changes its symmetry near the spin-reorientation transition, highlighting strong coupling between the charge transport and the magnetic order. The results of first-principles calculations indicate that TbAuPb is a band inverted semimetal in the non-magnetic state, which becomes topologically trivial in the field-induced ferromagnetic state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章，辅以第一性原理计算。判断依据：摘要明确提及对单晶进行了结构、热力学和电输运性质的实验研究，并进行了第一性原理计算。；研究对象：半赫斯勒铅化物 TbAuPb 单晶。具体研究了其晶体结构、磁有序、电输运性质以及电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TbAuPb 是一种在零场下具有反铁磁有序（TN = 5 K）的能带反转半金属，其电输运呈现多带特征且与磁有序强耦合；在强磁场诱导的铁磁态中，其拓扑性质变为平庸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TbAuPb 是一种在零场下具有反铁磁有序（TN = 5 K）的能带反转半金属，其电输运呈现多带特征且与磁有序强耦合；在强磁场诱导的铁磁态中，其拓扑性质变为平庸。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长、结构表征、热力学性质测量、电输运测量（包括角分辨磁电阻）、第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Driven Odd Elasticity in Passive Mechanical Metamaterials
papers.abstract: We present a mechanical mechanism leveraging passive mechanical components, i.e. chiral gears and a square lattice metamaterial, to demonstrate driven odd elasticity in a mechanical metamaterial. The mechanism couples tension and shear in a non-reciprocal way, resulting in an odd shear modulus. The emergence of this odd shear modulus enables non-conservative work in a standard quasistatic strain cycle, and further enables the non-Hermitian skin effect in dynamics. Our results demonstrate that odd elasticity can be achieved in mechanical structures using passive elements without electronic components coupled with feedback or robotic control systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：passive mechanical components, demonstrate, mechanical metamaterial）；研究对象：被动机械超材料，具体由手性齿轮和方形晶格超材料构成的力学结构，以及其中出现的驱动奇弹性（driven odd elasticity）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过被动机械元件（手性齿轮与方形晶格超材料）实现了非互易的拉剪耦合，从而在力学超材料中产生奇剪切模量，并进一步在准静态应变循环中实现非保守功，在动力学中实现非厄米趋肤效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过被动机械元件（手性齿轮与方形晶格超材料）实现了非互易的拉剪耦合，从而在力学超材料中产生奇剪切模量，并进一步在准静态应变循环中实现非保守功，在动力学中实现非厄米趋肤效应。；创新点：首次在完全被动（无电子元件、无反馈或机器人控制系统）的力学结构中实现了奇弹性，证明了奇弹性不依赖于主动控制或电子反馈。
papers.method_zh: 利用被动机械元件（手性齿轮和方形晶格超材料）构建力学超材料，通过结构设计实现张力与剪切力的非互易耦合，测量奇剪切模量，并分析准静态应变循环中的非保守功以及动力学中的非厄米趋肤效应。

papers.title: $\texttt{iNORG}$: An open-source quantum impurity solver package based on the natural orbitals renormalization group
papers.abstract: In the context of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) calculations for strongly correlated electron systems, quantum impurity solvers play a central computational role in treating correlated lattice models and realistic materials. Consequently, developing efficient and robust quantum impurity solvers remains a key challenge. In this paper, we present an open-source quantum impurity solver package based on the natural orbitals renormalization group (NORG) method, dubbed $\texttt{iNORG}$. This software delivers high accuracy with reduced computational cost by optimizing the bath representation using natural orbitals and incorporating advanced features such as efficient Hilbert space selection and efficient algorithms for computing Green's functions. We first introduce the basic principle of the NORG method and then discuss the implementation details. The software framework, major features, and installation procedure for $\texttt{iNORG}$ are explained as well. Finally, several simple examples are presented to demonstrate the usage of $\texttt{iNORG}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：open-source quantum impurity solver package、natural orbitals renormalization group (NORG)、implementation details。；研究对象：强关联电子系统中的量子杂质模型，具体服务于动力学平均场理论（DMFT）计算中的杂质求解器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个基于自然轨道重整化群（NORG）方法的开源量子杂质求解器软件包 iNORG，声称其具有高精度和较低计算成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个基于自然轨道重整化群（NORG）方法的开源量子杂质求解器软件包 iNORG，声称其具有高精度和较低计算成本。；创新点：开发并开源了基于NORG方法的量子杂质求解器软件包 iNORG，通过自然轨道优化浴场表示来降低计算成本，并集成了高效的希尔伯特空间选择和格林函数计算算法。
papers.method_zh: 自然轨道重整化群（NORG）方法，通过自然轨道优化浴场表示，并结合高效的希尔伯特空间选择算法以及计算格林函数的有效算法。

papers.title: Dipolar mixtures in checker-board optical bilayers
papers.abstract: Ultra-cold dipolar mixtures in component-dependent optical potentials constitute an interesting platform for the study of the interplay between intra- and inter-component anisotropic long-range interactions. We study the particular case of binary dipolar mixtures placed in separated bilayers which are displaced in an anti-magic wavelength configuration. Using a combination of second-order perturbation theory and cluster-Gutzwiller calculations, we unveil a rich landscape of possible crystalline phases for the two components, showing that, interestingly, inter-site hopping may result, via super-exchange, in solid-into-solid transitions between different crystalline phases. These crystalline phases and the corresponding transitions can be experimentally realized using e.g. lanthanide mixtures in optical lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用了二阶微扰理论和团簇-Gutzwiller计算方法。；研究对象：超冷偶极混合物在棋盘式光学双层晶格中的晶体相行为，具体研究二元偶极混合物在反魔幻波长配置下的分离双层体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了两种组分可能形成的丰富晶体相图，并发现通过超交换机制，晶格间跳跃可导致不同晶体相之间的“固体-固体”相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了两种组分可能形成的丰富晶体相图，并发现通过超交换机制，晶格间跳跃可导致不同晶体相之间的“固体-固体”相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 二阶微扰理论（second-order perturbation theory）和团簇-Gutzwiller计算（cluster-Gutzwiller calculations）。

papers.title: Using superpixels for interpretable feature reduction in large 2D diffraction datasets
papers.abstract: Large 2D diffraction datasets, consisting of hundreds or thousands of measurements, are commonly acquired with 4D-STEM electron diffraction or at synchrotron X-ray beamlines. Machine learning and artificial intelligence offer great promise for analyzing these datasets. However, the sheer volume of data presents a significant data processing bottleneck. Cropping the detector and pixel binning are standard ways to reduce data size. Here we propose grouping and averaging pixels into superpixels of variable area. High-information regions are sampled densely, while low-information areas are collected into larger superpixels. In the process, symmetries in the data are captured and exploited, making this approach suitable for preprocessing 2D diffraction data. We compare two variance-minimizing methods: K-means clustering (top-down) and agglomerative clustering (bottom-up) and demonstrate superior scaling and interpretability for the bottom-up method. As these methods are distance-based, we demonstrate that the construction of superpixels can be accelerated using Gaussian random projection. Finally we show over 100-fold acceleration for phase mapping with Non-negative matrix factorization on a 4D-STEM dataset when superpixels are used as a preprocessing step.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。关键词：machine learning、clustering、preprocessing、dimensionality reduction。；研究对象：大型二维衍射数据集，具体包括4D-STEM电子衍射和同步辐射X射线衍射数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出利用超像素（superpixels）对大型二维衍射数据进行可解释的特征降维，通过自底向上的凝聚聚类方法（agglomerative clustering）在缩放性和可解释性上优于K-means聚类，并在4D-STEM数据集上实现了超过100倍的相图映射加速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出利用超像素（superpixels）对大型二维衍射数据进行可解释的特征降维，通过自底向上的凝聚聚类方法（agglomerative clustering）在缩放性和可解释性上优于K-means聚类，并在4D-STEM数据集上实现了超过100倍的相图映射加速。；创新点：提出将超像素概念引入二维衍射数据预处理，通过变面积像素分组（高信息密度区域密集采样、低信息区域大块合并）来捕捉和利用数据中的对称性，实现高效且可解释的数据降维。摘要未突出说明与现有裁剪或像素合并方法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种基于方差最小化的聚类方法：K-means聚类（自上而下）和凝聚聚类（自下而上），并结合高斯随机投影加速距离计算。将超像素作为预处理步骤，应用于非负矩阵分解（NMF）进行相图映射。

papers.title: Dolomite Mineral-Inspired Equilateral Triangular-Lattice Magnets for Quantum Magnetism
papers.abstract: Equilateral triangular lattice magnets provide a versatile materials platform for exploring exotic quantum spin phenomena, while their field-tunable magnetic entropy offers opportunities for low-temperature adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration. Inspired by the natural mineral, we proposed a chemical strategy to achieve equilateral TL magnets, leveraging the high crystal symmetry of a large family of dolomite-type materials. As typical examples, the dolomite-type materials SnM(BO3)2 (M = Co, Mn) were synthesized, and structural analysis reveals that Co2+ and Mn2+ ions form equilateral triangular lattices with an A-B-C stacking fashion. The magnetic susceptibilities and specific heat measurements reveal dominant antiferromagnetic interactions, with Neel temperatures of 0.49K for SnCo(BO3)2 and 0.96K for SnMn(BO3)2, respectively. Our results establish the dolomite-type M'M(X)2 (M'and M sites allow various valence states, e.g., +4/+2 or +3/+3; X = CO32- or BO33-) system as a chemically flexible and structurally perfect material platform for exploring frustrated magnetism and low-temperature magnetocaloric applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“合成”、“结构分析”、“磁化率和比热测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：白云石型（dolomite-type）等边三角晶格磁性材料，具体为SnM(BO₃)₂（M = Co, Mn）化合物，用于研究阻挫磁性和低温磁热效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功合成了白云石型等边三角晶格磁体SnCo(BO₃)₂和SnMn(BO₃)₂，发现其具有主导的反铁磁相互作用，奈尔温度分别为0.49 K和0.96 K，为阻挫磁性和低温绝热去磁制冷提供了理想材料平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功合成了白云石型等边三角晶格磁体SnCo(BO₃)₂和SnMn(BO₃)₂，发现其具有主导的反铁磁相互作用，奈尔温度分别为0.49 K和0.96 K，为阻挫磁性和低温绝热去磁制冷提供了理想材料平台。；创新点：受天然白云石矿物启发，提出利用白云石型材料家族的高晶体对称性来实现等边三角晶格磁体的化学策略，并首次在SnM(BO₃)₂体系中验证了该策略的可行性。摘要未突出说明与已有三角晶格磁体相比的具体性能优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用化学合成方法制备样品，通过结构分析确定Co²⁺和Mn²⁺离子形成A-B-C堆叠的等边三角晶格；使用磁化率和比热测量表征磁性质。

papers.title: Lecture Notes: The two-dimensional electron Wigner crystal -- What's old and what's new?
papers.abstract: These are lecture notes created for a short lecture series at the 2026 CTEQ Summer School at Penn State. They are written in a conversational and informal style. The goal of these notes is to introduce and review a smattering of old and new ideas about the Wigner crystal (the solid phase of the two-dimensional electron system) in the context of recent experiments. Particular emphasis is given to the semiclassical description of the Wigner crystal, its quantum melting transition, its spin order, and the ways in which the Wigner crystal can be modified by Berry curvature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：lecture notes、semiclassical description、quantum melting transition、spin order、Berry curvature）；研究对象：二维电子系统中的Wigner晶体（电子固体相），重点关注其半经典描述、量子熔化转变、自旋序以及Berry曲率对其的修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，但指出该笔记旨在结合近期实验，回顾并介绍关于二维电子Wigner晶体的新旧理论观点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，但指出该笔记旨在结合近期实验，回顾并介绍关于二维电子Wigner晶体的新旧理论观点。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用半经典理论框架，结合量子熔化转变理论、自旋序分析以及Berry曲率效应进行描述。

papers.title: Angular momentum splitter effect of $d$-wave axial phonons in orbital altermagnets
papers.abstract: We theoretically demonstrate that axial phonons, lattice vibration quanta carrying finite angular momentum, can host a $d$-wave angular momentum texture in orbital altermagnets in the absence of spin-orbit coupling. We consider a minimal electronic tight-binding model with $d$-wave loop-current order that breaks time-reversal symmetry. Within the Born-Oppenheimer approximation, we incorporate electron-phonon coupling via the molecular Berry curvature and show that the underlying $d$-wave orbital magnetic moment texture of the electronic state is transferred to the phonons without requiring the relativistic spin-orbit coupling. Our results expand the range of platforms available for engineering axial phonons and point to functionality unique to $d$-wave textures, including angular-momentum Seebeck and splitter effects, corresponding to longitudinal and transverse angular-momentum currents driven by a temperature gradient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically demonstrate”“consider a minimal electronic tight-binding model”“within the Born-Oppenheimer approximation”等关键词，属于纯理论推导与模型计算。；研究对象：轨道交变磁体（orbital altermagnets）中的d波轴向声子（d-wave axial phonons），具体为具有d波环流序（d-wave loop-current order）且无自旋-轨道耦合的电子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无自旋-轨道耦合的轨道交变磁体中，轴向声子（携带有限角动量的晶格振动量子）可以呈现d波角动量纹理，并实现角动量塞贝克效应（angular-momentum Seebeck effect）和角动量分裂效应（angular-momentum splitter effect）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无自旋-轨道耦合的轨道交变磁体中，轴向声子（携带有限角动量的晶格振动量子）可以呈现d波角动量纹理，并实现角动量塞贝克效应（angular-momentum Seebeck effect）和角动量分裂效应（angular-momentum splitter effect）。；创新点：首次在无自旋-轨道耦合的轨道交变磁体中实现轴向声子的d波角动量纹理，并预言了基于d波纹理的角动量塞贝克效应和分裂效应，拓展了轴向声子的工程平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚模型构建具有d波环流序的最小电子模型，在玻恩-奥本海默近似下，通过分子贝里曲率（molecular Berry curvature）引入电子-声子耦合，将电子态的d波轨道磁矩纹理传递至声子。

papers.title: Modified Family-Vicsek Scaling and Probability Distributions for Brownian Castle Interfaces
papers.abstract: The Brownian Castle is a new interface growth model that is a variation on the well-known ballistic deposition model that results in an entirely new universality class. We present numerical verification that the interface width for BC interfaces displays modified Family-Vicsek scaling properties up to finite size corrections. Specifically, we find a growth exponent of $β=0.470 \pm 0.012$ and a roughness exponent of $α=1.01 \pm 0.018$. The scaling is modified at short times with a size scaling exponent that described the early time dependence of interface width on length. The probability distribution of heights for the BC interface shows significant deviations from simple Gaussian behavior and the probability distribution of height changes shows a Cauchy-Lorentz form consistent with expectations for a process involving relatively large jumps.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerical verification（数值验证）、probability distribution（概率分布）、scaling properties（标度性质）。；研究对象：Brownian Castle（布朗城堡）界面生长模型，这是一种新型界面生长模型，属于弹道沉积模型的变体，并对应全新的普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Brownian Castle界面的宽度表现出修正的Family-Vicsek标度行为，生长指数β=0.470±0.012，粗糙度指数α=1.01±0.018；其高度概率分布显著偏离高斯分布，高度变化的概率分布呈现柯西-洛伦兹形式，表明该过程涉及较大跳跃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Brownian Castle界面的宽度表现出修正的Family-Vicsek标度行为，生长指数β=0.470±0.012，粗糙度指数α=1.01±0.018；其高度概率分布显著偏离高斯分布，高度变化的概率分布呈现柯西-洛伦兹形式，表明该过程涉及较大跳跃。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟验证界面宽度的标度性质，并统计分析了高度分布与高度变化分布的概率密度函数。

papers.title: Chemical short-range order controls deformation pathways in a complex concentrated alloy
papers.abstract: Chemical short-range order (CSRO) is an intrinsic feature of complex concentrated alloys (CCAs), yet its influence on deformation mechanisms is controversial because of the inconclusive state of concurrent CSRO quantification during deformation. Here, we provide experimental evidence that CSRO acts as an intrinsic thermodynamic state variable governing stacking-fault energetics and deformation pathways in a Co30Cr40Ni30 alloy. By comparing quenched (CSRO-lean) and aged (CSRO-enriched) conditions with equivalent grain structure and phase constitution, we isolate the influence of atomic-scale chemical ordering on mechanical behavior. Calorimetry confirms reversible CSRO formation, while synchrotron X-ray diffraction and electron microscopy reveal that CSRO suppresses deformation-induced fcc-hcp martensitic transformation at both room and cryogenic temperatures. Despite differences in transformation dynamics, the macroscopic tensile response is still broadly similar. Atomistic simulations show that CSRO increases both stable and unstable stacking-fault energies, raising the energetic barrier for partial-dislocation activity and stabilizing the fcc lattice against transformation. Together, the experimental and computational results establish CSRO as an added degree of freedom for tuning stacking-fault energetics and controlling deformation pathways in complex concentrated alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。依据：摘要中同时使用了实验手段（量热法、同步辐射X射线衍射、电子显微镜）和计算方法（原子尺度模拟）。；研究对象：复杂浓缩合金（CCA）中的化学短程有序（CSRO）及其对变形机制的影响，具体材料为Co₃₀Cr₄₀Ni₃₀合金。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 化学短程有序（CSRO）作为内在热力学状态变量，通过提高层错能（包括稳定和不稳定层错能）来抑制变形诱导的fcc-hcp马氏体相变，从而调控变形路径，但宏观拉伸响应仍大致相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：化学短程有序（CSRO）作为内在热力学状态变量，通过提高层错能（包括稳定和不稳定层错能）来抑制变形诱导的fcc-hcp马氏体相变，从而调控变形路径，但宏观拉伸响应仍大致相似。；创新点：提供了CSRO在变形过程中作为内在热力学状态变量直接影响层错能及变形路径的实验证据，并建立了CSRO作为调控复杂浓缩合金层错能与变形路径的新自由度。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：量热法（确认CSRO可逆形成）、同步辐射X射线衍射、电子显微镜（观察相变抑制）；计算方法：原子尺度模拟（计算层错能变化）。通过对比淬火态（贫CSRO）和时效态（富CSRO）样品（保持等效晶粒结构和相组成）来隔离CSRO的影响。

papers.title: Revealing the MoS2 Growth Mechanism in Chemical Vapor Deposition: Real-Time Imaging and Statistical Analysis
papers.abstract: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) is a promising method for scalable synthesis of two-dimensional transitional metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) such as MoS2, but challenges in reproducibility and controllability persist due to an incomplete understanding of their dynamic growth mechanisms. While in-situ characterization methods could provide valuable insights, it remains challenging to track a large ensemble of crystals to enable quantitative, statistical analysis. Here, we address this gap by developing and applying a semi-automated image processing pipeline to analyze in-situ optical microscopy footage of MoS2 growth. This framework enables the high-throughput reconstruction of complete growth trajectories for over 400 individual crystals from a single experiment. Our statistical analysis demonstrates that MoS2 crystallization is governed by an edge-attachment-limited mechanism rather than by precursor diffusion. Furthermore, MoS2 crystals exhibit non-competitive growth, indicating that precursor supply does not limit the growth of neighboring flakes until physical impingement occurs. These findings provide direct, quantitative evidence that advances the fundamental understanding of TMD growth, establishing a powerful methodology for rational optimization of the CVD growth of two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：in-situ optical microscopy（原位光学显微镜）、real-time imaging（实时成像）、statistical analysis（统计分析）。；研究对象：化学气相沉积（CVD）生长二硫化钼（MoS₂）单晶的动态生长机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoS₂的结晶过程受边缘附着限制机制（edge-attachment-limited mechanism）主导，而非前驱体扩散限制；且MoS₂晶体生长是非竞争性的，相邻晶片在物理接触前不会因前驱体供应不足而相互限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoS₂的结晶过程受边缘附着限制机制（edge-attachment-limited mechanism）主导，而非前驱体扩散限制；且MoS₂晶体生长是非竞争性的，相邻晶片在物理接触前不会因前驱体供应不足而相互限制。；创新点：首次通过高通量、定量统计方法（基于大量单晶的完整生长轨迹）直接揭示MoS₂ CVD生长的具体限制机制，克服了以往原位表征难以追踪大量晶体进行统计分析的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 开发并应用半自动化图像处理流程，分析原位光学显微镜拍摄的MoS₂生长视频，从单次实验中高通量重建超过400个单晶的完整生长轨迹，并进行定量统计分析。

papers.title: Realization and manipulation of spiral charge density waves in a two-dimensional metal
papers.abstract: Nearly degenerate charge-density-wave (CDW) states play a central role in the competition among collective phenomena. In real materials, however, these states are often intertwined by disorder, hindering their disentanglement and control. Here we show that strain can lift this near-degeneracy and spatially separate distinct CDW states in NbSe2. Using van der Waals (vdW) interactions, we stabilize a micron-scale strain network that produces spatially inhomogeneous strain fields. Within this landscape, the intrinsic 3 * 3 CDW superlattice of pristine NbSe2 transforms into an isolated unidirectional 4 * 1 order under 1D-confined compression, and into a 2 * 2 order under biaxial tension. The 4 * 1 CDW has a multiband origin and exhibits markedly enhanced thermal stability, persisting up to 70 K. At strain-network nodes, it further develops into chiral spiral textures, which can be melted by voltage pulses. These results establish strain as a powerful approach to disentangle, stabilize and manipulate competing electronic orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验操作（施加应变、利用范德华相互作用）和测量结果（观察到不同CDW相、热稳定性、电压脉冲熔化）。；研究对象：二维金属二硒化铌（NbSe₂）中的电荷密度波（CDW）态，特别是通过应变工程实现的螺旋电荷密度波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过应变工程，可以在NbSe₂中分离并稳定多种近简并的CDW相，包括一种热稳定性显著增强（高达70K）的单向4×1 CDW，以及在应变网络节点处形成的、可被电压脉冲熔化的手性螺旋CDW纹理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过应变工程，可以在NbSe₂中分离并稳定多种近简并的CDW相，包括一种热稳定性显著增强（高达70K）的单向4×1 CDW，以及在应变网络节点处形成的、可被电压脉冲熔化的手性螺旋CDW纹理。；创新点：证明了应变是一种有效且强大的手段，可以解耦、稳定和操控二维金属中相互竞争的电子有序态，特别是实现了对近简并CDW态的空间分离和对手性螺旋纹理的动态操控。
papers.method_zh: 利用范德华相互作用在NbSe₂中构建微米尺度的应变网络，产生空间不均匀的应变场。通过一维压缩和双轴拉伸分别诱导出4×1和2×2的CDW有序，并利用电压脉冲操控螺旋CDW纹理。

papers.title: Superconducting proximity effect in a strongly correlated charge-transfer insulator
papers.abstract: Proximity-induced superconductivity in strongly correlated insulators provides a versatile route for engineering quantum states of matter and artificial systems with tailored functionalities. However, microscopic interplay between superconductivity and correlated insulating states remains poorly understood. Here we use ultralow-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM) to systemically investigate superconducting proximity effects in a charge-transfer insulator. Via STM tip manipulation, atomically sharp lateral junctions composed of superconducting monolayer H-NbSe2 and charge-transfer insulating monolayer T-NbSe2 are constructed, enabling direct access to tunable coupling regimes. In the weak-coupling regime, there is a robust proximity-induced superconducting gap in T-NbSe2, with a reduced gap value relative to that of H-NbSe2. Upon entering the strong-coupling regime, T-NbSe2 exhibits a superconducting gap comparable to that of H-NbSe2, accompanied by pronounced particle-hole-symmetric in-gap bound states, consistent with Yu-Shiba-Rusinov-like excitations. These findings establish monolayer H/T-NbSe2 lateral junctions as a model platform for elucidating superconducting proximity effects in strongly correlated charge-transfer insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了超低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）进行系统性实验研究，并通过STM针尖操控构建原子级尖锐的横向结。；研究对象：强关联电荷转移绝缘体（单层T-NbSe₂）中的超导邻近效应，具体体系为单层H-NbSe₂（超导体）与单层T-NbSe₂（电荷转移绝缘体）构成的原子级尖锐横向结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱耦合区，T-NbSe₂中可观测到稳健的超导邻近诱导能隙（但能隙值小于H-NbSe₂）；在强耦合区，T-NbSe₂展现出与H-NbSe₂相当的超导能隙，并伴随明显的粒子-空穴对称的隙内束缚态，其行为与Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）激发一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱耦合区，T-NbSe₂中可观测到稳健的超导邻近诱导能隙（但能隙值小于H-NbSe₂）；在强耦合区，T-NbSe₂展现出与H-NbSe₂相当的超导能隙，并伴随明显的粒子-空穴对称的隙内束缚态，其行为与Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）激发一致。；创新点：首次在原子级尖锐的横向结中系统研究了强关联电荷转移绝缘体中的超导邻近效应，并揭示了从弱耦合到强耦合的调控机制及YSR-like束缚态的出现。
papers.method_zh: 超低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）及STM针尖操控技术，用于构建并调控单层H-NbSe₂与单层T-NbSe₂之间的横向结耦合强度。

papers.title: Phonon down-conversion by normal metals for superconducting devices
papers.abstract: Thanks to low dissipation, superconducting devices are promising for a number of applications, such as detectors and implementations of quantum computation. However, their working can be adversely impacted by quasiparticles, which is why so-called quasiparticle poisoning mechanisms and their mitigation are under intense investigation. Here we focus on one poisoning mechanism, namely pair-breaking phonons, and its mitigation through down-conversion by a normal-metal film - the process in which scattering of high-energy phonons by electrons lowers the energy of the former below the pair-breaking threshold. To study the down-conversion, we introduce a model based on kinetic equations, which we solve both analytically (approximately) and numerically in the steady state. We use the solution the estimate a properly-defined down-conversion efficiency which depends on material parameters (such as the strength of electron-phonon interaction and the phonon transmission coefficient at interfaces) and film and substrate thicknesses. Interestingly, we find that the efficiency is nearly optimal over a finite range of metal thicknesses, with the minimum near-optimal thickness being typically of the order of a micron.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：模型、动力学方程、解析与数值求解、稳态分析）；研究对象：超导器件中由对破缺声子引起的准粒子中毒机制，以及通过正常金属薄膜进行声子降频转换的缓解方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 正常金属薄膜可将高能声子能量降至超导对破缺阈值以下，且降频转换效率在金属厚度的一定范围内接近最优，最小近优厚度通常在微米量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：正常金属薄膜可将高能声子能量降至超导对破缺阈值以下，且降频转换效率在金属厚度的一定范围内接近最优，最小近优厚度通常在微米量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于动力学方程建立理论模型，在稳态条件下分别进行近似解析求解和数值求解，并定义降频转换效率，分析其与材料参数（电子-声子耦合强度、界面声子透射系数）及薄膜/衬底厚度的依赖关系。

papers.title: Ultrafast altermagnetophononics
papers.abstract: Altermagnets feature symmetry-dictated nontrivial spin splitting in electronic structure promising for next-generation spintronics, yet their ultrafast dynamical manipulation remains largely unexplored. Here, we establish altermagnetophononics as an efficient route for magnetic control via selective symmetry breaking induced by coherent phonons. Using the prototypical altermagnet $α$-MnTe as an example, we demonstrate that the targeted excitation of B$_{1g}$ mode selectively lifts the symmetry constraints protecting altermagnetism (AM), driving ultrafast transition into a transient compensated ferrimagnetic (cFiM) phase characterized by a global spin splitting without net magnetization. Further, we show that the proposed mechanism is broadly applicable by demonstrating a multi-mode symmetry breaking pathway, and by realizing a ferrimagnetic order with reversible magnetic moment in metallic CrSb. These findings elucidate the potential to obtain desirable nonequilibrium properties in altermagnets via coherent phononic control over their spin splittings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：demonstrate、show、mechanism、symmetry breaking pathway。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnet）中的超快动力学操控，具体以α-MnTe和CrSb为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过相干声子选择性激发B₁g模式，可打破保护交变磁性的对称性约束，驱动超快相变至瞬态补偿铁磁（cFiM）相，实现无净磁化的全局自旋劈裂；该机制在金属CrSb中还可实现可逆磁矩的铁磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过相干声子选择性激发B₁g模式，可打破保护交变磁性的对称性约束，驱动超快相变至瞬态补偿铁磁（cFiM）相，实现无净磁化的全局自旋劈裂；该机制在金属CrSb中还可实现可逆磁矩的铁磁序。；创新点：首次提出“交变磁声子学”（altermagnetophononics）概念，利用相干声子选择性打破对称性来实现对交变磁体自旋劈裂的超快非平衡操控，而非传统的光激发或磁场调控。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析和第一性原理计算，研究相干声子诱导的对称性破缺路径及其对自旋劈裂的调控。

papers.title: Electron Beam Radiolysis-Assisted Growth of Rutile TiO2 Thin Films
papers.abstract: A new approach for growing crystalline thin films is developed that takes advantage of electron beam radiolysis being a constructive force to rearrange atoms into a crystalline structure. It is demonstrated that by irradiating the surface of a TiO2 film by an electron beam supplied by a reflection high energy electron diffraction (RHEED) gun inside the MBE chamber during growth, a crystalline film can be grown at much lower substrate temperatures, where deposited films typically appear amorphous. Here, rutile TiO2 films were grown using hybrid molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) allowing atomic level control of growth as well as an observation of radiolysis-driven crystallization. Analysis was carried out using a combination of SEM and atomic-resolution STEM imaging. It is also shown that by tuning the temperature of the substrate and the dose of the electron beam, the degree of crystallinity of the film can be controlled.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron beam radiolysis、growth、SEM、STEM、hybrid molecular beam epitaxy (MBE)。；研究对象：金红石相二氧化钛（rutile TiO2）薄膜的晶体生长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用电子束辐解（radiolysis）作为构建力，可在远低于传统生长温度的条件下实现TiO2薄膜的结晶，且通过调节衬底温度和电子束剂量可控制薄膜的结晶度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用电子束辐解（radiolysis）作为构建力，可在远低于传统生长温度的条件下实现TiO2薄膜的结晶，且通过调节衬底温度和电子束剂量可控制薄膜的结晶度。；创新点：首次将电子束辐解作为一种建设性（constructive）手段，在MBE生长过程中原位驱动非晶薄膜结晶，从而大幅降低结晶所需的衬底温度。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合分子束外延（hybrid MBE）实现原子级生长控制，同时利用反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）枪提供电子束辐照；结合扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和原子分辨率扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）进行结构分析。

papers.title: Temperature-driven sodium-ion dynamical-to-static crossover in the zig-zag ordered phase of Na$_{0.5}$CoO$_2$
papers.abstract: We employ polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy combined with first-principles calculations to study the sodium-ion lattice dynamics in a sodium zig-zag ordered cobaltate compound Na$_{0.5}$CoO$_2$. We detect two sodium phonon modes for the first time, and their mode frequencies are consistent with first-principles phonon calculations based on an orthorhombic unit cell. We find that they appear below around $T^*\sim300\pm50$K with large linewidth broadening, much lower than the sodium zig-zag ordering temperature $T_\text{S}\sim460$K, and then narrow at lower temperatures. We interpret the sodium-phonon anomalies occurring at $T^*$ as a dynamical-to-static crossover involving mainly the motion of sodium ions.
