Our results suggest that the gradual freezing of the sodium ions and the well-defined static sodium-zigzag order below $T^*$ set the stage for the emergent electronic and magnetic orders in the CoO$_2$ layer of Na$_{0.5}$CoO$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合第一性原理计算）。关键词：polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy、first-principles calculations。；研究对象：钠离子在之字形有序钴酸盐化合物 Na₀.₅CoO₂ 中的晶格动力学行为，特别是钠离子从动态到静态的交叉过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次探测到两个钠离子声子模式，并在约 300±50 K 的温度下观察到这些声子模式的异常展宽与随后的窄化，将其解释为钠离子从动态运动到静态有序的交叉过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次探测到两个钠离子声子模式，并在约 300±50 K 的温度下观察到这些声子模式的异常展宽与随后的窄化，将其解释为钠离子从动态运动到静态有序的交叉过程。；创新点：首次在实验上观测到 Na₀.₅CoO₂ 中钠离子的声子模式，并揭示了在钠离子之字形有序温度（约 460 K）以下存在一个更低温度的动力学-静态交叉转变（约 300 K），该交叉为 CoO₂ 层中电子和磁有序的出现提供了条件。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨拉曼光谱实验，结合基于正交晶胞的第一性原理声子计算。

papers.title: First-principles Study of Structural and Electronic Properties of Mn-doped Cu2NiXY4 (X=Sn, Ge, Si; Y=S, Se) Chalcogenide Semiconductors
papers.abstract: In this work, the effect of partial substitution of Mn by Ni on the structural and electronic properties of kesterite systems Cu2NiXY4 (X = Sn, Ge, Si; Y = S, Se) was studied using density functional theory (DFT). The mBJ+U method was used to characterize the bandgap more accurately. To the best of our knowledge, a systematic comparative study of Mn substitution in the entire Cu2NiXY4 (X = Sn, Ge, Si; Y = S, Se) family has not been previously performed. Due to crystallographic constraints of the kesterite unit cell, the substitution of a single Ni atom with Mn corresponds to 50%. This configuration was chosen to study the effect of Mn substitution on the structural and electronic properties of Cu2NiXY4 (X = Sn, Ge, Si; Y = S, Se) compounds, whereas the study of lower concentrations requires the use of a supercell and is the subject of further research. The calculation results show that the partial substitution of Ni with Mn preserves the tetragonal structure of kesterite and significantly alters the electronic structure. In all the compounds studied, the bandgap decreases from 1.028-3.397 to 1.007-3.333 eV. For example, in the Cu2NiSnS4 system, the bandgap width decreases from 1.59 eV to 1.49 eV. The narrowing of the bandgap results from hybridization between the Mn-3d, Cu-3d, and S/Se-p orbitals near the band edges, leading to a redistribution of electronic states around the Fermi level. The results demonstrate that Mn substitution is an effective strategy for controlling the electronic properties of Cu2NiXY4 kesterites, offering great promise for use in optoelectronic devices where adjustable bandgaps are required.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory (DFT)”、“mBJ+U method”、“calculation results”。；研究对象：Mn部分替代Ni的Cu₂NiXY₄ (X=Sn, Ge, Si; Y=S, Se) 黄锡矿结构硫族化合物半导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn部分替代Ni后，所有化合物的四方黄锡矿结构保持不变，但带隙普遍减小（从1.028-3.397 eV降至1.007-3.333 eV），例如Cu₂NiSnS₄的带隙从1.59 eV降至1.49 eV。带隙变窄源于Mn-3d、Cu-3d与S/Se-p轨道在带边附近的杂化，导致费米能级附近电子态重新分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn部分替代Ni后，所有化合物的四方黄锡矿结构保持不变，但带隙普遍减小（从1.028-3.397 eV降至1.007-3.333 eV），例如Cu₂NiSnS₄的带隙从1.59 eV降至1.49 eV。带隙变窄源于Mn-3d、Cu-3d与S/Se-p轨道在带边附近的杂化，导致费米能级附近电子态重新分布。；创新点：首次对Mn替代整个Cu₂NiXY₄ (X=Sn, Ge, Si; Y=S, Se) 家族进行了系统性的比较研究。摘要未明确说明此前是否有针对该体系中单个化合物的类似研究。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，使用mBJ+U方法更准确地描述带隙。

papers.title: Cooling rate and glassy behavior in the Fermi--Pasta--Ulam system
papers.abstract: In this work, we numerically studied the cooling process of a Fermi--Pasta--Ulam system, which occurs when the FPU system is placed in contact with a gas whose temperature $T$ is reduced with a certain cooling rate $ξ$. It was found that the existence of a weak stochastic threshold has a significant impact on the cooling process, because below such a stochastic threshold the specific FPU energy is larger than its temperature, i.e., the FPU system falls out of equilibrium. The difference remains finite in the limit $T \to 0$, so that the FPU system maintains a residual amount of energy $E_0$ at vanishing temperature. Our numerical simulations reveal that this energy exhibits a power--law dependence on both the system size and the cooling rate, scaling approximately as $E_{0} \sim (ξN)^{2/3}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerical simulations（数值模拟）、cooling process（冷却过程）、power-law dependence（幂律依赖）。；研究对象：Fermi–Pasta–Ulam（FPU）系统在接触降温气体时的冷却过程，以及由此产生的玻璃态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FPU系统在弱随机阈值以下会脱离热平衡，在温度趋于零时仍保留残余能量 \(E_0\)，且该能量与系统尺寸和冷却速率满足幂律标度关系 \(E_{0} \sim (\xi N)^{2/3}\)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FPU系统在弱随机阈值以下会脱离热平衡，在温度趋于零时仍保留残余能量 \(E_0\)，且该能量与系统尺寸和冷却速率满足幂律标度关系 \(E_{0} \sim (\xi N)^{2/3}\)。；创新点：揭示了弱随机阈值对FPU系统冷却过程的显著影响，并首次发现残余能量与系统尺寸和冷却速率之间的幂律标度关系。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟。具体为将FPU系统与温度以冷却速率 \(\xi\) 降低的气体接触，模拟其冷却过程，并测量系统能量与温度的关系。

papers.title: Fractional Chern insulators in alternating twisted multilayer MoTe$_{2}$
papers.abstract: We study strongly correlated many-body states in alternating twisted trilayer and tetralayer MoTe$_{2}$. By sliding the top layer with respect to others and applying a perpendicular electric field, a variety of band structures can be realized. In many cases, the topmost hole band has unity Chern number and its quantum geometric properties can be tuned to some extent. Exact diagonalizations suggest that fractional Chern insulators are stabilized in certain parameter regimes but not in some regimes even when the band is topological. This contrast is attributed primarily to different quantum geometries as quantified by the trace condition. Our results demonstrate that sliding can serve as a useful knob for probing many-body states in moiré systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“Exact diagonalizations”（精确对角化）、“band structures”（能带结构）、“quantum geometric properties”（量子几何性质），属于强关联多体系统的数值计算与理论分析。；研究对象：交替扭转多层MoTe₂体系，具体包括交替扭转三层和四层MoTe₂中的强关联多体态，以及通过层间滑动和垂直电场调控的拓扑能带与分数量子反常霍尔态（分数陈绝缘体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交替扭转多层MoTe₂中，通过滑动顶层和施加垂直电场可实现多种能带结构，其中部分参数区间能稳定分数陈绝缘体态，而另一些拓扑能带区间则不能，这一差异主要归因于量子几何性质（由迹条件量化）的不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交替扭转多层MoTe₂中，通过滑动顶层和施加垂直电场可实现多种能带结构，其中部分参数区间能稳定分数陈绝缘体态，而另一些拓扑能带区间则不能，这一差异主要归因于量子几何性质（由迹条件量化）的不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化方法研究强关联多体态，结合能带结构计算与量子几何性质分析（迹条件），通过滑动顶层和施加垂直电场调控能带。

papers.title: Mapping recrystallization trajectories in GaAs using latent space diffraction analysis
papers.abstract: Recrystallization in disordered solids proceeds through a sequence of local structural rearrangements that are difficult to resolve using conventional diffraction analysis. In amorphous and partially ordered materials, subtle variations in diffuse scattering, short-range order, and defect-mediated symmetry emergence encode the pathways through which ordering initiates and propagates. Here, we introduce a latent space framework for mapping these pathways directly from \textit{in situ} 4D-STEM diffraction data. A convolutional autoencoder provides a compact representation of structural motifs, and unsupervised clustering identifies recurring microstructural states, including amorphous, paracrystalline, crystalline, twinned, and hybrid intermediates. By tracking these states across temperature, we construct phase trajectory models that reveal the topology of the recrystallization landscape, including metastable basins, branching pathways, hybrid states, and temperature-dependent reorganizations of accessible states. Applied to ion irradiated GaAs, this approach uncovers two distinct recrystallization regimes separated by a transition near 250\textdegree{}C. At low temperature, recrystallization is growth-dominated and dominated by the persistence of amorphous and crystalline states. At high temperature, the transformation landscape reorganizes: hybrid and faulted states become metastable precursors to twinning, polycrystalline regions stabilize, and twinned structures emerge as dominant end states. The latent space representation also identifies amorphous patterns with weak symmetry signatures that precede recrystallization. This reveals structural precursors to ordering that are not captured by conventional descriptors give new insights into how recrystallization is initiated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：in situ 4D-STEM diffraction data（原位四维扫描透射电子显微镜衍射数据）、convolutional autoencoder（卷积自编码器）、unsupervised clustering（无监督聚类）。；研究对象：离子辐照砷化镓（GaAs）的再结晶过程，具体研究非晶态固体中结构有序化的路径与拓扑景观。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现GaAs再结晶存在两个不同温度区间（以约250°C为界）：低温区以生长为主导，非晶态与晶态持续存在；高温区相变景观重组，杂化态与缺陷态成为孪晶的前驱体，孪晶结构成为最终主导态。此外，潜空间分析揭示了传统描述符无法捕捉的弱对称性非晶结构前驱体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现GaAs再结晶存在两个不同温度区间（以约250°C为界）：低温区以生长为主导，非晶态与晶态持续存在；高温区相变景观重组，杂化态与缺陷态成为孪晶的前驱体，孪晶结构成为最终主导态。此外，潜空间分析揭示了传统描述符无法捕捉的弱对称性非晶结构前驱体。；创新点：引入潜空间衍射分析框架，直接从原位衍射数据中映射再结晶路径，揭示了传统衍射分析难以分辨的局部结构重排、亚稳态盆地、分支路径及杂化中间态，并首次识别出再结晶前的弱对称性非晶结构前驱体。
papers.method_zh: 采用原位4D-STEM衍射数据采集，结合卷积自编码器对结构基元进行压缩表示，再通过无监督聚类识别重复出现的微观结构状态（非晶、准晶、晶态、孪晶、杂化中间态），并构建温度依赖的相轨迹模型。

papers.title: Momentum Distribution and Contact Parameters of a mass-imbalanced three-body system across the Efimov-Unatomic transition
papers.abstract: We investigate the single-particle momentum distribution and contact parameters of mass-imbalanced three-body systems at the critical dimension Dc, where the transition between discrete and continuous scale invariance takes place as the spatial dimension is tuned between three and two dimensions. We show that the asymptotic momentum distribution at Dc is governed by a distinct logarithmic scaling structure, which differs fundamentally from both the log-periodic behavior of Efimov states and the power-law scaling of the unatomic regime. This structure requires the introduction of an additional three-body contact parameter associated with a quadratic logarithmic contribution, leading to a finite and well-defined description of the momentum tail at the transition. This additional three-body parameter depends sensitively on the mass imbalance, changing sign across different mass configurations and vanishing for identical particles. As a consequence, the three-body contribution to the momentum distribution can be suppressed at a characteristic momentum scale, leaving the asymptotic tail entirely determined by the two-body contact. We further analyze the narrow intermediate region connecting the Efimov and unatomic regimes, here identified as an intermediate scaling regime, whose extent and properties are strongly controlled by the mass ratio. These results establish the critical dimension as a regime with emergent scaling properties and provide experimentally accessible signatures for probing the transition between discrete and continuous scale invariance in few-body quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate, show, require, analyze（理论推导与分析）。；研究对象：质量不平衡的三体系统在临界维度（Dc）下的单粒子动量分布与接触参数，以及Efimov态与Unatomic态之间的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界维度Dc处，动量分布的渐近行为呈现独特的对数标度结构，不同于Efimov态的周期对数行为与Unatomic态的幂律标度；该结构需要引入一个额外的三体接触参数来描述，该参数对质量不平衡敏感，并在不同质量构型下改变符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界维度Dc处，动量分布的渐近行为呈现独特的对数标度结构，不同于Efimov态的周期对数行为与Unatomic态的幂律标度；该结构需要引入一个额外的三体接触参数来描述，该参数对质量不平衡敏感，并在不同质量构型下改变符号。；创新点：首次揭示了临界维度作为具有涌现标度性质的新区域，并指出该区域中动量分布的对数标度结构需要引入额外的三体接触参数，且该参数在质量不平衡系统中可改变符号，为实验探测离散与连续标度不变性之间的转变提供了可观测信号。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于空间维度在二维与三维之间调谐时离散与连续标度不变性之间的转变，推导临界维度下的动量分布渐近形式与接触参数。

papers.title: Aharonov-Casher-induced electric quadrupole of charge-neutral particles
papers.abstract: For charged particles, their orbital angular momentum (OAM) in solid have a direct magnetic manifestation as an orbital magnetization. For charge-neutral particles, however, the physical manifestation of the OAM in solid remains unclear. Here, we show that a charge-neutral particle carrying a magnetic moment couples to electric-field gradient through the Aharonov-Casher (AC) effect, thereby exhibiting the electric quadrupole in crystalline solids. This AC-induced electric quadrupole (AC-EQ) contains the scalar, toroidal dipole, and reduced quadrupole components, which are conjugate to the divergence, circulation, and shear of the electric field, respectively. As representative examples, we calculate the AC-EQ of magnons in two magnetic systems. In ferromagnetic pyrochlore, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) induces a sizable AC-EQ, whereas in helical Fe langasite the AC-EQ emerges from the helical spin configuration even in the absence of DMI. In both systems, the unit-cell-integrated AC-EQ components reach magnitudes comparable to typical nuclear electric quadrupole moments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“we show”“we calculate”等理论推导和计算表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：电荷中性粒子（如磁振子）在晶体中因Aharonov-Casher效应产生的电四极矩，具体以铁磁烧绿石和螺旋Fe langasite中的磁振子为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷中性粒子携带磁矩时，可通过Aharonov-Casher效应与电场梯度耦合，从而表现出电四极矩。该电四极矩包含标量、环形偶极和约化四极分量，其大小可与典型核电四极矩相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷中性粒子携带磁矩时，可通过Aharonov-Casher效应与电场梯度耦合，从而表现出电四极矩。该电四极矩包含标量、环形偶极和约化四极分量，其大小可与典型核电四极矩相当。；创新点：首次揭示电荷中性粒子（如磁振子）的轨道角动量在固体中可通过AC效应表现为电四极矩，并分解出与电场散度、旋度和剪切对应的三个分量。
papers.method_zh: 基于Aharonov-Casher效应的理论框架，推导电荷中性粒子的电四极矩表达式；通过计算磁振子在铁磁烧绿石（含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用）和螺旋Fe langasite（无DMI，仅由螺旋自旋构型驱动）中的电四极矩作为代表性示例。

papers.title: Microscopic constitutive theory of stress overshoot, yielding, and strain hardening in amorphous materials
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic constitutive theory for the nonlinear deformation of metallic and polymer glasses based on nonaffine elasticity coupled to irreversible many-body relaxation. The theory predicts the full stress--strain response, from linear elasticity through stress overshoot and yielding to steady plastic flow. We show that stress overshoot originates from the competition between a nonaffine elastic instability induced by strain-driven loss of mechanical connectivity at the atomic/molecular level, and viscous dissipation associated with structural relaxation. For polymer glasses, finite chain extensibility naturally accounts for strain hardening at large deformation. The stretched-exponential relaxation exponent is obtained independently from stress or modulus relaxation measurements and provides the primary dynamical input to the theory. Using a small set of physically meaningful parameters, the model quantitatively reproduces experimental stress--strain curves for metallic glasses, polycarbonate, PMMA, and epoxy resins over a broad range of strain rates. These results establish a unified microscopic framework linking relaxation dynamics, yielding, plastic flow, and strain hardening in amorphous solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a microscopic constitutive theory, predicts, theoretical framework）；研究对象：非晶态材料（金属玻璃和聚合物玻璃）的非线性变形行为，具体包括应力过冲、屈服和应变硬化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应力过冲源于原子/分子尺度上应变驱动的力学连接性丧失（非仿射弹性失稳）与结构弛豫相关的粘性耗散之间的竞争；聚合物玻璃中的应变硬化则源于有限链延展性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应力过冲源于原子/分子尺度上应变驱动的力学连接性丧失（非仿射弹性失稳）与结构弛豫相关的粘性耗散之间的竞争；聚合物玻璃中的应变硬化则源于有限链延展性。；创新点：建立了一个统一的微观理论框架，将弛豫动力学、屈服、塑性流动和应变硬化联系起来，并仅用少量物理参数即可定量复现多种非晶材料（金属玻璃、聚碳酸酯、PMMA、环氧树脂）在宽应变率范围内的实验应力-应变曲线。
papers.method_zh: 基于非仿射弹性与不可逆多体弛豫耦合的微观本构理论。该理论将应力或模量弛豫测量中独立获得的拉伸指数弛豫指数作为主要的动力学输入。

papers.title: Magnetic quadrupole current generation and accumulation in noncentrosymmetric systems
papers.abstract: Magnetization control via magnetic octupole injection has recently been proposed for a new class of centrosymmetric antiferromagnets, namely $d$-wave altermagnets, where the magnetic octupole is the lowest-rank magnetic multipole allowed by symmetry and serves as an alternative carrier to spin injection. In contrast, in noncentrosymmetric antiferromagnets, the magnetic quadrupole (MQ) constitutes the lowest-rank symmetry-allowed magnetic multipole, suggesting that MQ currents can provide an efficient route toward magnetization control through MQ injection. Here, we establish the symmetry conditions for MQ-current generation by constructing the multipole representation of the MQ conductivity tensor and show that MQ currents are generically allowed in noncentrosymmetric crystallographic point groups. As a representative example, we demonstrate MQ-current generation in the linear-response regime associated with symmetry lowering from the centrosymmetric point group ($mmm$) to its noncentrosymmetric subgroup ($mm2$). Furthermore, we reveal MQ accumulation near sample edges, analogous to spin accumulation induced by the spin Hall effect. This edge accumulation provides direct evidence of MQ-current generation and constitutes a key prerequisite for realizing MQ injection and MQ-based magnetization control in noncentrosymmetric antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“建立对称性条件”“构建多极子表示”“展示线性响应机制”等理论推导和对称性分析关键词。；研究对象：非中心对称反铁磁体中的磁四极矩（Magnetic Quadrupole, MQ）电流生成与积累现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非中心对称反铁磁体中，磁四极矩是允许的最低阶磁多极子，其电流可在线性响应下普遍产生，并在样品边缘形成积累，类似于自旋霍尔效应中的自旋积累，为基于磁四极矩注入的磁化控制提供了关键前提。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非中心对称反铁磁体中，磁四极矩是允许的最低阶磁多极子，其电流可在线性响应下普遍产生，并在样品边缘形成积累，类似于自旋霍尔效应中的自旋积累，为基于磁四极矩注入的磁化控制提供了关键前提。；创新点：首次系统建立非中心对称反铁磁体中磁四极矩电流生成的对称性条件，并揭示其边缘积累效应，为利用磁四极矩注入实现磁化控制提供了不同于中心对称d波交变磁体的新路径。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建磁四极矩电导率张量的多极子表示，分析非中心对称晶体点群的对称性条件；以中心对称点群（mmm）到其非中心对称子群（mm2）的对称性降低为例，在线性响应框架下演示磁四极矩电流的产生。

papers.title: Stoner transitions beyond mean-field in two-dimensional electronic systems: a diagrammatic Monte Carlo study
papers.abstract: Stoner instabilities for fermions with repulsive interaction have been well studied within the mean-field (ladder) approximation. In this study, we consider two-dimensional electronic systems with one or two valleys and discuss a Stoner transition beyond the ladder approximation. At weak coupling, the corrections to the ladder approximation come predominantly from the renormalization of the particle-hole vertex in the particle-particle channel, and the lowest-order corrections are logarithmically singular in the low-density limit. To investigate the problem beyond the lowest order, we apply the diagrammatic Monte Carlo algorithm and treat ladder and non-ladder renormalizations on equal footing. We find that in a one-valley system, a Stoner transition to a ferromagnetism occurs at low density only if there is a cutoff on the momentum transfer carried by the interaction. In a two-valley system, the restriction is less severe. Here we find either a direct Stoner transition into a spin- and valley-polarized state, or a set of two Stoner transitions via an intermediate valley-polarized state. The pathway is controlled by the anisotropy of the fermionic dispersion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：diagrammatic Monte Carlo study, beyond mean-field, theoretical framework）；研究对象：二维电子系统中的Stoner相变，具体研究单谷和双谷二维电子气中的铁磁性与谷极化相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单谷系统中，Stoner相变仅在相互作用存在动量转移截断时发生；在双谷系统中，可能发生直接的自旋-谷极化相变，或通过中间谷极化态的两步相变，具体路径由费米子色散的各向异性控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单谷系统中，Stoner相变仅在相互作用存在动量转移截断时发生；在双谷系统中，可能发生直接的自旋-谷极化相变，或通过中间谷极化态的两步相变，具体路径由费米子色散的各向异性控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但主要新意在于：1）超越了平均场（梯图）近似，系统研究了非梯图修正对Stoner相变的影响；2）在弱耦合和低密度极限下，识别出粒子-空穴顶点在粒子-粒子通道中的对数发散重整化是主要修正来源；3）揭示了双谷系统中相变路径对色散各向异性的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 图解蒙特卡洛（diagrammatic Monte Carlo）算法，该方法将梯图（ladder）和非梯图（non-ladder）重整化效应平等对待，超越了平均场（梯图近似）的层次。

papers.title: Direct observation of photon-induced vortices in superconducting films
papers.abstract: Nucleation of vortex-antivortex pairs (VAPs) is believed to play a central role in the photon detection mechanism of superconducting detectors; however, their direct dynamic observation has remained challenging. Here, we report the direct observation of photon-induced VAP dynamics in a current-carrying superconductor as quantized voltage signals following photon absorption. The observed signals are interpreted as discrete phase-slip events, where each vortex traversal induces a 2-pi phase change of the superconducting order parameter, resulting in a quantized voltage pulse whose time integral is given by the magnetic flux quantum. We analyze the resulting quantized signals as a function of bias current, base temperature, and input photon-number states, and find that the number of VAPs generated per absorbed photon becomes effectively stabilized under specific conditions. Under these conditions, we demonstrate photon-number-resolving capability by directly counting phase-slip-induced voltage quanta. Our results reveal a detection mechanism governed by phase dynamics rather than conventional resistive transitions. We further show that photon-number resolution emerges when the fluctuation of photon-induced vortex-antivortex pair generation becomes statistically suppressed. These findings establish a new route toward photon-number-resolving detection based on phase-slip counting and open opportunities for high-speed superconducting detectors for quantum optics and photonic quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：direct observation、reported、analyze、demonstrate。；研究对象：超导薄膜中光子诱导的涡旋-反涡旋对（VAP）动力学，以及基于此的相滑移计数型光子数分辨探测机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次直接观测到载流超导体中光子诱导的涡旋-反涡旋对动力学，表现为量子化的电压信号；在特定条件下，每个吸收光子产生的VAP数量趋于稳定，从而实现基于相滑移计数的光子数分辨探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次直接观测到载流超导体中光子诱导的涡旋-反涡旋对动力学，表现为量子化的电压信号；在特定条件下，每个吸收光子产生的VAP数量趋于稳定，从而实现基于相滑移计数的光子数分辨探测。；创新点：首次实现对光子诱导涡旋-反涡旋对动力学的直接动态观测，并揭示其探测机制由相位动力学而非传统电阻转变主导；通过抑制VAP生成的统计涨落，实现了基于相滑移计数的光子数分辨能力，为超导高速光子数分辨探测器开辟了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过测量超导薄膜在光子吸收后产生的量子化电压脉冲信号，分析其随偏置电流、基底温度和输入光子数态的变化规律；利用电压脉冲的时间积分等于磁通量子这一特性，将每个涡旋穿越解释为2π相位滑移事件。

papers.title: Role of small-radius and high-electronegativity A-Site dopants in enhancing proton transport and stability of perovskite electrolytes
papers.abstract: The practical application of BaCeO$_3$-based electrolytes is limited by their poor chemical stability in proton-conducting solid oxide fuel cells. Commonly employed B-site doping strategies typically improve proton transport with limited improvement in stability. Recent experiments show that A-site Ca doping can simultaneously enhance both properties. Here, through first-principles calculations and mechanistic analysis of Ca-doped BaCeO$_3$, we identify the synergistic roles of small-radius, high-electronegativity A-site dopants in governing proton transport and chemical stability in perovskite electrolytes. We show that the higher electronegativity of A-site dopant weakens the A-O ionic bonding, facilitating oxygen-vacancy formation and enhancing proton uptake by increasing the basicity. This weakened A-O interaction also suppresses the formation of impurity phases and reduces the adsorption strength of acidic gases such as CO$_2$ and SO$_2$. The lattice contraction induced by the smaller ionic radius improves thermal stability and can enhance proton diffusion in systems where proton transfer is the rate-limiting step. Furthermore, we find that Ca surface segregation can mitigate grain-boundary resistance effects. Our results demonstrate the advantages of A-site Ca doping in Ba-based electrolytes, clarify the mechanisms by which small-radius, high-electronegativity dopants influence proton transport and chemical stability, and provide guidance for the design of high-performance proton-conducting electrolytes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations、mechanistic analysis）；研究对象：Ca掺杂BaCeO₃质子导体电解质（A位掺杂对质子传输和化学稳定性的影响）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 小半径、高电负性的A位掺杂剂（如Ca）通过弱化A-O离子键促进氧空位形成和质子吸收，同时抑制杂质相和酸性气体吸附，从而同时提升质子传导性和化学稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：小半径、高电负性的A位掺杂剂（如Ca）通过弱化A-O离子键促进氧空位形成和质子吸收，同时抑制杂质相和酸性气体吸附，从而同时提升质子传导性和化学稳定性。；创新点：揭示了A位掺杂（而非传统B位掺杂）中掺杂剂的小半径和高电负性协同调控质子传输与化学稳定性的微观机制，并指出Ca表面偏析可缓解晶界电阻效应。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），结合机理分析（mechanistic analysis）

papers.title: Transverse order and longitudinal fluctuations in a near-Ising spin supersolid
papers.abstract: We investigate the polarization of the ordered moments and low-energy spin fluctuations in the spin supersolid state of the S = 1/2 triangular-lattice easy-axis antiferromagnet K2Co(SeO3)2 using neutron scattering. The supersolid order develops through successive BKT transitions: the longitudinal order appears at higher temperature, while the transverse component associated with the Bose-Einstein condensate emerges only below a lower-temperature transition accompanied by a change in the interlayer correlations. At the lowest measured temperature, the transverse ordered moment reaches only 11% of the longitudinal component. Moreover, the low-energy spin fluctuations are found to be predominantly longitudinal in character. These results provide direct evidence that the supersolid ground state survives even in the near-Ising regime and exhibits longitudinal low-energy dynamics, imposing stringent constraints on microscopic theories of triangular-lattice XXZ antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“neutron scattering”（中子散射）作为研究手段，并报告了实验测量结果（如有序矩大小、自旋涨落特征）。；研究对象：近伊辛自旋超固态。具体材料为S=1/2三角晶格易轴反铁磁体K2Co(SeO3)2，研究其自旋超固态中的有序矩极化与低能自旋涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近伊辛极限下，自旋超固态基态仍然存在，且其低能自旋涨落以纵向（Ising方向）为主；横向有序矩仅占纵向分量的11%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近伊辛极限下，自旋超固态基态仍然存在，且其低能自旋涨落以纵向（Ising方向）为主；横向有序矩仅占纵向分量的11%。；创新点：首次在近伊辛极限的三角晶格XXZ反铁磁体中直接证实自旋超固态基态的存在，并揭示其低能动力学以纵向涨落为主导，这对微观理论模型提出了严格约束。
papers.method_zh: 中子散射（neutron scattering），用于测量有序矩的极化方向、低能自旋涨落的特征，以及通过BKT相变序列分析纵向与横向有序的出现温度。

papers.title: Research progress in high-pressure tuning of layered magnetic materials
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals materials have enormous potential applications in many fields due to their unique layered structure and excellent properties. Compared with three-dimensional bulk materials, layered systems are coupled by weak van der Waals interactions between layers, endowing them with much higher structural compressibility, particularly along the interlayer direction, which is more sensitive to external pressure. High pressure can expand the accessible phase space, enabling the synthesis of new materials or the retention of metastable phases. On the microscopic level, pressure can significantly tune the interlayer structure and interactions, induce changes in the electronic structure, and consequently give rise to a variety of rich physical properties. This article systematically introduces in situ high-pressure experimental approaches, including diamond anvil cells combined with X-ray and spectroscopic techniques, high-pressure magnetic transport measurements, and emerging NV-center quantum sensing. It further reviews representative pressure-induced phenomena and underlying tuning mechanisms in layered magnetic materials, such as high-spin to low-spin transitions of transition-metal ions and the accompanying structural phase transitions and superconductivity; substantial enhancement of the Curie temperature and continuous switching of magnetocrystalline anisotropy; and antiferromagnetic-to-ferromagnetic transitions achieved by modulating exchange interactions or via stacking engineering. Finally, we discuss future directions, including synergistic multi-field control by combining pressure with electric fields and twisted heterostructures, as well as strategies such as pressure quenching to retain high-pressure metastable magnetic phases at ambient conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：systematically introduces, reviews, discuss future directions。；研究对象：层状磁性材料（layered magnetic materials），特别是二维范德华材料在外界高压下的结构、电子态与磁性调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高压可显著调控层状磁性材料的层间结构与相互作用，诱导高自旋-低自旋转变、居里温度大幅提升、磁晶各向异性连续切换、反铁磁-铁磁转变等丰富物理现象，并可通过压力淬火在常压下保留亚稳磁性相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高压可显著调控层状磁性材料的层间结构与相互作用，诱导高自旋-低自旋转变、居里温度大幅提升、磁晶各向异性连续切换、反铁磁-铁磁转变等丰富物理现象，并可通过压力淬火在常压下保留亚稳磁性相。；创新点：系统总结了高压调控层状磁性材料中多种压力诱导现象及其微观机制，并展望了压力与电场、扭转异质结协同调控以及压力淬火保留亚稳相的未来方向。
papers.method_zh: 综述了多种原位高压实验技术：金刚石对顶砧结合X射线与光谱技术、高压磁输运测量、以及新兴的NV色心量子传感方法。

papers.title: Phase diagram of one-dimensional bosons with Rydberg-dressed soft-core interactions
papers.abstract: Rydberg and Rydberg-dressed atomic gases have recently emerged as a promising quantum simulator for a variety of models in condensed matter physics. Here we investigate one-dimensional bosons with soft-core Rydberg-dressed interactions using exact path-integral quantum Monte Carlo simulations. The finite-range and the negative Fourier component of the interaction potential generate a roton mode at finite momentum, while particle-hole backscattering processes enhance the susceptibility of one-dimensional systems at twice the Fermi momentum. The competition between the corresponding length scales yields a rich phase diagram, featuring a conventional Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid (TLL) regime, a beyond-TLL regime, and commensurate cluster phases. In the TLL regime, the system transitions from Lieb-Liniger-like bnehavior with Luttinger parameter $K>1$ to hard-rod-like behavior with $K<1$, with a quasi-supersolid phase emerging for $K < 1/2$. For strong interactions and high densities, deviations from TLL theory appear as precursors for the onset of cluster phases, where particles aggregate into stable clusters of several particles. The properties of each phase is discussed in detail.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：exact path-integral quantum Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：一维玻色子体系，具有Rydberg-dressed软芯相互作用（soft-core interactions）的量子气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系展现出丰富的相图，包括常规Tomonaga-Luttinger液体（TLL）区域、超越TLL区域以及可公度团簇相；在TLL区域中，体系从Lieb-Liniger-like行为（Luttinger参数K>1）过渡到硬杆-like行为（K<1），并在K<1/2时出现准超固相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系展现出丰富的相图，包括常规Tomonaga-Luttinger液体（TLL）区域、超越TLL区域以及可公度团簇相；在TLL区域中，体系从Lieb-Liniger-like行为（Luttinger参数K>1）过渡到硬杆-like行为（K<1），并在K<1/2时出现准超固相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确路径积分量子蒙特卡洛模拟（exact path-integral quantum Monte Carlo simulations）。

papers.title: Opinion Formation in a Spatially Constrained Coevolving Nonlinear Voter Model
papers.abstract: We investigate a spatially constrained coevolving nonlinear voter model. Using a random geometric graph, we constrain the interaction range of voter dynamics. If local rewiring is not possible, the discordant link is deleted. Our results reveal absorbing states that differ not only in magnetization and activity, but also in mean degree and spatial state organization. By exploring dynamical and structural observables, we found that distinct regimes from the existing coevolving nonlinear voter model are characterized by a reduced consensus region, spatially segregated fragmentation, and isolated node formation. Additionally, we develop a phenomenological description of the evolution of the mean degree and terminal non-conserved quantities that is consistent with the numerical results. Our model highlights how local geometric accessibility reshapes the structure of the absorbing states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate”、“numerical results”、“phenomenological description”，以及使用随机几何图模型和数值模拟方法。；研究对象：空间约束下的共演化非线性投票者模型（spatially constrained coevolving nonlinear voter model），具体研究在随机几何图（random geometric graph）限制相互作用范围下的意见形成动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间约束导致吸收态不仅在磁化和活性上不同，还在平均度和空间状态组织上存在差异；与现有共演化非线性投票者模型相比，新模型表现出减小的共识区域、空间隔离的碎片化和孤立节点形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间约束导致吸收态不仅在磁化和活性上不同，还在平均度和空间状态组织上存在差异；与现有共演化非线性投票者模型相比，新模型表现出减小的共识区域、空间隔离的碎片化和孤立节点形成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比，但明确指出该模型通过引入局部几何可达性（local geometric accessibility）重塑了吸收态的结构，这是相对于现有共演化非线性投票者模型的主要新意。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机几何图限制投票者动力学的相互作用范围，当局部重连不可行时删除不一致连边；通过探索动力学和结构可观测量（如磁化、活性、平均度等）进行数值模拟，并发展了一个关于平均度演化和终端非守恒量的唯象描述。

papers.title: Rotation topological states: theory and material realization
papers.abstract: The conventional characterization of topological materials relies on topological invariants calculated from the entire set of occupied bands. However, when a system possesses rotational symmetry, the occupied Hilbert space can be decomposed into multiple subspaces labeled by distinct rotation eigenvalues. We show that this decomposition reveals hidden topological states characterized by a novel $\mathbb{Z}_2^n$ topological invariant, where $n$ is the number of subspaces, while the conventional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant may fail to detect the topology hidden in the rotation subspaces. Remarkably, time-reversal symmetry pairs conjugate rotation eigenvalues and guarantees that the two subspaces have the same $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariants, making the topology always hidden from the conventional global invariant. We formulate the theory of rotation-subspace topology and demonstrate its material realization in bulk CsCl. Using first-principles calculations and symmetry analysis, we show that bulk CsCl, which is diagnosed as topologically trivial by the conventional approach, features a nontrivial $\mathbb{Z}_2^3$ invariant along the $Γ$-R path and a nontrivial $\mathbb{Z}_2^4$ invariant along the $Γ$-Z and M-R paths, leading to double Weyl points on the (111) and (001) surfaces, respectively. The subspace $\mathbb{Z}_2^n$ invariant proposed here serves as a necessary refinement for symmetry-protected topological phases and will facilitate the identification of a large class of topological states overlooked by existing diagnostics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算验证）。判断依据：提出理论框架（theory of rotation-subspace topology）、第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）、对称性分析（symmetry analysis）。；研究对象：旋转对称性导致的隐藏拓扑态，具体材料为体相CsCl（bulk CsCl）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有旋转对称性的体系中，占据态希尔伯特空间可分解为不同旋转本征值的子空间，这些子空间可携带一种新型 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^n\) 拓扑不变量，而传统全局 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 不变量可能完全无法探测到这种隐藏拓扑。体相CsCl被传统方法诊断为拓扑平庸，但实际具有非平庸的 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^3\) 和 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^4\) 不变量，导致(111)和(001)表面出现双Weyl点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有旋转对称性的体系中，占据态希尔伯特空间可分解为不同旋转本征值的子空间，这些子空间可携带一种新型 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^n\) 拓扑不变量，而传统全局 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 不变量可能完全无法探测到这种隐藏拓扑。体相CsCl被传统方法诊断为拓扑平庸，但实际具有非平庸的 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^3\) 和 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^4\) 不变量，导致(111)和(001)表面出现双Weyl点。；创新点：提出旋转子空间拓扑理论，揭示了传统全局拓扑不变量无法检测的隐藏拓扑态，并给出了具体材料实现（CsCl）。该 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^n\) 不变量是对现有对称性保护拓扑相分类的必要补充。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（基于旋转对称性分解希尔伯特空间、定义 \(\mathbb{Z}_2^n\) 不变量）、第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）、对称性分析（symmetry analysis）。

papers.title: Quantum-classical crossover in finite spin-1/2 rings with Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya interaction
papers.abstract: We study finite spin-$\tfrac12$ rings with nearest-neighbor Heisenberg exchange, Dzyaloshinsky--Moriya interaction, and an external magnetic field. We introduce an interpolation parameter between the fully quantum Hamiltonian and a state-dependent mean-field description. Using dissipative Gisin--Schrödinger dynamics, we analyze the resulting quantum--classical crossover through local magnetization, connected spin correlations, single-site entropy, and the saturation field of the fully polarized state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce an interpolation parameter、mean-field description、dissipative Gisin–Schrödinger dynamics。；研究对象：有限尺寸的自旋-1/2环，包含最近邻海森堡交换相互作用、Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya（DM）相互作用以及外磁场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入量子-经典插值参数，利用耗散Gisin–Schrödinger动力学，分析了局域磁化、连通自旋关联、单点熵以及完全极化态的饱和场，揭示了有限自旋环中量子-经典交叉行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入量子-经典插值参数，利用耗散Gisin–Schrödinger动力学，分析了局域磁化、连通自旋关联、单点熵以及完全极化态的饱和场，揭示了有限自旋环中量子-经典交叉行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用状态依赖的平均场描述与全量子哈密顿量之间的插值参数，结合耗散Gisin–Schrödinger动力学进行理论分析。

papers.title: Emergent induction in magnetic Weyl semimetals
papers.abstract: We theoretically study emergent electromagnetic responses in Weyl semimetals. Focusing on magnetic Weyl semimetals, we develop a general theory of emergent induction driven by magnetic dynamics. We show that magnetoelectric (ME) responses in Weyl semimetals give rise to emergent induction mediated by magnetization dynamics. Using effective two-band models for magnetic Weyl semimetals, we derive a formula for the ME response that includes both intraband and interband contributions. The resulting formula shows that the intraband contribution is proportional to the relaxation time $τ$, whereas the interband contribution is associated with the separation of the Weyl nodes. Applying the general formula to a model of polar Weyl ferromagnets, we demonstrate that the dynamics of the toroidal moment is closely related to the emergent inductive response in polar Weyl ferromagnets, as recently discovered by Suzuki et al. [Y. Suzuki et al. arXiv:2607.12322]. The chemical-potential dependence of the inductance indicates that the emergent electromagnetic response is enhanced in the energy range of the Weyl dispersion, reflecting the topological nature of Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically study”、“develop a general theory”、“derive a formula”、“effective two-band models”。；研究对象：磁性Weyl半金属中的涌现电磁响应，特别是由磁动力学驱动的涌现电感效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Weyl半金属中，磁动力学可通过磁电响应产生涌现电感，其中带内贡献与弛豫时间τ成正比，带间贡献与Weyl节点的分离相关。该涌现电磁响应在Weyl色散的能量范围内得到增强，反映了Weyl半金属的拓扑性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Weyl半金属中，磁动力学可通过磁电响应产生涌现电感，其中带内贡献与弛豫时间τ成正比，带间贡献与Weyl节点的分离相关。该涌现电磁响应在Weyl色散的能量范围内得到增强，反映了Weyl半金属的拓扑性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于有效两带模型，推导了包含带内和带间贡献的磁电响应公式；并将该通用公式应用于极性Weyl铁磁体模型，分析了环状磁矩动力学与涌现电感响应的关系。

papers.title: Hybridization-controlled re-entrant electronic phase switching and moire-confined states in twisted bilayer PtTe2
papers.abstract: Twisting a van der Waals bilayer changes not only the moiré periodicity but also the local stacking and interlayer hybridization. Here, we show, using fully relaxed first-principles calculations including spin--orbit coupling, band unfolding, and Brillouin-zone-integrated densities of states, that bilayer PtTe$_2$ exhibits a non-monotonic evolution between gapless and gapped electronic regimes. The $7.34^\circ$ structure remains gapless, whereas finite direct gaps appear at the sampled intermediate angles. The gap closes at the sampled $60^\circ$ configuration and reopens at higher angles. The direct gap shows an overall increase with the minimum local interlayer Pt--Pt separation, although the complete distribution of local stacking environments is required to account for deviations from this trend. At $7.34^\circ$, the low-energy states are concentrated predominantly in the AA-like regions of the otherwise gapless moiré cell. Controlled interlayer-separation scans show that increasing the layer spacing removes the near-$E_F$ crossings and opens a gap, consistent with weakened interlayer Te-$p_z$ hybridization. These results identify the redistribution of interlayer hybridization as the microscopic origin of the re-entrant gap evolution in twisted bilayer PtTe$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“fully relaxed first-principles calculations”、“band unfolding”、“densities of states”。；研究对象：扭曲双层PtTe₂（twisted bilayer PtTe₂）中的电子能带结构、能隙演化以及莫尔局域态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭曲双层PtTe₂的电子能带在特定扭转角下呈现非单调的“重入”式演化：在7.34°和60°附近为无能隙金属态，而在中间角度则打开有限直接带隙。该重入能隙演化的微观起源是层间杂化的重新分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭曲双层PtTe₂的电子能带在特定扭转角下呈现非单调的“重入”式演化：在7.34°和60°附近为无能隙金属态，而在中间角度则打开有限直接带隙。该重入能隙演化的微观起源是层间杂化的重新分布。；创新点：揭示了扭曲双层PtTe₂中由层间杂化（特别是Te-pz轨道杂化）的重新分布所驱动的、非单调的“重入”式能隙开关行为，并指出在7.34°的莫尔超胞中，低能态主要局域在类AA堆叠区域。
papers.method_zh: 采用完全弛豫的第一性原理计算，并考虑了自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）、能带反折叠（band unfolding）以及布里渊区积分态密度分析。通过控制层间距的扫描计算来研究杂化效应。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Residual Deep Learning for Constitutive Modeling of Hot Deformation and Dynamic Recrystallization in a Mo-Rich $α+β$ Titanium Alloy
papers.abstract: Accurate constitutive modeling of hot deformation behavior is essential for designing thermomechanical processes in advanced structural alloys. Conventional Arrhenius-type and empirical models do not adequately capture the combined effects of strain hardening, dynamic recovery (DRV), and dynamic recrystallization (DRX) across broad processing conditions. In this study, two Stacked Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks (STAR-PINNs) were developed to simulate the hot deformation response of a Mo-rich $α+β$ titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4Mo-1V-0.1Si). The Enhanced STAR-PINN incorporated thermomechanical constitutive constraints, while the DRX-Aware STAR-PINN employed a dual-output architecture to account for recrystallization kinetics. Both models used a shared residual encoder trained on experimental flow stress data collected at temperatures from 800 to 1050 degrees C and strain rates between 0.01 and 10 per second. Physics-informed constraints, including thermal softening, strain-rate sensitivity, strain hardening, and post-peak softening, were enforced through automatic differentiation. The DRX-Aware model further integrated JMAK-Avrami regularization, DRX saturation constraints, and Arrhenius-based consistency with tunable parameters, directly linking the predicted DRX fraction to stress output via latent-feature fusion. The DRX-Aware STAR-PINN achieved RMSE = 11.69 MPa, MAE = 4.83 MPa, R^2 = 0.9850, and a cross-validated RMSE of 12.47 +/- 0.26 MPa. This model accurately reproduced temperature-dependent flow curves, DRX kinetics, and Zener-Hollomon relationships, while maintaining physically consistent constitutive behavior. These results demonstrate that physics-informed deep learning provides a robust and interpretable framework for constitutive modeling, offering a practical approach for advanced process modeling of titanium alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Physics-Informed Neural Networks、constitutive modeling、deep learning。；研究对象：Mo-rich α+β 钛合金（Ti-6Al-4Mo-1V-0.1Si）在热变形过程中的本构行为，包括应变硬化、动态回复（DRV）和动态再结晶（DRX）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于物理信息的残差深度学习模型（DRX-Aware STAR-PINN）能够准确预测该钛合金在不同温度和应变率下的流变应力曲线、动态再结晶动力学以及Zener-Hollomon关系，模型性能达到RMSE = 11.69 MPa，R² = 0.9850。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于物理信息的残差深度学习模型（DRX-Aware STAR-PINN）能够准确预测该钛合金在不同温度和应变率下的流变应力曲线、动态再结晶动力学以及Zener-Hollomon关系，模型性能达到RMSE = 11.69 MPa，R² = 0.9850。；创新点：将物理信息（如热软化、DRX动力学约束）直接嵌入深度学习网络架构，并通过潜特征融合将预测的再结晶分数与应力输出显式关联，实现了可解释的本构建模，克服了传统Arrhenius型模型和纯数据驱动方法的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种堆叠残差物理信息神经网络（STAR-PINN）：Enhanced STAR-PINN引入热力学本构约束；DRX-Aware STAR-PINN采用双输出架构，结合JMAK-Avrami正则化、DRX饱和约束和Arrhenius一致性，通过自动微分施加物理约束（热软化、应变率敏感性、应变硬化、峰后软化），并在800–1050°C、0.01–10 s⁻¹条件下使用实验流变应力数据训练共享残差编码器。

papers.title: Hubbard-assisted stability of Hatsugai-Kohmoto correlations in a one-dimensional open chain
papers.abstract: The Hatsugai-Kohmoto (HK) model has recently been identified as a fixed-point description of Mottness that is stable against perturbing local interactions. This raises a natural question beyond the weak-perturbation regime: how does a finite local repulsion modify HK physics in real-space observables and local spectra? We address this question in a half-filled one-dimensional spinful fermion chain, where the HK interaction is supplemented by an onsite Hubbard repulsion. Using exact diagonalization in an open chain, we compute ground-state correlation functions and site-resolved local spectra. We find that the Hubbard term does not drive the system away from the HK-dominated regime. Instead, at moderate $U_{\rm HK}$, a finite $U_{\rm Hub}$ promotes the emergence of behavior characteristic of the pure HK chain at larger $U_{\rm HK}$. This Hubbard-assisted strong-HK response is reflected consistently in the development of positive spin correlations, the suppression of single-particle coherence, the impurity-induced redistribution of local spectral weight, and the evolution of pairing correlations. As a control perturbation, we replace the onsite Hubbard interaction by a nearest-neighbor (NN) density interaction. In contrast to the Hubbard case, the HK and NN interactions display competing tendencies and do not reproduce the same strong-HK behavior. These results provide a nonperturbative real-space complement to the fixed-point stability of HK physics and show that the effect of an additional repulsive interaction depends sensitively on its spatial structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）进行数值计算，分析模型哈密顿量的基态性质。；研究对象：一维半填充自旋费米子开链中的Hatsugai-Kohmoto（HK）模型，并补充了局域Hubbard排斥相互作用或最近邻密度相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限大小的Hubbard排斥项不会破坏HK主导的物理行为，反而会促进系统表现出更大HK耦合强度下的纯HK链特征；而最近邻密度相互作用则与HK相互作用表现出竞争趋势，无法复现相同的强HK行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限大小的Hubbard排斥项不会破坏HK主导的物理行为，反而会促进系统表现出更大HK耦合强度下的纯HK链特征；而最近邻密度相互作用则与HK相互作用表现出竞争趋势，无法复现相同的强HK行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）方法计算开链的基态关联函数和位点分辨的局域谱。

papers.title: Resistivity in Dilute Cu-3d Alloys Governed by Disorder-Induced Band Broadening
papers.abstract: The mechanism governing the resistivity in dilute Cu-3d transition-metal alloys at ambient temperature -- the regime relevant to most practical applications and distinct from the low-temperature, Kondo-screened regime addressed by earlier theoretical work -- is investigated using first-principles calculations based on the Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker coherent potential approximation combined with the Kubo--Greenwood formalism. The paramagnetic state is described within the disordered local moment (DLM) framework, corresponding to a local-moment paramagnet rather than a Pauli paramagnet. We show that the experimentally observed resistivity trends are reproduced only within the DLM description, while nonmagnetic and ferromagnetic states fail to capture the correct element dependence. Contrary to conventional interpretations based on the density of states at the Fermi level, the resistivity exhibits a strong correlation with the full width at half maximum (FWHM) of the Bloch spectral function (BSF) on the Fermi surface. This correlation reflects the disorder-induced lifetime broadening of electronic states, directly related to the scattering rate that governs electrical resistivity. A common power-law scaling between resistivity and BSF broadening is identified across different magnetic states. These results demonstrate that the resistivity is governed by disorder-induced band broadening in momentum space rather than by local density-of-states effects, providing a unified microscopic interpretation of the breakdown of Linde's rule in Cu-based alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”、“Korringa–Kohn–Rostoker coherent potential approximation”、“Kubo–Greenwood formalism”。；研究对象：稀Cu-3d过渡金属合金在室温下的电阻率行为，特别是与低温近藤屏蔽区不同的实际应用相关输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验观测到的电阻率趋势仅在无序局域矩（DLM）描述下被复现，而非磁或铁磁态无法捕捉正确的元素依赖性；电阻率与费米面上布洛赫谱函数的半高宽（FWHM）强相关，而非传统认为的费米能级态密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验观测到的电阻率趋势仅在无序局域矩（DLM）描述下被复现，而非磁或铁磁态无法捕捉正确的元素依赖性；电阻率与费米面上布洛赫谱函数的半高宽（FWHM）强相关，而非传统认为的费米能级态密度。；创新点：揭示了电阻率由动量空间中的无序诱导能带展宽（而非局域态密度效应）主导，并发现不同磁态下电阻率与布洛赫谱函数展宽之间存在共同的幂律标度关系，从而为Cu基合金中林德规则的失效提供了统一的微观解释。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的Korringa–Kohn–Rostoker相干势近似（KKR-CPA）结合Kubo–Greenwood公式计算电导率；顺磁态采用无序局域矩（DLM）框架描述，对应局域矩顺磁体而非泡利顺磁体。

papers.title: Dirac topology, anomalous Hall response, and giant magnetoresistance in carrier-compensated altermagnetic semimetal NiS
papers.abstract: We combine first-principles density-functional theory, Berry-curvature analysis, semiclassical Boltzmann transport, and atomistic spin dynamics to establish hexagonal NiS as a compensated 3d altermagnetic semimetal in which topology, magnetism, and lattice dynamics are intrinsically intertwined. The rotational coset symmetry of the NiAs lattice produces momentum-dependent spin splitting characteristic of altermagnetism. With spin-orbit coupling, gapped Dirac-like crossings generate intense Berry-curvature hot spots and nearly compensated electron-hole pockets. This leads to a large and anisotropic intrinsic spin Hall conductivity comparable to that of several 4d, 5d metals, a symmetry-allowed anomalous Hall response despite zero net magnetization, and nonsaturating magnetoresistance exceeding 10000 percent. On the magnetic side, first-principles determination of the exchange tensor reveals dominant long-range superexchange and sizable anisotropic interactions, quantitatively reproducing the experimental Neel temperature. Our results identify NiS as a model 3d platform in which carrier compensation, altermagnetic symmetry, Berry-curvature driven transport, and lattice-sensitive magnetism coexist within a single symmetry framework, offering a design principle for multi-functional quantum responses in correlated transition-metal compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算为主，辅以理论分析）。判断依据：第一性原理密度泛函理论、贝里曲率分析、半经典玻尔兹曼输运、原子自旋动力学。；研究对象：六方晶系NiS，一种载流子补偿的3d交变磁半金属。具体研究其拓扑、磁性、晶格动力学之间的内在关联，以及由此产生的反常霍尔效应和巨磁电阻等输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NiS是一种载流子补偿的交变磁半金属，其狄拉克能带在自旋-轨道耦合下产生能隙，形成强烈的贝里曲率热点和近乎补偿的电子-空穴口袋，从而在零净磁化强度下产生巨大的、各向异性的内禀自旋霍尔电导率（与4d、5d金属相当）、对称性允许的反常霍尔效应以及超过10000%的非饱和磁电阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NiS是一种载流子补偿的交变磁半金属，其狄拉克能带在自旋-轨道耦合下产生能隙，形成强烈的贝里曲率热点和近乎补偿的电子-空穴口袋，从而在零净磁化强度下产生巨大的、各向异性的内禀自旋霍尔电导率（与4d、5d金属相当）、对称性允许的反常霍尔效应以及超过10000%的非饱和磁电阻。；创新点：将载流子补偿、交变磁对称性、贝里曲率驱动的输运以及晶格敏感的磁性统一在同一个对称性框架内，确立了NiS作为一个模型3d平台，为在关联过渡金属化合物中设计多功能量子响应提供了设计原理。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论、贝里曲率分析、半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论、原子自旋动力学模拟。具体包括：计算能带结构、交换张量、贝里曲率分布、输运系数（如反常霍尔电导、自旋霍尔电导、磁电阻）以及奈尔温度。

papers.title: On-chip quantum sensing of Kondo spins in a high-mobility quasi-one-dimensional nanoconstriction
papers.abstract: The precise nature of Kondo spins has remained enigmatic when extended to multiple spin impurities or, more intriguingly, when the localized spin itself may already be the consequence of many-body interactions in a presumably-delocalized open nanoconstriction, such as a quantum point contact (QPC). It is experimentally challenging to distinguish the Kondo state from other coexisting many-body spin states in such a strongly correlated system. Here we lithographically define an all-on-chip electronic resonator (ER) and a QPC in a high-mobility GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure transistor. Local Kondo screening of the QPC spin and nonlocal spin singlet across the ER-QPC integration are controllable in response to ER occupancy parity. We also show that the 0.7 anomaly, another strongly-correlated state in QPCs, not only has a different physical origin but furthermore counteracts the Kondo spin singlet. These results demonstrate a noninvasive quantum method for sensing spontaneous magnetic impurities within an open nanoconstriction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：lithographically define、experimentally challenging、demonstrate。；研究对象：高迁移率GaAs/AlGaAs异质结晶体管中准一维纳米收缩区（量子点接触，QPC）内的近藤自旋态，以及与之集成的全芯片电子谐振器（ER）中的自旋单态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过片上电子谐振器的占据数宇称可控制地调节QPC自旋的局域近藤屏蔽及ER-QPC间的非局域自旋单态；同时发现QPC中的0.7反常态与近藤自旋单态物理起源不同且相互拮抗。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过片上电子谐振器的占据数宇称可控制地调节QPC自旋的局域近藤屏蔽及ER-QPC间的非局域自旋单态；同时发现QPC中的0.7反常态与近藤自旋单态物理起源不同且相互拮抗。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用光刻技术在GaAs/AlGaAs异质结晶体管上定义全芯片电子谐振器与量子点接触，通过测量ER占据数宇称对QPC自旋态的影响，实现非侵入式量子传感。

papers.title: The nonequilibrium statistical mechanics of Markov interacting particles
papers.abstract: We consider coupled stochastic systems decomposed into exterior, boundary, and interior variables, with the boundary variables sometimes carrying the directed structure of a sensor and actuator. The central question is when the conditional law of histories factorises, and how this path space statement is detected by log likelihoods, by Girsanov changes of measure, and by information theoretic quantities used in nonequilibrium statistical physics. The basic object is a regular conditional probability on a path space. Under domination by clamped reference laws, the boundary property becomes multiplicative separation of a Radon--Nikodym derivative, or equivalently additive separation of a path log likelihood. For Itō diffusions this log likelihood is computed by Girsanov's theorem; its expectation is the quadratic control energy appearing in the Föllmer entropy identity and in the stochastic control formulation of Schrödinger bridge problems. When exact factorisation fails, the remaining coupling is measured by conditional mutual information, namely the relative entropy between the true boundary-conditioned path law and the product of its conditional marginals. This gives a common language for boundary screening, path likelihood inference, controlled changes of path law, and the thermodynamic value of mutual information.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：nonequilibrium statistical mechanics、stochastic systems、path space、Radon--Nikodym derivative、Girsanov theorem、relative entropy。；研究对象：马尔可夫相互作用粒子系统的非平衡统计力学，具体关注由外部、边界和内部变量耦合构成的随机系统，边界变量有时具有传感器和致动器的有向结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当边界条件化路径律的因子化成立时，Radon--Nikodym导数（或路径对数似然）呈现乘性分离（或加性分离）；当精确因子化失败时，剩余耦合由条件互信息（即真实边界条件化路径律与其条件边缘乘积之间的相对熵）度量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当边界条件化路径律的因子化成立时，Radon--Nikodym导数（或路径对数似然）呈现乘性分离（或加性分离）；当精确因子化失败时，剩余耦合由条件互信息（即真实边界条件化路径律与其条件边缘乘积之间的相对熵）度量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于路径空间上的正则条件概率，利用受钳制参考律的支配性，通过Radon--Nikodym导数、Girsanov定理（用于Itō扩散的对数似然计算）、Föllmer熵恒等式中的二次控制能量，以及随机控制框架下的Schrödinger桥问题，结合条件互信息与相对熵进行理论分析。

papers.title: A Loewner-Theoretic Approach to the Nonlinear Generalized Langevin Equation: The Role of Entropy in Colored Noise Environment
papers.abstract: In this study, the formal derivation of a one-dimensional nonlinear generalized Langevin equation is demonstrated using a decomposition method based on the conformal transformation governed by the chordal Loewner equation. Here, we used a modified Mori-Zwanzig method whose operator is substituted by that is derived from the discrete Loewner evolution. By this approach, the different types of fluctuation-dissipation relation (FDR) were reformulated using mathematical terms affected by the conformal maps. Dealing with a memory kernel that models the cell migration experiment, the numerical simulation was performed to obtain the specific scaling law of energy dissipation that is common among the two obtained types of FDRs. In addition, the concept of Loewner entropy is used for the estimation of the canonical ensemble in the colored noise environment throughout the theoretical analyses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：formal derivation、theoretical analyses、numerical simulation（模拟为理论验证手段）。；研究对象：一维非线性广义朗之万方程（nonlinear generalized Langevin equation）在有色噪声环境下的动力学行为，以及熵在其中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于弦Loewner方程的共形变换分解方法，重新推导了非线性广义朗之万方程，并得到了两种不同类型的涨落-耗散关系（FDR），且两者具有共同的能量耗散标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于弦Loewner方程的共形变换分解方法，重新推导了非线性广义朗之万方程，并得到了两种不同类型的涨落-耗散关系（FDR），且两者具有共同的能量耗散标度律。；创新点：将Loewner方程（共形变换）引入非线性广义朗之万方程的推导，并以此重新表述涨落-耗散关系；提出“Loewner熵”概念用于有色噪声环境下的系综分析。
papers.method_zh: 采用修正的Mori-Zwanzig方法，将其中的算符替换为离散Loewner演化导出的算符；利用弦Loewner方程控制的共形变换进行分解；通过数值模拟处理模拟细胞迁移实验的记忆核，获得能量耗散标度律；引入Loewner熵概念用于有色噪声环境下正则系综的估计。

papers.title: The Sample Pre-selection and Characterization Station at the SECUF: Instrumentation, Capabilities, and Representative Scientific Achievements
papers.abstract: The Synergetic Extreme Condition User Facility (SECUF) is a comprehensive, state-of-the-art user facility designed to provide integrated extreme physical conditions-including ultrahigh pressure, ultralow temperature, strong magnetic fields, and ultrafast optical fields-for frontier research in condensed matter physics and materials science. Within SECUF, the F2 Sample Pre-selection and Characterization Station plays a pivotal supporting role. Its mission is to provide comprehensive sample synthesis, processing, pre-screening, and characterization services to prepare high-quality specimens for subsequent experiments under extreme conditions. This paper details the specifications and performance of ten core instrument systems within these units. Furthermore, we highlight several breakthrough scientific achievements enabled by the F2 Station, encompassing the discovery of novel quantum spin supersolid states, pressure-induced high-temperature superconductivity in nickelates, giant anomalous Hall angles, and molecular water in lunar soil. We also outline ongoing technical developments that expand the station's capabilities, such as integrated high-pressure cells and self-built ancillary measurement systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：instrumentation（仪器）、characterization（表征）、scientific achievements（科学成就）。；研究对象：SECUF（综合极端条件用户装置）中的F2样品预选与表征站，及其所服务的凝聚态物理与材料科学研究，包括量子自旋超固态、镍酸盐高压高温超导、巨反常霍尔角、月壤中分子水等具体体系与现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: F2站通过集成样品合成、加工、预筛选与表征服务，成功支撑了多项突破性科学发现，包括新型量子自旋超固态、镍酸盐中压力诱导的高温超导、巨反常霍尔角以及月壤中分子水的发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：F2站通过集成样品合成、加工、预筛选与表征服务，成功支撑了多项突破性科学发现，包括新型量子自旋超固态、镍酸盐中压力诱导的高温超导、巨反常霍尔角以及月壤中分子水的发现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有设施或方法的创新点，但强调了F2站作为SECUF中关键支撑单元，在提供综合极端条件实验前样品预筛选与表征方面的独特功能与已取得的科学成就。
papers.method_zh: 详细描述了F2站内十套核心仪器系统的规格与性能，并提及了集成高压腔体、自建辅助测量系统等正在开发的技术手段。摘要未具体列出各仪器名称（如X射线衍射、扫描电镜等），但整体属于实验表征方法。

papers.title: Direct Imaging of Temperature Evolution of Polar Nanoregions and Chemically Ordered Regions in PMN Relaxor: Evidence for Polar Phase Percolation
papers.abstract: Polar nanoregions (PNRs) are central to understanding the exceptional dielectric and piezoelectric properties of relaxor ferroelectrics and are key to advancing dielectrics for high-energy storage. However, direct real-space imaging of their formation and evolution remains a major challenge in condensed matter physics. Here, we report the real-space mappings of both PNRs and chemically ordered regions (CORs) in the prototypical relaxor Pb(Mg1/3Nb2/3)O3 and their temperature dependence using convergent-beam electron diffraction (CBED) combined with four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM). The results reveal that CORs, with sizes of 2-5 nm, remain static with temperature and act to suppress PNR growth. In contrast, PNRs evolve from isolated 2-5 nm regions at room temperature to interconnected structures ~10 nm in size at low temperatures, indicative of a percolation transition. These observations support the random-field model, in which PNRs emerge from a paraelectric matrix and their growth and collective interactions are constrained by random local fields associated with CORs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：direct imaging、convergent-beam electron diffraction (CBED)、four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM)。；研究对象：弛豫铁电体Pb(Mg1/3Nb2/3)O3（PMN）中的极性纳米区域（PNRs）和化学有序区域（CORs）及其温度演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 直接实空间成像表明，化学有序区域（CORs）尺寸为2-5 nm且随温度保持静态，并抑制极性纳米区域（PNRs）的生长；而PNRs从室温下的孤立2-5 nm区域演变为低温下约10 nm的互联结构，表明发生了逾渗转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：直接实空间成像表明，化学有序区域（CORs）尺寸为2-5 nm且随温度保持静态，并抑制极性纳米区域（PNRs）的生长；而PNRs从室温下的孤立2-5 nm区域演变为低温下约10 nm的互联结构，表明发生了逾渗转变。；创新点：首次实现了对弛豫铁电体中PNRs和CORs形成与演化的直接实空间成像，并提供了极性相逾渗转变的实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 会聚束电子衍射（CBED）结合四维扫描透射电子显微镜（4D-STEM）进行实空间成像。

papers.title: Fundamental Relation between Conductance of Biomolecules and the Fukui Function
papers.abstract: The finite-temperature conductance of a molecule coupled to metallic leads is derived entirely within the framework of density functional theory (DFT) and its time-dependent extension for open quantum systems. Starting from the Mermin grand potential, the foundational Kohn-Sham equations, the Fukui function, and the open-system master equation for the single-particle density matrix are systematically formulated. The non-equilibrium electron-phonon dissipator is obtained from the partial trace over the phonon bath. By applying Wick's theorem for non-interacting fermions, a fully exchange-symmetric collision integral is obtained that strictly preserves Pauli exclusion at the operator level. Performing a double perturbation expansion, initially in the applied voltage (linear response), and subsequently in the molecule-lead coupling (weak coupling), it is demonstrated that under the fast-thermalization condition, the complex exchange-correlation self-consistent field response is analytically projected out by the diagonal structure of the slow Liouvillian mode. Consequently, the thermal conductance is governed by the finite-temperature Fukui function, the central reactivity descriptor of conceptual density functional theory. This condition is satisfied in proteins, whose wave functions are extended and multifractal due to quantum criticality at the Anderson metal-insulator transition. This derivation establishes a fundamental link between electronic transport and chemical reactivity, identifying conducting paths with reactive sites. It opens new technological avenues connecting drug design to conductance experiments and also provides a foundation for designing next-generation bioelectronic sensing and computing architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：密度泛函理论（DFT）、时间依赖密度泛函理论（TDDFT）、开放量子系统、主方程、微扰展开。；研究对象：生物分子（如蛋白质）与金属电极耦合形成的分子结中的电子输运现象，具体关注其热导率与化学活性位点之间的内在联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在快速热化条件下，生物分子的热导率由有限温度下的Fukui函数（概念密度泛函理论中的核心反应性描述符）决定。这建立了电子输运与化学反应性之间的基本联系，即导电通路对应反应活性位点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在快速热化条件下，生物分子的热导率由有限温度下的Fukui函数（概念密度泛函理论中的核心反应性描述符）决定。这建立了电子输运与化学反应性之间的基本联系，即导电通路对应反应活性位点。；创新点：该工作首次从第一性原理（DFT框架内）严格推导出生物分子电导与Fukui函数之间的基本关系，将凝聚态物理中的电子输运理论与化学中的反应性理论（概念DFT）统一起来。摘要未突出说明与以往具体输运理论（如Landauer公式）的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 严格基于密度泛函理论（DFT）及其对开放量子系统的时间依赖扩展。具体步骤包括：从Mermin巨势出发，系统推导了Kohn-Sham方程、Fukui函数以及单粒子密度矩阵的开放系统主方程；通过对声子浴求偏迹得到非平衡电子-声子耗散项；应用Wick定理得到完全交换对称的碰撞积分；最后在弱耦合和线性响应下进行双重微扰展开。

papers.title: Theoretical prediction of structural stability and superconductivity in T-hexagonal molybdenum dihydrides Monolayer
papers.abstract: The realization of ambient-pressure, high-temperature superconductivity in hydrogen-rich materials remains a major pursuit in condensed-matter physics. While bulk hydrides require extreme pressures to stabilize, two-dimensional (2D) transition-metal hydrides offer a promising alternative to bypass these compression constraints. In this work, we investigate the structural stability, electronic properties, and phonon-mediated superconductivity of a hexagonal molybdenum dihydride (MoH2) monolayer using first-principles calculations. Total-energy evaluations reveal that the octahedral T-phase is energetically more favorable than the previously reported trigonal prismatic H-phase by 0.198 eV, establishing the T-phase as the true ground-state configuration. Consequently, we systematically evaluate the lattice dynamics and superconducting properties of this ground-state T-MoH2 monolayer within the frameworks of density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) and the anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg formalism. The transition metal-hydrogen vibrational networks induce strong electron-phonon coupling (EPC), yielding an integrated coupling parameter of λ= 1.04. Solving the anisotropic Eliashberg equations predicts a conventional superconducting transition temperature (Tc of 14.4K) at ambient pressure, characterized by a moderately gap distribution (Δ= 2.07-3.01meV at 5.0 K). Our findings highlight the T-MoH2 monolayer as a structurally, mechanically, and thermally stable platform for exploring low-dimensional conventional superconductivity under ambient conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“density functional perturbation theory (DFPT)”（密度泛函微扰理论）、“anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg formalism”（各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg形式）。；研究对象：六方二氢化钼（MoH₂）单层薄膜，具体为T相（八面体相）的晶体结构、电子性质及声子介导超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: T相（八面体相）MoH₂单层是能量更低的基态构型，在常压下具有强电子-声子耦合（λ=1.04），理论预测其超导转变温度Tc约为14.4 K，且结构、力学和热学性质稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：T相（八面体相）MoH₂单层是能量更低的基态构型，在常压下具有强电子-声子耦合（λ=1.04），理论预测其超导转变温度Tc约为14.4 K，且结构、力学和热学性质稳定。；创新点：首次提出T相（八面体相）MoH₂单层是比此前报道的H相（三角棱柱相）更稳定的基态结构，并系统预测了其在常压下的常规超导电性，为低维常压超导研究提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算进行总能评估以确定基态结构；利用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）分析晶格动力学；通过各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg方程求解超导转变温度及超导能隙分布。

papers.title: Electronic properties and topological aspects of graphene nanohelicoids
papers.abstract: We introduce graphene nanohelicoids, geometric analogues of graphene nanoribbons, in which the honeycomb lattice is embedded on a helicoidal surface. Starting from the three-dimensional helical structure, we construct effective one-dimensional lattice models with band structures characterized by a momentum-shifted particle-hole relation $E_v(k)=-E_c(k+π)$ that reflects an anti-chiral symmetry arising from the nonsymmorphic symmetry. A systematic investigation of graphene nanohelicoids using the tight-binding approximation reveals a number of trends upon varying width and edge orientation, for instance, alternating transitions between semiconducting and metallic regimes. As the structure width varies, the band gap periodically closes and reopens, accompanied by an alternating Zak phase that switches between trivial and nontrivial. We derive an analytic tight-binding model and introduce a continuous deformation of the graphene nanohelicoids that explains the origin of width-dependent band inversion and alternating Zak phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tight-binding approximation（紧束缚近似）、analytic model（解析模型）、band structure（能带结构）。；研究对象：石墨烯纳米螺旋体（graphene nanohelicoids），即蜂窝晶格嵌入螺旋曲面形成的三维结构，是石墨烯纳米带的几何类比物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现石墨烯纳米螺旋体的能带结构具有由非对称空间对称性导致的反对称手性对称性（anti-chiral symmetry），表现为动量平移的粒子-空穴关系；随着结构宽度变化，体系在半导体和金属态之间交替转变，能隙周期性闭合与重开，同时Zak相位在平凡与非平凡之间交替。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现石墨烯纳米螺旋体的能带结构具有由非对称空间对称性导致的反对称手性对称性（anti-chiral symmetry），表现为动量平移的粒子-空穴关系；随着结构宽度变化，体系在半导体和金属态之间交替转变，能隙周期性闭合与重开，同时Zak相位在平凡与非平凡之间交替。；创新点：首次提出并系统研究石墨烯纳米螺旋体的电子性质，揭示了由非对称空间对称性导致的反对称手性对称性，以及宽度依赖的能带反转和拓扑相变机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚近似构建有效一维晶格模型，系统研究宽度和边缘取向对电子性质的影响；推导解析紧束缚模型，并引入连续形变方法解释能带反转和Zak相位交替的起源。

papers.title: Modeling damage and fracture in additively manufactured polymeric triply periodic minimal surface lattices
papers.abstract: Architected triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) lattices offer superior specific energy absorption, toughness, fatigue strength, and tunability. While recent advancements have established rate-dependent viscoplastic constitutive models to capture the complex nonlinear deformation response of additively manufactured polymeric TPMS structures, predicting fracture and the resulting structural failure remains a significant challenge. We address this by performing systematic experiments on unit cells and lattices of various sizes under tension, compression, and non-monotonic loading. The experiments inform the development of a new constitutive model that captures the damage and fracture behavior of polymeric TPMS lattices. We first implement a high-fidelity viscoplastic deformation constitutive model from Ma et al. (2026) into finite element software Abaqus/Explicit via a user material subroutine. We then propose a damage initiation criterion for amorphous polymers based on stored elastic energy and equivalent plastic strain. The damage model is implemented in Abaqus using gradient-damage framework following Konale and Srivastava(2025). The damage model and numerical simulation capability are quantitatively and qualitatively validated using experimental results for a unit cell under non-monotonic loading and lattices under tension. The proposed damage model and simulation capability enable in silico design of architected polymer structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确进行了“systematic experiments”（系统实验）来获取数据，并在此基础上“develop a new constitutive model”（开发新本构模型），最后通过“finite element software”（有限元软件）进行数值模拟验证。；研究对象：增材制造（3D打印）聚合物三周期极小曲面（TPMS）点阵结构。具体研究其在外力作用下的损伤（damage）和断裂（fracture）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合实验与数值模拟，成功建立了一个能够预测增材制造聚合物TPMS点阵结构损伤起始和断裂失效的本构模型，实现了对该类结构失效行为的定量与定性模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合实验与数值模拟，成功建立了一个能够预测增材制造聚合物TPMS点阵结构损伤起始和断裂失效的本构模型，实现了对该类结构失效行为的定量与定性模拟。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，主要创新在于首次将损伤和断裂机制系统地整合到已有的粘塑性变形模型中，从而能够预测TPMS点阵结构的完整失效过程，而不仅仅是其非线性变形响应。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验手段**：对单胞（unit cell）和不同尺寸的点阵结构进行拉伸、压缩及非单调加载（non-monotonic loading）实验。

papers.title: Exact collective first-passage statistics of N trail-interacting walkers
papers.abstract: Memory encoded in the environment mediates interactions between active agents, from trail-following organisms to synthetic active matter depositing persistent tracks. Although such memory is known to strongly affect transport, its consequences for collective first-passage phenomena remain largely unexplored. Here we study $N$ one-dimensional random walkers interacting through a shared trail field. We characterize the $k^{\rm th}$ (among $N$) arrival time at a fixed target, and the probability that exactly $k$ walkers in $[0,1]$ reach one boundary before the other. For the broad class of self-interacting walkers with a saturating response to the trail, we derive exact expressions for the corresponding persistence exponents and splitting probabilities. Strikingly, despite the strong history-dependent correlations generated by the common environment, splitting probabilities are exactly identical whether walkers explore simultaneously or one after another. This invariance breaks down for nonsaturating trail interactions. Our results follow from an exact representation of the collective trail field and establish a framework for first-passage phenomena in systems coupled through persistent environmental memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive exact expressions”“exact representation”“establish a framework”等表述，属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：N个一维随机行走者通过共享的痕迹场（trail field）相互作用，研究集体首次通过统计（collective first-passage statistics），包括第k个到达时间以及分裂概率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于具有饱和响应的自相互作用行走者，尽管环境记忆导致强历史依赖关联，但分裂概率在行走者同时探索与依次探索时完全相同；这一不变性在非饱和痕迹相互作用下被破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于具有饱和响应的自相互作用行走者，尽管环境记忆导致强历史依赖关联，但分裂概率在行走者同时探索与依次探索时完全相同；这一不变性在非饱和痕迹相互作用下被破坏。；创新点：首次对通过持久环境记忆耦合的集体首次通过现象建立了精确解析框架，并揭示了饱和响应下分裂概率在同时/依次探索下的惊人不变性。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导。具体包括：对N个一维随机行走者与共享痕迹场的耦合系统，推导了第k个到达时间的持久性指数（persistence exponents）和分裂概率（splitting probabilities）的精确表达式，并利用集体痕迹场的精确表示进行分析。

papers.title: Multiwavelength Raman investigation of mono- and few-layer MoS2 grown by Pulsed Laser Deposition on SiO2
papers.abstract: Molybdenum disulfide (MoS$_2$) is a semiconductor whose vibrational and excitonic properties are highly sensitive to layer number and structural disorder. We demonstrate the growth of MoS$_2$ monolayers on inert, electronics-compatible SiO$_2$ substrates using room-temperature pulsed laser deposition (PLD). Control of the process parameters enables tuning from monolayer to multilayer films, which we investigate by multiwavelength Raman spectroscopy. The evolution of the Raman-shift difference between the $E_{2g}^{1}$ and $A_{1g}$ modes, combined with an assessment of defect density, tracks film growth as a function of the number of deposition laser pulses. Although excitonic effects strongly influence the optical response of two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides, experimental reports of symmetry-selective exciton-phonon coupling remain limited. We provide experimental evidence of symmetry-dependent exciton-phonon coupling in PLD-grown monolayer MoS$_2$. Specifically, we observe modulation of the resonant behaviour of the out-of-plane $A_{1g}$ and in-plane $E_{2g}^{1}$ modes, related to their different coupling to A excitons, predominantly derived from Mo $d_{z^2}$ orbitals, and C excitons, characterized by mixed orbital contributions from Mo $d_{z^2}$ and S $p_x$ and $p_y$ states. Comparison with mechanically exfoliated monolayers reveals the role of growth-induced defects in modulating these interactions. These findings establish room-temperature PLD as a viable approach for growing two-dimensional MoS$_2$ on inert, electronics-compatible substrates and provide insight into the interplay between excitonic resonances and growth-induced disorder in two-dimensional MoS$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：Raman spectroscopy（拉曼光谱）、Pulsed Laser Deposition（脉冲激光沉积）、growth（生长）。；研究对象：单层及少层二硫化钼（MoS₂）薄膜，生长在惰性、与电子学兼容的SiO₂衬底上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过室温脉冲激光沉积（PLD）成功在SiO₂衬底上生长出单层MoS₂，并观察到对称性依赖的激子-声子耦合效应：面外A₁g模与面内E²g模的共振行为因分别与A激子和C激子耦合不同而受到调制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过室温脉冲激光沉积（PLD）成功在SiO₂衬底上生长出单层MoS₂，并观察到对称性依赖的激子-声子耦合效应：面外A₁g模与面内E²g模的共振行为因分别与A激子和C激子耦合不同而受到调制。；创新点：首次在PLD生长的MoS₂中提供对称性依赖的激子-声子耦合的实验证据，并揭示了生长诱导缺陷对该耦合的调制作用；同时证明了室温PLD在惰性、电子学兼容衬底上生长二维MoS₂的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 采用室温脉冲激光沉积（PLD）生长MoS₂薄膜；使用多波长拉曼光谱（multiwavelength Raman spectroscopy）表征层数、缺陷密度及激子-声子耦合；通过对比机械剥离的单层MoS₂样品分析生长诱导缺陷的作用。

papers.title: Zero-energy bound state trapped in line-shaped vortex in topological superconductor
papers.abstract: Fermion bound states in the core of a line-shaped vortex of a two-dimensional topological superconductor are investigated. The superconducting pairing potential, described in terms of elliptical coordinates, vanishes along a line defect with the two foci at the endpoints. The superconductivity is induced into a topological insulator via proximity effect with a type II s-wave superconductor. The spin and the momentum are perpendicularly locked by the strong spin-orbit coupling via Rashba interaction. A zero-energy Majorana state arises from the Berry phase together with a sequence of equally spaced fermion exitations. By solving the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations using the method employed by Caroli, de Gennes and Matricon we calculate the energies, the wave-functions and spin-polarization of the bound states. An analytic expression for the local density of states within the vortex is obtained.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“investigated”、“solving the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations”、“calculate the energies, the wave-functions and spin-polarization”，属于理论推导与数值计算。；研究对象：二维拓扑超导体中线状涡旋（line-shaped vortex）中的费米子束缚态。具体体系为通过邻近效应在拓扑绝缘体上诱导的s波超导体，并考虑Rashba自旋-轨道耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在线状涡旋核心中，由于贝里相位（Berry phase）的存在，会产生一个零能量马约拉纳态（zero-energy Majorana state），并伴随一系列等间距的费米子激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在线状涡旋核心中，由于贝里相位（Berry phase）的存在，会产生一个零能量马约拉纳态（zero-energy Majorana state），并伴随一系列等间距的费米子激发。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用椭圆坐标系描述沿一条线缺陷（两端点为焦点）消失的超导配对势；通过Caroli、de Gennes和Matricon方法求解Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程，计算束缚态的能量、波函数和自旋极化，并得到涡旋内局域态密度的解析表达式。

papers.title: Synthesis of the Elusive Bulk Iodide Double-Perovskite Semiconductor, Cs2AgBiI6: Microcrystals and Photoconductive Films
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) iodide double-perovskite (elpasolite) semiconductors have attracted interest as potential lead-free metal-halide absorber layers for solar applications. Although studied extensively by computational methods, they have remained largely inaccessible synthetically, consistent with their predicted thermodynamic instability. Here, we report the first synthesis of bulk Cs2AgBiI6, demonstrating both microcrystalline and thin-film forms. Microcrystalline powders of Cs2AgBiI6 were prepared via anion exchange from phase-pure Cs2AgBiBr6 microcrystals. The resulting iodide elpasolite shows broad absorption throughout the visible with a 1.70 +/- 0.05 eV optical bandgap and near-infrared photoluminescence centered at 1.03 eV. We identify the elimination of trace moisture in bulk Cs2AgBiBr6 as the critical factor enabling complete halide exchange and isolation of bulk Cs2AgBiI6 with phase purity. In inert atmosphere, microcrystalline Cs2AgBiI6 shows no decomposition when stored for months at room temperature or heated to ~70 °C, and it appears equally stable in dry air. Building upon these insights, we then demonstrate the preparation of phase-pure Cs2AgBiI6 films by flash thermal evaporation of Cs2AgBiBr6 followed by anion exchange. Photoconductivity measurements on such Cs2AgBiI6 films demonstrate photocarrier generation and transport, marking the first optoelectronic measurement on this elusive 3D iodide double perovskite.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了合成、表征和器件制备等实验过程，如“anion exchange”、“flash thermal evaporation”、“Photoconductivity measurements”。；研究对象：三维碘化物双钙钛矿（elpasolite）半导体材料 Cs₂AgBiI₆ 的块体微晶和薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次成功合成了块体相纯的 Cs₂AgBiI₆ 微晶和薄膜，并证实其具有光电导性。关键合成条件是消除前驱体 Cs₂AgBiBr₆ 中的痕量水分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次成功合成了块体相纯的 Cs₂AgBiI₆ 微晶和薄膜，并证实其具有光电导性。关键合成条件是消除前驱体 Cs₂AgBiBr₆ 中的痕量水分。；创新点：解决了长期以来三维碘化物双钙钛矿（如 Cs₂AgBiI₆）因热力学不稳定性而难以通过传统方法合成块体材料的难题，首次实现了该材料的块体微晶和薄膜的相纯合成，并首次报道了其光电导特性。
papers.method_zh: 1. 通过阴离子交换法，以相纯的 Cs₂AgBiBr₆ 微晶为前驱体合成 Cs₂AgBiI₆ 微晶。2. 采用闪蒸热蒸发（flash thermal evaporation）技术制备 Cs₂AgBiBr₆ 薄膜，再通过阴离子交换转化为 Cs₂AgBiI₆ 薄膜。3. 使用光学吸收光谱（测得1.70 eV带隙）、光致发光光谱（测得1.03 eV发光峰）和光电导测量进行表征。

papers.title: Emergent Yielding from Structural Load Transfer in Disordered Soft Solids
papers.abstract: Yielding in disordered soft solids originates from the progressive redistribution of load-bearing capacity from recoverable elastic networks to frictional interactions through deformation-induced structural evolution. We present a unified, non-singular constitutive framework demonstrating that this mechanism naturally generates a finite yield stress and a smooth solid-to-fluid transition without prescribed yield criteria, constitutive switching, or divergent viscosities. The framework captures diverse transient and steady rheological phenomena, including Herschel-Bulkley behavior, stress overshoots, hysteresis, viscosity bifurcation, plug-flow formation, and thixotropic steady-state shear banding.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出统一、非奇异的本构框架”（unified, non-singular constitutive framework），属于理论建模工作。；研究对象：无序软固体（disordered soft solids）的屈服行为（yielding），具体涉及结构载荷传递（structural load transfer）导致的固-液转变过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序软固体的屈服源于变形诱导的结构演化，使可恢复弹性网络的承载能力逐步向摩擦相互作用转移；该机制无需预设屈服准则、本构切换或发散黏度，即可自然产生有限屈服应力和光滑的固-液转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序软固体的屈服源于变形诱导的结构演化，使可恢复弹性网络的承载能力逐步向摩擦相互作用转移；该机制无需预设屈服准则、本构切换或发散黏度，即可自然产生有限屈服应力和光滑的固-液转变。；创新点：该框架无需预设屈服准则、本构切换或发散黏度，即可统一描述多种瞬态和稳态流变现象（如Herschel-Bulkley行为、应力过冲、滞后、黏度分岔、塞流形成及触变性稳态剪切带），克服了传统屈服应力流体模型需要人为引入奇异性的局限。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个非奇异的统一本构框架（non-singular constitutive framework），通过理论推导描述结构载荷传递与屈服行为的关系。

papers.title: Half dualization and non-invertible particle-vortex duality defect on lattice
papers.abstract: We introduce half dualization as a general principle to construct non-invertible duality defects. The construction performs a duality transformation only in a subregion of spacetime, leaving an interface between the original theory and its dual. A non-invertible duality defect can be hosted on this interface. Half dualization is applicable whenever a local duality transformation is available, and does not depend on the spacetime dimension. We demonstrate the construction procedure in the (2+1)-dimensional Villainized charge-$n$ XY model on a cubic lattice. Half dualization yields a non-invertible particle-vortex duality defect whose fusion with its orientation reverse produces a (1+1)-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_n$ gauge theory on the fusion surface. We then apply half dualization to the $\mathbb{Z}_n$-gauged XY model relevant to the 3D XY$^\ast$ transition. In the gauged model, the half dualization interface hosts a gauge covariant duality wall, rather than a genuine gauge invariant duality defect. It flows to an invertible duality defect in infrared when the $\mathbb{Z}_n$ gauge theory is confined or Higgsed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：half dualization（半对偶化）、non-invertible duality defect（非可逆对偶缺陷）、lattice（格点）模型构造。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是（2+1）维立方格点上的Villain化荷-n XY模型，以及与之相关的Z_n规范化的XY模型（涉及3D XY*相变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“半对偶化”作为构造非可逆对偶缺陷的一般原理，并在格点模型中具体实现了非可逆的粒子-涡旋对偶缺陷，发现该缺陷与其方向反转的融合会产生一个（1+1）维Z_n规范理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“半对偶化”作为构造非可逆对偶缺陷的一般原理，并在格点模型中具体实现了非可逆的粒子-涡旋对偶缺陷，发现该缺陷与其方向反转的融合会产生一个（1+1）维Z_n规范理论。；创新点：将“半对偶化”提升为构造非可逆对偶缺陷的一般性原理，并在格点（而非连续场论）上具体实现了非可逆粒子-涡旋对偶缺陷，同时展示了其在规范理论（Z_n规范化的XY模型）中的应用，揭示了该缺陷在红外极限下可变为可逆对偶缺陷的条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用理论构造方法，具体为在时空子区域中执行局域对偶变换（半对偶化），从而在原始理论与其对偶理论之间生成界面，并在该界面上承载非可逆对偶缺陷。该方法不依赖时空维度，且适用于任何存在局域对偶变换的理论。

papers.title: Three-Dimensional Non-Foliated Fractional Quantum Hall Phases with Irrational Anyons in Twisted van der Waals Multilayers
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional fractional quantum Hall phases offer a route to intrinsically higher-dimensional topological order beyond simple stacks of two-dimensional quantum Hall liquids. Such phases can exhibit non-foliated, intrinsically three-dimensional entanglement structures, exponentially large topological degeneracies and quasiparticles with irrational braiding statistics. Their microscopic realization has remained elusive because Landau quantization in three dimensions generally leaves dispersive one-dimensional bands, favoring metallic and density-wave states over incompressible fractional liquids. Here we show that large-angle twisted van der Waals multilayers provide a practical route around this obstruction. Large twist angles suppress coherent interlayer tunneling through momentum mismatch, while the atomic-scale layer separation preserves strong interlayer Coulomb interactions.
