Using Monte Carlo calculations to compare the energies of an extensive set of 862 competing trial wavefunctions, we find that generalized Halperin states with quantum coherence extending across multiple consecutive layers are stabilized. In experimentally accessible magnetic-field regimes, these states replace the metallic spontaneous-interlayer-coherent phases that dominate conventional untwisted graphite-like multilayers. The resulting liquids realize non-foliated fractional quantum Hall order closely related to fractonic topological order, hosting quasiparticles with rational electric charges but irrational braiding statistics. Their large topological degeneracy and non-rational statistical phases may offer unconventional resources for quantum information storage and processing. Our results establish twisted van der Waals multilayers as a realistic materials platform for three-dimensional fractional Hall matter beyond conventional two-dimensional quantum Hall systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Monte Carlo calculations、competing trial wavefunctions、理论分析）；研究对象：大角度扭转范德华多层膜中的三维分数量子霍尔相，特别是非叶状（non-foliated）拓扑序及具有无理数编织统计的任意子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大角度扭转范德华多层膜中，通过强层间库仑相互作用和动量失配抑制相干隧穿，可稳定具有跨多层量子相干性的广义Halperin态，实现非叶状分数量子霍尔相，其准粒子具有有理电荷但无理数编织统计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大角度扭转范德华多层膜中，通过强层间库仑相互作用和动量失配抑制相干隧穿，可稳定具有跨多层量子相干性的广义Halperin态，实现非叶状分数量子霍尔相，其准粒子具有有理电荷但无理数编织统计。；创新点：提出大角度扭转范德华多层膜作为实现三维非叶状分数量子霍尔相的实际材料平台，突破了传统三维体系中朗道量子化导致金属态或密度波态的限制，并揭示了无理数编织统计与分形拓扑序的关联。
papers.method_zh: 通过蒙特卡洛计算比较862种竞争试探波函数的能量，确定稳定相；理论框架基于分数量子霍尔效应和分形拓扑序（fractonic topological order）。

papers.title: SiMOS quantum-dot spin qubits enabled by extreme-ultraviolet lithography
papers.abstract: The realization of large-scale silicon quantum processors requires spin qubits compatible with advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies, demanding lithographic processes that combine nanometer-scale precision with exceptional uniformity. Although the highest-performing silicon spin qubits demonstrated to date have relied on electron-beam (e-beam) lithography, its serial exposure process limits reproducibility studies and wafer-scale fabrication. Here, we demonstrate high-performance silicon metal-oxide-semiconductor (SiMOS) spin qubits fabricated using extreme-ultraviolet (EUV) lithography in a 300 mm semiconductor pilot line. We report wafer-scale quantum-dot uniformity metrics, including 100 % room-temperature gate-to-gate leakage yield and sub-nanometer control of critical gate dimensions. We characterize four double-dot systems realized in two triple-quantum-dot devices. Gate set tomography (GST) reveals consistently high fidelities across all four systems, with values up to 99.8 % for SPAM, 99.9 % for single-qubit gates, and 99.1 % for two-qubit gates. The devices exhibit highly reproducible exchange turn-on characteristics of 10-13 dec/V, indicating high fabrication uniformity enabled by EUV patterning. These results establish EUV lithography as a viable manufacturing technology for quantum processors based on high-fidelity SiMOS spin qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“demonstrate”、“characterize”、“reveals”等实验操作和结果，并提及了具体的制造工艺（EUV光刻）和测量手段（门组断层扫描GST）。；研究对象：基于硅金属-氧化物-半导体（SiMOS）量子点的自旋量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用极紫外（EUV）光刻技术在300毫米半导体试产线上成功制造出高性能SiMOS自旋量子比特，其单比特门保真度高达99.9%，两比特门保真度高达99.1%，证明了EUV光刻是实现大规模硅量子处理器的可行制造技术。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用极紫外（EUV）光刻技术在300毫米半导体试产线上成功制造出高性能SiMOS自旋量子比特，其单比特门保真度高达99.9%，两比特门保真度高达99.1%，证明了EUV光刻是实现大规模硅量子处理器的可行制造技术。；创新点：首次在300毫米半导体试产线上使用极紫外（EUV）光刻技术替代传统的电子束（e-beam）光刻来制造高性能硅自旋量子比特，解决了电子束光刻串行曝光导致的重复性差和难以晶圆级制造的问题，展示了EUV光刻在量子处理器制造中的可行性和优越的均匀性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，采用极紫外（EUV）光刻技术在300毫米半导体试产线上制造SiMOS量子点器件。通过室温栅-栅漏电流测试评估晶圆级均匀性，并利用门组断层扫描（GST）对四个双量子点系统进行量子门保真度表征。

papers.title: DeepCormack: Fermi surface tomography using model-based data-driven algorithms
papers.abstract: The experimental reconstruction of the 3D two-photon momentum density (TPMD) via angular correlation of electron-positron annihilation radiation (ACAR) is a particularly useful method for studying material Fermi surfaces. It does not rely on low temperatures, UHV conditions, or strong magnetic fields, and enables the study of the spin-resolved electronic structure of materials. Yet, it remains a challenging inverse problem. Typically, 10^8 positron annihilation events are measured for 3--6 projections of the TPMD at different angles. The standard reconstruction approach is an ACAR adaptation of Cormack's method (the MCM) that leverages the inherent symmetry in the crystal's structure. However, the poor signal-to-noise ratio means collecting data of sufficient quality for Fermi surface studies can take months per sample. We present DeepCormack, a family of data-driven model-based reconstruction algorithms that augments the MCM by integrating supervised deep-learning models (CNN, MLP, and UNet) at various stages. To overcome the lack of large experimental training sets, we propose a method which leverages singular value decomposition with dynamic mode decomposition to generate realistic synthetic TPMD volumes, requiring only a single reference momentum density computed via density functional theory. On test data, DeepCormack improves reconstruction quality over MCM by about 8.5 dB PSNR at 200M counts and remains stable at reduced counts, enabling significantly faster acquisition times. Generalisation to experimental data depends strongly on how well the training distribution from the reference momentum density matches the sample. We therefore recommend pairing DeepCormack with a DFT calculation of the target material to create sample-specific training data. Our proposed method offers either much higher quality reconstructions, or enables significantly faster ones, on the order of weeks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+理论）。判断依据：提出了数据驱动的深度学习重建算法（DeepCormack），并结合了密度泛函理论（DFT）生成合成训练数据，同时涉及实验数据重建的逆问题。；研究对象：材料费米面的三维双光子动量密度（TPMD）重建，具体通过正电子湮没辐射角关联（ACAR）实验技术实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DeepCormack算法在测试数据上相比标准Cormack方法（MCM）将重建质量提升约8.5 dB PSNR（在2亿计数下），并在低计数条件下保持稳定，从而将数据采集时间从数月缩短至数周量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DeepCormack算法在测试数据上相比标准Cormack方法（MCM）将重建质量提升约8.5 dB PSNR（在2亿计数下），并在低计数条件下保持稳定，从而将数据采集时间从数月缩短至数周量级。；创新点：提出了一种无需大量实验训练集的方法，通过SVD+DMD从单个DFT参考动量密度生成合成训练数据，并针对目标材料推荐结合DFT计算生成样本特异性训练数据，从而提升对实验数据的泛化能力。
papers.method_zh: 采用模型驱动的数据驱动算法，将监督式深度学习模型（CNN、MLP、UNet）集成到ACAR适配的Cormack方法（MCM）中；利用奇异值分解（SVD）结合动态模态分解（DMD）生成逼真的合成TPDM体积数据，仅需一个通过密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的参考动量密度作为训练基础。

papers.title: Cooper pairing with the onsite exchange interaction: A possible mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity
papers.abstract: Among the various mechanisms proposed for unconventional superconductivity, this paper focuses on the Coulomb interaction responsible for $d$-wave and $s\pm$-wave pairing symmetries in cuprates and iron pnictides. Although the effective interaction $U_\text{eff}=U-J$ is predominantly repulsive, an attractive component arising from the Hund's coupling parameter $J$ is sufficient to bind fractional charges. Evaluating this binding energy within a single-band Hubbard model yields a superconducting pairing gap $Δ_0$ and estimates the transition temperature $T_c$. Given the complex electronic structure and vast compositional space of these materials, the model focuses exclusively on the doped superconducting plane hosting these fractional charges. Through this approach, an analytical expression dependent on the Hubbard $U$ and Hund $J$ parameters that accurately reproduces the superconducting dome is derived. Furthermore, the model successfully addresses the characteristic electron and hole doping asymmetry observed in cuprates by accounting for Hund's coupling parameters. Finally, while the theory accurately describes strange metal behavior, it currently provides only a qualitative explanation for the pseudogap phase and the underdoped isotope effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“focuses on”、“evaluating”、“derived”、“model”。；研究对象：铜氧化物和铁基超导体中的高温超导配对机制，具体聚焦于掺杂超导平面内的分数电荷及其配对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于局域交换相互作用（Hund耦合参数J）的库仑配对机制：尽管有效相互作用U_eff=U-J总体是排斥的，但Hund耦合J提供的吸引分量足以束缚分数电荷，从而产生超导配对。该模型导出的解析表达式能准确再现超导穹顶，并解释了铜氧化物中电子与空穴掺杂的不对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于局域交换相互作用（Hund耦合参数J）的库仑配对机制：尽管有效相互作用U_eff=U-J总体是排斥的，但Hund耦合J提供的吸引分量足以束缚分数电荷，从而产生超导配对。该模型导出的解析表达式能准确再现超导穹顶，并解释了铜氧化物中电子与空穴掺杂的不对称性。；创新点：将Hund耦合J作为超导配对的吸引来源，并以此解释了铜氧化物中电子/空穴掺杂不对称性；同时给出了能准确再现超导穹顶的解析表达式。摘要未突出说明与已有Hund耦合相关理论（如Hund金属理论）的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 采用单带Hubbard模型，通过考虑Hubbard U和Hund J参数，计算分数电荷的束缚能，进而得到超导配对能隙Δ0并估算转变温度Tc。模型仅聚焦于承载分数电荷的掺杂超导平面。

papers.title: Sail membranes for optomechanical accelerometry
papers.abstract: Strained membrane resonators have emerged as a promising platform for optomechanical accelerometry; however, the desired combination of low frequency and high $Q$-mass product requires a rethinking of their dissipation dilution engineering. Applying Bayesian optimization to a Si$_3$N$_4$ membrane, we discover a class of sail-like trampoline resonators in which the frequency is decreased by an order of magnitude while preserving the $Q$-mass product. We demonstrate centimeter-scale sails with kHz frequencies, $Q\sim10^7$ and $Q\times\text{mass}\sim$ 10 g. Vertically integrating a 7 kHz device with a nanoribbon, we realize a monolithic cavity optomechanical accelerometer with a room temperature thermal noise of $40\;\text{n}g_0/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$, sufficient to resolve $μg_0/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$ ambient vibration over a bandwidth of 4 kHz with a displacement imprecision of $10^{-14}\;\text{m}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$. Cryogenic arrays of sail membranes may be attractive for new physics searches and distributed quantum sensing experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体实验实现（demonstrate、realize、measurements），包括器件制备、性能测试和噪声测量。；研究对象：基于Si₃N₄薄膜的帆状蹦床谐振器（sail-like trampoline resonators），用于光机械加速度计（optomechanical accelerometry）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过贝叶斯优化设计，发现了一类帆状蹦床谐振器，在保持高品质因子-质量乘积（Q×mass）的同时，将谐振频率降低了一个数量级；基于此实现了室温热噪声为40 ng₀/√Hz的集成光机械加速度计，可分辨μg₀/√Hz量级的环境振动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过贝叶斯优化设计，发现了一类帆状蹦床谐振器，在保持高品质因子-质量乘积（Q×mass）的同时，将谐振频率降低了一个数量级；基于此实现了室温热噪声为40 ng₀/√Hz的集成光机械加速度计，可分辨μg₀/√Hz量级的环境振动。；创新点：提出并实现了“帆状”蹦床谐振器结构，打破了低频与高Q×mass乘积之间的传统设计限制，显著提升了光机械加速度计的性能。摘要未突出说明与已有蹦床谐振器设计的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯优化（Bayesian optimization）对Si₃N₄薄膜进行结构设计；制备厘米尺度、千赫兹频率的帆状谐振器；通过垂直集成7 kHz器件与纳米带（nanoribbon），构建单片腔光机械加速度计（monolithic cavity optomechanical accelerometer）；测量品质因子Q~10⁷、Q×mass~10 g、位移不精确度10⁻¹⁴ m/√Hz。

papers.title: Cluster-configurational study of G-center in Silicon
papers.abstract: Understanding the properties of defects is imperative for proper use for variety of applications including quantum computing. In this paper, we use the multiconfigurational self consistent field (MCSCF) combined with DFT optimized geometry in order to investigate the spin and optical properties of G centers in Silicon. By utilizing quantum chemistry based methods, we show excellent agreement with the Zero Phonon Line and Zero Field Splitting Tensor components of the G center. We also calculate the theoretical spin decoherence time of the G centers using Cluster Correlation Expansion (CCE) methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“multiconfigurational self consistent field (MCSCF)”、“DFT optimized geometry”、“Cluster Correlation Expansion (CCE)”等计算方法。；研究对象：硅材料中的G中心缺陷（G-center in Silicon），具体研究其自旋和光学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多组态自洽场（MCSCF）结合DFT优化几何的方法，计算得到的G中心的零声子线（Zero Phonon Line）和零场分裂张量（Zero Field Splitting Tensor）分量与实验值高度吻合；同时利用团簇关联展开（CCE）方法计算了G中心的理论自旋退相干时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多组态自洽场（MCSCF）结合DFT优化几何的方法，计算得到的G中心的零声子线（Zero Phonon Line）和零场分裂张量（Zero Field Splitting Tensor）分量与实验值高度吻合；同时利用团簇关联展开（CCE）方法计算了G中心的理论自旋退相干时间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用多组态自洽场（MCSCF）方法结合密度泛函理论（DFT）优化几何结构，并利用团簇关联展开（CCE）方法计算自旋退相干时间。

papers.title: Acoustic Firewalls: Analogue Gravity Perspective on the AMPS Paradox
papers.abstract: The monogamy of quantum entanglement, applied by Almheiri-Marolf-Polchinski-Sully (AMPS) to black holes, obstructs a smooth horizon vacuum after the Page time. We transcribe this argument to Hawking-like phonon radiation from a sonic horizon in the Unruh acoustic metric. An exact purity identity shows that post-Page-time unitarity forces the entanglement between an outgoing phonon and its interior partner to vanish, selecting a non-Hadamard (Boulware-like) phonon state, which we define as an acoustic firewall. Its renormalized stress tensor differs from the smooth state by a constant, negative near-horizon flux, and the thermal-atmosphere energy density it removes, measured by a static calorimeter, grows as $(δr)^{-2}$ in the radial coordinate toward the horizon (singular in the free-fall frame), cut off at the healing length. The construction is kinematic and does not resolve the information paradox; it yields one concrete, falsifiable prediction: a differential phonon-calorimetry signal $\mathcal{R}(δr)=|Δ\mathcal{E}|/\mathcal{E}^{(0)}\to(\ell_κ/δr)^{2}$, present only after the analogue Page time in a Bose-Einstein condensate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analogue gravity perspective、transcribe this argument、construction is kinematic。；研究对象：声学黑洞（sonic horizon）中类似霍金辐射的声子辐射，以及类比于AMPS悖论的“声学火墙”现象，具体体系为玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在类比Page时间之后，声学黑洞的幺正性迫使出射声子与其内部伙伴粒子之间的纠缠消失，从而选择一种非Hadamard（类似Boulware态）的声子态，即“声学火墙”。该火墙的归一化应力张量与平滑态相差一个常数负的近地平通量，且其移除的热大气能量密度在径向坐标上以(δr)^{-2}发散（在自由落体参考系中奇异），并在愈合长度处截断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在类比Page时间之后，声学黑洞的幺正性迫使出射声子与其内部伙伴粒子之间的纠缠消失，从而选择一种非Hadamard（类似Boulware态）的声子态，即“声学火墙”。该火墙的归一化应力张量与平滑态相差一个常数负的近地平通量，且其移除的热大气能量密度在径向坐标上以(δr)^{-2}发散（在自由落体参考系中奇异），并在愈合长度处截断。；创新点：首次将AMPS火墙悖论从引力系统映射到凝聚态类比系统（声学黑洞），并给出了一个可证伪的微分声子量热学信号预言：ℛ(δr)=|Δℰ|/ℰ^{(0)}→(ℓ_κ/δr)^2，该信号仅在类比Page时间后出现于玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中。摘要未突出说明该工作是否解决了信息悖论，明确表示其构造是运动学的，不解决信息悖论。
papers.method_zh: 基于Unruh声学度规，将AMPS关于黑洞纠缠单配性的论证转录到声学黑洞的声子辐射中，通过精确纯度恒等式分析Page时间后的幺正性约束，并计算重正化应力张量及静态量热计测量的能量密度。

papers.title: Dynamics of a microroller under confinement
papers.abstract: Rotating particles can translate when placed near a surface, forming microrollers with a wide range of biomedical and microfluidic applications. In this work, we investigate the dynamics of microrollers in confined microchannels with different geometries by combining experiments, numerical simulations, and scaling analysis. In constricted channels, we find that the translational velocity of a microroller decreases as it approaches the constricted region. In both rectangular and cylindrical channels, velocity reversal occurs as the characteristic channel width decreases. Using the force-free condition for free translation, we develop a systematic scaling framework that can be generalized to different channel geometries. The scaling analysis yields functional dependences of the translational velocity on the degree of confinement, which agree well with both experiments and simulations. Importantly, we demonstrate that the viscous stress generated by the far-field rotlet flow governs the observed velocity reduction and reversal, while the translational resistance resulting from the near-field shear flow suppresses translation under tight confinement. The distinct roles of these flow components revealed by our analysis may provide practical guidance for controlling microroller dynamics in confined fluid environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验、数值模拟与标度分析相结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combining experiments, numerical simulations, and scaling analysis”。；研究对象：受限微通道中微滚轮（microroller）的动力学行为，具体涉及矩形和圆柱形通道中的运动，以及收缩通道中的速度变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微滚轮在受限通道中靠近收缩区域时平移速度下降，且当特征通道宽度减小时会发生速度反转；远场旋转流（rotlet flow）产生的粘性应力主导了速度的降低与反转，而近场剪切流产生的平移阻力则抑制了强受限下的平移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微滚轮在受限通道中靠近收缩区域时平移速度下降，且当特征通道宽度减小时会发生速度反转；远场旋转流（rotlet flow）产生的粘性应力主导了速度的降低与反转，而近场剪切流产生的平移阻力则抑制了强受限下的平移。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验观测、数值模拟、以及基于自由平移无净力条件（force-free condition）的系统标度分析框架。

papers.title: Temporal Entanglement from Twist Correlators in 2d Conformal Field Theory and Holography
papers.abstract: We formulate timelike entanglement entropy and its Rényi extension in two-dimensional conformal field theory through the analytic continuation of replica twist correlators to time-ordered, timelike-separated insertions. This field-theoretic construction grounds and generalizes recent developments, and applies to temporal subregions of arbitrary extent. Within three-dimensional holography, the semiclassical boundary correlator identifies boundary-anchored complex geodesics as the relevant bulk saddles and selects the one with the smallest real part of the length. This provides a direct boundary derivation of the proposed complex extremal surface prescription and extends to Rényi index $n>1$, for which we explicitly construct the corresponding complex cosmic brane geometry in the vacuum. We develop these ideas in several representative settings, including locally and globally excited states and quantum operator quenches, making manifest the precise agreement between boundary twist correlator and bulk complex geodesic calculations. For AdS-Vaidya, our approach predicts a different result from earlier piecewise geodesic constructions, while reproducing the field theory answer. Across these examples, the operator ordering uniquely determines the imaginary part of the complex-valued entropy, which is quantized in units of $cπ/6$ and sensitive to the effective causal structure but not to the underlying dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：conformal field theory, holography, analytic continuation, twist correlators。；研究对象：二维共形场论中的类时间纠缠熵及其Rényi推广，以及其在三维全息对偶中的实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过复制扭曲关联函数在时序、类时间隔插入下的解析延拓，系统构建了类时间纠缠熵的场论定义，并证明全息对偶中边界扭曲关联函数选择具有最小实部长度的复测地线作为主导鞍点，从而直接推导出复极值曲面方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过复制扭曲关联函数在时序、类时间隔插入下的解析延拓，系统构建了类时间纠缠熵的场论定义，并证明全息对偶中边界扭曲关联函数选择具有最小实部长度的复测地线作为主导鞍点，从而直接推导出复极值曲面方案。；创新点：首次从边界场论角度直接推导了全息复极值曲面方案，并将其推广到Rényi指数n>1；在AdS-Vaidya背景下，该方法预测了与早期分段测地线构造不同的结果，但复现了场论答案；揭示了算符排序对复熵虚部的决定性作用，该虚部以cπ/6为量子化单位，仅依赖于有效因果结构而非动力学细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维共形场论中的复制扭曲关联函数解析延拓方法，结合三维全息对偶中的半经典边界关联函数计算，并构造了真空中的复宇宙弦几何。具体应用包括局域/全局激发态和量子算符淬火等模型。

papers.title: Activity Regeneration from Silent States in Neuronal Networks with Transient Synaptic Memory
papers.abstract: Transient synaptic memory has emerged as a potential mechanism for maintaining short-term information even in the absence of persistent neuronal activity. However, it remains unclear whether the hidden synaptic state alone contains sufficient information to predict the future evolution of neuronal networks after activity has ceased. Here, we introduce a minimal neuronal network model with finite-lifetime synapses and investigate the mechanism underlying spontaneous activity regeneration following complete neuronal silence. We show that the residual synaptic configuration at the first silent state already determines whether network activity terminates after a single activation cycle or spontaneously regenerates an additional cycle. By analyzing this synaptic-memory snapshot, we identify the Latent Excitatory Recruitment (LER) capacity, quantified by the cumulative number of fresh excitatory neurons, as a near-perfect predictor of multi-cycle dynamics without continuing the subsequent network simulation. Remarkably, these distinct dynamical outcomes emerge in an otherwise homogeneous neuronal network, demonstrating that transient synaptic memory alone is sufficient to generate diverse future dynamics. Our findings provide a mechanistic explanation for activity regeneration from a residual synaptic state and suggest that short-term memory is encoded not only in ongoing neuronal activity but also in the latent synaptic configuration that preserves the network's capacity to recruit new neuronal assemblies. More broadly, the proposed snapshot-based framework offers a new perspective for predicting and potentially controlling the future evolution of neuronal networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“introduce a minimal neuronal network model”、“investigate the mechanism”、“analyzing this synaptic-memory snapshot”。；研究对象：具有瞬态突触记忆的神经元网络中的自发活动再生现象。具体体系为：一个具有有限寿命突触的最小神经元网络模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在神经元网络完全静默后的第一个静息态，残留的突触配置（特别是“潜在兴奋性招募”容量）已能近乎完美地预测网络是否会自发再生出额外的活动周期，而无需继续模拟后续网络演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在神经元网络完全静默后的第一个静息态，残留的突触配置（特别是“潜在兴奋性招募”容量）已能近乎完美地预测网络是否会自发再生出额外的活动周期，而无需继续模拟后续网络演化。；创新点：揭示了瞬态突触记忆本身（而非持续神经元活动）足以产生多样化的未来动力学，并提出了基于突触状态快照的框架，用于预测和潜在控制神经元网络的未来演化。摘要未突出说明与已有模型或理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个具有有限寿命突触的最小神经元网络模型，通过分析第一个静息态时的突触记忆快照，定义并量化了“潜在兴奋性招募”（LER）容量（即新鲜兴奋性神经元的累积数量），并以此作为多周期动力学的预测指标。

papers.title: Magneto-optical hologram lens with microsecond focal switching in magnetic garnet
papers.abstract: Active lenses based on metasurfaces have been demonstrated across broad applications, and their response speeds remain limited to the microsecond range. Here we report the experimental demonstration of a magneto-optical (MO) active lens based on a magnetic hologram formed on a magnetic garnet film. A Fresnel zone plate pattern was created using an array of permanent magnets, focusing a 633 nm laser beam of 12.5 mm diameter to a spot size of 0.7 mm at a focal length of 3.1 m with a modulation depth of ~91%. The focusing state was reversibly switched by applying an external magnetic field pulse. Through optimization of the magnetic field application system, a switching speed of 10.8 $μ$s was achieved, surpassing the operating speeds of conventional active lenses. The intrinsic picosecond-scale response of the MO effect indicates that further improvement in switching speed is achievable, establishing this work as a proof-of-concept for ultra-fast active lenses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“experimental demonstration”、“achieved”、“was created”。；研究对象：基于磁性石榴石薄膜（magnetic garnet film）的磁光（MO）主动透镜，具体为一种磁光全息透镜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验实现了一种基于磁光效应的主动透镜，其聚焦状态可通过外部磁场脉冲进行可逆切换，并实现了10.8微秒的开关速度，超越了传统主动透镜的工作速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验实现了一种基于磁光效应的主动透镜，其聚焦状态可通过外部磁场脉冲进行可逆切换，并实现了10.8微秒的开关速度，超越了传统主动透镜的工作速度。；创新点：首次实验演示了基于磁光全息图的主动透镜，并实现了微秒级的聚焦切换速度。摘要指出，磁光效应固有的皮秒级响应表明该工作为超快主动透镜提供了概念验证。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，利用永磁体阵列在磁性石榴石薄膜上创建菲涅尔波带片图案，形成磁光全息透镜。使用633 nm激光进行聚焦测试，并通过施加外部磁场脉冲来切换聚焦状态，优化磁场施加系统以测量开关速度。

papers.title: Confinement effects on protein stability in a freezing water environment
papers.abstract: Understanding how proteins behave at low temperatures remains a central challenge in biophysics, with direct implications for cold denaturation and cryopreservation. While cold denaturation of proteins in the supercooled liquid regime has been studied extensively, the behavior of a protein embedded in a growing ice lattice remains largely inaccessible to experiments. Here we use molecular dynamics simulations that explicitly capture ice Ih formation to characterize the conformational dynamics of yeast frataxin (Yfh1) as its aqueous environment crystallizes. Using four independent ice-seeded replicas and liquid-water controls at three temperatures, we first validate the liquid-solid transition through convergent changes in solvent density, potential energy, and local bond-order parameters (W4, W6). Principal component analysis (PCA), dihedral PCA (dPCA), and free-energy landscapes then reveal that crystallization of the solvent markedly reshapes the accessible conformational space, shifting it from a continuous, highly connected regime in liquid water toward a discretized landscape dominated by confined states. Complementary analyses of solvent-accessible surface area (SASA), radius of gyration, and hydrogen bonding indicate a solvent-driven reorganization of protein-water interactions: although first-shell water remains liquid-like, its surface density increases under freezing, while conformational sampling contracts. Together, these results indicate that protein behavior at low temperatures is governed not by temperature alone but by the structural organization of the surrounding water. By imposing geometrical constraints on the solvent, ice formation restricts conformational sampling while preserving -- and even densifying -- the interfacial hydration layer, highlighting the role of water structure as a determinant of protein stability under freezing conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）、explicitly capture ice Ih formation（明确捕捉冰Ih形成）、ice-seeded replicas（冰晶种子副本）。；研究对象：蛋白质在冻结水环境中的稳定性，具体体系为酵母frataxin（Yfh1）蛋白在冰晶（冰Ih）生长过程中的构象动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 冰晶的形成通过几何约束重塑了蛋白质的构象空间，使其从液态水中的连续、高度连通状态转变为离散化的受限状态；蛋白质在低温下的行为不仅取决于温度，更取决于周围水的结构组织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：冰晶的形成通过几何约束重塑了蛋白质的构象空间，使其从液态水中的连续、高度连通状态转变为离散化的受限状态；蛋白质在低温下的行为不仅取决于温度，更取决于周围水的结构组织。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟，明确模拟冰Ih的形成过程；使用四个独立的冰晶种子副本和液态水对照（三个温度）；通过溶剂密度、势能、局域键序参数（W4, W6）验证液-固转变；采用主成分分析（PCA）、二面角主成分分析（dPCA）和自由能景观分析构象空间；辅以溶剂可及表面积（SASA）、回转半径和氢键分析。

papers.title: Condition for $1/f$ noise to occur along with an example for a diffusion equation
papers.abstract: While $1/f$ noise is ubiquitous and has been found in various systems, its physics remains uncertain. From an analytical study of an ordinary diffusion equation, we find an additional example of the $1/f$ noise. The formula for this example, together with existing knowledge about scaling in fluid turbulence, implies a necessary and sufficient condition for the occurrence of any stationary $1/f$ noise. That is, the noise needs to be characterized by two constant frequencies of $f_{\rm low} \ll f_{\rm high}$. For a frequency range from $f = f_{\rm low}$ to $f_{\rm high}$, it is further needed that, except for the mean amplitude of the noise, there is no other constant parameter. Then, at $f_{\rm low} \ll f \ll f_{\rm high}$, the noise scales asymptotically as $1/f$. Being statistical and simple, our condition applies to any system and hence explains the ubiquity of the $1/f$ noise. It is also applicable to some systems with noise of $α\ne 1.0$ for $1/f^α$, via intermittency analogous to that of the turbulence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytical study”（解析研究）、“necessary and sufficient condition”（充要条件）、“scaling”（标度律）等理论分析关键词。；研究对象：1/f 噪声（粉红噪声）的普适发生条件，以及一个基于普通扩散方程的具体例子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了任意稳态1/f噪声发生的充要条件：噪声需由两个恒定频率f_low和f_high（f_low ≪ f_high）刻画，且在f_low到f_high的频率范围内，除噪声的平均振幅外无其他恒定参数；此时在f_low ≪ f ≪ f_high区间，噪声渐近标度为1/f。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了任意稳态1/f噪声发生的充要条件：噪声需由两个恒定频率f_low和f_high（f_low ≪ f_high）刻画，且在f_low到f_high的频率范围内，除噪声的平均振幅外无其他恒定参数；此时在f_low ≪ f ≪ f_high区间，噪声渐近标度为1/f。；创新点：给出了一个基于扩散方程的1/f噪声新例子，并提出了一个统计性、简单且适用于任意系统的充要条件，从而解释了1/f噪声的普适性；该条件还可通过间歇性（类似湍流）推广到1/f^α（α≠1.0）的噪声。
papers.method_zh: 对普通扩散方程进行解析研究，并结合流体湍流中已知的标度律知识进行类比推理。

papers.title: A Showcase of Using the Partial-Structure R1 to Assemble Small-Molecule Crystal Structures
papers.abstract: Using a few concrete examples this paper has demonstrated a few observations on using the partial-structure R1 (pR1) to assemble small-molecule crystal structures. (1) Assembling can start with orienting and/or placing large fragments or small fragments containing heavy atom(s). (2) It is handy to attach a fragment to a partial model as only the orientation needs to be optimized. (3) In a structure containing heavy atoms it is impossible to directly calculate the orientations of a light-atom-only fragment. Instead, it is necessary to use residual reflection intensities in which the contribution of the partial model containing all heavy atoms is deducted away. These observations indicate that pR1 is a useful tool for solving some small-molecule crystal structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验/方法文章。关键词：partial-structure R1 (pR1)、assembling small-molecule crystal structures、concrete examples。；研究对象：小分子晶体结构，具体涉及含有重原子和轻原子碎片的晶体结构组装过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用部分结构R1因子（pR1）可以有效地辅助小分子晶体结构的组装，尤其适用于含有重原子的体系，通过扣除重原子贡献后的残余衍射强度来计算轻原子碎片的方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用部分结构R1因子（pR1）可以有效地辅助小分子晶体结构的组装，尤其适用于含有重原子的体系，通过扣除重原子贡献后的残余衍射强度来计算轻原子碎片的方向。；创新点：系统展示了pR1在解决小分子晶体结构中的实用技巧，特别是针对含重原子体系中轻原子碎片方向无法直接计算的问题，提出了使用残余反射强度扣除重原子贡献的解决方案。
papers.method_zh: 基于部分结构R1因子（pR1）的结构组装方法，通过具体实例演示了如何从大碎片或含重原子的小碎片开始定向/放置，以及如何通过仅优化取向将碎片附加到部分模型上。

papers.title: Wireless millikelvin interconnects for superconducting quantum hardware
papers.abstract: Scalable quantum computing is limited by the dense network of electrical interconnects linking cryogenic quantum processors to room-temperature control electronics. To overcome this bottleneck, considerable effort has focused on cryogenic CMOS electronics and microwave-to-optical transduction, aiming to reduce wiring complexity and thermal loading. Wireless interconnects have recently emerged as a promising complementary approach, yet their compatibility with superconducting quantum hardware remains largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate the wireless excitation of a superconducting microwave resonator of the type routinely employed for qubit readout, operating at millikelvin temperatures inside a dilution refrigerator. By directly comparing wired and wireless operation within the same cryogenic environment, we show that wireless coupling preserves the intrinsic resonator response while revealing parasitic electromagnetic pathways arising from stray radiation within the cryostat enclosure. These results establish a framework for the co-design of wireless interconnects, cryogenic packaging and superconducting quantum hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、directly comparing wired and wireless operation、cryogenic environment。；研究对象：超导量子硬件中的无线互连技术，具体为工作在稀释制冷机毫开尔文温度下的超导微波谐振器（用于量子比特读取）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无线耦合方式能够保持超导微波谐振器的本征响应特性，同时揭示了低温恒温器内由杂散辐射引起的寄生电磁路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无线耦合方式能够保持超导微波谐振器的本征响应特性，同时揭示了低温恒温器内由杂散辐射引起的寄生电磁路径。；创新点：首次在毫开尔文温度下实验验证了无线互连与超导量子硬件的兼容性，并建立了无线互连、低温封装与超导量子硬件协同设计的框架。
papers.method_zh: 在稀释制冷机内同时进行有线与无线两种方式的直接对比实验，通过测量超导微波谐振器的响应来评估无线互连的性能。

papers.title: Microstructure-Conditioned Surrogate Models for Graded Multiscale Optimization of Mycelium Composites
papers.abstract: Emerging sustainable materials increasingly rely on engineered hierarchy and microstructure to achieve control of their properties and mechanical behavior. Optimizing these materials with controllable microstructures requires efficient multiscale simulations. Data-driven surrogate models for the microscale can accelerate multiscale simulations, but require large amounts of data even for a fixed microstructure. When a range of microstructures is considered, as is the case in multiscale optimization, even more data is needed to train a surrogate. To overcome this challenge, we condition a hybrid physics-data surrogate on microstructural variables using a hypernetwork. This approach enables accurate predictions of multiscale mechanical behavior for a mycelium-woodchip composite material, even when trained on small datasets. The conditioned surrogate makes multiscale simulations of functionally graded structures tractable, and we validate it against a full FE^2 simulation. We optimize a graded multiscale disk, and reduce the peak stress by 42% compared to one with a random microstructure. Then, we go one step further, conditioning the network directly on manufacturing variables that can have a complex influence on the microstructure. This is a practical route to engineer the microscale for desired macroscale behavior. This contribution highlights the benefits of microarchitectured structures and demonstrates how conditioned surrogate models enable their multiscale optimization, which will accelerate the development and design of future sustainable materials and structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：data-driven surrogate models、multiscale simulations、FE² simulation、optimization）；研究对象：菌丝-木屑复合材料（mycelium-woodchip composite material），一种具有可控微观结构的可持续材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将混合物理-数据代理模型（surrogate model）条件化于微观结构变量，可以在小训练数据集下准确预测多尺度力学行为，并实现对功能梯度结构的多尺度优化，将峰值应力降低42%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将混合物理-数据代理模型（surrogate model）条件化于微观结构变量，可以在小训练数据集下准确预测多尺度力学行为，并实现对功能梯度结构的多尺度优化，将峰值应力降低42%。；创新点：提出了一种条件化代理模型方法，使多尺度优化中只需少量数据即可处理不同微观结构，并进一步将网络条件化于制造变量，为通过微观结构工程实现目标宏观性能提供了实用路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用超网络（hypernetwork）将混合物理-数据代理模型条件化于微观结构变量；使用全FE²模拟（full FE² simulation）作为验证基准；通过多尺度优化对梯度圆盘进行设计。

papers.title: Imprinting topology on thermal light
papers.abstract: Topological structuring of light inevitably leverages on optical coherence to ensure that the imparted spatial phases are preserved, requiring highly coherent sources or coherence engineering embedded in the design. Now we show that thermal light can be spatially engineered to carry optical topologies in the form of Skyrmions. Such topologies are immune to time averaged decoherence, a fact we leverage on in reverse to create metasurface mediated incoherent topologies from a thermal source. The pristine nature of our measured Skyrmions validates the approach, while simulations reveal how coherence management in the metasurface design would further enhance the functionality. Remarkably, the generation stage inherits robustness from the topology, remaining immune to material and fabrication defects. Our work reports the first topologies from purely thermal light, opening a path to exploiting topology in ubiquitous everyday light sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含仿真模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“measured Skyrmions”“simulations reveal”，表明有实验测量和仿真验证。；研究对象：热光（thermal light）的空间拓扑结构，具体为在热光源中实现光学斯格明子（Skyrmions）的拓扑结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次证明热光可以被空间工程化以携带光学拓扑（斯格明子），且该拓扑结构对时间平均退相干具有免疫性；拓扑结构在生成阶段对材料和制造缺陷具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次证明热光可以被空间工程化以携带光学拓扑（斯格明子），且该拓扑结构对时间平均退相干具有免疫性；拓扑结构在生成阶段对材料和制造缺陷具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次在纯热光中实现拓扑结构，突破了以往认为拓扑光结构必须依赖高相干光源或相干性工程的限制，为利用日常热光源中的拓扑特性开辟了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超表面（metasurface）介导的方式，从热光源产生非相干拓扑结构；同时结合仿真模拟分析超表面设计中的相干性管理对功能性的影响。

papers.title: Deterministic single-electron trapping on solid neon using engineered dielectric surface geometry
papers.abstract: Levitating electron qubit on the surface of solid neon has recently emerged as a promising and intrinsically noise-resilient platform for quantum information processing. Their ultra-clean, inert environment suppresses conventional decoherence pathways associated with lattice disorder, charge traps, and nuclear-spin baths that limit coherence in semiconductor qubits. Yet, uncontrolled surface features such as bumps, valleys, and electrode-defined gaps can bind electrons unintentionally, contributing charge noise and inducing spin-orbit coupling mediated decoherence. To address this challenge, we propose an engineered interface in which a dielectric layer is deposited beneath the solid neon to provide an atomically smooth template, eliminating surface-roughness induced trapping. By selectively etching this dielectric layer at desired qubit locations, deterministic potential minima can be engineered to reliably capture electrons while suppressing unwanted surface bound states. We perform large-scale Schrodinger and Poisson simulation to compare the existing and proposed strategies of electron trapping on neon, obtaining good agreement with recent experimental measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：large-scale Schrodinger and Poisson simulation、propose、simulation）；研究对象：基于固态氖表面悬浮电子量子比特的介电表面工程结构，具体为通过介电层刻蚀实现确定性单电子俘获的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在固态氖下方沉积原子级平滑的介电层并选择性刻蚀，可工程化确定性势能最小值，可靠俘获电子并抑制由表面粗糙度引起的非故意束缚态，从而降低电荷噪声和自旋-轨道耦合导致的退相干。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在固态氖下方沉积原子级平滑的介电层并选择性刻蚀，可工程化确定性势能最小值，可靠俘获电子并抑制由表面粗糙度引起的非故意束缚态，从而降低电荷噪声和自旋-轨道耦合导致的退相干。；创新点：提出在固态氖下方引入工程化介电层界面，通过刻蚀形成确定性势阱，替代传统依赖表面随机特征或电极间隙的电子俘获方式，从根本上消除表面粗糙度诱导的寄生束缚态。
papers.method_zh: 大规模薛定谔-泊松方程联合模拟（large-scale Schrodinger and Poisson simulation），对比现有与提出的电子俘获策略，并与近期实验测量结果进行比对验证。

papers.title: Robust topological oscillators govern a tunable phase transition to synchronized circadian rhythms
papers.abstract: While synchronization has been well-studied in deterministic oscillators, most underlying oscillators are stochastic in both natural and man-made systems. Yet, the effects of intrinsic stochasticity remain poorly understood. Here, we develop a new mechanism for synchronizing circadian KaiC molecules that have topologically protected cycles. We find a phase transition to synchronization that depends only on the single-oscillator coherence, across a range of molecular changes that determine this coherence. Examining both mesoscopic and macroscopic numbers relevant for cellular and in vitro conditions respectively, we find different scaling properties above and below the phase transition. Our results shed light on several existing experiments and further predict that external changes can be offset by compensatory changes that improve the single-oscillator coherence - demonstrating a tunable pathway between stochastic single oscillators and their robust collective rhythms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a new mechanism、phase transition、scaling properties）；研究对象：随机振荡器（stochastic oscillators）的同步化相变，具体以生物钟KaiC分子为模型系统，研究其拓扑保护周期（topologically protected cycles）驱动的同步化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现随机单振荡器的相干性（single-oscillator coherence）是决定同步化相变的唯一控制参数，且相变前后具有不同的标度性质；外部扰动可通过补偿性变化（提高单振荡器相干性）被抵消，从而实现从随机单振荡器到鲁棒集体节律的可调路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现随机单振荡器的相干性（single-oscillator coherence）是决定同步化相变的唯一控制参数，且相变前后具有不同的标度性质；外部扰动可通过补偿性变化（提高单振荡器相干性）被抵消，从而实现从随机单振荡器到鲁棒集体节律的可调路径。；创新点：首次提出拓扑保护周期（topologically protected cycles）作为随机振荡器同步化的新机制，并揭示单振荡器相干性作为相变唯一控制参数的可调性，为解释现有实验及预测补偿性调控提供了统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值分析：构建具有拓扑保护周期的随机振荡器模型，分别针对介观（细胞尺度）和宏观（体外实验尺度）粒子数进行标度行为分析。

papers.title: Precision quantum simulation of magnon spectra and interactions
papers.abstract: Quantum simulation promises to advance materials discovery by accurately simulating complex states of matter, their microscopic excitations, and macroscopic response functions. The central challenge in resolving the underlying interacting dynamics is to combine high-fidelity evolution with the sophisticated control necessary to manipulate individual quasi-particles in quantum many-body states. Here, we report on high-precision simulation of both linear and non-linear response functions in a 2D XY spin-1/2 magnet using an analog-digital superconducting processor of up to 97 qubits. By interleaving digital gates with analog evolution precisely characterized via Hamiltonian learning, we selectively excite magnons at tunable energy densities. Measuring first the linear magnon response -- a central probe in neutron-scattering experiments -- we extract temperature-dependent spectra and lifetimes. Our results reveal stark variations in magnon decay rates across the Brillouin zone, with enhancement near van Hove singularities and suppression for edge-localized modes. Next, we perform a suite of nonlinear measurements, including the study of self-scattering mechanisms, as well as pump-probe spectroscopy to directly characterize the magnon interactions. While matrix-product state simulations capture the dynamics well in either small systems or at low temperatures, their predictions become inaccurate away from these limits. This work demonstrates precise simulation of the interacting dynamics in quantum magnets, and provides key insights into quasi-particles and their microscopic scattering mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：使用模拟-数字超导处理器进行实验，并结合哈密顿量学习、矩阵乘积态模拟等计算方法。；研究对象：二维XY自旋1/2磁体中的磁振子谱及其相互作用，具体为线性与非线性响应函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多达97个量子比特的超导处理器上，实现了对二维XY磁体中磁振子线性与非线性响应的高精度量子模拟，揭示了磁振子衰变率在布里渊区的显著变化（范霍夫奇点附近增强、边缘局域模抑制），并发现矩阵乘积态模拟在小系统或低温外会失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多达97个量子比特的超导处理器上，实现了对二维XY磁体中磁振子线性与非线性响应的高精度量子模拟，揭示了磁振子衰变率在布里渊区的显著变化（范霍夫奇点附近增强、边缘局域模抑制），并发现矩阵乘积态模拟在小系统或低温外会失效。；创新点：首次在超导量子处理器上同时实现了对磁振子线性与非线性响应的高精度量子模拟，并直接通过泵浦-探测光谱表征了磁振子相互作用，揭示了传统张量网络方法在特定条件下的不准确性。
papers.method_zh: 使用模拟-数字超导处理器（最多97个量子比特），通过数字门与经哈密顿量学习精确表征的模拟演化交替，选择性地激发可调能量密度的磁振子；测量线性磁振子响应（类似中子散射实验）提取温度依赖的谱与寿命；进行非线性测量（自散射机制、泵浦-探测光谱）表征磁振子相互作用；并与矩阵乘积态模拟结果对比。

papers.title: Towards stealthy hyperuniform networks with optimal isotropic complete photonic band gaps using a novel inverse design procedure
papers.abstract: We present a two-stage inverse design procedure for producing disordered stealthy hyperuniform trivalent photonic networks in two dimensions with isotropic complete photonic band gaps (PBGs) blocking light regardless of direction or polarization (TE or TM) over a wide frequency range. Most ordinary disordered systems fail to maintain complete PBGs as system size increases. The only known exceptions that remain open in the largest simulations have been generated by mapping stealthy hyperuniform point patterns into trivalent networks. However, the resulting networks are not truly stealthy hyperuniform two-phase media. Although their PBGs remain open, they are relatively narrow due to limited overlap between the TE and TM band gaps and broad band tails caused by localized defect states. By contrast, our two-stage inverse design aims to make the final network itself stealthy hyperuniform, achieving unprecedented near-optimal overlap between the TE and TM band gaps and a small defect state density at the band edges. We obtain not only single realizations with large PBGs, but a striking homogeneity across a large ensemble, effectively probing a network with 100,000 vertices. This ensemble-based band gap is comparable in width to the complete PBG of an anisotropic honeycomb photonic crystal with the same network parameters and nearly an order of magnitude wider than the previously widest known isotropic complete PBGs. Our designs can be fabricated using additive manufacturing, offering new pathways to manipulate electromagnetic waves for photonic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：inverse design procedure（逆设计方法）、simulations（模拟）、ensemble-based（基于系综的）。；研究对象：二维无序隐身超均匀三价光子网络，旨在实现各向同性完全光子带隙（PBG）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两阶段逆设计方法，首次使最终网络本身成为隐身超均匀两相介质，实现了TE与TM带隙的近最优重叠，并获得了比此前已知最宽各向同性完全PBG宽近一个数量级的带隙宽度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两阶段逆设计方法，首次使最终网络本身成为隐身超均匀两相介质，实现了TE与TM带隙的近最优重叠，并获得了比此前已知最宽各向同性完全PBG宽近一个数量级的带隙宽度。；创新点：不同于以往仅通过映射点图案得到非严格隐身超均匀的网络，本工作直接设计网络本身为隐身超均匀介质，从而显著提升TE/TM带隙重叠并抑制带边局域缺陷态，实现接近各向异性蜂窝光子晶体水平的各向同性完全PBG。
papers.method_zh: 两阶段逆设计程序：首先将隐身超均匀点图案映射为三价网络，再通过优化使最终网络本身满足隐身超均匀性，并利用系综平均（含100,000个顶点）评估带隙性能。

papers.title: Emulating XX catalysts for quantum annealing via self-consistent transverse fields
papers.abstract: Fully-connected transverse interactions have been considered as catalysts for quantum annealing that could mitigate exponentially small gaps and circumvent first-order phase transitions, but their experimental implementation remains challenging. In this work, we introduce a procedure for emulating their effects via a self-consistent transverse field. All that is required beyond conventional transverse-field annealing is the ability to make measurements in the transverse ($\hatσ^x$) basis. We show that this protocol yields identical dynamics in the large-system limit, and study the approach to that limit in numerical simulations of the (uniform) $p$-spin model. However, realizing the protocol in practice requires us to consider a series of approximate variants, each of whose errors we quantify and demonstrate can be made sufficiently small. Lastly, we show how to map the protocol onto annealing platforms that vary only a single control parameter. Even after the multiple stages of approximation, our procedure can generate dynamics that agree well with the original transverse-interaction catalyst, establishing self-consistent transverse fields as a viable alternative on near-term quantum annealers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：introduce a procedure, numerical simulations, mapping protocol）；研究对象：量子退火中的全连接横向相互作用催化剂，以及通过自洽横向场模拟其效应的方案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种通过自洽横向场模拟全连接横向相互作用催化剂效应的协议，在大量子系统极限下动力学与原始催化剂一致，且经过多阶段近似后仍能在近期量子退火机上实现良好匹配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种通过自洽横向场模拟全连接横向相互作用催化剂效应的协议，在大量子系统极限下动力学与原始催化剂一致，且经过多阶段近似后仍能在近期量子退火机上实现良好匹配。；创新点：首次提出利用自洽横向场替代难以实验实现的全连接横向相互作用催化剂，仅需在传统横向场退火基础上增加横向基矢测量能力，并系统量化了各近似阶段的误差可控性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟：在均匀p-自旋模型上进行数值模拟，研究有限系统趋近大系统极限的行为；通过测量横向（σ^x）基矢实现自洽场更新；将协议映射到仅调节单一控制参数的退火平台。

papers.title: Tensor-Network Finite Elements for Analytic Operator Equations
papers.abstract: Operator equations (OEs) underpin quantitative modeling across science and engineering. Finite-element (FE) methods discretize continuous OEs into finite-dimensional algebraic systems, whereas tensor networks (TNs) provide flexible variational representations of correlated discrete systems. Here, we develop a framework that connects FE with TN for analytic OEs. The power of this method comes from its ability to convert highly non-linear partial differential equations into linear matrix equations. In particular, we show that FE discretization induces a hierarchy of multilinear interaction tensors, through which differential, integral, nonlinear, memory, and delay equations can be expressed within a common algebraic structure. The resulting systems are reformulated as weighted-residual optimization problems over TN degrees of freedom. Matrix-product-state calculations for one-dimensional linear and nonlinear diffusion reproduce conventional solutions with controlled error while preserving continuity and Neumann boundary conditions. The framework provides a common variational language for analytic OEs and establishes a direct connection between FE numerical formalism and TN variational algorithms, offering a general foundation for TN-based and quantum-inspired approaches to solving OEs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a framework、reformulated as weighted-residual optimization problems、provides a common variational language。；研究对象：解析算子方程（Analytic Operator Equations），包括微分、积分、非线性、记忆和延迟方程等，具体示例为一维线性和非线性扩散方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限元离散化可诱导出多线性相互作用张量的层级结构，从而将高度非线性的偏微分方程转化为线性矩阵方程，并通过张量网络自由度上的加权残差优化问题统一求解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限元离散化可诱导出多线性相互作用张量的层级结构，从而将高度非线性的偏微分方程转化为线性矩阵方程，并通过张量网络自由度上的加权残差优化问题统一求解。；创新点：建立了有限元数值形式与张量网络变分算法之间的直接联系，为基于张量网络和量子启发的算子方程求解提供了通用基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将有限元（FE）方法与张量网络（TN）结合，利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）对一维线性和非线性扩散方程进行数值计算，并保持连续性及诺伊曼边界条件。

papers.title: Loophole-Robust Certification of Quantum Advantage
papers.abstract: Claims of quantum advantage should remain robust even when classical strategies have access to side information correlated with the benchmark under evaluation, just as Bell certification must account for measurement dependence. We formalize such correlations as benchmark dependence, a task-level generalization of measurement dependence. For every bounded-reward task, we show that the optimal benchmark-dependent classical score obeys $S_η\leq\min\{1,S_{\mathrm{cl}}+η\}$, and construct a family of tasks that saturates this bound, showing that the linear dependence on $η$ is tight without further assumptions. For repeated product tasks with roundwise dependence, we obtain the stronger multiplicative bound $S_η^{(n)}\leq(ω_{\mathrm c}+η)^n$, and extend the framework to finite-sample data, mutual-information constraints, multipartite tasks, and correlations distributed along a causal path. Applying these results to aggregated IBM hardware data, we obtain positive raw-count cycle-product certificates of 0.0812 for CHSH and 0.2178 for Mermin--GHZ, while the nine-context magic-square construction remains uncertified; readout-mitigated values are reported separately as sensitivity estimates. We also analyze a non-Bell quantum-kernel benchmark, where a label-construction variable has measured conditional dependence $\widehatη_λ^{(Y)}=0.5$, above the threshold $η_{\mathrm{req}}=0.375$, required to close the reported score gap, and yields perfect classical classification. The framework therefore converts a quantum--classical score separation into a quantitative lower bound on the benchmark-correlated classical information required to explain the score separation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数据分析）。判断依据：摘要主要进行形式化理论框架的构建与证明（如推导不等式、构造任务族），并应用该框架分析已有的IBM硬件数据。；研究对象：量子优势认证的鲁棒性问题。具体研究在经典策略可获取与基准测试相关的侧信息（即“基准依赖”）时，如何量化并认证量子优势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于有界奖励任务，最优的基准依赖经典分数满足线性上界 \(S_\eta \leq \min\{1, S_{\mathrm{cl}}+\eta\}\)，且该线性依赖是紧的。对于重复乘积任务，存在更强的乘法上界。该框架可将量子-经典分数差距转化为对解释该差距所需的基准相关经典信息量的定量下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于有界奖励任务，最优的基准依赖经典分数满足线性上界 \(S_\eta \leq \min\{1, S_{\mathrm{cl}}+\eta\}\)，且该线性依赖是紧的。对于重复乘积任务，存在更强的乘法上界。该框架可将量子-经典分数差距转化为对解释该差距所需的基准相关经典信息量的定量下界。；创新点：提出了“基准依赖”这一概念，将贝尔测试中的“测量依赖”推广到一般任务，并建立了从量子-经典分数差距到基准相关经典信息量下界的定量转化框架。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与形式化证明。具体包括：形式化定义“基准依赖”（benchmark dependence）作为测量依赖的任务级推广；推导最优基准依赖经典分数的上界（线性界与乘法界）；将框架扩展到有限样本数据、互信息约束、多体任务及因果路径相关分布等场景；应用该框架分析IBM硬件数据（CHSH、Mermin-GHZ、魔方构型）及一个非贝尔量子核基准测试。

papers.title: When is the combined load identifiable from a stress-intensity profile? A coupled forward-inverse study on SIFBench finite-element data
papers.abstract: This work studies the inverse problem of recovering the relative magnitudes of the tension, bending, and bearing loads acting on a crack from its stress-intensity-factor profile along the crack front, using the public SIFBench finite-element data. The central claim is not forensic load recovery on field cases, but a rigorous characterization of when the combined load is identifiable at all, together with an estimator that returns calibrated uncertainty precisely in the regimes where it is not. For a known geometry the forward map from loads to profile is exactly linear, and identifiability reduces to a single geometric question: whether the three elementary load profiles are linearly independent as functions along the front. When they are nearly dependent, many different load combinations produce almost the same profile and the inverse problem is illposed; the analysis shows that the degree of ill-posedness is controlled by an intrinsic stability margin, not by the conditioning number alone. A single crack-front operator serves both as a structured forward surrogate and as the differentiable map required by a simplex-constrained, set-valued inverse estimator. On the SIFBench corner-crack scenario the empirical behaviour matches the theory: the typical geometry is well posed while a sizable minority is genuinely ill-posed, so a point estimate is reliable on the majority and provably uninformative on the rest. Validation is on controlled synthetic noise; no real fracture cases are used or claimed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。关键词：inverse problem（反问题）、finite-element data（有限元数据）、forward map（正向映射）、identifiability（可辨识性）。；研究对象：裂纹在拉伸、弯曲和轴承载荷共同作用下的应力强度因子（SIF）沿裂纹前缘的分布，以及从该分布反推各载荷相对大小的可辨识性问题。具体体系为SIFBench有限元数据集中的角裂纹（corner-crack）几何构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当三种基本载荷的应力强度因子剖面沿裂纹前缘线性相关（或接近线性相关）时，反问题病态，不同载荷组合可产生几乎相同的剖面，此时点估计不可靠；而该病态程度由内在稳定性裕度（intrinsic stability margin）控制，而非仅由条件数决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当三种基本载荷的应力强度因子剖面沿裂纹前缘线性相关（或接近线性相关）时，反问题病态，不同载荷组合可产生几乎相同的剖面，此时点估计不可靠；而该病态程度由内在稳定性裕度（intrinsic stability margin）控制，而非仅由条件数决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于SIFBench公开有限元数据，构建从载荷到应力强度因子剖面的线性正向映射；通过分析三个基本载荷剖面的线性独立性来判定可辨识性；采用单纯形约束的集值反估计器（simplex-constrained, set-valued inverse estimator）进行反演，并输出校准后的不确定性。

papers.title: On multipoles, their decomposition by time-reversal symmetry, and the electric toroidal monopole
papers.abstract: The multipole decomposition of the single-site density matrix provides a symmetry-adapted representation of local electronic degrees of freedom. Conventional, so-called fixed-shell, formulations do not span the full local single-particle operator space, as only operators mapping within the same orbital $l$ are resolved. Here we construct a complete orthogonal basis of real Hermitian multipole operators for the local density matrix by extending the existing formulation to inter-shell operators. We revisit the multipole decomposition as a decomposition of the operator space by $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ by first decomposing the orbital and spin operator spaces. Then by coupling them we arrive at the spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ local single-particle operator space, staying consistent with the existing fixed-shell formulations. We then classify the multipoles by parity and time-reversal symmetry, which allows for unique identification of multipole moments of the density matrix that contribute to expectation values of fully symmetry-resolved observables. As an application, we analyze the two enantiomers of chiral trigonal tellurium by computing the electric toroidal monopole moment selected by symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：multipole decomposition、operator space、symmetry classification、theoretical framework。；研究对象：局域密度矩阵的多极展开，特别是扩展到壳间（inter-shell）算符的完整正交基，以及手性三角碲（trigonal tellurium）中的电环形单极矩（electric toroidal monopole moment）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将多极展开从固定壳层（fixed-shell）扩展到壳间算符，构建了局域单粒子算符空间的完整正交实厄米多极算符基，并利用宇称和时间反演对称性对多极矩进行分类，从而唯一识别密度矩阵中贡献于完全对称分辨可观测量期望值的多极矩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将多极展开从固定壳层（fixed-shell）扩展到壳间算符，构建了局域单粒子算符空间的完整正交实厄米多极算符基，并利用宇称和时间反演对称性对多极矩进行分类，从而唯一识别密度矩阵中贡献于完全对称分辨可观测量期望值的多极矩。；创新点：将传统固定壳层多极展开推广到包含壳间算符的完整基，并引入宇称和时间反演对称性分类，使得多极矩与完全对称分辨的物理可观测量之间建立唯一对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于SO(3)群表示论，先分解轨道和自旋算符空间，再耦合得到自旋1/2局域单粒子算符空间；利用宇称和时间反演对称性对多极矩进行分类；以手性三角碲的两个对映体为例，计算了对称性选择的电环形单极矩。

papers.title: Symmetry-Informed Deep Learning for Electromagnetic Scattering
papers.abstract: Deep learning can accelerate the modeling of electromagnetic devices by replacing costly simulations with neural networks trained to map design parameters to scattering parameters. However, data efficiency remains a central bottleneck, as training data is typically generated through expensive numerical simulations. Here we show that symmetry provides a powerful and largely untapped route to overcoming this limitation in electromagnetic scattering problems. Leveraging the equivariance of Maxwell's equations, we obtain general transformation rules that map symmetries of electromagnetic devices to corresponding transformations of their scattering parameters. This enables both systematic data augmentation and the construction of exactly equivariant neural networks. We implement the framework for both discrete and continuous symmetry groups and demonstrate its effectiveness on photonic-crystal slabs and free-form diffraction gratings. Incorporating symmetry improves data efficiency by an order of magnitude compared to standard architectures, while equivariant models additionally enforce physical constraints exactly. Our approach is general and complementary to existing physics-informed strategies, provides a first-principles framework for constructing physically grounded surrogate models, and establishes symmetry as a unifying inductive bias for data-efficient and physically consistent learning in computational electromagnetics and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：deep learning、neural networks、symmetry、data augmentation、equivariant models。；研究对象：电磁散射问题，具体包括光子晶体平板（photonic-crystal slabs）和自由形态衍射光栅（free-form diffraction gratings）中的散射参数（scattering parameters）建模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用麦克斯韦方程的等变性（equivariance），可以将电磁器件的对称性系统地映射为散射参数的变换规则，从而在深度学习中实现数据增强和构建严格等变的神经网络，将数据效率提升一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用麦克斯韦方程的等变性（equivariance），可以将电磁器件的对称性系统地映射为散射参数的变换规则，从而在深度学习中实现数据增强和构建严格等变的神经网络，将数据效率提升一个数量级。；创新点：将对称性作为统一的归纳偏置（inductive bias）引入电磁散射的深度学习建模，显著提升数据效率并强制满足物理约束，与现有物理信息驱动策略互补，为构建物理一致的代理模型提供了第一性原理框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性信息（symmetry-informed）的深度学习框架。具体包括：利用麦克斯韦方程的等变性推导出对称性变换规则；对离散和连续对称群分别实现数据增强（data augmentation）和构建严格等变的神经网络（exactly equivariant neural networks）；在光子晶体平板和自由形态衍射光栅上进行验证。

papers.title: Quantum Boomerang Effect in Time-Crystalline Structures
papers.abstract: The quantum boomerang effect (QBE) is a unique dynamical signature of Anderson localization, characterized by a launched wavepacket that initially drifts but ultimately returns to its initial position due to fundamental quantum interference. In this work, we theoretically establish and quantitatively characterize the QBE in a time-crystalline structure using a periodically driven quantum particle in a one-dimensional potential well. By constructing maximally localized Floquet-Wannier states and introducing temporal disorder, we rigorously map the continuous Floquet dynamics onto a discrete disordered tight-binding lattice. By positioning a detector at a fixed spatial coordinate, we monitor the temporal evolution of the wavepacket, to extract the mean temporal center of mass of the probability density in a time-crystalline structure. This mean temporal center of mass exhibits an initial ballistic expansion, followed by a pronounced U-turn, and ultimately returns to its initial temporal position after long-time evolution. These results confirm the existence of the complete QBE in the time domain. They also demonstrate that non-trivial dynamics can be explored within time-crystalline systems, even though these structures already possess an inherent temporal periodicity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically establish”“rigorously map”“constructing”等理论构建与数学映射关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：时间晶体结构（time-crystalline structure）中的量子回旋镖效应（Quantum Boomerang Effect, QBE）。具体体系为一维势阱中受周期性驱动的量子粒子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在时间晶体结构中，波包的平均时间质心先经历弹道扩散，随后发生显著的U形转向，最终在长时间演化后回到初始时间位置，证实了时间域中完整的量子回旋镖效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在时间晶体结构中，波包的平均时间质心先经历弹道扩散，随后发生显著的U形转向，最终在长时间演化后回到初始时间位置，证实了时间域中完整的量子回旋镖效应。；创新点：首次在具有固有时间周期性的时间晶体结构中建立并定量表征了量子回旋镖效应，将原本在空间域中定义的安德森局域化动力学特征推广到时间域。
papers.method_zh: 通过构造最大局域化的Floquet-Wannier态并引入时间无序，将连续的Floquet动力学严格映射到离散的无序紧束缚晶格模型；在固定空间坐标处设置探测器，监测波包的时间演化以提取概率密度的时间质心。
